definition: used before countable or singular nouns referring to people or things that have not already been mentioned
example: a man/horse/unit
definition_zh: 用于指尚未提及的人或事物的单数可数名词之前
example_zh: 一个人/马/一个单位

definition: to leave somebody, especially somebody you are responsible for, with no intention of returning
example: abandon somebody, The baby had been abandoned by its mother.
definition_zh: 离开一个人，尤其是你负责的人，却没有回来的打算
example_zh: 抛弃某人，婴儿被母亲遗弃了。

definition: the fact that somebody/something is able to do something
example: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.
definition_zh: 某人或某物能够做到某件事这一事实
example_zh: 患有该疾病的人可能会丧失沟通能力。

definition: to have the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do something
example: You must be able to speak French for this job.
definition_zh: 要具备完成某件事所需的技能、智慧、机会等
example_zh: 你必须会说法语才能胜任这份工作。

definition: to officially end a law, a system or an institution
example: This tax should be abolished.
definition_zh: 正式终结一项法律、系统或机构
example_zh: 这项税应该被废除。

definition: the deliberate ending of a pregnancy at an early stage
example: to support/oppose abortion
definition_zh: 在早期阶段故意终止妊娠
example_zh: 支持/反对堕胎

definition: a little more or less than; a little before or after
example: It costs about $10.
definition_zh: 稍微多一点或少一点;稍微早一点或稍晚一点
example_zh: 大约10美元。

definition: on the subject of somebody/something; in connection with somebody/something
example: a book about flowers
definition_zh: 关于某人/某物的主题;与某人/某物相关
example_zh: 一本关于花的书

definition: at or to a higher place
example: Put it on the shelf above.
definition_zh: 在更高的地方或更高的地方
example_zh: 把它放在上面的架子上。

definition: at or to a higher place or position than something/somebody
example: The water came above our knees.
definition_zh: 在某个比某物或某个人更高的地方或位置
example_zh: 水淹到我们膝盖上方。

definition: in or to a foreign country
example: to go/travel/live/study abroad
definition_zh: 在国外或前往外国
example_zh: 去/旅行/生活/留学

definition: the fact of somebody being away from a place where they are usually expected to be; the occasion or period of time when somebody is away
example: in somebody's absence, The decision was made in my absence (= while I was not there).
definition_zh: 某人离开了通常被期望在场的地方;某人离开的时间或时间
example_zh: 在某人缺席的情况下，决定是在我不在时做出的（=在我不在场时）。

definition: not in a place because of illness, etc.
example: He was absent from work for two weeks.
definition_zh: 因为生病等原因，我不在一个地方。
example_zh: 他缺勤了两周。

definition: total and complete
example: I've joined a class for absolute beginners.
definition_zh: 全程且完整
example_zh: 我参加了一个专门针对完全初学者的课程。

definition: used to emphasize that something is completely true
example: You're absolutely right.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事完全真实
example_zh: 你说得完全正确。

definition: to take in a liquid, gas or other substance from the surface or space around
example: absorb something, Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
definition_zh: 从表面或周围空间吸收液体、气体或其他物质
example_zh: 吸收某些东西，植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。

definition: based on general ideas and not on any particular real person, thing or situation
example: abstract knowledge/principles
definition_zh: 基于一般观点，而非任何具体的真实人物、事物或情境
example_zh: 抽象知识/原则

definition: extremely silly; not logical and sensible
example: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
definition_zh: 极其愚蠢;不合逻辑也不理智
example_zh: 那身制服让守卫看起来很可笑。

definition: a large quantity that is more than enough
example: The brochure promised beautiful walks with an abundance of wildlife.
definition_zh: 一个足够多的量
example_zh: 宣传册承诺有美丽的徒步路线，周围有丰富的野生动物。

definition: the use of something in a way that is wrong or harmful
example: alcohol/drug abuse
definition_zh: 以错误或有害的方式使用某物
example_zh: 酒精/药物滥用

definition: to make bad use of something, or to use so much of something that it harms your health
example: to abuse alcohol/drugs
definition_zh: 不当地利用某样东西，或者用得太多以至于损害你的健康
example_zh: 滥用酒精/毒品

definition: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities
example: high/low academic standards
definition_zh: 与教育相关，尤其是在学校和大学学习
example_zh: 高/低学术标准

definition: a person who teaches and/or does research at a university or college
example: a leading/distinguished/prominent academic
definition_zh: 在大学或学院任教和/或从事研究的人
example_zh: 一位领袖/杰出/杰出的学者

definition: a school or college for special training
example: She trained at the Royal Academy of Music.
definition_zh: 专门培训学校或学院
example_zh: 她曾在皇家音乐学院接受培训。

definition: to happen faster or earlier; to make something happen faster or earlier
example: Inflation continues to accelerate.
definition_zh: 让事情发生得更快或更早;让事情发生得更快或更早
example_zh: 通胀持续加速。

definition: a way of pronouncing the words of a language that shows which country, area or social class a person comes from; how well somebody pronounces a particular language
example: a northern/Dublin/Scottish accent
definition_zh: 一种发音方式，显示一个人来自哪个国家、地区或社会阶层;某人对某种语言的发音有多好;
example_zh: 带有北部/都柏林/苏格兰口音

definition: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.
example: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.
definition_zh: 心甘情愿地接受别人所提供的东西;对提议、邀请等说“是”。
example_zh: 他向我求婚，我答应了。

definition: agreed or approved of by most people in a society
example: Children must learn socially acceptable behaviour.
definition_zh: 得到社会中大多数人的同意或认可
example_zh: 儿童必须学习社会可接受的行为。

definition: the act of accepting a gift, an invitation, an offer, etc.
example: Please confirm your acceptance of this offer in writing.
definition_zh: 接受礼物、邀请、提议等行为。
example_zh: 请以书面形式确认您接受本报价。

definition: the opportunity or right to use something or to see somebody/something
example: High-speed internet access has become a necessity.
definition_zh: 使用某物或见某人/某物的机会或权利
example_zh: 高速互联网接入已成为必需品。

definition: to open a computer file or use a computer system
example: Most people use their phones to access the internet.
definition_zh: 打开计算机文件或使用计算机系统
example_zh: 大多数人用手机上网。

definition: that can be reached, entered, used, seen, etc.
example: The remote desert area is accessible only by helicopter.
definition_zh: 可以被触及、输入、使用、看到等。
example_zh: 偏远的沙漠地区只能通过直升机到达。

definition: an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage
example: a car/road/traffic accident
definition_zh: 尤其是在车辆中，发生意外并造成伤害或损害的不愉快事件
example_zh: 一场汽车/道路/交通事故

definition: by chance; in a way that was not planned
example: As I turned around, I accidentally hit him in the face.
definition_zh: 偶然;而且是事先没计划好的
example_zh: 我转身时不小心打到了他的脸。

definition: to provide somebody with a room or place to sleep, live or sit
example: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
definition_zh: 为某人提供一个可以睡觉、居住或坐着的房间或地方
example_zh: 酒店最多可容纳500位客人。

definition: a place to live, work or stay in
example: rented/temporary accommodation
definition_zh: 一个适合居住、工作或停留的地方
example_zh: 租赁/临时住宿

definition: to travel or go somewhere with somebody/something
example: accompany somebody/something + adv./prep., His wife accompanied him on the trip.
definition_zh: 去旅行或和某人/某物一起去某个地方
example_zh: 陪同某人/某物 + 副词/介词，他的妻子陪同他出行。

definition: to succeed in doing or completing something
example: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
definition_zh: 成功完成某事
example_zh: 计划的第一部分已经安全完成。

definition: an impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work
example: It was one of the President's greatest accomplishments.
definition_zh: 这是经过大量努力后完成或取得的令人印象深刻的成就
example_zh: 这是总统最伟大的成就之一。

definition: according to a rule or the way that somebody says that something should be done
example: in accordance with legal requirements
definition_zh: 根据某条规则，或者某人说某事应该做的方式
example_zh: 符合法律要求

definition: as stated or reported by somebody/something
example: According to Mick, it's a great movie.
definition_zh: 如某人/某物所述或报告
example_zh: 据米克说，这是一部很棒的电影。

definition: in a way that is appropriate to what has been done or said in a particular situation
example: We have to discover his plans and act accordingly.
definition_zh: 以一种与特定情境中所做或所说的适当方式
example_zh: 我们必须发现他的计划并据此采取行动。

definition: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.
example: I don't have a bank account.
definition_zh: 就是某人和银行等达成的安排，用来把钱留在那里、取出一些钱等等。
example_zh: 我没有银行账户。

definition: to have the opinion that somebody/something is a particular thing
example: be accounted + adj., In English law a person is accounted innocent until they are proved guilty.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物是某种特定事物的看法
example_zh: 被记载 + 形容词，在英国法中，一个人在被证明有罪之前被视为无罪。

definition: the fact of being responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
example: proposals for greater police accountability
definition_zh: 对自己的决定或行为负责，并且被要求在被要求时解释这些决定的事实
example_zh: 加强警察问责的提案

definition: responsible for your decisions or actions and expected to explain them when you are asked
example: The state spends taxpayers’ money and should be held accountable.
definition_zh: 对你的决定或行为负责，并被要求在被要求时解释这些决定
example_zh: 国家花纳税人的钱，理应承担责任。

definition: a person whose job is to keep or check financial accounts
example: We talked to the company’s chief accountant.
definition_zh: 一个负责维护或核查财务账户的人
example_zh: 我们和公司的首席会计谈过。

definition: to gradually get more and more of something over a period of time
example: I seem to have accumulated a lot of books.
definition_zh: 在一段时间内逐渐获得越来越多的内容
example_zh: 我似乎积累了很多书。

definition: the process of gradually increasing or getting more and more of something over a period of time
example: the accumulation of wealth
definition_zh: 在一段时间内逐步增加或获得更多某些东西的过程
example_zh: 财富的积累

definition: the state of being exact or correct; the ability to do something with skill and without making mistakes
example: They questioned the accuracy of the information in the file.
definition_zh: 准确或正确的状态;能够以娴熟的技巧完成某事而不犯错的能力
example_zh: 他们质疑档案中信息的准确性。

definition: correct and true in every detail
example: an accurate description/picture of something
definition_zh: 每一个细节都正确且真实
example_zh: 对某物的准确描述/图片

definition: in a way that is correct and true in every detail
example: The article accurately reflects public opinion.
definition_zh: 而且要在每一个细节上都正确、真实
example_zh: 文章准确反映了公众舆论。

definition: a statement saying that you think a person is guilty of doing something wrong or illegal; the fact of accusing somebody
example: I don't want to make an accusation until I have some proof.
definition_zh: 一种声明，表示你认为某人做了不当或违法的事情;指控某人的事实
example_zh: 在有证据之前，我不想轻易指控。

definition: to say that somebody has done something wrong or is guilty of something
example: accuse somebody of something, to accuse somebody of murder/a crime
definition_zh: 说某人做错了什么，或者有罪
example_zh: 指控某人某事，指控某人谋杀/犯罪

definition: a person who is on trial for committing a crime
example: The accused was found innocent.
definition_zh: 因犯罪而受审的人
example_zh: 被告被判无罪。

definition: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time
example: He had finally achieved success.
definition_zh: 要成功达到某个特定目标、地位或标准，尤其是通过长时间的努力
example_zh: 他终于取得了成功。

definition: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
example: the greatest scientific achievement of the decade
definition_zh: 某人成功完成的事情，尤其是靠自己的努力和技巧完成的
example_zh: 本十年最伟大的科学成就

definition: that contains acid or has the essential characteristics of an acid; that has a pH of less than seven
example: Rye is tolerant of poor, acid soils.
definition_zh: 含有酸或具有酸性特征的;pH值小于七的
example_zh: 黑麦能耐受贫瘠的酸性土壤。

definition: a chemical, usually a liquid, that contains hydrogen and has a pH of less than seven. The hydrogen can be replaced by a metal to form a salt. Acids usually have a bitter sharp taste and can often burn holes in or damage things they touch.
example: The acid burned a hole in her coat.
definition_zh: 一种含有氢且pH值小于七的化学物质，通常是液体。氢可以被金属替代，形成盐。酸通常带有苦涩刺鼻的味道，常常会在接触到的东西上烧出洞或损坏。
example_zh: 酸液在她的外套上烧出一个洞。

definition: to accept that something is true
example: acknowledge something, She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
definition_zh: 接受某件事是真的
example_zh: 承认某些事，她拒绝承认改革的必要性。

definition: to gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour
example: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.
definition_zh: 通过自己的努力、能力或行为获得某种东西
example_zh: 她已经掌握了良好的英语水平。

definition: the act of getting something, especially knowledge, a skill, etc.
example: theories of child language acquisition
definition_zh: 获得某种东西的行为，尤其是知识、技能等。
example_zh: 儿童语言习得理论

definition: a unit for measuring an area of land; 4 840 square yards or about 4 050 square metres
example: 3 000 acres of parkland
definition_zh: 用于测量土地面积的单位;4 840 平方码，约 4 050 平方米
example_zh: 3 000英亩的公园用地

definition: from one side to the other side
example: It's too wide. We can't swim across.
definition_zh: 从一边到另一边
example_zh: 太宽了。我们不能游过去。

definition: from one side to the other side of something
example: He walked across the field.
definition_zh: 从某物的一端到另一端
example_zh: 他穿过田野走了过去。

definition: a particular thing that somebody does
example: You have committed a serious criminal act.
definition_zh: 某人做的某件特定事情
example_zh: 你犯下了严重的犯罪行为。

definition: to do something for a particular purpose or in order to deal with a situation
example: act to do something, It is vital that we act to stop the destruction of the rainforests.
definition_zh: 为特定目的或应对某种情况而做某件事
example_zh: 采取行动，阻止雨林的破坏至关重要。

definition: the process of doing something in order to make something happen or to deal with a situation
example: The time has come for action if these beautiful animals are to survive.
definition_zh: 为了让某件事发生或处理某个情况而采取行动的过程
example_zh: 如果这些美丽的动物想要生存，现在是采取行动的时候了。

definition: to make something such as a device or chemical process start working
example: The burglar alarm is activated by movement.
definition_zh: 让某个装置或化学工艺之类的东西开始工作
example_zh: 防盗警报由动作触发。

definition: the act of making something such as a device or chemical process start working
example: The activation of several target genes results in two major effects.
definition_zh: 让某件设备或化学过程开始工作的行为
example_zh: 激活多个靶基因会产生两个主要效应。

definition: always busy doing things, especially physical activities
example: Staying physically active in later years can also keep you feeling younger.
definition_zh: 总是忙着做各种事情，尤其是体力活动
example_zh: 晚年保持身体活动也能让你感觉更年轻。

definition: a person who works to achieve political or social change, especially as a member of an organization with particular aims
example: human/civil/animal rights activists
definition_zh: 一个致力于实现政治或社会变革的人，尤其是作为具有特定目标的组织成员
example_zh: 人权/公民/动物权利活动人士

definition: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure
example: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities
definition_zh: 你为了兴趣或娱乐而做的事情
example_zh: 休闲/户外/休闲活动

definition: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: Both lead actors (= the ones who play the main parts) are outstanding.
definition_zh: 一个在舞台、电视或电影中表演的人，尤其是作为职业
example_zh: 两位主角（=饰演主角的演员）都表现出色。

definition: a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession
example: The Oscar-winning actress has taken a break from acting.
definition_zh: 一位在舞台、电视或电影中表演的女性，尤其是作为职业
example_zh: 这位奥斯卡获奖女演员暂时从演艺圈中休息。

definition: used to emphasize something that is real or exists in fact
example: James looks younger than his wife but in actual fact (= really) he is five years older.
definition_zh: 用来强调真实存在或确实存在的事物
example_zh: 詹姆斯看起来比妻子年轻，但实际上（=真的）他比妻子大五岁。

definition: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that something is really true
example: What did she actually say?
definition_zh: 在说话时用来强调某一事实或评论，或者表明某件事确实真实
example_zh: 她到底说了什么？

definition: very serious or severe
example: There is an acute shortage of water.
definition_zh: 非常严重或严重
example_zh: 水资源极度短缺。

definition: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: The TV ads were first run last year.
definition_zh: 一张告知、图片或影片，向人们介绍某项产品、工作或服务
example_zh: 这些电视广告是在去年首次播出的。

definition: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation
example: It's amazing how soon you adapt.
definition_zh: 改变你的行为，以便更好地应对新情况
example_zh: 你适应得真快，真是惊人。

definition: the action or process of changing something, or of being changed, to suit a new purpose or situation
example: the adaptation of buildings for military purposes
definition_zh: 改变某物或被改变的过程，以适应新的目的或情境
example_zh: 建筑物为军事用途的改造

definition: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.
example: add something, Next add the flour.
definition_zh: 把某样东西和其他东西组合起来，以增加体积、数量、数量等。
example_zh: 再加点东西，然后再加面粉。

definition: the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful
example: cocaine addiction
definition_zh: 无法停止使用或作为习惯，尤其是对有害的事情的行为的状态
example_zh: 可卡因成瘾

definition: a thing that is added to something else
example: All of these technologies are fairly recent additions.
definition_zh: 一个被添加到另一个东西上的事物
example_zh: 这些技术都是相对较新的新增。

definition: more than was first mentioned or is usual
example: additional resources/funds/security/funding/costs
definition_zh: 比最初提到或通常更多的
example_zh: 额外资源/资金/安全/资金/费用

definition: in a way that is more than was first mentioned or is usual
example: Additionally, the bus service will run on Sundays, every two hours.
definition_zh: 以一种比最初提到或常见情况更为丰富的方式
example_zh: 此外，公交服务将在周日每两小时一班。

definition: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent
example: What's your name and address?
definition_zh: 关于某人居住或工作地点的详细信息，以及信件等可以寄往何处
example_zh: 你叫什么名字和地址？

definition: to think about a problem or a situation and decide how you are going to deal with it
example: address something, Your essay does not address the real issues.
definition_zh: 思考一个问题或情境，并决定你将如何应对它
example_zh: 回应一些问题，你的文章并没有触及真正的问题。

definition: enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need
example: They'll need an adequate supply of hot water.
definition_zh: 数量足够，质量足够满足特定目的或需求
example_zh: 他们需要充足的热水供应。

definition: in a way that is enough in quantity, or good enough in quality, for a particular purpose or need
example: Are you adequately insured?
definition_zh: 以数量足够或质量足够满足特定目的或需求的方式
example_zh: 你的保险是否足够充足？

definition: to stick to something
example: Once in the bloodstream, the bacteria adhere to the surface of the red cells.
definition_zh: 坚持某件事
example_zh: 细菌进入血液后，会附着在红细胞表面。

definition: next to something
example: The planes landed on adjacent runways.
definition_zh: 旁边有东西
example_zh: 飞机降落在相邻的跑道上。

definition: to change something slightly to make it more suitable for a new set of conditions or to make it work better
example: adjust something, Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.
definition_zh: 稍作修改，使其更适合新的条件或使其工作更好
example_zh: 调整一下，注意急弯，并相应调整速度。

definition: a small change made to something in order to correct or improve it
example: I've made a few adjustments to the design.
definition_zh: 为纠正或改进某项内容而对某项内容做的小修改
example_zh: 我对设计做了一些调整。

definition: to manage and organize the affairs of a company, an organization, a country, etc.
example: to administer a charity/fund/school
definition_zh: 负责管理和组织一家公司、一个组织、一个国家等的事务。
example_zh: 管理慈善机构/基金/学校

definition: the activities that are done in order to plan, organize and run a business, school or other institution
example: Administration costs are passed on to the customer.
definition_zh: 为规划、组织和运营企业、学校或其他机构而进行的活动
example_zh: 管理成本转嫁给客户。

definition: connected with organizing the work of a business or an institution
example: an administrative job/assistant/error
definition_zh: 与组织企业或机构工作相关
example_zh: 一个管理作业/助理/错误

definition: a person whose job is to manage and organize the public or business affairs of a company or an institution, or a person who works in an office dealing with records, accounts, etc.
example: Such organizational decisions are made by the hospital administrators.
definition_zh: 指负责管理和组织公司或机构公共或商业事务的人，或在办公室处理记录、账目等事务的人。
example_zh: 此类组织决策由医院管理者作出。

definition: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities
example: admire somebody/something, I really admire your enthusiasm.
definition_zh: 尊重某人所做的事情，或尊重他们的品质
example_zh: 欣赏某人/某事，我真的很佩服你的热情。

definition: the act of accepting somebody into an institution, organization, etc.; the right to enter a place or to join an institution or organization
example: Hospital admission is not necessary in most cases.
definition_zh: 接纳某人进入某机构、组织等的行为;进入某处或加入机构或组织的权利
example_zh: 大多数情况下住院并非必要。

definition: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true
example: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.
definition_zh: 往往是不情愿地同意某件事是真的
example_zh: 我承认，那是件愚蠢的事。

definition: a young person who is developing from a child into an adult
example: adolescents between the ages of 13 and 18 and the problems they face
definition_zh: 一个正在从孩子成长为成年人的年轻人
example_zh: 13至18岁的青少年及其面临的问题

definition: to take somebody else’s child into your family and become its legal parent(s)
example: a campaign to encourage childless couples to adopt
definition_zh: 将别人的孩子纳入你的家庭，并成为其法定父母
example_zh: 一项鼓励无子女夫妇收养的运动

definition: the act of adopting a child; the fact of being adopted
example: She put the baby up for adoption.
definition_zh: 收养孩子的行为;被收养的事实
example_zh: 她把孩子送去领养了。

definition: fully grown or developed
example: preparing young people for adult life
definition_zh: 完全成熟或已开发
example_zh: 为年轻人准备成年生活

definition: a fully grown person who is legally responsible for their actions
example: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
definition_zh: 一个完全成年且对自己行为负有法律责任的人
example_zh: 儿童必须有成年人陪同。

definition: done or given before something is going to happen
example: Please give us advance warning of any changes.
definition_zh: 在事情发生之前就已经完成或给予
example_zh: 如有任何变动，请提前告知我们。

definition: progress or a development in a particular activity or area of understanding
example: We live in an age of rapid technological advance.
definition_zh: 在特定活动或理解领域的进展或发展
example_zh: 我们生活在一个技术快速进步的时代。

definition: if knowledge, technology, etc. advances, it develops and improves
example: Technology is advancing at an incredibly rapid pace.
definition_zh: 如果知识、技术等进步，它就会发展和改进
example_zh: 科技正以惊人的速度进步。

definition: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.
example: Scientists are working on highly advanced technology to replace fossil fuels.
definition_zh: 拥有最现代、最新发展的理念、方法等。
example_zh: 科学家们正在研发高度先进的技术以替代化石燃料。

definition: a thing that helps you to be better or more successful than other people
example: a distinct/significant/huge advantage
definition_zh: 一件能帮助你比别人更好或更成功的事情
example_zh: 一个独特/显著/巨大的优势

definition: an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events
example: her adventures travelling in Africa
definition_zh: 一次不同寻常、激动人心或危险的经历、旅程或一系列事件
example_zh: 她在非洲旅行的冒险经历

definition: negative and unpleasant; not likely to produce a good result
example: adverse change/circumstances/weather conditions
definition_zh: 负面且令人不快;不太可能产生好结果
example_zh: 不利变化/环境/天气条件

definition: to tell the public about a product or a service in order to encourage people to buy or to use it
example: If you want to attract customers you need to advertise.
definition_zh: 向公众介绍产品或服务，以鼓励人们购买或使用该产品
example_zh: 如果你想吸引客户，就必须做广告。

definition: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: a newspaper/television advertisement
definition_zh: 一张告知、图片或影片，向人们介绍某项产品、工作或服务
example_zh: 报纸/电视广告

definition: the activity and industry of advertising things to people on television, in newspapers, on the internet, etc.
example: Cigarette advertising has been banned.
definition_zh: 在电视、报纸、互联网等媒体上向人们宣传事物的活动和行业。
example_zh: 香烟广告已被禁止。

definition: an opinion or a suggestion about what somebody should do in a particular situation
example: expert/practical/professional/medical advice
definition_zh: 关于某人在特定情境下应该做什么的意见或建议
example_zh: 专家/实用/专业/医疗建议

definition: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation
example: advise against doing something, I would strongly advise against going out on your own.
definition_zh: 告诉某人你认为他们在特定情况下应该做什么
example_zh: 建议不要做某件事，我强烈建议不要独自出门。

definition: a person who supports or speaks in favour of somebody or of a public plan or action
example: advocate for something/somebody, an advocate for hospital workers
definition_zh: 支持或表态支持某人或公共计划或行动的人
example_zh: 为某事/某人发声，为医院工作人员发声

definition: to support something publicly
example: advocate something, The group does not advocate the use of violence.
definition_zh: 公开支持某事
example_zh: 倡导一些什么，本团体并不主张使用暴力。

definition: connected with beauty and art and the understanding of beautiful things
example: the aesthetic appeal of the songs
definition_zh: 与美、艺术以及对美丽事物的理解相连
example_zh: 歌曲的美学吸引力

definition: events that are of public interest or political importance
example: world/international affairs
definition_zh: 具有公共利益或政治重要性的事件
example_zh: 世界/国际事务

definition: to produce a change in somebody/something
example: How will these changes affect us?
definition_zh: 为某人/某物带来改变
example_zh: 这些变化将如何影响我们？

definition: the feeling of liking or loving somebody/something very much and caring about them
example: Children need lots of love and affection.
definition_zh: 那种非常喜欢或爱上某个人/某事并关心他们的感觉
example_zh: 孩子需要大量的爱与关怀。

definition: to have enough money to be able to buy or do something
example: afford something, Can we afford a new car?
definition_zh: 有足够的钱买东西或做点什么
example_zh: 买得起点东西，我们能买得起新车吗？

definition: cheap enough that people can afford to pay it or buy it
example: We offer quality products at affordable prices.
definition_zh: 便宜到人们都能买得起或付得起
example_zh: 我们以实惠的价格提供优质产品。

definition: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer
example: Don't be afraid.
definition_zh: 感到恐惧;害怕，因为你觉得自己可能会受伤或受苦
example_zh: 别害怕。

definition: later in time; afterwards
example: That was in 1996. Soon after, I heard that he'd died.
definition_zh: 以后;之后
example_zh: 那是在1996年。不久之后，我听说他去世了。

definition: at a time later than something; when something has finished
example: I'll call you after I've spoken to them.
definition_zh: 在某件事之后;当某件事结束时
example_zh: 我跟他们说完电话再给你打电话。

definition: later than something; following something in time
example: We'll leave after lunch.
definition_zh: 比某件事晚;追随某个时间的未来
example_zh: 我们午饭后就走。

definition: the situation that exists as a result of an important (and usually unpleasant) event, especially a war, an accident, etc.
example: in the aftermath of something, A lot of rebuilding took place in the aftermath of the war.
definition_zh: 是指因重要（且通常令人不快）事件而产生的局面，尤其是战争、事故等。
example_zh: 在某件事之后，战争结束后发生了大量重建工作。

definition: the period of time from 12 o'clock in the middle of the day until about 6 o’clock in the evening
example: this/yesterday/tomorrow afternoon
definition_zh: 从中午12点到傍晚约6点的时间段
example_zh: 今天/昨天/明天下午

definition: at a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned
example: Afterwards she was sorry for what she'd said.
definition_zh: 以后;在已经提到的事件之后
example_zh: 事后她为自己说的话感到抱歉。

definition: one more time; on another occasion
example: This must never happen again.
definition_zh: 再来一次;在另一个场合
example_zh: 这种事绝不能再发生。

definition: opposing or disagreeing with somebody/something
example: the fight against terrorism
definition_zh: 反对或不同意某人/某事
example_zh: 打击恐怖主义

definition: the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed
example: You're the same age as my brother.
definition_zh: 一个人或某物存在的年数
example_zh: 你和我哥哥同龄。

definition: to become older
example: As he aged, his memory got worse.
definition_zh: 变老
example_zh: 随着年龄增长，他的记忆力变得越来越差。

definition: of the age of
example: They have two children aged six and nine.
definition_zh: 时代
example_zh: 他们有两个孩子，分别是六岁和九岁。

definition: a business or an organization that provides a particular service especially when representing other businesses or organizations
example: She works for an advertising agency.
definition_zh: 一家提供特定服务的企业或组织，尤其是在代表其他企业或组织时
example_zh: 她在一家广告公司工作。

definition: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting
example: We have a very full agenda of issues to discuss.
definition_zh: 会议中要讨论的事项列表
example_zh: 我们有非常繁忙的议题要讨论。

definition: a person whose job is to act for, or manage the affairs of, other people in business, politics, etc.
example: Our agent in New York deals with all US sales.
definition_zh: 一个工作是代表或管理商业、政治等他人事务的人。
example_zh: 我们在纽约的代理人负责所有美国销售。

definition: feelings of anger and hate that may result in threatening or violent behaviour
example: The research shows that computer games may cause aggression.
definition_zh: 愤怒和仇恨的情绪，可能导致威胁或暴力行为
example_zh: 研究表明，电子游戏可能引发攻击性。

definition: angry, and behaving in a threatening way; ready to attack
example: Seals have been known to exhibit aggressive behaviour towards swimmers.
definition_zh: 愤怒，行为充满威胁;准备发动攻击
example_zh: 海豹被发现会对游泳者表现出攻击性行为。

definition: used in expressions of time with the simple past tense to show how far in the past something happened
example: two weeks/months/years ago
definition_zh: 在时间表达中，用简单过去时表示某事发生在多久以前
example_zh: 两周/几个月/几年前

definition: to have the same opinion as somebody; to say that you have the same opinion
example: When he said that, I had to agree.
definition_zh: 与某人持有相同观点;说你有相同的看法
example_zh: 他这么说时，我不得不同意。

definition: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody
example: an international peace agreement
definition_zh: 与某人达成的安排、承诺或合同
example_zh: 一项国际和平协议

definition: connected with the science or practice of farming
example: agricultural policy/land/production/development
definition_zh: 与农业科学或实践相关的
example_zh: 农业政策/土地/生产/发展

definition: the science or practice of farming
example: The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.
definition_zh: 农业的科学或实践
example_zh: 过去十年，农业就业人数有所下降。

definition: used to express surprise, pleasure or sympathy, or when you disagree with somebody
example: Ah, there you are!
definition_zh: 用来表达惊讶、喜悦或同情，或者当你不同意某人观点时
example_zh: 啊，你在这儿啊！

definition: further forward in space or time; in front
example: I'll run ahead and warn them.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上更前方;在前方
example_zh: 我先跑去警告他们。

definition: money, food, etc. that is sent to help countries in difficult situations
example: humanitarian/food/medical aid
definition_zh: 资金、食物等，用于援助处于困境中的国家
example_zh: 人道主义/食品/医疗援助

definition: to help somebody/something to do something, especially by making it easier
example: aid in something, The test is designed to aid in the diagnosis of various diseases.
definition_zh: 帮助某人/某物完成某件事，尤其是通过让事情变得更容易
example_zh: 辅助某项，该测试旨在帮助诊断各种疾病。

definition: a person who helps another person, especially a politician, in their job
example: White House aides
definition_zh: 一个帮助另一个人，尤其是政治家，在工作上帮助的人
example_zh: 白宫助手

definition: a serious illness caused by a virus called HIV that attacks the body’s ability to resist infection (the abbreviation for ‘Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome’)
example: the AIDS epidemic
definition_zh: 这是一种由名为HIV的病毒引起的严重疾病，它攻击人体抵抗感染的能力（即“获得性免疫缺陷综合征”的缩写）
example_zh: 艾滋病疫情

definition: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve
example: the stated aims of the study
definition_zh: 做某件事的目的;某人试图实现的目标
example_zh: 研究的既定目标

definition: to try or plan to achieve something
example: He has always aimed high (= tried to achieve a lot).
definition_zh: 尝试或计划实现某件事
example_zh: 他一直志向高远（=努力追求很多成就）。

definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe
example: Let's go out for some fresh air.
definition_zh: 环绕地球、我们呼吸的气体混合物
example_zh: 我们出去透透气吧。

definition: any vehicle that can fly and carry goods or passengers
example: fighter/transport/military aircraft
definition_zh: 任何能够飞行并能运载货物或乘客的车辆
example_zh: 战斗机/运输机/军用飞机

definition: a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places
example: an airline pilot/passenger
definition_zh: 一家提供定期航班，将乘客和货物运往不同地点的公司
example_zh: 一名航空公司飞行员/乘客

definition: a place where planes land and take off and that has buildings for passengers to wait in
example: Gatwick Airport
definition_zh: 一个飞机起降的地方，还有供乘客等候的建筑
example_zh: 盖特威克机场

definition: a loud noise or a signal that warns people of danger or of a problem
example: She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).
definition_zh: 一种响亮的噪音，或警告人们危险或问题的信号
example_zh: 她决定拉响警报（=警告人们情况危险）。

definition: to make somebody anxious or afraid
example: I can only guess that they don't want to alarm the public yet.
definition_zh: 让人感到焦虑或害怕
example_zh: 我只能猜他们还不想让公众感到惊慌。

definition: although
example: He finally agreed, albeit reluctantly, to help us.
definition_zh: 虽然
example_zh: 他最终虽然有些犹豫，但同意帮助我们。

definition: a book in which you keep photographs, stamps, etc.
example: a photo album
definition_zh: 一本可以保存照片、邮票等物品的书。
example_zh: 相册

definition: drinks such as beer, wine, etc. that can make people drunk
example: He never drinks alcohol.
definition_zh: 啤酒、葡萄酒等饮料，可能让人醉醺醺
example_zh: 他从不喝酒。

definition: connected with or containing alcohol
example: alcoholic drinks/beverages
definition_zh: 与酒精相关或含有酒精的
example_zh: 酒精饮料

definition: able to think quickly; quick to notice things
example: Suddenly he found himself awake and fully alert.
definition_zh: 能够快速思考;敏锐地注意到事物
example_zh: 突然间，他发现自己清醒了，完全清醒。

definition: a situation in which people are watching for danger and ready to deal with it
example: on the alert (for something), Police are warning the public to be on the alert for suspicious packages.
definition_zh: 这是一个人们警惕危险并准备应对的局面
example_zh: 警方在保持警觉（针对某件事）的同时，提醒公众要警惕可疑包裹。

definition: to warn somebody about a dangerous situation or one that requires immediate action
example: alert somebody, Neighbours quickly alerted the emergency services.
definition_zh: 提醒某人危险情况或需要立即采取行动的情况
example_zh: 通知别人，邻居们迅速通知了紧急服务。

definition: strange and frightening; different from what you are used to
example: an alien environment
definition_zh: 既陌生又可怕;与你习惯的截然不同
example_zh: 一个陌生的环境

definition: a person who is not a citizen of the country in which they live or work
example: an illegal alien
definition_zh: 非其居住或工作所在国公民的人
example_zh: 一名非法移民

definition: to arrange something in the correct position, or to be in the correct position, in relation to something else, especially in a straight line
example: Make sure the shelf is aligned with the top of the cupboard.
definition_zh: 将某物摆放在正确的位置，或者相对于其他事物处于正确的位置，尤其是在直线上
example_zh: 确保搁板与橱柜顶部对齐。

definition: arrangement in a straight line
example: the alignment of the sun, moon and earth at a particular time
definition_zh: 直线排列
example_zh: 太阳、月亮和地球在特定时间的排列

definition: very similar
example: My sister and I do not look alike.
definition_zh: 非常相似
example_zh: 我和我妹妹长得一点也不像。

definition: in a very similar way
example: They tried to treat all their children alike.
definition_zh: 以非常相似的方式
example_zh: 他们试图一视同仁地对待所有孩子。

definition: living; not dead
example: Is your mother still alive?
definition_zh: 活着;不是死去
example_zh: 妈还活着吗？

definition: completely
example: She was dressed all in white.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 她全身都是白色的。

definition: the whole number of
example: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
definition_zh: 全数
example_zh: 所有马都是动物，但并非所有动物都是马。

definition: the whole number or amount
example: All of the food has gone.
definition_zh: 全数或金额
example_zh: 所有的食物都没了。

definition: acceptable; in an acceptable manner
example: Is the coffee all right?
definition_zh: 可接受;以可接受的方式
example_zh: 咖啡还好吗？

definition: acceptable; in an acceptable manner
example: Is the coffee all right?
definition_zh: 可接受;以可接受的方式
example_zh: 咖啡还好吗？

definition: used to check that somebody agrees or understands
example: We've got to get up early, all right?
definition_zh: 用于检查某人是否同意或理解
example_zh: 我们得早点起床，好吗？

definition: a public statement that is made without giving proof, accusing somebody of doing something that is wrong or illegal
example: to investigate/deny/withdraw an allegation
definition_zh: 一种公开声明，但没有提供证据，指责某人做了错误或违法的事情
example_zh: 调查/否认/撤回指控

definition: to state something as a fact but without giving proof
example: allege (that)…, The prosecution alleges (that) she was driving carelessly.
definition_zh: 把某件事当成事实陈述，却不给出证据
example_zh: 控方指控她驾驶不小心。

definition: expressed as though something is a fact but without giving any proof
example: crimes allegedly committed during the war
definition_zh: 表达得好像某事是事实，但没有提供任何证据
example_zh: 据称在战争期间犯下的罪行

definition: an agreement between countries, political parties, etc. to work together in order to achieve something that they all want
example: to form/make an alliance
definition_zh: 各国、政党等之间达成的协议，共同努力实现他们共同想要的目标
example_zh: 组建/建立联盟

definition: to give something officially to somebody/something for a particular purpose
example: allocate something (for something), A large sum has been allocated for buying new books for the library.
definition_zh: 为特定目的正式授予某人或某物
example_zh: 拨出某项（用于某事），已拨出一大笔款项用于为图书馆购买新书。

definition: an amount of money, space, etc. that is given to somebody for a particular purpose
example: We have spent our entire allocation for the year.
definition_zh: 为特定目的提供给某人的金额、空间等
example_zh: 我们已经花光了全年全部的配额。

definition: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done
example: allow somebody/something to do something, His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
definition_zh: 允许某人/某物做某事;让某事发生或被完成
example_zh: 允许某人或某事做点什么，他的父母不允许他晚归。

definition: an amount of money that is given to somebody regularly or for a particular purpose
example: an allowance of $20 a day
definition_zh: 定期或为特定目的支付给某人的金额
example_zh: 每天20美元的津贴

definition: a country that has agreed to help and support another country, especially in case of a war
example: our European/NATO allies
definition_zh: 一个同意帮助和支持另一个国家的国家，尤其是在战争爆发时
example_zh: 我们的欧洲/北约盟友

definition: not quite
example: I like almost all of them.
definition_zh: 还不完全是
example_zh: 我几乎都喜欢。

definition: without any other people
example: not alone in, Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
definition_zh: 没有其他人
example_zh: 汤姆并不孤单，他并不孤单，觉得瑞克难以相处。

definition: without any other people
example: not alone in, Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.
definition_zh: 没有其他人
example_zh: 汤姆并不孤单，他并不孤单，觉得瑞克难以相处。

definition: forward
example: I was just walking along singing to myself.
definition_zh: 向前
example_zh: 我只是一边走一边自言自语地唱着歌。

definition: from one end to or towards the other end of something
example: They walked slowly along the road.
definition_zh: 从某物的一端到另一端或朝另一端走去
example_zh: 他们沿着路慢慢走着。

definition: next to or at the side of something
example: A police car pulled up alongside us.
definition_zh: 在某物旁边或旁边
example_zh: 一辆警车停在我们旁边。

definition: before now or before a particular time in the past
example: ‘Lunch?’ ‘No thanks, I've already eaten.’
definition_zh: 在此之前或某个特定时间之前
example_zh: “午饭？”“不用了，谢谢，我已经吃过了。”

definition: in addition; too
example: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.
definition_zh: 此外;也
example_zh: 她精通法语和德语。她还会说一点意大利语。

definition: to become different; to make somebody/something different
example: Prices did not alter significantly during 2019.
definition_zh: 变得与众不同;让某人/某物变得不同
example_zh: 2019年价格变化不大。

definition: that can be used instead of something else
example: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.
definition_zh: 可以替代别的东西
example_zh: 路封闭了，所以我们不得不找另一条替代路线。

definition: a thing that you can choose to do or have out of two or more possibilities
example: The car is too expensive so we're trying to find a cheaper alternative.
definition_zh: 一种你可以在两种或更多可能性中选择去做或拥有的事情
example_zh: 这辆车太贵了，所以我们正在找更便宜的替代品。

definition: used for introducing a statement that makes the main statement in a sentence seem surprising
example: Although the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.
definition_zh: 用于引入一个让句子中主语句显得令人惊讶的语句
example_zh: 虽然阳光明媚，但并不温暖。

definition: (used to emphasize something) completely; in every way
example: The train went slower and slower until it stopped altogether.
definition_zh: （用来强调某件事）完全;在各方面
example_zh: 列车越来越慢，直到完全停了下来。

definition: a chemical element. Aluminium is a light, silver-grey metal used for making pans, etc.
example: aluminium saucepans/window frames
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。铝是一种轻质的银灰色金属，用于制作锅具等。
example_zh: 铝制平底锅/窗框

definition: at all times; on every occasion
example: There's almost always somebody at home in the evenings.
definition_zh: 无论任何时候;每一次
example_zh: 晚上几乎总有人在家。

definition: doing something for pleasure or interest, not as a job
example: an amateur photographer
definition_zh: 为了兴趣或兴趣而做某事，而不是当作工作
example_zh: 一名业余摄影师

definition: a person who takes part in a sport or other activity for pleasure, not as a job
example: The tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.
definition_zh: 一个以娱乐为目的而参与体育或其他活动的人，而非作为工作
example_zh: 该锦标赛对业余和职业选手均开放。

definition: very surprised
example: an amazed look
definition_zh: 非常惊讶
example_zh: 惊讶的表情

definition: very surprising, especially in a way that you like or admire
example: an amazing feat/story/experience
definition_zh: 非常令人惊讶，尤其是以你喜欢或欣赏的方式
example_zh: 一个令人惊叹的壮举/故事/体验

definition: an official who lives in a foreign country as the senior representative there of their own country
example: the British Ambassador to Italy/in Rome
definition_zh: 作为本国高级代表居住在外国的官员
example_zh: 英国驻意大利/驻罗马大使

definition: something that you want to do or achieve very much
example: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.
definition_zh: 你非常想做或实现的事情
example_zh: 她实现了毕生的抱负。

definition: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
example: a fiercely ambitious young manager
definition_zh: 决心要成功、富有、有权势等等。
example_zh: 一位雄心勃勃的年轻经理

definition: a vehicle with special equipment, used for taking sick or injured people to a hospital
example: Call an ambulance!
definition_zh: 配备特殊设备的车辆，用于将病人或受伤人员送往医院
example_zh: 叫救护车！

definition: to change a law, document, statement, etc. slightly in order to correct a mistake or to improve it
example: He asked to see the amended version.
definition_zh: 为了纠正或改进错误，对法律、文件、陈述等进行轻微修改
example_zh: 他要求查看修改后的版本。

definition: a small change or improvement that is made to a document or proposed new law; the process of changing a document or proposed new law
example: to introduce/propose/table an amendment (= to suggest it)
definition_zh: 对文件或拟议新法律所做的小幅修改或改进;修改文件或拟议新法律的过程
example_zh: 提出/提议/提交修正案（= 提出建议）

definition: in the middle of or during something, especially something that causes excitement or fear
example: He finished his speech amid tremendous applause.
definition_zh: 在某件事进行中或进行中，尤其是那些会引起兴奋或恐惧的事情
example_zh: 他在热烈掌声中结束了演讲。

definition: surrounded by somebody/something; in the middle of somebody/something
example: a house among the trees
definition_zh: 被某个人/某物包围;在某个人/某物的正中央
example_zh: 树林中的房子

definition: a quantity of something
example: I was amazed at the amount he could eat.
definition_zh: 某种数量
example_zh: 我对他能吃的量感到惊讶。

definition: to add up to a particular total or be equal to something
example: His earnings amount to $50,000 a year.
definition_zh: 要将总数加起来或等于某物
example_zh: 他的年收入为5万美元。

definition: funny and giving pleasure
example: an amusing story/game/incident
definition_zh: 幽默又带来乐趣
example_zh: 一个有趣的故事/游戏/事件

definition: a comparison of one thing with another thing that has similar features; a feature that is similar
example: analogy (between A and B), The teacher drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.
definition_zh: 将一个事物与另一个具有相似特征的事物进行比较;一个相似的特征
example_zh: 类比（A与B之间），老师将人类心脏与泵作了类比。

definition: to examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it
example: analyse something, The job involves collecting and analysing data.
definition_zh: 研究某物的本质或结构，尤其是通过将其拆分成各个部分，以便理解或解释它
example_zh: 分析某件事，这项工作涉及收集和分析数据。

definition: the detailed study or examination of something in order to understand more about it; the result of the study
example: statistical/data analysis
definition_zh: 对某事进行详细研究或检查，以进一步理解它;研究的结果
example_zh: 统计/数据分析

definition: a person whose job involves examining facts or materials in order to give an opinion on them
example: a political/financial analyst
definition_zh: 一个工作内容是审查事实或材料以就其发表意见的人
example_zh: 一名政治/金融分析师

definition: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
example: His ancestors had come to America from Ireland.
definition_zh: 你家里一个很久以前生活的人
example_zh: 他的祖先是从爱尔兰来到美洲的。

definition: a heavy metal object that is attached to a rope or chain and dropped over the side of a ship or boat to keep it in one place
example: to drop anchor
definition_zh: 一种沉重的金属物体，系在绳索或链条上，从船或船的船舷上掉落以固定其位置
example_zh: 抛锚

definition: belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past
example: Archaeologists are excavating the ruined temples of this ancient civilization.
definition_zh: 属于数千年前的历史时期
example_zh: 考古学家正在发掘这个古文明的废墟神庙。

definition: also; in addition to
example: bread and butter
definition_zh: 此外;除了
example_zh: 面包和黄油

definition: a spirit who is believed to be a servant of God, and is sent by God to deliver a message or perform a task. Angels are often shown dressed in white, with wings.
example: a host of angels
definition_zh: 被认为是上帝仆人的灵体，由上帝派遣来传递信息或完成任务。天使常被描绘成身穿白色、长着翅膀的身影。
example_zh: 一群天使

definition: the strong feeling that you have when something has happened that you think is bad and unfair
example: She had to find a way to express her pent-up anger.
definition_zh: 当发生了你认为不好、不公平的事情时，你会有强烈的感觉
example_zh: 她必须找到一种方式来表达自己积压的愤怒。

definition: the space between two lines or surfaces that join, measured in degrees
example: a 45° angle
definition_zh: 两条线或两面相连之间的间距，以度数为单位

definition: having strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation
example: Her behaviour really made me angry.
definition_zh: 对自己非常不喜欢的事情或对不公平的情况有强烈的感受
example_zh: 她的行为真的让我很生气。

definition: a creature that is not a bird, a fish, a reptile, an insect or a human
example: the animals and birds of South America
definition_zh: 一种既不是鸟、不是鱼、不是爬行动物、不是昆虫也不是人类的生物
example_zh: 南美洲的动物和鸟类

definition: the process of making films, videos and computer games in which drawings, models or images of people and animals seem to move
example: computer/cartoon animation
definition_zh: 制作电影、视频和电脑游戏时，使人物或动物的图画、模型或图像看起来会动的过程
example_zh: 电脑动画/卡通动画

definition: the joint connecting the foot to the leg; the narrow part of the leg just above the ankle joint
example: to sprain/break/twist your ankle
definition_zh: 连接脚与腿的关节;腿部紧邻踝关节的狭窄部分
example_zh: 扭伤/骨折/扭伤脚踝

definition: a date that is an exact number of years after the date of an important or special event
example: on the anniversary of his wife’s death
definition_zh: 一个日期，恰好是在重要或特殊事件发生日期之后的确切年数
example_zh: 在他妻子去世的周年纪念日

definition: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.
example: announce something, He officially announced his intention to resign at today's press conference.
definition_zh: 正式告诉别人一些事情，尤其是关于某个决定、计划等等。
example_zh: 宣布点什么，他在今天的记者会上正式宣布了辞职的意向。

definition: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something
example: to make an announcement
definition_zh: 一种口头或书面的陈述，用来告知人们某件事
example_zh: 发布一项公告

definition: to make somebody slightly angry
example: annoy somebody, His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.
definition_zh: 让某人稍微生气
example_zh: 惹恼别人，他不停的玩笑开始让她烦了。

definition: slightly angry
example: annoyed with somebody at/about something, He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.
definition_zh: 略带生气
example_zh: 对某人感到恼火，他开始对我的粗心大意感到非常恼火。

definition: making somebody feel slightly angry
example: This interruption is very annoying.
definition_zh: 让某人感到有点生气
example_zh: 这种打断非常烦人。

definition: happening or done once every year
example: an annual meeting/event/report/conference
definition_zh: 每年举办或完成一次
example_zh: 年度会议/活动/报告/研讨会

definition: once a year
example: The exhibition is held annually.
definition_zh: 一年一次
example_zh: 该展览每年举办一次。

definition: with a name that is not known or that is not made public
example: an anonymous donor
definition_zh: 名称未知或未公开
example_zh: 一位匿名捐赠者

definition: one more; an extra thing or person
example: Would you like another drink?
definition_zh: 再来一个;多一个东西或一个人
example_zh: 你还想再来一杯吗？

definition: one more; an extra thing or person
example: Would you like another drink?
definition_zh: 再来一个;多一个东西或一个人
example_zh: 你还想再来一杯吗？

definition: something that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation
example: I rang the bell, but there was no answer.
definition_zh: 你用来回应某个问题或情境时说的、写的或做的某件事
example_zh: 我按了门铃，但没人应答。

definition: to say, write or do something as a reaction to a question or situation
example: I repeated the question, but she didn't answer.
definition_zh: 对问题或情境的反应说、写或做某事
example_zh: 我重复了一遍问题，但她没有回答。

definition: to expect something
example: anticipate something, We don't anticipate any major problems.
definition_zh: 期待某样东西
example_zh: 预料到什么，我们不预期会有重大问题。

definition: the state of feeling nervous or worried that something bad is going to happen
example: acute/intense/deep anxiety
definition_zh: 那种感到紧张或担心会发生不好的事情的状态
example_zh: 急性/强烈/深度焦虑

definition: feeling worried or nervous
example: The bus was late and Sue began to get anxious.
definition_zh: 感到担忧或紧张
example_zh: 公交车晚点了，苏开始感到焦虑。

definition: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb in negative sentences or questions, meaning ‘at all’
example: He wasn't any good at French.
definition_zh: 用于强调否定句或疑问句中的形容词或副词，意为“完全”。
example_zh: 他法语一点也不好。

definition: used with uncountable or plural nouns in negative sentences and questions, after if or whether, and after some verbs such as prevent, ban, forbid, etc. to refer to an amount or a number of something, however large or small
example: I didn't eat any meat.
definition_zh: 在否定句和疑问句中，与不可数或复数名词一起使用，在 if 或 whether 之后，以及某些动词（如 prevent、ban、forbid 等）后用来指代某物的数量或数量，无论大小
example_zh: 我没吃肉。

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions and after if or whether to refer to an amount or a number, however large or small
example: We need some more paint; there isn't any left.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句，以及之后是否指代某个数量或数字，无论大小
example_zh: 我们还需要一些油漆;已经没有剩下了。

definition: often used at the end of negative sentences and at the end of questions, to mean ‘any longer’
example: She doesn't live here any more.
definition_zh: 常用于否定句末和提问句末，意为“再长”。
example_zh: 她已经不住这里了。

definition: used instead of somebody in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
example: Is there anybody who can help me?
definition_zh: 在否定句中代替 someone 使用，以及在 if/whether 之后以及 prevent 等动词之后使用 someone。
example_zh: 有人能帮我吗？

definition: used instead of someone in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
example: Is anyone there?
definition_zh: 在否定句中代替 person，以及在 if/whether 之后以及 prevent 等动词之后的疑问句中使用。
example_zh: 有人在吗？

definition: used instead of something in negative sentences and in questions; after if/whether; and after verbs such as prevent, ban, avoid, etc.
example: Would you like anything else?
definition_zh: 在否定句和疑问句中代替某物使用;在 if/whether 之后;以及在 prevent、ban、avoid 等动词之后。
example_zh: 还想要别的吗？

definition: used when adding something to support an idea or argument
example: It's too expensive and anyway the colour doesn't suit you.
definition_zh: 用于添加某项内容以支持某个观点或论证
example_zh: 太贵了，而且颜色也不适合你。

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
example: I can't see it anywhere.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中，而不是某处
example_zh: 我哪儿都看不到它。

definition: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere
example: I don't have anywhere to stay.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句中，而不是某处
example_zh: 我没地方住。

definition: separated by a distance, of space or time
example: The two houses stood 500 metres apart.
definition_zh: 被空间或时间的距离隔开
example_zh: 两座房子相距500米。

definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building
example: an apartment building
definition_zh: 一组供居住的房间，通常位于建筑的一层
example_zh: 一栋公寓楼

definition: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem
example: Why should I apologize?
definition_zh: 说你为做错事或惹出问题而道歉
example_zh: 我为什么要道歉？

definition: a word or statement saying sorry for something that has been done wrong or that causes a problem
example: to offer/make/demand/accept an apology
definition_zh: 一个词或语句，对被做错或造成问题的事道歉
example_zh: 提出/提出/要求/接受道歉

definition: a piece of software that you can download to a device such as a smartphone or tablet, for example to look up information or to play a game
example: You first need to install the app on your device.
definition_zh: 一种你可以下载到智能手机或平板等设备上的软件，例如用于查询信息或玩游戏
example_zh: 首先你需要在设备上安装该应用。

definition: the tools or other pieces of equipment that are needed for a particular activity or task
example: a piece of laboratory apparatus
definition_zh: 为特定活动或任务所需的工具或其他设备
example_zh: 一件实验室仪器

definition: easy to see or understand
example: Their devotion was apparent.
definition_zh: 易于查看或理解
example_zh: 他们的虔诚显而易见。

definition: according to what you have heard or read; according to the way something appears
example: Apparently they are getting divorced soon.
definition_zh: 根据你听到或读到的内容;根据某物呈现的方式;
example_zh: 显然他们很快就要离婚了。

definition: a deeply felt request for money, help or information that is needed immediately, especially one made by a charity or by the police
example: appeal for something, to launch a TV appeal for donations to the charity
definition_zh: 一种深切的请求，要求资金、帮助或立即需要的信息，尤其是来自慈善机构或警方的请求
example_zh: 为某事呼吁，发起电视募捐活动，向慈善机构募捐

definition: to make a deeply felt request, especially for something that is needed immediately
example: I am appealing (= asking for money) on behalf of the famine victims.
definition_zh: 提出一个深切的请求，尤其是对眼前急需的事
example_zh: 我代表饥荒受害者申诉（=请求资金）。

definition: attractive or interesting
example: Spending the holidays in Britain wasn't a prospect that I found particularly appealing.
definition_zh: 吸引人或有趣
example_zh: 在英国度过假期并不是一个让我特别感兴趣的选择。

definition: to start to be seen
example: Three days later a rash appeared.
definition_zh: 开始被看见
example_zh: 三天后出现了皮疹。

definition: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be
example: the physical/outward/external appearance of something
definition_zh: 某人/某物在外表上的样子;某人/某物看起来是什么样子
example_zh: 某物的物理/外在/外观

definition: physical desire for food
example: He suffered from headaches and loss of appetite.
definition_zh: 对食物的身体渴望
example_zh: 他饱受头痛和食欲减退的困扰。

definition: to show your approval of somebody/something by clapping your hands (= hitting your open hands together several times)
example: He started to applaud and the others joined in.
definition_zh: 通过拍手表示你对某人/某事的认可（=多次将张开的双手相击）
example_zh: 他开始鼓掌，其他人也跟着鼓掌。

definition: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside
example: Peel and core the apples.
definition_zh: 一种圆形果实，果皮呈亮红色或绿色，内里相当坚硬且白色
example_zh: 把苹果去皮去核。

definition: that can be said to be true in the case of somebody/something
example: Give details of children where applicable (= if you have any).
definition_zh: 对于某人或某物来说，这可以说是真的。
example_zh: 如适用，提供有关孩子的详细信息（= 如果有的话）。

definition: a person who makes a formal request for something (= applies for it), especially for a job, a place at a college or university, etc.
example: There were over 500 applicants for the job.
definition_zh: 指对某事正式提出请求（=申请）的人，尤其是关于工作、大学或学院的录取额等。
example_zh: 当时有超过500名申请者应聘。

definition: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, permission to do something or a place at a college or university
example: a planning/patent/visa application
definition_zh: 一份正式（通常是书面）的请求，比如一份工作、允许我做某事或在学院或大学的名额
example_zh: 规划/专利/签证申请

definition: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.
example: You should apply in person/by letter.
definition_zh: 提出正式请求，通常是书面的，比如工作、贷款、许可、大学名额等。
example_zh: 你应该亲自申请或通过信件申请。

definition: to choose somebody for a job or position of responsibility
example: appoint somebody, They have appointed a new head teacher at my son's school.
definition_zh: 选择某人担任某个职位或责任岗位
example_zh: 任命一个人，他们已经在我儿子的学校任命了一位新校长。

definition: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work
example: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
definition_zh: 一种正式的约定，约定在特定时间见面或拜访某人，特别是出于与其工作相关的原因
example_zh: 我下午三点有个牙科预约。

definition: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something
example: Over the years he came to appreciate the beauty and tranquillity of the river.
definition_zh: 去认可某人/某物的优点
example_zh: 多年来，他逐渐欣赏到这条河的美丽与宁静。

definition: pleasure that you have when you recognize and enjoy the good qualities of somebody/something
example: She shows little appreciation of good music.
definition_zh: 当你认出并享受某人或某物的优点时所获得的快乐
example_zh: 她对好音乐几乎没有欣赏。

definition: a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task
example: She took the wrong approach in her dealings with them.
definition_zh: 一种处理某人/某物的方式;一种对某件事（如问题或任务）的处理或思考方式
example_zh: 她在与他们打交道时采取了错误的态度。

definition: to come near to somebody/something in distance or time
example: We could hear the train approaching.
definition_zh: 在远处或时间上接近某个人或某物
example_zh: 我们能听到火车驶近的声音。

definition: suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances
example: an appropriate response/measure/method
definition_zh: 适用于具体情况的适用、可接受或正确
example_zh: 合适的应对/措施/方法

definition: in a way that is suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances
example: The government has been accused of not responding appropriately to the needs of the homeless.
definition_zh: 以适合、可接受或正确的方式，以符合具体情况的方式
example_zh: 政府被指责未能恰当地回应无家可归者的需求。

definition: the feeling that somebody/something is good or acceptable; a positive opinion of somebody/something
example: She desperately wanted to win her father's approval.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物是好的或可接受的感觉;对某人/某物的积极评价
example_zh: 她拼命想赢得父亲的认可。

definition: to think that somebody/something is good, acceptable or suitable
example: I told my mother I wanted to leave school but she didn't approve.
definition_zh: 认为某人/某物是好的、可接受的或合适的
example_zh: 我告诉我妈妈我想离开学校，但她不同意。

definition: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct
example: The journey took approximately seven hours.
definition_zh: 用于表明某件事几乎准确或正确，但并非完全正确
example_zh: 整个旅程大约花了七个小时。

definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
example: in April, She was born in April.
definition_zh: 每年的第四个月，介于三月至五月之间
example_zh: 四月，她出生于四月。

definition: not seeming to be based on a reason, system or plan and sometimes seeming unfair
example: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
definition_zh: 看起来不像是基于某种理由、系统或计划，有时甚至显得不公平
example_zh: 球队的球员选择看起来完全是随意的。

definition: a person whose job is designing buildings
example: The house was designed by architect Louis Kahn.
definition_zh: 一个职业设计建筑的人
example_zh: 这座房子由建筑师路易斯·卡恩设计。

definition: relating to architecture and buildings
example: architectural features
definition_zh: 与建筑和建筑有关
example_zh: 建筑特色

definition: the art and study of designing buildings
example: to study architecture
definition_zh: 建筑设计的艺术与研究
example_zh: 学习建筑

definition: a collection of historical documents or records of a government, a family, a place or an organization; the place where these records are stored
example: the National Sound Archive
definition_zh: 政府、家庭、地点或组织的历史文件或记录的集合;这些记录存放的地点
example_zh: 国家声音档案馆

definition: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world
example: to improve access to services in rural areas
definition_zh: 某地、城镇等的一部分，或国家或世界的某一地区
example_zh: 改善农村地区服务的可及性

definition: a place with a flat open area in the middle and seats around it where people can watch sports and entertainment
example: a concert at Wembley Arena
definition_zh: 一个中间有平坦开放区域、周围有座位的地方，人们可以在这里观看体育和娱乐
example_zh: 温布利竞技场的音乐会

definition: used (often before a comparative or superlative adjective) when you are stating an opinion that you believe you could give reasons to support
example: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.
definition_zh: 用于（通常在比较或最高级形容词之前）当你陈述一个你认为可以给出理由支持的观点时
example_zh: 他可以说是他这一代最出色的演员。

definition: to speak angrily to somebody because you disagree with them
example: My brothers are always arguing.
definition_zh: 因为你不同意别人的看法而愤怒地跟他们说话
example_zh: 我兄弟们总是吵架。

definition: a conversation or discussion in which two or more people disagree, often angrily
example: to win/lose an argument
definition_zh: 一种两个或多人意见不合的对话或讨论，往往是愤怒的
example_zh: 赢得或输掉一场辩论

definition: to happen; to start to exist
example: An opportunity arose to work in the United States.
definition_zh: 发生;开始存在
example_zh: 一个机会出现在美国工作。

definition: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands
example: He escaped with only a broken arm.
definition_zh: 就是从身体顶部伸出、连接肩膀和双手的两个长部分之一
example_zh: 他只带着一只手臂骨折逃脱。

definition: to provide weapons for yourself/somebody in order to fight a battle or a war
example: The country was arming against the enemy.
definition_zh: 为自己或他人提供武器，以便参与战斗或战争
example_zh: 国家正在武装对抗敌人。

definition: involving the use of weapons
example: an armed robbery
definition_zh: 涉及武器的使用
example_zh: 一起持械抢劫

definition: weapons, especially as used by the army, navy, etc.
example: arms and ammunition
definition_zh: 武器，尤其是陆军、海军等部队使用的武器。
example_zh: 武器与弹药

definition: a large organized group of soldiers who are trained to fight on land
example: The two opposing armies faced each other across the battlefield.
definition_zh: 一支由接受陆地作战训练的大型有组织士兵队伍
example_zh: 两支敌军在战场上对峙。

definition: approximately
example: He arrived around five o'clock.
definition_zh: 大约
example_zh: 他大约五点钟到达。

definition: surrounding somebody/something; on each side of something
example: The house is built around a central courtyard.
definition_zh: 包围着某个人/某物;在某物的两侧
example_zh: 这座房子围绕一个中央庭院建造。

definition: to plan or organize something in advance
example: arrange something, The party was arranged quickly.
definition_zh: 提前规划或组织某件事
example_zh: 安排点什么吧，派对很快就安排好了。

definition: a plan or preparation that you make so that something can happen
example: Travel and accommodation arrangements have been finalized.
definition_zh: 你制定的计划或准备，以便某件事发生
example_zh: 旅行和住宿安排已经敲定。

definition: a group or collection of things or people, often one that is large or impressive
example: a vast array of bottles of different shapes and sizes
definition_zh: 一个群体或一组人或事物，通常规模庞大或令人印象深刻
example_zh: 各种形状和大小的瓶子

definition: the act of arresting somebody
example: The police made several arrests.
definition_zh: 逮捕某人的行为
example_zh: 警方逮捕了多名人员。

definition: if the police arrest somebody, the person is taken to a police station and kept there because the police believe they may be guilty of a crime
example: arrest somebody, A man has been arrested in connection with the robbery.
definition_zh: 如果警察逮捕某人，该人会被带到警察局并被关押，因为警方认为他可能犯了罪
example_zh: 逮捕某人，一名男子因抢劫案被捕。

definition: an act of coming or being brought to a place
example: We apologize for the late arrival of the train.
definition_zh: 来到或被带到某个地方的行为
example_zh: 我们为列车晚到致歉。

definition: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey
example: I'll wait until they arrive.
definition_zh: 到达一个地方，尤其是在旅程的终点
example_zh: 我会等他们来。

definition: a thin stick with a sharp point at one end, which is shot from a bow
example: a bow and arrow
definition_zh: 一根一端尖锐的细棍，由弓箭射出
example_zh: 一把弓和箭

definition: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture
example: modern/contemporary art
definition_zh: 运用想象力表达思想或情感，尤其是在绘画、素描或雕塑中
example_zh: 现代/当代艺术

definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.
example: to read/write/publish an article
definition_zh: 一篇关于某一特定主题的报纸或杂志、网站等的文章。
example_zh: 阅读/写入/发布文章

definition: to express or explain your thoughts or feelings clearly in words
example: She struggled to articulate her thoughts.
definition_zh: 用语言清晰表达或解释你的想法或感受
example_zh: 她努力想把自己的想法表达清楚。

definition: made or produced to copy something natural; not real
example: an artificial limb/flower/sweetener/fertilizer
definition_zh: 为了复制某种自然的东西而制作或制作;不是真实的
example_zh: 一种假枝/花/人工化肥

definition: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings
example: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
definition_zh: 创作艺术作品的人，尤其是绘画或素描
example_zh: 当代英国艺术家作品展

definition: connected with art or artists
example: the artistic works of the period
definition_zh: 与艺术或艺术家相关
example_zh: 该时期的艺术作品

definition: pictures and photographs prepared for books, magazines, etc.
example: Can you let me have the finished artwork for the poster by Friday?
definition_zh: 为书籍、杂志等准备的图片和照片。
example_zh: 你能在星期五之前把海报的完成稿给我吗？

definition: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations
example: You're as tall as your father.
definition_zh: 当你比较两个人、两个事物或两个情境时
example_zh: 你和你爸爸一样高。

definition: while something else is happening
example: He sat watching her as she got ready.
definition_zh: 而与此同时，还有别的事情正在发生
example_zh: 他坐着看着她准备。

definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else
example: They were all dressed as clowns.
definition_zh: 用来描述某人/某物看起来像另一个人/别人
example_zh: 他们全都打扮成小丑。

definition: the grey or black powder that is left after something, especially tobacco, wood or coal, has burnt
example: cigarette ash
definition_zh: 在某物，尤其是烟草、木材或煤炭燃烧后留下的灰色或黑色粉末
example_zh: 香烟灰

definition: feeling shame or feeling embarrassed about somebody/something or because of something you have done
example: ashamed of something, She was deeply ashamed of her behaviour at the party.
definition_zh: 因为某人/某事或你做过的某件事感到羞愧或尴尬
example_zh: 她对自己在派对上的表现感到深深羞愧。

definition: to one side; out of the way
example: She pulled the curtain aside.
definition_zh: 向一侧;让开
example_zh: 她拉开了窗帘。

definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information
example: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
definition_zh: 以问题的形式说或写东西，以获取信息
example_zh: 如果你不介意我问，你几岁了？

definition: sleeping
example: I waited until they were all fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).
definition_zh: 睡觉
example_zh: 我等到他们都睡得很熟（=睡得很沉）。

definition: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered
example: aspect of something, The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.
definition_zh: 情境中的某个特定部分或特征、一个想法、一个问题等;一种可以将其考虑的方式
example_zh: 某方面，本书旨在涵盖城市生活的各个方面。

definition: a strong desire to have or do something
example: I didn't realize you had political aspirations.
definition_zh: 强烈的渴望——想要拥有或去做某件事
example_zh: 我没想到你有政治抱负。

definition: to have a strong desire to achieve or to become something
example: aspire (to something), She aspired to a scientific career.
definition_zh: 有强烈的成就欲望或成为某物
example_zh: 她渴望从事科学事业。

definition: the murder of an important or famous person, especially for political reasons
example: The president survived a number of assassination attempts.
definition_zh: 谋杀重要或知名人士，尤其是出于政治原因
example_zh: 总统曾多次幸免于刺杀企图。

definition: the crime of attacking somebody physically
example: Both men were charged with assault.
definition_zh: 对他人进行身体攻击的罪行
example_zh: 两人均被控袭击罪。

definition: to attack somebody violently, especially when this is a crime
example: He has been charged with assaulting a police officer.
definition_zh: 暴力攻击某人，尤其是当这是犯罪时
example_zh: 他被控袭警。

definition: to come together as a group; to bring people or things together as a group
example: All the students were asked to assemble in the main hall.
definition_zh: 作为一个群体聚集在一起;将人或事物作为一个团体聚集在一起
example_zh: 所有学生被要求在主礼堂集合。

definition: a group of people who have been elected to meet together regularly and make decisions or laws for a particular region or country
example: state/legislative/federal/local assemblies
definition_zh: 一群被选出来定期聚在一起，为特定地区或国家制定决策或法律的人
example_zh: 州/立法/联邦/地方议会

definition: to state clearly and definitely that something is true
example: assert that…, She continued to assert that she was innocent.
definition_zh: 明确而肯定地表明某件事是真实的
example_zh: 她坚持自己是无辜的。

definition: a statement saying that you strongly believe something to be true
example: He was correct in his assertion that the minister had been lying.
definition_zh: 一句话，说明你坚信某件事是真的
example_zh: 他说部长说谎的说法是正确的。

definition: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something
example: assess somebody/something, Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物的性质或品质作出判断
example_zh: 评估某人/某物，准确评估环境影响非常复杂。

definition: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully
example: a detailed assessment of the risks involved
definition_zh: 对某个人或某事经过非常仔细思考的观点或判断
example_zh: 对相关风险的详细评估

definition: a person or thing that is valuable or useful to somebody/something
example: In his job, patience is an invaluable asset.
definition_zh: 对某人或某物有价值或有用的人或事物
example_zh: 在他的工作中，耐心是无价的资产。

definition: to give somebody something that they can use, or some work or responsibility
example: assign something (to somebody), The teacher assigned a different task to each of the children.
definition_zh: 给别人一些他们能用的东西，或者工作或责任
example_zh: 给某人分配一项任务，老师给每个孩子分配了不同的任务。

definition: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies
example: Students are required to complete all homework assignments.
definition_zh: 某人被分配去做的任务或工作，通常是作为其工作或学习的一部分
example_zh: 学生必须完成所有家庭作业。

definition: to help somebody to do something
example: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.
definition_zh: 帮助某人完成某事
example_zh: 任何愿意协助的人都可以联系这个号码。

definition: help or support
example: technical/economic/military assistance
definition_zh: 帮助或支持
example_zh: 技术/经济/军事援助

definition: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work
example: the assistant manager/director/commissioner
definition_zh: 在高层职位下，并协助他们工作
example_zh: 助理经理/主任/专员

definition: a person who helps or supports somebody, usually in their job
example: My assistant will now demonstrate the machine in action.
definition_zh: 指帮助或支持他人的人，通常是在工作中
example_zh: 我的助手现在将演示机器的实际操作。

definition: to make a connection between people or things in your mind
example: associate somebody/something with somebody/something, I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.
definition_zh: 在你脑海中将人或事物建立联系
example_zh: 把某人/某物和某人/某物联系起来，我总是把烘焙的味道和我的童年联系在一起。

definition: if one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other
example: associated with doing something, the risks associated with taking drugs
definition_zh: 如果一件事与另一件事相关联，这两件事之所以联系起来，是因为它们同时发生，或者一件事引发了另一件事
example_zh: 与做某事有关，以及服用药物所带来的风险

definition: an official group of people who have joined together for a particular purpose
example: Do you belong to any professional or trade associations?
definition_zh: 一个为特定目的而联合起来的官方团体
example_zh: 你是否加入任何专业或行业协会？

definition: to think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it
example: assume (that)…, It is reasonable to assume (that) the economy will continue to improve.
definition_zh: 认为或接受某件事是真的，但却没有证据
example_zh: 假设（这个）......，合理地假设经济将继续改善。

definition: a belief or feeling that something is true or that something will happen, although there is no proof
example: an underlying/implicit assumption
definition_zh: 一种信念或感觉，认为某件事是真的，或者某件事将会发生，尽管没有任何证据
example_zh: 一种潜在/隐含的假设

definition: a statement that something will certainly be true or will certainly happen, particularly when there has been doubt about it
example: They called for assurances that the government is committed to its education policy.
definition_zh: 一种声明，表明某件事必然会成为事实，或者必然会发生，尤其是在对此存在怀疑时
example_zh: 他们呼吁政府确保其致力于教育政策。

definition: to tell somebody that something is definitely true or is definitely going to happen, especially when they have doubts about it
example: assure somebody (that)…, You think I did it deliberately, but I assure you (that) I did not.
definition_zh: 告诉别人某件事绝对是真的，或者肯定会发生，尤其是在他们对此有所怀疑的时候
example_zh: 向某人保证......你认为我是故意的，但我向你保证我没有。

definition: very surprising; difficult to believe
example: She ran 100m in an astonishing 10.6 seconds.
definition_zh: 非常令人惊讶;难以置信
example_zh: 她以惊人的10.6秒完成了100米。

definition: protection that a government gives to people who have left their own country, usually because they were in danger for political reasons
example: to seek/apply for/be granted asylum
definition_zh: 政府给予那些离开本国的人的保护，通常是因为政治原因他们处于危险之中
example_zh: 寻求/申请/被授予庇护

definition: used to say where something/somebody is or where something happens
example: at the corner of the street
definition_zh: 过去用来指某事/某人在哪里，或者某事发生在哪里
example_zh: 在街角

definition: a person who competes in sports
example: Olympic athletes
definition_zh: 一个参加体育比赛的人
example_zh: 奥运运动员

definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth
example: Wind power doesn't release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
definition_zh: 环绕地球的气体混合物
example_zh: 风能不会向大气中释放二氧化碳。

definition: a cruel and violent act, especially in a war
example: In the war, both sides committed atrocities.
definition_zh: 这是一种残忍而暴力的行为，尤其是在战争中
example_zh: 在战争中，双方都犯下了暴行。

definition: to fasten or join one thing to another
example: attach something, I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
definition_zh: 将一物固定或连接到另一物
example_zh: 附上点东西，我会附上我的笔记副本供你参考。

definition: a document that you send to somebody using email
example: No attachment was included.
definition_zh: 你通过电子邮件发送给某人的文档
example_zh: 没有附带附件。

definition: an act of using violence to try to hurt or kill somebody
example: Five people were killed in the attacks that took place last night.
definition_zh: 一种使用暴力试图伤害或杀害他人的行为
example_zh: 昨晚发生的袭击造成五人死亡。

definition: to use violence to try to hurt or kill somebody
example: Most dogs will not attack unless provoked.
definition_zh: 用暴力试图伤害或杀害某人
example_zh: 大多数狗除非被激怒，否则不会攻击。

definition: to succeed in getting something, usually after a lot of effort
example: Most of our students attained five ‘A’ grades in their exams.
definition_zh: 成功获得某样东西，通常是经过大量努力
example_zh: 我们的大多数学生在考试中获得了五个“A”等级。

definition: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult, often with no success
example: I passed my driving test at the first attempt.
definition_zh: 一种尝试做某事的行为，尤其是困难的事，往往毫无成功
example_zh: 我第一次就通过了驾照考试。

definition: to make an effort or try to do something, especially something difficult
example: attempt to do something, I will attempt to answer all your questions.
definition_zh: 去努力或尝试做点什么，尤其是困难的事情
example_zh: 试着做点什么，我会尽力回答你所有的问题。

definition: to be present at an event
example: We'd like as many people as possible to attend.
definition_zh: 出席活动
example_zh: 我们希望尽可能多的人能参加。

definition: the act of being present at a place, for example at school
example: Attendance at these lectures is not compulsory.
definition_zh: 在某个地方出现的行为，比如在学校
example_zh: 参加这些讲座并非强制性。

definition: used for asking people to listen to something that is being announced
example: Attention, please! Passengers for flight KL412 are requested to go to gate 21 immediately.
definition_zh: 用于邀请人们收听正在宣布的内容
example_zh: 请注意！KL412航班的乘客请立即前往21号登机口。

definition: the act of listening to, looking at or thinking about something/somebody carefully; interest that people show in somebody/something
example: the report’s attention to detail
definition_zh: 倾听、观察或仔细思考某事/某人;人们对某人/某事表现出的兴趣
example_zh: 报告对细节的关注

definition: the way that you think and feel about somebody/something; the way that you behave towards somebody/something that shows how you think and feel
example: attitude towards somebody/something, These societies have to change their attitudes towards women.
definition_zh: 你对某人/某物的想法和感受;你对某人或某物的行为方式，体现了你的想法和感受
example_zh: 对某人或某物的态度，这些社会必须改变他们对女性的态度。

definition: a lawyer, especially one who can act for somebody in court
example: The prosecuting attorney began with a short opening statement.
definition_zh: 律师，尤其是能在法庭上代表别人行事的律师
example_zh: 检察官以简短的开场陈述开始。

definition: if you are attracted by something, it interests you and makes you want it; if you are attracted by somebody, you like or admire them
example: be attracted by somebody/something, I had always been attracted by the idea of working abroad.
definition_zh: 如果你被某样东西吸引，它会让你感兴趣并渴望它;如果你被某人吸引，你喜欢或钦佩他
example_zh: 被某个人或某物吸引，我一直被出国工作的想法所吸引。

definition: an interesting or lively place to go or thing to do
example: Buckingham Palace is a major tourist attraction.
definition_zh: 一个有趣或热闹的去处或活动
example_zh: 白金汉宫是主要的旅游景点。

definition: pleasant to look at, especially in a sexual way
example: an attractive woman
definition_zh: 看起来很舒服，尤其是带有性意味的感觉
example_zh: 一位有吸引力的女人

definition: a quality or feature of somebody/something
example: Patience is one of the most important attributes in a teacher.
definition_zh: 某人/某物的一种特质或特征
example_zh: 耐心是教师最重要的品质之一。

definition: to say or believe that something is the result of a particular thing
example: She attributes her success to hard work and a little luck.
definition_zh: 说或相信某件事是由某件事造成的结果
example_zh: 她将自己的成功归功于努力工作和一点点运气。

definition: a public sale in which things are sold to the person who offers the most money for them
example: an auction of paintings
definition_zh: 公开拍卖，物品被卖给出价最高的人
example_zh: 画作拍卖

definition: the group of people who have gathered to watch or listen to something (a play, concert, somebody speaking, etc.)
example: The audience was/were clapping for 10 minutes.
definition_zh: 那群人聚集在一起观看或聆听某件事（戏剧、音乐会、有人演讲等）
example_zh: 观众持续鼓掌了10分钟。

definition: connected with sound that is recorded
example: audio and video recordings/files/clips
definition_zh: 与录音的声音相连
example_zh: 音频和视频录制/文件/剪辑

definition: an official examination of business and financial records to see that they are true and correct
example: an annual audit
definition_zh: 对商业和财务记录进行官方审查，以确保其真实无误
example_zh: 年度审计

definition: the 8th month of the year, between July and September
example: She was born in August.
definition_zh: 每年第八个月，七月至九月之间
example_zh: 她出生于八月。

definition: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle or aunt
example: Aunt Alice
definition_zh: 你父亲或母亲的姐妹;你叔叔或姑妈的妻子
example_zh: 爱丽丝阿姨

definition: known to be real and what somebody claims it is and not a copy
example: I don't know if the painting is authentic.
definition_zh: 被证明是真实的，正如别人所声称的那样，而不是复制品
example_zh: 我不知道这幅画是否真品。

definition: a person who writes books or the person who wrote a particular book
example: Who is your favourite author?
definition_zh: 一个写书的人，或者写过某本特定书的人
example_zh: 你最喜欢的作家是谁？

definition: the power to give orders to people
example: in a position of authority
definition_zh: 向人下达命令的权力
example_zh: 处于权威位置

definition: to give official permission for something, or for somebody to do something
example: authorize something, I can authorize payments up to £5 000.
definition_zh: 对某事给予正式许可，或者某人去做某事
example_zh: 授权某项费用，我可以授权最高5000英镑的付款。

definition: a car
example: the auto industry
definition_zh: 一辆车
example_zh: 汽车行业

definition: having controls that work without needing a person to operate them
example: automatic doors
definition_zh: 拥有无需人操作即可正常运作的控制装置
example_zh: 自动门

definition: without needing a person to operate controls
example: The heating switches off automatically.
definition_zh: 无需人员操作控制
example_zh: 暖气会自动关闭。

definition: the freedom for a country, a region or an organization to govern itself independently
example: a campaign in Wales for greater autonomy
definition_zh: 一个国家、一个地区或一个组织独立治理自身的自由
example_zh: 在威尔士争取更大自治权的运动

definition: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes colder
example: in the autumn of something, in the autumn of 2010
definition_zh: 一年中夏冬之间的季节，叶子变色，天气转冷
example_zh: 《某事之秋》，2010年秋天

definition: the fact that something is possible to get, buy or find
example: the availability of cheap flights
definition_zh: 某样东西是可以获得、购买或找到的
example_zh: 廉价航班的可用性

definition: that you can get, buy or find
example: available resources/data
definition_zh: 你可以买到、买到或找到
example_zh: 可用资源/数据

definition: calculated by adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: The average age of participants was 52 years.
definition_zh: 通过将多个金额相加，找到总数，再将总数除以金额数来计算得出
example_zh: 参与者的平均年龄为52岁。
