definition: the result of adding several amounts together, finding a total, and dividing the total by the number of amounts
example: The average of 4, 5 and 9 is 6.
definition_zh: 将多个金额相加，找到总额，并将总额除以金额数的结果
example_zh: 4、5、9的平均值是6。

definition: to be equal to a particular amount as an average
example: Economic growth is expected to average 2% next year.
definition_zh: 以平均值等于某一特定金额
example_zh: 预计明年经济增长平均为2%。

definition: to prevent something bad from happening
example: avoid something, to avoid conflict/confrontation
definition_zh: 以防止发生不好的事
example_zh: 避免某些事情，以避免冲突或对抗

definition: to wait for somebody/something
example: He is in custody awaiting trial.
definition_zh: 等待某个人/某物
example_zh: 他目前被拘留等待审判。

definition: a prize such as money, etc. for something that somebody has done
example: He was nominated for the best actor award.
definition_zh: 比如奖品，比如钱，等等，奖励某人做过的事
example_zh: 他曾获得最佳男演员提名。

definition: to make an official decision to give something to somebody as a payment, prize, contract, etc.
example: award something, Knowing why and how corporations award contracts is vitally important.
definition_zh: 为了正式决定把某样东西作为报酬、奖品、合同等方式送给某人。
example_zh: 授予某项协议，了解企业为何以及如何授予合同至关重要。

definition: knowing or realizing something
example: As you're aware, this is not a new problem.
definition_zh: 知道或领悟某事
example_zh: 正如你所知，这并不是一个新问题。

definition: knowing something; knowing that something exists and is important
example: awareness of something, an awareness of the importance of eating a healthy diet
definition_zh: 知道某件事;知道某物存在且重要
example_zh: 对某件事的觉察，对健康饮食重要性的觉察

definition: to or at a distance from somebody/something in space or time
example: The beach is a mile away.
definition_zh: 与某个人/某物在空间或时间上保持距离
example_zh: 海滩离这里只有一英里。

definition: very bad or unpleasant
example: That's an awful colour.
definition_zh: 非常糟糕或令人不快
example_zh: 那颜色真糟糕。

definition: making you feel embarrassed
example: There was an awkward silence.
definition_zh: 让你感到尴尬
example_zh: 现场陷入了尴尬的沉默。

definition: a very young child or animal
example: The baby's crying!
definition_zh: 一个非常年幼的孩子或动物
example_zh: 宝宝在哭！

definition: located behind or at the back of something
example: We were sitting in the back row
definition_zh: 位于某物的后方或后方
example_zh: 我们当时坐在后排

definition: to or into the place, condition, situation or activity where somebody/something was before
example: When is he coming back to work?
definition_zh: 前往或进入之前某人/某物所在的地点、条件、情境或活动
example_zh: 他什么时候回来上班？

definition: the part of the human body that is on the opposite side to the chest, between the neck and the tops of the legs; the part of an animal’s body that corresponds to this
example: on your back, He was lying on his back on the sofa.
definition_zh: 人体中位于胸部对侧、颈部与腿部顶部之间的部分;动物身体中与此对应的部分
example_zh: 仰面；他仰面躺在沙发上。

definition: to encourage somebody or give them help; to give financial support to somebody/something
example: Her parents backed her in her choice of career.
definition_zh: 鼓励某人或给予帮助;为某人或某事提供经济支持
example_zh: 她的父母支持她的职业选择。

definition: everything that can be seen around an event or scene
example: The mountains provided a dramatic backdrop for our picnic.
definition_zh: 在事件或场景周围可见的一切
example_zh: 群山为我们的野餐提供了壮观的背景。

definition: the details of a person’s family, education, experience, etc.
example: somebody's ethnic/genetic/cultural background
definition_zh: 一个人的家庭细节、教育背景、经历等。
example_zh: 某人的族裔/遗传/文化背景

definition: help and support from somebody to do something; financial support for something
example: The police gave the proposals their full backing.
definition_zh: 有人给予帮助和支持去做某件事;某项事情的经济支持
example_zh: 警方对这些提案给予了全力支持。

definition: extra help or support that you can get if necessary
example: The police had backup from the army.
definition_zh: 如果需要，你可以获得额外的帮助或支持
example_zh: 警方得到了军队的支援。

definition: towards a place or position that is behind
example: I lost my balance and fell backwards.
definition_zh: 朝向落后的某个位置或位置
example_zh: 我失去平衡，向后摔倒。

definition: the simplest and smallest forms of life. Bacteria exist in large numbers in air, water and soil, and also in living and dead creatures and plants, and are often a cause of disease.
example: Neither chilling nor freezing kills all bacteria.
definition_zh: 最简单、最小的生命形式。细菌大量存在于空气、水和土壤中，也存在于活的和死去的生物和植物中，且常常是疾病的原因。
example_zh: 冷藏或冷冻都不能杀死所有细菌。

definition: unpleasant; full of problems
example: I have some bad news for you, I'm afraid.
definition_zh: 令人不快;充满问题
example_zh: 恐怕我有个坏消息要告诉你。

definition: a small piece of metal or plastic, with a design or words on it, that a person wears or carries to show that they belong to an organization, support something, have achieved something, have a particular rank, etc.
example: She wore a badge saying ‘Vote for Coates’.
definition_zh: 一小块金属或塑料，上面有图案或文字，个人佩戴或携带，用以表明自己属于某个组织、支持某事、取得成就、拥有特定军衔等。
example_zh: 她佩戴着写着“投票给科茨”的徽章。

definition: without skill or care
example: to play/sing badly
definition_zh: 没有技巧或关心
example_zh: 弹奏/唱得很糟糕

definition: a container made of cloth, leather, plastic or paper, used to carry things in, especially when shopping or travelling
example: He was carrying a heavy bag of groceries.
definition_zh: 一种由布、皮革、塑料或纸制成的容器，用于携带物品，尤其是在购物或旅行时
example_zh: 他提着一大袋杂货。

definition: money that somebody agrees to pay if a person accused of a crime does not appear at their trial. When bail has been arranged, the accused person is allowed to go free until the trial.
example: Can anyone put up bail for you?
definition_zh: 如果被控犯罪的人未出庭受审，某人同意支付的钱。一旦安排好保释，被告可以被允许自由，直到审判结束。
example_zh: 有人能帮你交保释吗？

definition: to cook food in an oven without extra fat or liquid; to be cooked in this way
example: bake (something), to bake bread/biscuits/cookies
definition_zh: 在烤箱中烹饪时不添加额外脂肪或液体;以这种方式烹饪
example_zh: 烘焙（某样东西），用来烤面包/饼干/饼干

definition: a situation in which different things exist in equal, correct or good amounts
example: This newspaper maintains a good balance in its presentation of different opinions.
definition_zh: 一种不同事物以相等、正确或充足的比例存在的情形
example_zh: 本报在呈现不同观点方面保持了良好的平衡。

definition: to put your body or something else into a position where it is steady and does not fall
example: balance on something, How long can you balance on one leg?
definition_zh: 让你的身体或其他物体处于一个稳定且不会倒下的位置
example_zh: 站在某样东西上，你能单腿保持平衡多久？

definition: keeping or showing a balance so that different things or different parts of something exist in equal or correct amounts
example: The programme presented a balanced view of the two sides of the conflict.
definition_zh: 保持或展示平衡，使不同事物或不同部分以同等或正确的比例存在
example_zh: 该节目对冲突双方呈现了平衡的观点。

definition: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports
example: a golf/tennis/bowling/soccer ball
definition_zh: 一种圆形物体，用于在游戏和体育运动中投掷、击打或踢击
example_zh: 高尔夫球/网球/保龄球/足球

definition: a style of dancing that tells a dramatic story with music but no talking or singing
example: She wants to be a ballet dancer.
definition_zh: 这是一种用音乐讲述戏剧性故事但不讲话也不唱歌的舞蹈风格
example_zh: 她想成为芭蕾舞者。

definition: a small bag made of very thin rubber that becomes larger and rounder when you fill it with air or gas. Balloons are brightly coloured and used as decorations or toys.
example: to blow up/burst/pop a balloon
definition_zh: 一个由非常薄的橡胶制成的小袋子，当你注满空气或气体时，它会变得更大更圆。气球颜色鲜艳，常用作装饰品或玩具。
example_zh: 要把气球吹/爆/戳破

definition: the system of voting in writing and usually in secret; an occasion on which a vote is held
example: The chairperson is chosen by secret ballot.
definition_zh: 书面投票制度，通常以秘密进行;举行投票的场合
example_zh: 主席通过无记名投票选出。

definition: an official rule that says that something is not allowed
example: a smoking ban
definition_zh: 官方规则规定某项内容不被允许
example_zh: 禁烟令

definition: to decide or say officially that something is not allowed
example: ban something, The law effectively bans smoking in all public places.
definition_zh: 决定或正式声明某事不允许
example_zh: 禁止某件事，法律实际上禁止在所有公共场所吸烟。

definition: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and that is soft inside, which grows on trees in hot countries
example: a bunch of bananas
definition_zh: 一种长而弯曲的果实，果皮厚厚且黄色，内里柔软，生长在炎热地区的树上
example_zh: 一串香蕉

definition: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers
example: a rock/punk/jazz band
definition_zh: 一个由音乐家组成的小团体，他们一起演奏流行音乐，通常会有一位或多位歌手一起演奏
example_zh: 一支摇滚/朋克/爵士乐队

definition: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money
example: I don't have much money in the bank at the end of the month.
definition_zh: 提供各种金融服务的组织，例如提供资金保管或贷款
example_zh: 月底我银行里没多少钱。

definition: a long piece of cloth with a message on it that is carried between two poles or hung in a public place to show support for something
example: A huge banner over the street said ‘Welcome home’.
definition_zh: 一块长布，上面写着信息，夹在两根杆子之间，或挂在公共场所以表达对某项支持的信号
example_zh: 街道上悬挂着一条巨大的横幅，上面写着“欢迎回家”。

definition: a place where you can buy and drink alcoholic and other drinks
example: We arranged to meet in a bar called the Flamingo.
definition_zh: 一个可以购买和饮用酒精饮料及其他饮品的地方
example_zh: 我们约好在一家叫“火烈鸟”的酒吧见面。

definition: to ban or prevent somebody from doing something
example: bar somebody from doing something, Prisoners are barred by law from voting in general elections.
definition_zh: 禁止或阻止某人做某事
example_zh: 禁止某人做某事，囚犯依法被禁止参加大选投票。

definition: not covered by any clothes
example: She likes to walk around in bare feet.
definition_zh: 没有被任何衣服遮住
example_zh: 她喜欢光脚走来走去。

definition: in a way that is just possible but only with difficulty
example: He could barely read and write.
definition_zh: 以某种方式，这只是有可能，但前提是困难重重
example_zh: 他几乎不会读写。

definition: a thing bought for less than the usual price
example: I picked up a few good bargains in the sale.
definition_zh: 一个比平价便宜买到的东西
example_zh: 我在促销时捡到了几件划算的好货。

definition: a large round container, usually made of wood or metal, with flat ends and, usually, curved sides
example: a beer/wine barrel
definition_zh: 一个大型圆形容器，通常由木头或金属制成，两端平坦，侧面通常弯曲
example_zh: 啤酒/葡萄酒桶

definition: an object like a fence that prevents people from moving forward from one place to another
example: The crowd had to stand behind barriers.
definition_zh: 像栅栏这样的物体，阻止人们从一个地方向前移动到
example_zh: 人群不得不站在栏杆后面。

definition: the lowest part of something, especially the part or surface on which it rests or stands
example: The lamp has a heavy base.
definition_zh: 某物的最低部分，尤其是它所依托或站立的部分或表面
example_zh: 灯座很重。

definition: to use a particular city, town, etc. as the main place for a business, holiday, etc.
example: be based in… , The organization is now based in Geneva.
definition_zh: 比如把某个特定的城市、城镇等作为开展业务、度假等的主要场所。
example_zh: 总部设在......，该组织现设在日内瓦。

definition: a game played especially in the US by two teams of nine players, using a bat and ball. Each player tries to hit the ball and then run around four bases before the other team can return the ball.
example: a baseball bat/team/cap/fan/player/game
definition_zh: 一种特别在美国由两队各九名球员进行的游戏，使用球棒和球。每位球员都试图击球，然后在对方球队把球传回之前跑过四个垒。
example_zh: 棒球棒/球队/帽子/球迷/球员/游戏

definition: if one thing is based on another, it uses it or is developed from it
example: The movie is based on a real-life incident.
definition_zh: 如果一件事基于另一件事，它就会使用它，或者从中发展出来
example_zh: 这部电影基于一桩真实事件改编。

definition: a room or rooms in a building, partly or completely below the level of the ground
example: Kitchen goods are sold in the basement.
definition_zh: 建筑物内部分或完全低于地面水平的房间
example_zh: 厨房用品在地下室出售。

definition: forming the part of something that is most necessary and from which other things develop
example: basic information/facts/ideas
definition_zh: 构成最必要的部分，并由此孕育出其他事物
example_zh: 基本信息/事实/想法

definition: in the most important ways, without considering things that are less important
example: I think we are basically saying the same thing.
definition_zh: 以最重要的方式，而不考虑那些不那么重要的事情
example_zh: 我觉得我们基本上是在说同一个话。

definition: the way things are organized or arranged; how often something happens
example: We are in contact on a regular basis.
definition_zh: 事物的组织或摆放方式;某件事发生的频率
example_zh: 我们保持定期联系。

definition: a container for holding or carrying things. Baskets are made of long thin pieces of material that bends and twists easily, for example plastic, wire or wicker.
example: a shopping basket
definition_zh: 用于盛装或携带物品的容器。篮子由细长的材料制成，容易弯曲和扭转，例如塑料、铁丝或柳条。
example_zh: 购物篮

definition: a game played by two teams of five players, using a large ball which players try to throw into a high net hanging from a ring
example: a basketball game/coach/team/player
definition_zh: 一种由两队各五名玩家进行的游戏，使用一个大球，玩家试图将球投向悬挂在环上的高网中
example_zh: 一场篮球比赛/教练/球队/球员

definition: the lowest tone or part in music, for instruments or voices
example: He always plays his stereo with the bass turned right up.
definition_zh: 音乐中最低音或声部，适用于乐器或声部
example_zh: 他总是把音响开到最大音量。

definition: a piece of wood with a handle, made in various shapes and sizes, and used for hitting the ball in games such as baseball, cricket and table tennis
example: a baseball/cricket bat
definition_zh: 一块带手柄的木头，形状和尺寸各异，用于棒球、板球和乒乓球等游戏中击球
example_zh: 棒球/板球棒

definition: to hit a ball with a bat, especially in a game of baseball or cricket
example: He bats very well.
definition_zh: 用球棒击球，尤其是在棒球或板球比赛中
example_zh: 他的击球非常出色。

definition: a large, long container that you put water in and then get into to wash your whole body
example: I'm in the bath!
definition_zh: 一个又大又长的容器，你要装水进去，然后用它来清洗全身
example_zh: 我在浴缸里！

definition: a room in which there is a bath, a washbasin and often a toilet
example: Go and wash your hands in the bathroom.
definition_zh: 一个房间里有浴缸、洗脸盆，通常还有马桶
example_zh: 去洗手间洗手。

definition: a device that is placed inside a car engine, clock, radio, etc. and that produces the electricity that makes it work
example: to replace the batteries
definition_zh: 一种安装在汽车发动机、钟表、收音机等内部的装置，并产生使其工作所需的电力
example_zh: 更换电池

definition: a fight between armies, ships or planes, especially during a war; a violent fight between groups of people
example: Napoleon was defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.
definition_zh: 军队、舰船或飞机之间的战斗，尤其是在战争期间;群体之间的激烈战斗
example_zh: 拿破仑在滑铁卢战役中被击败。

definition: to try very hard to achieve something difficult or to deal with something unpleasant or dangerous
example: Both teams battled hard.
definition_zh: 努力去完成困难的事情，或者应对不愉快或危险的事情
example_zh: 两队都拼尽全力。

definition: a place where a battle is being fought or has been fought
example: heavy casualties on the battlefield
definition_zh: 一个正在进行或已经发生战斗的地方
example_zh: 战场上的重大伤亡

definition: a part of the sea, or of a large lake, partly surrounded by a wide curve of the land
example: the Bay of Bengal
definition_zh: 一部分是海洋的一部分，或是一大片湖泊，部分被宽阔的陆地曲线环绕
example_zh: 孟加拉湾

definition: used when you are naming people or things, describing them or giving more information about them
example: + noun, Today is Monday.
definition_zh: 当你为人物或事物命名、描述它们或提供更多信息时，它会被用到
example_zh: + 名词，今天是星期一。

definition: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses
example: I am studying Chinese.
definition_zh: 与现在分词一起使用，形成进行式时态
example_zh: 我在学中文。

definition: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), next to the sea or a lake
example: on the beach, tourists sunbathing on the beach
definition_zh: 靠近海边或湖泊的一片沙地或小石头（称为卵石）
example_zh: 在海滩上，游客们在海滩上晒太阳

definition: a line of light, electromagnetic waves or particles
example: narrow beams of light/sunlight
definition_zh: 一线光线、电磁波或粒子
example_zh: 狭窄的光束/阳光

definition: a seed, or pod containing seeds, of a climbing plant, eaten as a vegetable. There are several types of bean and the plants that they grow on are also called beans.
example: green beans
definition_zh: 一种攀缘植物的种子或荚内的种子，作为蔬菜食用。豆类有多种类型，它们生长的植物也被称为豆类。
example_zh: 四季豆

definition: a heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws (= pointed parts on the ends of its feet). There are many types of bear.
example: a black bear
definition_zh: 一种体型庞大、毛发浓密且爪子锋利的野生动物。熊有许多种。
example_zh: 一只黑熊

definition: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant
example: bear something, The pain was almost more than he could bear.
definition_zh: 能够接受并应对一些不愉快的事情
example_zh: 承受点什么，那种痛苦几乎超出了他的承受范围。

definition: an animal, especially one that is large or dangerous, or one that is unusual
example: wild/savage/ferocious beasts
definition_zh: 一只动物，尤其是体型庞大、危险，或者特殊动物
example_zh: 野性/野性/凶猛的野兽

definition: a single hit to something, such as a drum, or a movement of something, such as your heart; the sound that this makes
example: several loud beats on the drum
definition_zh: 比如敲击某物，比如鼓，或者某物的运动，比如你的心;这所产生的声音
example_zh: 鼓声响起几声响亮的敲击声

definition: to defeat somebody in a game or competition
example: beat somebody at something, He beat me at chess.
definition_zh: 在游戏或比赛中击败某人
example_zh: 在某件事上打败了别人，他在国际象棋上也打败了我。

definition: having beauty; giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: a beautiful woman/girl
definition_zh: 拥有美丽;为感官或心灵带来愉悦
example_zh: 一位美丽的女性/女孩

definition: the quality of giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: beauty of something, the beauty of the sunset/of poetry/of his singing
definition_zh: 赋予感官或心灵愉悦的品质
example_zh: 某物之美，夕阳之美/诗歌之美/他歌唱的美

definition: for the reason that
example: I did it because he told me to.
definition_zh: 原因在于
example_zh: 我这么做是因为他让我这么做。

definition: to start to be something
example: + adj., It soon became apparent that no one was going to come.
definition_zh: 开始成为某种意义
example_zh: + 形容词，很快就显而易见没人会来。

definition: a piece of furniture for sleeping on
example: a single/double bed
definition_zh: 一件适合睡觉的家具
example_zh: 一张单人床/双人床

definition: a room for sleeping in
example: the spare/guest bedroom
definition_zh: 一个睡觉的房间
example_zh: 备用/客房

definition: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting (= touch your skin and make you feel a sharp pain).Bees live in large groups and make honey (= a sweet sticky substance that is good to eat).
example: Bees were buzzing in the clover.
definition_zh: 一种黑黄相间的飞行昆虫，能蜇人（=触碰皮肤并让你感到剧痛）。蜜蜂成群生活，产蜂蜜（=一种甜甜黏稠、适合食用的物质）。
example_zh: 蜜蜂在三叶草里嗡嗡飞舞。

definition: meat that comes from a cow
example: roast beef
definition_zh: 来自牛的肉
example_zh: 烤牛肉

definition: an alcoholic drink made from malt with hops added to give it taste. There are many types of beer.
example: a pint/can/bottle of beer
definition_zh: 一种由麦芽制成，加入啤酒花以增添风味的酒精饮料。啤酒有许多种类。
example_zh: 一品脱/一罐/一瓶啤酒

definition: at an earlier time; in the past; already
example: You should have told me so before.
definition_zh: 更早的时间;过去;已经
example_zh: 你早该告诉我。

definition: earlier than the time when
example: Do it before you forget.
definition_zh: 比
example_zh: 趁还没忘之前去做。

definition: earlier than somebody/something
example: before lunch
definition_zh: 比某个人/某物更早
example_zh: 午饭前

definition: to ask somebody for something especially in an anxious way because you want or need it very much
example: Now you have to beg and plead.
definition_zh: 尤其是用焦虑的心情去向别人请求某样东西，因为你非常想要或需要它
example_zh: 现在你得乞求和哀求。

definition: to start doing something; to do the first part of something
example: Shall I begin?
definition_zh: 开始做点什么;做某件事的第一部分
example_zh: 我可以开始吗？

definition: the time when something starts; the first part of an event, a story, etc.
example: A story has to have a beginning, middle, and end.
definition_zh: 某件事开始的时间;事件的第一部分、故事等等。
example_zh: 一个故事必须有开头、中间和结尾。

definition: in order to help somebody
example: He began a petition in behalf of the farmers.
definition_zh: 为了帮助某人
example_zh: 他发起了一份为农民辩护的请愿书。

definition: to do things in a particular way
example: The doctor behaved very unprofessionally.
definition_zh: 以特定方式做事
example_zh: 医生的行为非常不专业。

definition: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
example: good/bad behaviour
definition_zh: 一个人的行为方式，尤其是对别人
example_zh: 良好/不良行为

definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something; further back
example: She rode off down the road with the dog running behind.
definition_zh: 在某人或某物的背后或背后;更后面
example_zh: 她骑着马沿着路跑去，狗也跟在后面。

definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them
example: Who's the girl standing behind Jan?
definition_zh: 在某人或某物的后面，且常常被其遮挡
example_zh: 站在Jan后面的那个女孩是谁？

definition: existence
example: The Irish Free State came into being in 1922.
definition_zh: 存在
example_zh: 爱尔兰自由邦于1922年成立。

definition: a strong feeling that something/somebody exists or is true; confidence that something/somebody is good or right
example: belief in something/somebody, I admire his passionate belief in what he is doing.
definition_zh: 强烈的感觉，认为某事/某人存在或真实;对某事/某人是善或正确的确信
example_zh: 对某件事/某人的信念，我钦佩他对自己所做的事情充满热情的信念。

definition: to feel certain that something is true or that somebody is telling you the truth
example: believe somebody, I don't believe you!
definition_zh: 确信某件事是真的，或者有人在告诉你真相
example_zh: 相信别人，我不信你！

definition: a hollow metal object, often like a cup in shape, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes
example: A peal of church bells rang out in the distance.
definition_zh: 一种中空金属物体，形状通常像杯子，当内部有一小块金属击中时会发出嗡嗡声;它发出的声音
example_zh: 远处传来教堂钟声。

definition: to be in the right or suitable place
example: Where do these plates belong (= where are they kept)?
definition_zh: 要处于正确或合适的位置
example_zh: 这些盘子属于哪里（=它们存放在哪里）？

definition: loved very much
example: in memory of our dearly beloved son, John
definition_zh: 非常深爱
example_zh: 纪念我们深爱的儿子约翰

definition: at or to a lower level, position or place
example: They live on the floor below.
definition_zh: 在较低的层级、位置或地点
example_zh: 他们住在楼下。

definition: at or to a lower level or position than somebody/something
example: He dived below the surface of the water.
definition_zh: 在某个人或某物的层级或位置上或位置
example_zh: 他潜入水面以下。

definition: a long narrow piece of leather, cloth, etc. that you wear around the middle part of your body
example: to do up/fasten/tighten a belt
definition_zh: 一条又长又窄的皮革、布料等，你穿在身体中段
example_zh: 系紧/系紧/系紧皮带

definition: a long seat for two or more people, usually made of wood
example: a park bench
definition_zh: 一个可容纳两人或以上的长座椅，通常由木头制成
example_zh: 一张公园长椅

definition: something that can be measured and used as a standard that other things can be compared with
example: Tests at the age of seven provide a benchmark against which the child's progress at school can be measured.
definition_zh: 可以被测量并作为标准，用来比较其他事物
example_zh: 七岁时的测试为衡量孩子在学校的学习进展提供了基准。

definition: a curve or turn, especially in a road or river
example: a sharp bend in the road
definition_zh: 一个弯道或转弯，尤其是在公路或河流中
example_zh: 路面上的一个急弯

definition: to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction
example: He bent and kissed her.
definition_zh: 向某个特定方向倾斜，或者让某物倾斜
example_zh: 他俯身吻了她。

definition: in or to a lower position than somebody/something; under somebody/something
example: They found the body buried beneath a pile of leaves.
definition_zh: 处于某人/某物的较低位置;在某人/某物之下
example_zh: 他们发现尸体埋在一堆落叶下。

definition: improving a situation; having a helpful or useful effect
example: A good diet is beneficial to health.
definition_zh: 改善情况;产生有益或有用的效果
example_zh: 良好的饮食对健康有益。

definition: a person who gains as a result of something
example: Who will be the main beneficiary of the cuts in income tax?
definition_zh: 一个因某事而获益的人
example_zh: 谁将成为所得税削减的主要受益者？

definition: an advantage that something gives you; a helpful and useful effect that something has
example: Freedom of information brings great benefits.
definition_zh: 某样东西给你带来的优势;某样东西带来的有益且有用的效果
example_zh: 信息自由带来了巨大的好处。

definition: to be useful to somebody or improve their life in some way
example: We should spend the money on something that will benefit everyone.
definition_zh: 为某人提供帮助或以某种方式改善他们的生活
example_zh: 我们应该把钱花在对所有人都有益的事情上。

definition: not straight
example: a piece of bent wire
definition_zh: 不是直的
example_zh: 一根弯线

definition: next to or at the side of somebody/something
example: He sat beside her all night.
definition_zh: 位于某人/某物旁边或侧面
example_zh: 他整晚都坐在她身边。

definition: used for making an extra comment that adds to what you have just said
example: I don't really want to go. Besides, it's too late now.
definition_zh: 用于补充你刚才说的话
example_zh: 我其实不太想去。再说了，现在已经太晚了。

definition: in addition to somebody/something; apart from somebody/something
example: We have lots of things in common besides music.
definition_zh: 除了某人/某物之外;除了某人/某物之外
example_zh: 除了音乐，我们还有很多共同点。

definition: of the most excellent type or quality
example: That's the best movie I've ever seen!
definition_zh: 最优良的类型或质量
example_zh: 这是我看过的最棒的电影！

definition: most; to the greatest extent
example: Which one do you like best?
definition_zh: 大多数;在最大程度上
example_zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？

definition: the most excellent thing or person
example: We all want the best for our children.
definition_zh: 最优秀的事物或人
example_zh: 我们都希望孩子拥有最好的。

definition: an arrangement to risk money, etc. on the result of a particular event; the money that you risk in this way
example: to win/lose a bet
definition_zh: 为某一特定事件的结果承担资金等风险的安排;你以此方式承担的资金风险
example_zh: 赢/输投注

definition: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result
example: You have to be over 16 to bet.
definition_zh: 通过预测结果来冒险在比赛或赛事上赌上金钱
example_zh: 你必须年满16岁才能下注。

definition: to give information about somebody/something to an enemy
example: betray somebody/something, He was offered money to betray his colleagues.
definition_zh: 向敌人提供有关某人/某物的信息
example_zh: 背叛某人/某物，有人出钱让他出卖同事。

definition: of a higher standard or less poor quality; not as bad as something else
example: We're hoping for better weather tomorrow.
definition_zh: 质量更高或质量较好;不像其他东西那么糟糕
example_zh: 我们希望明天天气会好些。

definition: in a more excellent or pleasant way; not as badly
example: She sings much better than I do.
definition_zh: 以一种更优秀或更愉快的方式;没那么糟
example_zh: 她唱歌比我好听多了。

definition: something that is better
example: the better of the two books
definition_zh: 更好的东西
example_zh: 两本书中较好的一本

definition: in the space or period of time separating two or more points, objects, etc. or two dates, events, etc.
example: The house was near a park but there was a road in between.
definition_zh: 在两个或多个点、物体等之间的时间或空间内，或者两个日期、事件等。
example_zh: 房子靠近一个公园，但中间有条路。

definition: in or into the space separating two or more points, objects, people, etc.
example: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
definition_zh: 在两个或多个点、物体、人等之间的空间内或内部。
example_zh: Q位于英文字母表中的P和R之间。

definition: on the other side; further on
example: Snowdon and the mountains beyond were covered in snow.
definition_zh: 在另一侧;更远处
example_zh: 斯诺登及其外的山脉被白雪覆盖。

definition: on or to the further side of something
example: The road continues beyond the village up into the hills.
definition_zh: 在某物的另一侧或更远处
example_zh: 道路继续延伸至村庄之外的丘陵。

definition: a strong feeling in favour of or against one group of people, or one side in an argument, often not based on fair judgement
example: accusations of political bias in news programmes (= that reports are unfair and show favour to one political party)
definition_zh: 一种强烈支持或反对某一群体或某一方的情绪，往往并非基于公正判断
example_zh: 新闻节目中政治偏见的指控（=报道不公正，偏袒某一政党）

definition: a road vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals with your feet
example: He got on his bicycle and rode off.
definition_zh: 一种带两个轮子的公路车辆，你通过脚踩油门来驾驶
example_zh: 他骑上自行车离开了。

definition: an offer by a person or a company to pay a particular amount of money for something
example: bid for something, A German firm launched a takeover bid for the company.
definition_zh: 一个人或公司提出为某物支付特定金额的报价
example_zh: 某项竞标，一家德国公司发起了对该公司的收购要约。

definition: to offer to pay a particular price for something, especially at an auction
example: bid (something) (for something), I bid £2 000 for the painting.
definition_zh: 在拍卖会上，提出为某样东西支付特定价格
example_zh: 出价（某物）（某物），我出价2000英镑买这幅画。

definition: large in size, degree, amount, etc.
example: a big man/house/increase
definition_zh: 规模、程度、数量等都很大。
example_zh: 一个大男人/大个子/增援

definition: a bicycle
example: I used to ride my bike around the neighbourhood for hours.
definition_zh: 一辆自行车
example_zh: 我以前常骑自行车在附近兜几个小时。

definition: a document that shows how much you owe somebody for goods or services
example: the phone/electricity/gas bill
definition_zh: 一份显示你欠某人商品或服务金额的文件
example_zh: 电话/电/燃气账单

definition: to send somebody a bill for something
example: bill somebody for something, Please bill me for the books.
definition_zh: 给某人寄账单
example_zh: 给别人收账，请给我账单。

definition: 1 000 000 000; one thousand million
example: Worldwide sales reached 2.5 billion.
example_zh: 全球销售额达到25亿。

definition: a container that you put waste in
example: a rubbish bin
definition_zh: 一个用来装垃圾的容器
example_zh: 一个垃圾桶

definition: to tie somebody/something with rope, string, etc. so that they/it cannot move or are held together strongly
example: bind somebody/something to something, She was bound to a chair.
definition_zh: 用绳索、绳子等将某人/某物绑住，使其无法移动或牢固地固定在一起
example_zh: 把某人/某物绑在某物上，她被绑在椅子上。

definition: the story of a person’s life written by somebody else; this type of writing
example: Boswell’s biography of Johnson
definition_zh: 由他人书写的一个人的一生故事;这种写作类型
example_zh: 博斯韦尔关于约翰逊的传记

definition: connected with the science of biology
example: the biological sciences
definition_zh: 与生物学科学相关
example_zh: 生物科学

definition: the scientific study of the life and structure of plants and animals
example: a degree in biology
definition_zh: 对植物和动物生命及结构的科学研究
example_zh: 生物学学位

definition: a creature that is covered with feathers and has two wings and two legs. Most birds can fly.
example: a bird’s nest with two eggs in it
definition_zh: 一种全身覆满羽毛、有两只翅膀和两条腿的生物。大多数鸟类都能飞翔。
example_zh: 一个鸟巢里有两个蛋

definition: the time when a baby is born; the process of being born
example: at birth, The baby weighed three kilos at birth.
definition_zh: 婴儿出生的时间;出生的过程
example_zh: 出生时，婴儿体重为三公斤。

definition: the day in each year which is the same date as the one on which you were born
example: Happy Birthday!
definition_zh: 每一年中的这一天，与你出生的那一天相同
example_zh: 生日快乐！

definition: a small flat dry cake for one person, usually sweet, and baked until hard
example: a packet/tin of chocolate biscuits
definition_zh: 一份小而扁的、干的蛋糕，通常为一人份，通常偏甜，烤到硬
example_zh: 一包/一罐巧克力饼干

definition: a senior priest in charge of the work of the Church in a city or district
example: the Bishop of Oxford
definition_zh: 负责教会在某一城市或地区工作的高级神父
example_zh: 牛津主教

definition: rather; to some extent
example: These trousers are a bit tight.
definition_zh: 相反地;在某种程度上
example_zh: 这条裤子有点紧。

definition: an act of biting
example: The dog gave me a playful bite.
definition_zh: 咬人的行为
example_zh: 狗还顽皮地咬了我一下。

definition: to use your teeth to cut into or through something
example: Does your dog bite?
definition_zh: 用牙齿切开或穿透某物
example_zh: 你的狗会咬人吗？

definition: having a strong, unpleasant taste; not sweet
example: Black coffee leaves a bitter taste in the mouth.
definition_zh: 味道浓烈且令人不快;不甜
example_zh: 黑咖啡会在口中留下苦涩的味道。

definition: very strange or unusual
example: a bizarre situation/incident/story
definition_zh: 非常奇怪或不寻常
example_zh: 一个离奇的情况/事件/故事

definition: having the very darkest colour, like coal or the sky at night
example: a shiny black car
definition_zh: 拥有最深的颜色，就像煤炭或夜晚的天空
example_zh: 一辆闪亮的黑色汽车

definition: the very darkest colour, like night or coal
example: the black of the night sky
definition_zh: 最深的颜色，比如夜色或煤炭色
example_zh: 夜空的黑暗

definition: the flat part of a knife, tool or machine, which has a sharp edge or edges for cutting
example: The machine comes with a plastic guard over the blade to protect the operator.
definition_zh: 刀、工具或机器的扁平部分，带有用于切割的锋利边缘
example_zh: 机器配有塑料护板覆盖刀片，以保护操作人员。

definition: responsibility for doing something badly or wrongly; saying that somebody is responsible for something
example: Why do I always get the blame for everything that goes wrong?
definition_zh: 对做错或做错事负责;说某人对某事负有责任
example_zh: 为什么所有出错的事情总是归咎于我？

definition: to think or say that somebody/something is responsible for something bad
example: blame somebody/something for something, She doesn't blame anyone for her father's death.
definition_zh: 认为或说某人/某物对坏事负有责任
example_zh: 把责任推给别人/某件事，她不会因为父亲的死怪任何人。

definition: empty, with nothing written, printed or recorded on it
example: Sign your name in the blank space below.
definition_zh: 空无一物，上面没有任何文字、印刷或记录
example_zh: 请在下方空白处签名。

definition: an empty space on a printed form or document for you to write answers, information, etc. in
example: Please fill in the blanks.
definition_zh: 打印表单或文档上的空白处，供你填写答案、信息等
example_zh: 请填写空白。

definition: a large cover, often made of wool, used especially on beds to keep people warm
example: It’s cold tonight—can I have another blanket?
definition_zh: 一种大型罩子，通常由羊毛制成，特别用于床上保暖
example_zh: 今晚很冷——我能再要一条毯子吗？

definition: an explosion or a powerful movement of air caused by an explosion
example: a bomb blast
definition_zh: 爆炸或由爆炸引起的强烈空气流动
example_zh: 炸弹爆炸

definition: to violently destroy or break something into pieces, using explosives
example: They blasted a huge crater in the runway.
definition_zh: 用爆炸物暴力摧毁或砸碎物体
example_zh: 他们在跑道上炸出了一个巨大的弹坑。

definition: to lose blood, especially from a wound or an injury
example: My finger's bleeding.
definition_zh: 失血，尤其是因伤口或受伤而失血
example_zh: 我的手指在流血。

definition: a mixture of different types of the same thing
example: a blend of tea
definition_zh: 同一种东西的多种类型混合体
example_zh: 一杯茶的混合

definition: to mix two or more substances together
example: blend A with B, Blend the flour with the milk to make a smooth paste.
definition_zh: 将两种或多种物质混合在一起
example_zh: 将A和B搅拌，将面粉与牛奶混合成光滑的糊状。

definition: to ask God to protect somebody/something
example: They brought the children to Jesus and he blessed them.
definition_zh: 请求上帝保护某人/某物
example_zh: 他们把孩子们带到耶稣面前，耶稣赐福了他们。

definition: God’s help and protection, or a prayer asking for this
example: to pray for God’s blessing
definition_zh: 上帝的帮助和保护，或祈求这种帮助和保护的祷告
example_zh: 祈求上帝的祝福

definition: not able to see
example: Doctors think he will go blind.
definition_zh: 看不见
example_zh: 医生认为他会失明。

definition: a large piece of a solid material that is square or rectangular in shape and usually has flat sides
example: The houses are made of concrete blocks with tin roofs.
definition_zh: 一大块实心材料，形状为方形或长方形，通常侧面平坦
example_zh: 房屋由混凝土块和锡皮屋顶建造。

definition: to stop something from moving or flowing through a pipe, a passage, a road, etc. by putting something in it or across it
example: After today's heavy snow, many roads are still blocked.
definition_zh: 通过把东西放进管道、通道、道路等，阻止某物移动或流动
example_zh: 经过今天的大雪，许多道路仍然封闭。

definition: a website where an individual person, or people representing an organization, write regularly about recent events or topics that interest them, usually with photos and links to other websites that they find interesting
example: This is a link to the museum's blog.
definition_zh: 一个网站，个人或代表某一组织的人定期撰写他们感兴趣的最新事件或话题，通常配有照片和指向他们感兴趣的其他网站链接
example_zh: 这是博物馆博客的链接。

definition: pale gold in colour
example: She had long blonde hair.
definition_zh: 淡金色
example_zh: 她有一头长长的金发。

definition: the red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals
example: He lost a lot of blood in the accident.
definition_zh: 流经人类和动物体内的红色液体
example_zh: 他在事故中失血很多。

definition: a hard hit with the hand, a weapon, etc.
example: She received a severe blow on the head.
definition_zh: 比如用手重击、武器等等。
example_zh: 她头部遭受了重击。

definition: to send out air from the mouth
example: + adv./prep., You're not blowing hard enough!
definition_zh: 从嘴里放出空气
example_zh: + 副词/介词，你吹得不够用力！

definition: having the colour of a clear sky or the sea on a clear day
example: piercing blue eyes
definition_zh: 拥有晴朗天空或晴朗日子中大海的颜色
example_zh: 锐利的蓝眼睛

definition: the colour of a clear sky or the sea on a clear day
example: bright/dark/light/pale/deep blue
definition_zh: 晴朗天空或晴朗日子海面的颜色
example_zh: 明亮/深/浅/浅/深蓝

definition: a long thin piece of strong hard material, especially wood, used, for example, for making floors, building walls and roofs and making boats
example: He had ripped up the carpet, leaving only the bare boards.
definition_zh: 一块细长且坚硬的材料，尤其是木材，例如用于铺设地板、建造墙体和屋顶以及制作船只
example_zh: 他把地毯撕了一遍，只留下光秃秃的木板。

definition: to get on a ship, train, plane, bus, etc.
example: Passengers are waiting to board.
definition_zh: 比如登上船、火车、飞机、公交车等等。
example_zh: 乘客正在等待登机。

definition: to talk in a way that shows you are too proud of something that you have or can do
example: I don't want to boast, but I can actually speak six languages.
definition_zh: 用一种让你对自己拥有或能做到的事情感到过于自豪的方式说话
example_zh: 我不想自夸，但我实际上会说六种语言。

definition: a vehicle (smaller than a ship) that travels on water, moved by oars, sails or a motor
example: a rowing/sailing boat
definition_zh: 一种在水上行驶的交通工具（比船只小），由桨、帆或马达驱动
example_zh: 一艘划艇/帆船

definition: the whole physical structure of a human or an animal
example: The human body is a complex structure.
definition_zh: 人类或动物的整体物理结构
example_zh: 人体是一个复杂的结构。

definition: when a liquid boils or when you boil it, it is heated to the point where it forms bubbles and turns to steam or vapour
example: The water was bubbling and boiling away.
definition_zh: 当液体沸腾或你煮沸时，它被加热到形成气泡，变成蒸汽或蒸气
example_zh: 水在沸腾、沸腾。

definition: brave and confident; not afraid to say what you feel or to take risks
example: It was a bold move on their part to open a business in France.
definition_zh: 勇敢而自信;不怕说出自己的感受，也不怕冒险
example_zh: 他们在法国开设企业，是一次大胆的举动。

definition: a weapon designed to explode at a particular time or when it is dropped or thrown
example: a bomb goes off/explodes
definition_zh: 一种设计成在特定时间或被投掷或投掷时爆炸的武器
example_zh: 炸弹爆炸/爆炸

definition: to attack something/somebody by leaving a bomb in a place or by dropping bombs from a plane
example: Warplanes bombed targets in and around the capital.
definition_zh: 通过在某个地方放置炸弹或从飞机上投掷炸弹来攻击某物或某人
example_zh: 战机轰炸了首都及其周边的目标。

definition: an occasion when a bomb is dropped or left somewhere; the act of doing this
example: recent bombings in major cities
definition_zh: 炸弹被投下或遗留在某处的情形;做这件事的过程
example_zh: 近期主要城市爆炸事件

definition: something that forms a connection between people or groups, such as a feeling of friendship or shared ideas and experiences
example: the bond that links us
definition_zh: 某种能在人或群体之间建立联系的东西，比如友谊的感觉，或者共同的想法和经历
example_zh: 将我们连结在一起的纽带

definition: any of the hard parts that form the skeleton of the body of a human or an animal
example: He survived the accident with no broken bones.
definition_zh: 构成人体或动物骨骼的任何坚硬部分
example_zh: 他在事故中幸存下来，没有骨折。

definition: an extra amount of money that is added to a payment, especially to somebody’s wages or salary as a reward
example: a £100 Christmas bonus
definition_zh: 额外支付的金额，尤其是作为奖励加到某人的工资或薪金中
example_zh: 100英镑圣诞奖金

definition: a set of printed pages that are fastened inside a cover so that you can turn them and read them
example: His desk was covered with piles of books.
definition_zh: 一组印刷好的纸页，固定在封面内，方便你翻阅
example_zh: 他的书桌上堆满了一大堆书。

definition: to arrange to have or use something on a particular date in the future; to buy a ticket in advance
example: Book early to avoid disappointment.
definition_zh: 安排在未来某一天拥有或使用某项物品;提前购买机票
example_zh: 尽早预订以避免失望。

definition: an arrangement that you make in advance to buy a ticket to travel somewhere, go to the theatre, etc.
example: a booking form/hall/clerk
definition_zh: 你提前安排好买票去某个地方旅行、去看剧院等等。
example_zh: 登记表/大厅/书记员

definition: a sudden increase in trade and economic activity; a period of wealth and success
example: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.
definition_zh: 贸易和经济活动的突然增长;一段富裕与成功的时期
example_zh: 战后经济繁荣期间，生活水平迅速改善。

definition: something that helps or encourages somebody/something
example: a great/tremendous/welcome boost
definition_zh: 帮助或鼓励某人或某物的事情
example_zh: 这是一个极大的、巨大的、令人欢迎的鼓舞

definition: to make something increase, or become better or more successful
example: to boost exports/profits
definition_zh: 让某样东西增长、变得更好、更成功
example_zh: 以促进出口/利润

definition: a strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle and often the lower part of the leg
example: (British English), walking boots
definition_zh: 一种覆盖脚踝、通常还覆盖小腿下半部的结实鞋
example_zh: （英式英语），行走靴

definition: the line that divides two countries or areas; the land near this line
example: I live in a small town in the US, near the Canadian border.
definition_zh: 分隔两个国家或地区的界线;靠近这条线的土地
example_zh: 我住在美国一个小镇，靠近加拿大边境。

definition: to share a border with another country or area
example: the countries bordering the Baltic
definition_zh: 与另一个国家或地区共享边界
example_zh: 波罗的海沿岸国家

definition: feeling tired and impatient because you have lost interest in somebody/something or because you have nothing to do
example: There was a bored expression on her face.
definition_zh: 因为你对某个人或某件事失去了兴趣，或者因为没事可做而感到疲惫和不耐烦
example_zh: 她脸上带着无聊的表情。

definition: not interesting; making you feel tired and impatient
example: He's such a boring man!
definition_zh: 不有趣;让你感到疲惫和不耐烦
example_zh: 他真是个无聊的男人！

definition: to come out of your mother’s body at the beginning of your life
example: I was born in 1976.
definition_zh: 在你生命的开始时从你母亲的身体里出来
example_zh: 我出生于1976年。

definition: to take and use something that belongs to somebody else, and return it to them at a later time
example: borrow something, Can I borrow your umbrella?
definition_zh: 取用属于别人的东西，然后在之后归还给他们
example_zh: 借点东西，我能借你的伞吗？

definition: a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do
example: I'll ask my boss if I can have the day off.
definition_zh: 一个在工作中负责别人、告诉他们该做什么的人
example_zh: 我会问问老板能不能请假一天。

definition: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’
example: Both women were French.
definition_zh: 与复数名词结合使用，表示“这两者”或“既是另一也”。
example_zh: 两位女性均为法国人。

definition: used with plural nouns to mean ‘the two’ or ‘the one as well as the other’
example: Both women were French.
definition_zh: 与复数名词结合使用，表示“这两者”或“既是另一也”。
example_zh: 两位女性均为法国人。

definition: to spend time and/or energy doing something
example: ‘Shall I wait?’ ‘No, don't bother’.
definition_zh: 花时间和/或精力做某件事
example_zh: “我要等吗？”“不用了，别费心了。”

definition: a glass or plastic container, usually round with straight sides and a narrow neck, used especially for storing liquids
example: a wine/beer/milk/water bottle
definition_zh: 一种玻璃或塑料容器，通常为圆形，侧壁直且口部较窄，特别用于储存液体
example_zh: 一瓶葡萄酒/啤酒/牛奶/水瓶

definition: in the lowest, last or furthest place or position
example: your bottom lip
definition_zh: 在最低、最后或最远的位置或地点
example_zh: 你的下唇

definition: the lowest part of something
example: the bottom of the screen/stairs/hill
definition_zh: 某物最低层的部分
example_zh: 屏幕底部/楼梯/山坡

definition: if something bounces or you bounce it, it moves quickly away from a surface it has just hit or you make it do this
example: The ball bounced twice before he could reach it.
definition_zh: 如果东西弹跳，或者你弹了它，它会迅速远离刚碰到的表面，或者你让它这么做
example_zh: 球在他够到之前弹了两下。

definition: certain or likely to happen, or to do or be something
example: There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced.
definition_zh: 确定或很可能发生，或者做或成为某事
example_zh: 新系统推出时必然会有变化。

definition: a real or imagined line that marks the limits or edges of something and separates it from other things or places; a dividing line
example: After the war the national boundaries were redrawn.
definition_zh: 一条真实或想象中的线，标示某物的界限或边界，并将其与其他事物或地点分隔开;一条分界线
example_zh: 战后，国界被重新划定。

definition: the act of bending your head or the upper part of your body forward in order to say hello or goodbye to somebody or to show respect
example: She gave a slight bow of her head in greeting.
definition_zh: 将头或上半身向前倾，以向某人打招呼、告别或表达尊重的行为
example_zh: 她微微低头致意。

definition: to move your head or the top half of your body forwards and downwards as a sign of respect or to say hello or goodbye
example: bow (to/before somebody/something), He bowed low to the assembled crowd.
definition_zh: 将头部或身体上半部分向前和向下移动，以表达尊重，或说声你好或告别
example_zh: 向聚集的人群鞠躬（向某人/某物鞠躬），他深深鞠躬。

definition: a deep round dish with a wide open top, used especially for holding food or liquid
example: a salad/fruit/sugar bowl
definition_zh: 一种深而圆、顶部宽敞的盘子，特别用于盛载食物或液体
example_zh: 沙拉/水果/糖碗

definition: a container made of wood, thick card, metal, etc. with a flat stiff base and sides and often a lid (= cover), used especially for holding solid things
example: in a box, Everything we owned was neatly packed in cardboard boxes.
definition_zh: 一种由木头、厚纸板、金属等制成的容器，底部和侧面平坦坚硬，通常带有盖子（=盖子），特别用于盛放坚固物品
example_zh: 我们所有的东西都整齐地装在纸箱里。

definition: a male child or a young male person
example: a little/small/young boy
definition_zh: 一名男婴或一名年轻男性
example_zh: 一个小男孩/小男孩

definition: a man or boy that somebody has a romantic or sexual relationship with
example: She's got a new boyfriend.
definition_zh: 与某人有浪漫或性关系的男人或男孩
example_zh: 她有了新男朋友。

definition: the organ inside the head that controls movement, thought, memory and feeling
example: The human brain is a complex organ.
definition_zh: 头部内部的器官，掌控运动、思维、记忆和感觉
example_zh: 人类大脑是一个复杂的器官。

definition: a part of a tree that grows out from the main stem and on which leaves, flowers and fruit grow
example: She climbed the tree and hid in the branches.
definition_zh: 树木的一部分，从主干长出，叶子、花朵和果实生长在其上
example_zh: 她爬上树，藏在树枝里。

definition: a type of product, service, etc. made or offered by a particular company under a particular name
example: a well-known brand of toothpaste
definition_zh: 由特定公司以特定名称生产或提供的一种产品、服务等类型
example_zh: 知名牙膏品牌

definition: to apply a brand name, image or identity to something
example: brand something, The website was not doing a very good job of branding the company.
definition_zh: 将品牌名称、形象或身份应用于某物
example_zh: 品牌方面，网站在品牌塑造方面做得并不好。

definition: willing to do things that are difficult, dangerous or painful; not afraid
example: brave men and women
definition_zh: 愿意做那些困难、危险或痛苦的事情;不害怕
example_zh: 勇敢的男女

definition: a failure to do something that must be done by law
example: a breach of contract/copyright/warranty
definition_zh: 未能完成法律必须完成的事
example_zh: 违约/版权/保修

definition: to not keep to an agreement or not keep a promise
example: The government is accused of breaching the terms of the treaty.
definition_zh: 不遵守协议或不守承诺
example_zh: 政府被指控违反条约条款。

definition: a type of food made from flour, water and usually yeast mixed together and baked
example: a loaf/slice/piece of bread
definition_zh: 一种由面粉、水和通常酵母混合制成并烘烤而成的食物
example_zh: 一条面包/一片/一片面包

definition: a short period of time when you stop what you are doing and rest, eat, etc.
example: She was on her lunch break.
definition_zh: 那就是你停下手头的事，休息、吃饭等的短时间。
example_zh: 她正在午休。

definition: to be damaged and separated into two or more parts, as a result of force; to damage something in this way
example: All the windows broke with the force of the blast.
definition_zh: 因外力而受损，并被撕裂成两个或更多部分;以这种方式损坏某物
example_zh: 所有窗户都被爆炸的力量震碎了。

definition: an occasion when a vehicle or machine stops working
example: a breakdown on the motorway
definition_zh: 车辆或机器停止工作的事件
example_zh: 高速公路上的故障

definition: the first meal of the day
example: They were having breakfast when I arrived.
definition_zh: 一天的第一餐
example_zh: 我到的时候他们正在吃早餐。

definition: an important development that may lead to an agreement or achievement
example: to make/achieve a breakthrough
definition_zh: 一项可能促成协议或成就的重要进展
example_zh: 为了实现/实现突破

definition: either of the two round soft parts at the front of a woman’s body that produce milk when she has had a baby
example: She put the baby to her breast.
definition_zh: 女性产后身体前部两个圆形柔软部位中的任意一个，产奶时会分泌乳汁
example_zh: 她把宝宝抱在胸前。

definition: the air that you take into your lungs and send out again
example: His breath smelt of garlic.
definition_zh: 你吸入肺部并再次呼出的空气
example_zh: 他的呼吸中带着大蒜味。

definition: to take air into your lungs and send it out again through your nose or mouth
example: He breathed deeply before speaking again.
definition_zh: 吸入肺部的空气，然后通过鼻子或嘴巴再次呼出
example_zh: 他深吸一口气，再次开口。

definition: the action of taking air into the lungs and sending it out again
example: Her breathing became steady and she fell asleep.
definition_zh: 将空气吸入肺部并再次呼出的动作
example_zh: 她的呼吸变得平稳，随后睡着了。

definition: a particular type of animal that has been developed by people in a certain way, especially a type of dog, cat or farm animal
example: Labradors and other large breeds of dog
definition_zh: 一种由人类以特定方式培育出的动物，尤其是狗、猫或农场动物
example_zh: 拉布拉多及其他大型犬种

definition: to have sex and produce young
example: Many animals breed only at certain times of the year.
definition_zh: 为了发生性关系并生育后代
example_zh: 许多动物只在一年中的特定时间繁殖。

definition: baked clay used for building walls, houses and other buildings; an individual block of this
example: The school is built of brick.
definition_zh: 用于建筑墙体、房屋及其他建筑的烘烤粘土;其中一块单独的粘土
example_zh: 学校采用砖砌结构。

definition: a woman on her wedding day, or just before or just after it
example: a toast to the bride and groom
definition_zh: 一位女性在婚礼当天，或者婚礼前后不久
example_zh: 为新郎新娘干杯

definition: a structure that is built over a road, railway, river, etc. so that people, vehicles, etc. can cross from one side to the other
example: We crossed the bridge over the River Windrush.
definition_zh: 一种建在道路、铁路、河流等道路上方的结构，以便人员、车辆等能够从一侧通行到另一侧
example_zh: 我们穿过了温德拉什河上的桥。

definition: lasting only a short time; short
example: a brief visit/meeting/conversation
definition_zh: 只持续很短的时间;很短
example_zh: 一次简短的拜访/会面/对话

definition: for a short time
example: He had spoken to Emma only briefly.
definition_zh: 短暂的
example_zh: 他只和艾玛简短地说过话。

definition: full of light; shining strongly
example: bright light/sunshine
definition_zh: 充满光芒;明亮耀眼
example_zh: 明亮的光线/阳光

definition: extremely clever or impressive
example: What a brilliant idea!
definition_zh: 极其聪明或令人印象深刻
example_zh: 多么绝妙的主意！

definition: to come to a place with somebody/something
example: bring somebody/something (with you), Don't forget to bring your books with you.
definition_zh: 和某个人/某物一起来到一个地方
example_zh: 带上某个人/某样东西，别忘了带上你的书。

definition: wide
example: a broad street/avenue/river
definition_zh: 宽
example_zh: 一条宽街/大道/河流

definition: a way of connecting to the internet that allows you to receive information, including pictures, etc., very quickly and that is always active (so that the user does not have to connect each time)
example: plans to provide rural areas with fast broadband
definition_zh: 一种连接互联网的方式，允许您非常快速地接收信息，包括图片等，并且始终处于激活状态（这样用户就不必每次都连接）
example_zh: 为农村地区提供高速宽带的计划

definition: a radio or television programme
example: (British English), a party political broadcast (= for example, before an election)
definition_zh: 广播或电视节目
example_zh: （英式英语），政党政治广播（=例如，选举前）

definition: to send out programmes on television or radio
example: The concert will be broadcast live (= at the same time as it takes place) tomorrow evening.
definition_zh: 用于发送电视或广播节目
example_zh: 音乐会将于明天晚上进行现场直播（=与演出时间同步）。

definition: a person whose job is presenting or talking on television or radio programmes
example: She is a writer and broadcaster on environmental matters.
definition_zh: 一个职业是主持或在电视或广播节目中发言的人
example_zh: 她是一位环境议题作家和广播员。

definition: generally, without considering details
example: Broadly speaking, I agree with you.
definition_zh: 一般而言，不考虑细节
example_zh: 总体来说，我同意你的看法。

definition: that has been damaged or injured; no longer whole or working correctly
example: a broken window/plate
definition_zh: 已经受损或受伤;不再完整或正常工作
example_zh: 破碎的窗户/盘子

definition: a boy or man who has the same parents as another person
example: We're brothers.
definition_zh: 一个与他人有相同父母的男孩或男人
example_zh: 我们是兄弟。

definition: having the colour of earth or coffee
example: brown eyes/hair
definition_zh: 拥有土色或咖啡色
example_zh: 棕色眼睛/棕色头发

definition: the colour of earth or coffee
example: leaves of various shades of brown
definition_zh: 土色或咖啡色
example_zh: 叶片呈不同深浅的棕色

definition: a computer program that lets you look at or read documents on the World Wide Web
example: What do you use as your default browser?
definition_zh: 一种计算机程序，允许您查看或阅读万维网上的文档
example_zh: 你默认使用的浏览器是什么？

definition: an object made of short stiff hairs (called bristles) or wires set in a block of wood or plastic, usually attached to a handle. Brushes are used for many different jobs, such as cleaning, painting and tidying your hair.
example: a paintbrush
definition_zh: 由短而硬的毛（称为刷毛）或嵌入木块或塑料中的金属丝制成的物体，通常连接在手柄上。刷子用于许多不同的工作，比如清洁、涂漆和整理头发。
example_zh: 一把画笔

definition: to clean, polish or make something smooth with a brush
example: brush something, to brush your hair/teeth
definition_zh: 用刷子清洁、抛光或使物品光滑
example_zh: 刷点东西，用来刷头发/刷牙

definition: violent and cruel
example: a brutal attack/murder/rape/killing
definition_zh: 暴力而残忍
example_zh: 一场残忍的袭击/谋杀/强奸/杀戮

definition: a ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass
example: champagne bubbles
definition_zh: 液体中的一团空气或气体，或玻璃等固体物质内的一团空气
example_zh: 香槟气泡

definition: a US, Australian or New Zealand dollar; a South African rand; an Indian rupee
example: They cost ten bucks.
definition_zh: 一枚美国、澳大利亚或新西兰元;一枚南非兰特;一枚印度卢比
example_zh: 它们要十块钱。

definition: a friend
example: an old college buddy of mine
definition_zh: 一个朋友
example_zh: 我大学时的一个老朋友

definition: the money that is available to a person or an organization and a plan of how it will be spent over a period of time
example: an annual budget of £10 million
definition_zh: 个人或组织可用的资金，以及在一段时间内如何使用的计划
example_zh: 年度预算为1000万英镑

definition: a thing or person that reduces a shock or protects somebody/something against difficulties
example: buffer against something, Support from family and friends acts as a buffer against stress.
definition_zh: 一种能减轻冲击或保护某人/事物免受困难的事物或人
example_zh: 缓冲，来自家人和朋友的支持起到了抵御压力的缓冲作用。

definition: any small insect
example: There's a bug crawling up your arm.
definition_zh: 任何小昆虫
example_zh: 有只虫子爬上你的胳膊。

definition: to make something, especially a building, by putting parts together
example: build (something), They have permission to build 200 new homes.
definition_zh: 通过将零件组装起来，尤其是建筑物
example_zh: 建（某样东西），他们获准建造200套新房。

definition: a structure such as a house or school that has a roof and walls
example: a tall/high-rise/ten-storey building
definition_zh: 一种结构，例如有屋顶和墙壁的房屋或学校
example_zh: 一座高层/高层/十层建筑

definition: the main part of something; most of something
example: The bulk of the population lives in cities.
definition_zh: 某物的主要部分；某物的大部分
example_zh: 大多数人口居住在城市中。

definition: a small metal object that is fired from a gun
example: He was found to have a single bullet wound in his chest.
definition_zh: 一个从枪中发射的小型金属物体
example_zh: 他胸部被发现有一处枪伤。

definition: a number of things of the same type which are growing or fastened together
example: a bunch of bananas, grapes, etc.
definition_zh: 若干同类型的物品正在生长或紧密结合在一起
example_zh: 一堆香蕉、葡萄之类的。

definition: a duty, responsibility, etc. that causes worry, difficulty or hard work
example: to bear/carry/ease/reduce/share the burden
definition_zh: 一种会带来担忧、困难或辛苦工作的责任、责任等
example_zh: 承担/承担/减轻/分担负担

definition: the system of official rules and ways of doing things that a government or an organization has, especially when these seem to be too complicated
example: unnecessary/excessive bureaucracy
definition_zh: 政府或组织所拥有的官方规则和处理方式，尤其是当这些规则显得过于复杂时
example_zh: 不必要的/过度官僚主义

definition: the act or ceremony of burying a dead body
example: a burial place/mound/site
definition_zh: 埋葬尸体的行为或仪式
example_zh: 墓地/土墩/遗址

definition: an injury or a mark caused by fire, heat or acid
example: to have minor/severe/third-degree burns
definition_zh: 由火灾、高温或酸液造成的伤害或痕迹
example_zh: 有轻度/重度/三度烧伤

definition: to produce flames and heat
example: A welcoming fire was burning in the fireplace.
definition_zh: 以产生火焰和热量
example_zh: 壁炉里燃着一团热情的火。

definition: to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make something break in this way
example: That balloon will burst if you blow it up any more.
definition_zh: 因为内部压力而破裂或分裂;以这种方式让某物破碎
example_zh: 你再吹气球会爆的。

definition: to place a dead body in the ground
example: bury somebody/something, They killed her and buried her body.
definition_zh: 把一具尸体埋进土里
example_zh: 埋葬某人/某物，他们杀了她，埋了她的尸体。

definition: a large road vehicle that carries passengers, especially one that travels along a fixed route and stops regularly to let people get on and off
example: by bus, Shall we walk or go by bus?
definition_zh: 一种大型公路载客车辆，尤其是那种沿着固定路线行驶、定期停车供乘客上下车的车辆
example_zh: 坐公交，我们走路还是坐公交？

definition: a plant that grows thickly with several hard stems coming up from the root
example: a rose/holly bush
definition_zh: 一种生长得很粗壮、根部长出几根硬茎的植物
example_zh: 玫瑰/冬青灌木

definition: the activity of making, buying, selling or supplying goods or services for money
example: It's been a pleasure to do business with you.
definition_zh: 为货币制造、购买、销售或提供商品或服务的活动
example_zh: 与您做生意很愉快。

definition: a man who works in business, especially at a high level
example: a group of visiting Italian politicians and businessmen
definition_zh: 一个在商界工作的男人，尤其是在高层次工作
example_zh: 一群来访的意大利政治家和商人

definition: having a lot to do; perhaps not free to do something else because you are working on something
example: Are you busy tonight?
definition_zh: 有很多事情要做;也许因为你正在忙某件事，就没空去做别的事
example_zh: 你今晚忙吗？

definition: used to introduce a word or phrase that contrasts with what was said before
example: I got it wrong. It wasn't the red one but the blue one.
definition_zh: 用于引入与之前所说内容形成对比的词语或短语
example_zh: 我搞错了。不是红色的，而是蓝色的。

definition: except; apart from
example: We've had nothing but trouble with this car.
definition_zh: 除了;除了
example_zh: 这车我们一直遇到麻烦。

definition: a soft yellow food made from cream, used in cooking and for spreading on bread
example: Fry the onions in butter.
definition_zh: 一种由奶油制成的柔软黄色食品，用于烹饪和涂抹面包
example_zh: 用黄油煎洋葱。

definition: a small round piece of metal, plastic, etc. that is sewn onto a piece of clothing and used for fastening two parts together
example: (British English), to do up/undo your buttons
definition_zh: 一小块圆形金属、塑料等，缝在衣服上，用于将两部分固定在一起
example_zh: （英式英语），扣上/解开纽扣

definition: to obtain something by paying money for it
example: buy (something), Where did you buy that dress?
definition_zh: 通过支付钱获得某样东西
example_zh: 买（点什么），你在哪儿买的那件裙子？

definition: past
example: Just drive by. Don't stop.
definition_zh: 过去
example_zh: 就开过去吧。别停。

definition: used for showing how or in what way something is done
example: The house is heated by gas.
definition_zh: 用于展示某事是如何或以何种方式完成的
example_zh: 房子由燃气取暖。

definition: goodbye
example: Bye! See you next week.
definition_zh: 再见
example_zh: 再见！下周见。

definition: a small room on a ship in which you live or sleep
example: I lay in my cabin feeling miserably seasick.
definition_zh: 你居住或睡觉的船上一间小房间
example_zh: 我躺在舱里，感觉极度晕船。

definition: a group of senior members of a government that is responsible for advising and deciding on government policy
example: a cabinet meeting
definition_zh: 一群政府高级成员，负责就政府政策提供建议和决策
example_zh: 一次内阁会议

definition: a set of wires, covered in plastic or rubber, that carries electricity, phone signals, etc.
example: fibre-optic cable
definition_zh: 一整组覆盖塑料或橡胶的电线，用于传输电流、电话信号等。
example_zh: 光纤电缆

definition: a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals. Alcohol is not usually served in British or American cafes.
example: There are small shops and pavement cafes around every corner.
definition_zh: 一个可以买饮料和简单餐食的地方。英国或美国的咖啡馆通常不供应酒精饮料。
example_zh: 每个拐角都有小商店和人行道咖啡馆。

definition: a sweet food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, butter, sugar, etc. that is baked in an oven. Cakes are made in various shapes and sizes and are often decorated, for example with cream or icing.
example: a piece/slice of cake
definition_zh: 一种由面粉、鸡蛋、黄油、糖等混合物制成的甜食，在烤箱中烘烤。蛋糕有各种形状和大小，通常会装饰，比如用奶油或糖霜装饰。
example_zh: 一块/一片蛋糕

definition: to use numbers to find out a total number, amount, distance, etc.
example: calculate something, An independent valuer will calculate the value of your property.
definition_zh: 用数字来推算总数、金额、距离等。
example_zh: 算一算，独立估价师会帮你估算房产的价值。

definition: the act or process of using numbers to find out an amount
example: Cathy did a rough calculation.
definition_zh: 使用数字来计算金额的行为或过程
example_zh: 凯茜做了个粗略的计算。

definition: the act of speaking to somebody on the phone
example: to get/receive a call from somebody
definition_zh: 与某人通电话的行为
example_zh: 接听某人的电话

definition: to give somebody/something a particular name; to use a particular name or title when you are talking to somebody
example: call somebody/something + noun, They decided to call the baby Mark.
definition_zh: 给某人/某物一个特定的名字;在与某人交谈时使用某个特定的名字或称号
example_zh: 叫某人/某物+名词，他们决定给宝宝叫马克。

definition: not excited, nervous or upset
example: It is important to keep calm in an emergency.
definition_zh: 没有兴奋、紧张或不高兴
example_zh: 在紧急情况下保持冷静非常重要。

definition: a quiet and peaceful time or situation
example: The police appealed for calm.
definition_zh: 一个安静平和的时光或情境
example_zh: 警方呼吁保持冷静。

definition: to make somebody/something become quiet and more relaxed, especially after strong emotion or excitement
example: Have some tea; it'll calm your nerves.
definition_zh: 让某人或某物变得安静、放松，尤其是在强烈情绪或兴奋之后
example_zh: 喝点茶;能让你平静下来。

definition: a piece of equipment for taking photographs, moving pictures or television pictures. It can be a separate item or part of another device.
example: Just point the camera and press the button.
definition_zh: 用于拍照、动态影像或电视画面的设备。它可以是单独的物品，也可以是其他设备的一部分。
example_zh: 只要把摄像头对准，按下按钮就行。

definition: a place where people live temporarily in tents or temporary buildings
example: Let's return to camp.
definition_zh: 人们暂时住在帐篷或临时建筑中的地方
example_zh: 我们回营地吧。

definition: to put up a tent and live in it for a short time
example: I camped overnight in a field.
definition_zh: 搭个帐篷，短暂住进去
example_zh: 我在一片田野里露营过夜。

definition: a series of planned activities that are intended to achieve a particular social, commercial or political aim
example: an anti-smoking campaign
definition_zh: 一系列旨在实现特定社会、商业或政治目标的计划活动
example_zh: 一场反吸烟运动

definition: to take part in or lead a campaign, for example to achieve social or political change, or in order to win an election
example: The party campaigned vigorously in the north of the country.
definition_zh: 参与或领导竞选活动，例如为实现社会或政治变革，或为赢得选举
example_zh: 该党在该国北部积极开展竞选活动。

definition: living in a tent, etc. on holiday
example: Do you go camping?
definition_zh: 度假时住帐篷等
example_zh: 你会去露营吗？

definition: the buildings of a university or college and the land around them
example: university/college campuses
definition_zh: 大学或学院的建筑及其周围土地
example_zh: 大学校园

definition: a metal container in which food and drink is sold
example: can of something, a can of beans/beer/soda
definition_zh: 一个金属容器，用来销售食物和饮料
example_zh: 一罐什么的，一罐豆子/啤酒/汽水

definition: used to say that it is possible for somebody/something to do something, or for something to happen
example: I can run fast.
definition_zh: 以前常说，某人/某物有可能做某件事，或者某件事发生
example_zh: 我跑得很快。

definition: a long straight passage dug in the ground and filled with water for boats and ships to travel along; a smaller passage used for carrying water to fields, crops, etc.
example: the Panama/Suez Canal
definition_zh: 一条在地里挖掘并注满水的长直通道，供船只通行;一条较小的通道，用于将水输送到田地、农作物等处。
example_zh: 巴拿马/苏伊士运河

definition: to decide that something that has been arranged will not now take place
example: All flights have been cancelled because of bad weather.
definition_zh: 决定已经安排好的事现在不会发生
example_zh: 由于恶劣天气，所有航班都取消了。

definition: a serious disease in which growths of cells, also called cancers, form in the body and kill normal body cells. The disease often causes death.
example: breast/lung cancer
definition_zh: 这是一种严重疾病，体内细胞增生，也称为癌症，并杀死正常的身体细胞。该病常导致死亡。
example_zh: 乳腺/肺癌

definition: a person who is trying to be elected or is applying for a job
example: a presidential candidate
definition_zh: 一个正在竞选或申请工作的人
example_zh: 总统候选人

definition: a round stick of wax with a piece of string (called a wick) through the middle that is lit to give light as it burns
example: a flickering candle
definition_zh: 一根圆蜡棒，中间穿过一小段绳子（称为灯芯），燃烧时点燃以发光
example_zh: 一根摇曳的蜡烛

definition: the negative of can; can not
example: I cannot believe the price of the tickets!
definition_zh: “can”的否定形式；不能
example_zh: 我简直不敢相信票价！

definition: a strong heavy rough material used for making tents, sails, etc. and by artists for painting on
example: tents made from heavy canvas
definition_zh: 一种坚韧且粗糙的材料，用于制作帐篷、帆布等，也被艺术家用于绘画
example_zh: 厚帆布帐篷

definition: a type of soft flat hat with a peak (= a hard curved part sticking out in front). Caps are worn especially by men and boys, often as part of a uniform
example: to wear a cap.
definition_zh: 一种带有尖顶的软扁帽（=前方突出的硬弧形部分）。帽子主要由男性和男孩佩戴，常作为制服的一部分
example_zh: 戴帽子。

definition: the ability or qualities necessary to do something
example: Age affects the range of a person's capabilities.
definition_zh: 完成某事所需的能力或素质
example_zh: 年龄会影响一个人能力的范围。

definition: having the ability or qualities necessary for doing something
example: capable of something, You are capable of better work than this.
definition_zh: 具备完成某事所需的能力或素质
example_zh: 你有能力做些什么，你本可以做得更好。

definition: the number of things or people that a container or space can hold
example: a fuel tank with a maximum capacity of 50 litres
definition_zh: 一个容器或空间能容纳的物品或人数
example_zh: 最大容量为50升的油箱

definition: having the form and size used at the beginning of a sentence or a name
example: English is written with a capital ‘E’.
definition_zh: 具有句子开头或名称中使用的形式和大小
example_zh: 英语以大写字母“E”书写。

definition: the most important town or city of a country or region, where the government operates from
example: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.
definition_zh: 一个国家或地区最重要的城镇或城市，政府在该地运作
example_zh: 开罗是埃及的首都。

definition: an economic system in which a country’s businesses and industry are controlled and run for profit by private owners rather than by the government
example: the growth of industrial capitalism in the West
definition_zh: 一种经济体系，在这种体制下，一个国家的企业和工业由私人所有者控制并运营，以盈利为目的，而非由政府
example_zh: 西方工业资本主义的增长

definition: based on the principles of capitalism
example: a capitalist society/system/economy
definition_zh: 基于资本主义原则
example_zh: 一个资本主义社会/体系/经济

definition: the person in charge of a ship or commercial aircraft
example: Captain Cook
definition_zh: 船舶或商用飞机的负责人
example_zh: 库克船长

definition: the act of capturing somebody/something or of being captured
example: He evaded capture for three days.
definition_zh: 捕捉某人/某物或被捕获的行为
example_zh: 他逃避了三天的追捕。

definition: to catch a person or an animal and keep them as a prisoner or shut them in a space that they cannot escape from
example: Allied troops captured over 300 enemy soldiers.
definition_zh: 抓住一个人或动物并将其囚禁，或将其关押在无法逃脱的空间中
example_zh: 盟军俘虏了300多名敌军士兵。

definition: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels that can carry a small number of passengers
example: Paula got into the car and drove off.
definition_zh: 一种配备发动机和四个轮子、可载少量乘客的公路车辆
example_zh: 宝拉上了车，开走了。

definition: a chemical element. Carbon is found in all living things, existing in a pure state as diamond and graphite.
example: carbon fibre
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。碳存在于所有生物中，以钻石和石墨等纯净状态存在。
example_zh: 碳纤维

definition: thick, stiff paper; a piece of this for writing on
example: a piece of card
definition_zh: 厚实、坚硬的纸张;一张用来写字的纸
example_zh: 一张纸牌

definition: the process of caring for somebody/something and providing what they need for their health or protection
example: Some people were badly injured and needed medical care.
definition_zh: 照顾某人或某物，并为其健康或保护提供所需物资的过程
example_zh: 有些人受了重伤，需要医疗救护。

definition: to feel that something is important and worth worrying about
example: I don't care (= I will not be upset) if I never see him again!
definition_zh: 让我觉得某件事很重要，值得担心
example_zh: 我不在乎（=我不会生气）就算再也见不到他！

definition: the series of jobs that a person has in a particular area of work, usually involving more responsibility as time passes
example: a teaching career
definition_zh: 一个人在某一特定工作领域所从事的工作序列，通常随着时间推移责任增加
example_zh: 教学生涯

definition: giving attention or thought to what you are doing so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Be careful!
definition_zh: 关注或思考自己正在做的事情，以避免伤害自己、损坏东西或做错事
example_zh: 小心！

definition: with a lot of attention or thought, so that you avoid hurting yourself, damaging something or doing something wrong
example: Drive carefully.
definition_zh: 需要大量关注或思考，以避免伤害自己、损坏东西或做错事
example_zh: 开车小心。

definition: not giving enough attention and thought to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes
example: careless driving
definition_zh: 没有足够关注和思考自己在做的事情，导致犯错
example_zh: 粗心驾驶

definition: the goods carried in a ship, an aircraft or a motor vehicle
example: The tanker began to spill its cargo of oil.
definition_zh: 船舶、飞机或机动车所运载的货物
example_zh: 油轮开始泄漏油料。

definition: a piece of thick woven material made of wool, etc., used to cover the floor of a room or stairs; the material used for carpets
example: He spent the morning laying the new carpet.
definition_zh: 一块厚实的羊毛等编织材料，用于覆盖房间或楼梯的地板;用于地毯的材料
example_zh: 他花了整个上午铺设新地毯。

definition: a separate section of a train for carrying passengers
example: a railway carriage
definition_zh: 列车中用于载客的独立部分
example_zh: 一辆铁路车厢

definition: a long pointed orange root vegetable
example: grated carrot
definition_zh: 一种长而尖的橙色根茎蔬菜
example_zh: 刨丝胡萝卜

definition: to support the weight of somebody/something and take them or it from place to place; to take somebody/something from one place to another
example: carry somebody/something, He was carrying a large bag.
definition_zh: 承托某人或某物的重量，并将他们或物品从一个地方带到另一个地方;将某人或某物从一个地方带到另一个地方
example_zh: “抱着某人/什么东西”，他还提着一个大包。

definition: a humorous drawing in a newspaper or magazine, especially one about politics or events in the news
example: a political/satirical cartoon
definition_zh: 报纸或杂志上的幽默画作，尤其是关于政治或新闻事件的画
example_zh: 一部政治/讽刺漫画

definition: to make objects, patterns, etc. by cutting away material from a piece of wood or stone, or another hard material
example: carve something, a carved doorway
definition_zh: 通过从木头、石头或其他硬质材料上切割材料来制作物体、图案等
example_zh: 雕刻点什么，一个雕刻好的门

definition: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type
example: in… cases, In some cases people have had to wait several weeks for an appointment.
definition_zh: 特定情况或特定类型的情况
example_zh: 在......在某些情况下，人们甚至需要等待数周才能预约。

definition: money in the form of coins or notes
example: How much cash do you have on you?
definition_zh: 以硬币或纸币形式出现的货币
example_zh: 你身上有多少现金？

definition: a public building or room where people play gambling games for money
example: a new hotel and casino in Las Vegas
definition_zh: 公共建筑或房间，人们在那里玩赌博游戏赚钱
example_zh: 拉斯维加斯的新酒店和赌场

definition: all the people who act in a play or film
example: an all-star cast (= including many well-known actors)
definition_zh: 所有出演戏剧或电影的人
example_zh: 全明星阵容（=包括许多知名演员）

definition: to look, smile, etc. in a particular direction
example: cast something + adv./prep., She cast a welcoming smile in his direction.
definition_zh: 朝某个特定方向看、微笑等
example_zh: 施放了某个 + 副词/介词，她朝他露出欢迎的微笑。

definition: a large strong building with thick, high walls and towers, built in the past by kings or queens, or other important people, to defend themselves against attack
example: a medieval castle
definition_zh: 一座坚固的建筑，墙壁厚重，塔楼高耸，过去由国王、女王或其他重要人物建造，用以抵御攻击
example_zh: 一座中世纪城堡

definition: not formal
example: casual clothes (= comfortable clothes that you choose to wear in your free time)
definition_zh: 非正式
example_zh: 休闲服装（= 你在空闲时间选择穿的舒适服装）

definition: a person who is killed or injured in war or in an accident
example: Our primary objective is reducing road casualties.
definition_zh: 在战争或事故中丧生或受伤的人
example_zh: 我们的首要目标是减少道路伤亡。

definition: a small animal with soft fur that people often keep as a pet. Cats catch and kill birds and mice.
example: a tin of cat food
definition_zh: 一种毛发柔软的小动物，人们常把它当作宠物饲养。猫会捕捉并杀死鸟和老鼠。
example_zh: 一罐猫粮

definition: a complete list of items, for example of things that people can look at or buy
example: a mail-order catalogue (= a book showing goods for sale to be sent to people’s homes)
definition_zh: 一份完整的物品清单，比如人们可以查看或购买的物品
example_zh: 邮购目录（=一本展示商品的书，将寄送至人们家中）

definition: an act of catching something, for example a ball
example: Roger made some brilliant catches at today's game.
definition_zh: 接住某物的行为，比如接球
example_zh: 罗杰今天的比赛中做出了一些精彩的接球。

definition: to stop and hold a moving object or person, especially in your hands
example: She managed to catch the keys as they fell.
definition_zh: 停下来并握住移动的物体或人，尤其是用手握住
example_zh: 她设法接住掉落的钥匙。

definition: a group of people or things with particular features in common
example: These are the nominees from each category.
definition_zh: 一组具有特定共同特征的人或事物
example_zh: 这些是各类别的提名作品。

definition: to provide food and drinks for a social event
example: (British English), cater for somebody/something, Most of our work now involves catering for weddings.
definition_zh: 为社交活动提供食物和饮料
example_zh: （英式英语），为某人/某物提供餐饮服务，我们现在大部分工作都涉及婚礼餐饮。

definition: cows and bulls that are kept as farm animals for their milk or meat
example: a herd of cattle
definition_zh: 作为农场动物饲养以获取牛奶或肉类的牛和公牛
example_zh: 一群牛

definition: the person or thing that makes something happen
example: Unemployment is a major cause of poverty.
definition_zh: 那个让某件事发生的人或事
example_zh: 失业是贫困的主要原因之一。

definition: to make something happen, especially something bad or unpleasant; to make somebody do something
example: cause something, Do they know what caused the fire?
definition_zh: 让某件事发生，尤其是坏事或不愉快的事;让某人做某事
example_zh: 引发什么事，他们知道火灾的原因吗？

definition: care that you take in order to avoid danger or mistakes; the fact of not taking any risks
example: extreme/great caution
definition_zh: 你为避免危险或错误所采取的注意;不冒任何风险的事实
example_zh: 极度/极度谨慎

definition: being careful about what you say or do, especially to avoid danger or mistakes; not taking any risks
example: The government has been cautious in its response to the report.
definition_zh: 谨慎对待自己的言行，尤其是为了避免危险或错误;不冒险
example_zh: 政府对该报告的回应一直持谨慎态度。

definition: a large hole in the side of a hill or cliff or under the ground
example: the mouth (= the entrance) of the cave
definition_zh: 山坡、悬崖或地下的一个大洞
example_zh: 洞口（=入口）

definition: a small disc on which sound or information is recorded. CDs can be played or read on various types of machines, including CD players and computers. (the abbreviation for ‘compact disc’)
example: on CD, His albums are available on CD and online.
definition_zh: 一种用于录制声音或信息的小光盘。CD 可以在各种类型的机器上播放或读取，包括 CD 播放器和计算机。（“CD”的缩写）
example_zh: 他的专辑以CD和网络形式发行。

definition: to stop happening or existing; to stop something from happening or existing
example: Welfare payments cease as soon as an individual starts a job.
definition_zh: 停止发生或存在;阻止某事发生或存在
example_zh: 一旦个人开始工作，福利金即停止。

definition: the top inside surface of a room
example: a large room with a high ceiling
definition_zh: 房间内侧的顶部表面
example_zh: 一间高挑天花板的大房间

definition: to show that a day or an event is important by doing something special on it
example: Jake's passed his exams. We're going out to celebrate.
definition_zh: 通过在某一天或事件上做一些特别的事情来展示它的重要性
example_zh: 杰克通过了考试。我们要出去庆祝。

definition: a special event that people organize in order to celebrate something
example: The occasion was the 40th anniversary celebrations of the orchestra.
definition_zh: 人们为庆祝某件事而组织的特别活动
example_zh: 这次活动是乐团成立40周年庆典。

definition: a famous person
example: a celebrity chef
definition_zh: 一位名人
example_zh: 一位名厨

definition: the smallest unit of living matter that can exist on its own. All plants and animals are made up of cells.
example: red and white blood cells
definition_zh: 能独立存在的最小生命物质单位。所有植物和动物都是由细胞组成的。
example_zh: 红细胞和白细胞

definition: an area of land used for burying dead people, especially one that is not next to a church
example: He was buried in a private cemetery.
definition_zh: 一块用于埋葬死者的土地，尤其是不在教堂旁边的土地
example_zh: 他被安葬在一座私人墓地。

definition: a coin and unit of money worth 1% of the main unit of money in many countries, for example of the US dollar or of the euro
example: A one-minute phone call to the UK cost 10 cents.
definition_zh: 一种硬币和货币单位，在许多国家，其价值为主要货币单位的1%，例如美元或欧元
example_zh: 打一通电话给英国，费用是10美分。

definition: in the centre of an area or object
example: central London
definition_zh: 位于区域或对象的中心
example_zh: 伦敦市中心

definition: the middle point or part of something
example: He walked to the centre of the circle.
definition_zh: 某物的中间点或部分
example_zh: 他走到圆圈中央。

definition: to be the person or thing around which most activity takes place; to make somebody/something the central person or thing
example: centre around/round somebody/something, State occasions always centred around the king.
definition_zh: 成为大多数活动围绕的人或事物展开;使某人或某物成为中心人物或事物
example_zh: 围绕某个人/某物展开，国家活动总是围绕国王展开。

definition: a period of 100 years
example: A century ago, Valparaiso was the country's main port.
definition_zh: 一百年的时期
example_zh: 一个世纪前，瓦尔帕莱索是该国的主要港口。

definition: a public or religious occasion that includes a series of formal or traditional actions
example: More than 1 000 people attended the ceremony.
definition_zh: 包括一系列正式或传统活动的公共或宗教场合
example_zh: 超过1000人参加了仪式。

definition: strongly believing something; having no doubts
example: I think it was him, but I can't be certain.
definition_zh: 坚定地相信某件事;毫无怀疑
example_zh: 我觉得是他，但我不能确定。

definition: without doubt
example: Without treatment, she will almost certainly die.
definition_zh: 毫无疑问
example_zh: 如果不接受治疗，她几乎肯定会死亡。

definition: the state of being certain
example: There is no certainty that the president's removal would end the civil war.
definition_zh: 确定状态
example_zh: 目前尚不能确定总统被罢免是否会结束内战。

definition: an official document that may be used to prove that the facts it states are true
example: a birth/marriage/death certificate
definition_zh: 一份可用于证明其所述事实属实的官方文件
example_zh: 出生/结婚/死亡证明

definition: a series of connected metal rings, used for pulling or fastening things; a length of chain used for a particular purpose
example: She wore a heavy gold chain around her neck.
definition_zh: 一系列连接的金属环，用于拉扯或固定物品;一段用于特定目的的链条
example_zh: 她脖子上系着一条沉重的金链。

definition: to fasten something with a chain; to fasten somebody/something to another person or thing with a chain, so that they do not escape or get stolen
example: chain somebody/something, The doors were always locked and chained.
definition_zh: 用链子固定某物;用链子将某人或某物绑在另一个人或物身上，防止其逃跑或被偷走
example_zh: 锁住某人/某物，门总是锁着、用链子锁着。

definition: a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back, a seat and four legs
example: a table and chairs
definition_zh: 一件供一个人坐的家具，有靠背、座椅和四条腿
example_zh: 一张桌子和几把椅子

definition: to act as the chairman or chairwoman of a meeting, discussion, etc.
example: to chair a committee
definition_zh: 担任会议、讨论等的主席或主席。
example_zh: 主持一个委员会

definition: the person in charge of a meeting, who tells people when they can speak, etc.
example: Sir Herbert took it upon himself to act as chairman.
definition_zh: 负责会议的人，告诉大家什么时候可以发言等等。
example_zh: 赫伯特爵士自愿担任主席。

definition: a new or difficult task that tests somebody’s ability and skill
example: a tough/major/significant challenge
definition_zh: 一项新的或困难的任务，考验一个人的能力和技能
example_zh: 一个艰难/重大/重大的挑战

definition: to question whether a statement or an action is right, legal, etc.; to refuse to accept something
example: challenge something, His legal team immediately sought to challenge the decision.
definition_zh: 质疑某项陈述或行为是否正确、合法等;拒绝接受某事
example_zh: 质疑某事，他的法律团队立刻试图对该决定提出质疑。

definition: difficult in an interesting way that tests your ability
example: challenging work/questions/problems
definition_zh: 以一种有趣的方式艰难，考验你的能力
example_zh: 具有挑战性的工作/问题/问题

definition: a hall in a public building that is used for formal meetings
example: The members left the council chamber.
definition_zh: 公共建筑中的一个用于正式会议的大厅
example_zh: 议员们离开了议会厅。

definition: a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, especially in a sport
example: the world/European/national/Olympic champion
definition_zh: 一个赢得比赛的人、团队等，尤其是在某项运动中
example_zh: 世界/欧洲/国家/奥运冠军

definition: a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport
example: the National Basketball Association Championship
definition_zh: 一项旨在寻找某项运动中最佳球员或球队的比赛
example_zh: 国家篮球协会冠军赛

definition: a possibility of something happening, especially something that you want
example: chance of doing something, She only has a slim chance of passing the exam.
definition_zh: 有可能发生某件事，尤其是你想要的事
example_zh: 做点什么的机会，她通过考试的机会微乎其微。

definition: the act or result of something becoming different
example: change in something, We're hoping for a change in the weather.
definition_zh: 某件事变得不同时的行为或结果
example_zh: 某种变化，我们希望天气能有所变化。

definition: to become different
example: Rick hasn't changed. He looks exactly the same as he did at school.
definition_zh: 变得与众不同
example_zh: 瑞克一点都没变。他看起来和在学校时一模一样。

definition: a television station
example: a television/TV channel
definition_zh: 一家电视台
example_zh: 一个电视/电视频道

definition: a complete lack of order
example: economic/political/domestic chaos
definition_zh: 完全缺乏秩序
example_zh: 经济/政治/国内混乱

definition: a separate section of a book, usually with a number or title
