example: I went to see a debt counsellor and she agreed to come to the bank with me.
definition_zh: 一个受过培训，能够为有问题的人，尤其是个人问题提供建议的人
example_zh: 我去找了债务顾问，她同意陪我去银行。

definition: an act of counting to find the total number of somebody/something
example: If the election result is close, there will be a second count.
definition_zh: 通过计数来计算某个人/某物的总数
example_zh: 如果选举结果接近，将进行第二次计票。

definition: to say numbers in the correct order
example: Billy can't count yet.
definition_zh: 按正确顺序说数字
example_zh: 比利还不会数。

definition: a long flat surface over which goods are sold or business is done in a shop, bank, etc.
example: behind the counter, I asked the woman behind the counter if they had any postcards.
definition_zh: 一条长而平坦的表面，货物被出售或在商店、银行等场所开展业务。
example_zh: 柜台后面，我问柜台后面的女士有没有明信片。

definition: to reply to somebody by trying to prove that what they said is not true
example: counter somebody/something, Such arguments are not easily countered.
definition_zh: 试图证明某人说的不是真的来回应
example_zh: 反驳某人或某物，这样的论点并不容易被反驳。

definition: a person or thing that has the same position or function as somebody/something else in a different place or situation
example: The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.
definition_zh: 一个与某个人或某物在不同地点或情境中拥有相同位置或功能的人或事物
example_zh: 外交部长与中国对口部长进行了会谈。

definition: very many; too many to be counted or mentioned
example: I've warned her countless times.
definition_zh: 非常多;多得数不过来，也无法一一提及
example_zh: 我已经警告过她无数次了。

definition: an area of land that has or used to have its own government and laws
example: European countries
definition_zh: 一块曾经拥有或曾经拥有自己政府和法律的土地
example_zh: 欧洲国家

definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, etc.
example: The surrounding countryside is windswept and rocky.
definition_zh: 城镇外的土地，包括田地、树林等。
example_zh: 周围的乡村风吹拂，岩石丛生。

definition: one of a number of areas that some countries are divided into, each with its own local government
example: rural counties west of the Mississippi
definition_zh: 这是一些国家划分为多个区域之一，每个地区都有自己的地方政府
example_zh: 密西西比河以西的农村县

definition: a sudden change of government that is illegal and often violent
example: He seized power in a military coup in 2008.
definition_zh: 一种突然的政府更迭，而且这种更迭是非法且常常带有暴力的
example_zh: 他于2008年通过军事政变夺取政权。

definition: two people or things
example: I saw a couple of men get out.
definition_zh: 两个人或两个人
example_zh: 我看到有几个男人出来了。

definition: the ability to do something dangerous, or to face pain or opposition, without showing fear
example: He showed great courage and determination.
definition_zh: 能够做出危险的事情，或者面对痛苦或反对，而不表现出恐惧
example_zh: 他展现了极大的勇气和决心。

definition: a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject
example: a French/chemistry course
definition_zh: 关于特定主题的一系列课程或讲座
example_zh: 法语/化学课程

definition: the place where legal trials take place and where crimes, etc. are judged
example: the civil/criminal courts
definition_zh: 法律审判进行的地方，以及犯罪等案件被审判的地方
example_zh: 民事/刑事法院

definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
example: I was treated with the utmost courtesy by the staff.
definition_zh: 体现尊重他人的礼貌行为
example_zh: 工作人员对我极为礼貌。

definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
example: She's my cousin.
definition_zh: 你姑姑或叔叔的孩子
example_zh: 她是我表妹。

definition: a thing that is put over or on another thing, usually to protect it or to decorate it
example: Brighten up your room with some colourful cushion covers.
definition_zh: 一种覆盖在别的东西上或覆盖在其他东西上的东西，通常是为了保护它或装饰它
example_zh: 用色彩丰富的靠垫套点亮你的房间。

definition: to place something over or in front of something in order to hide, protect or decorate it
example: cover something with something, Cover the chicken loosely with foil.
definition_zh: 将某物放在某物之上或前面，以隐藏、保护或装饰它
example_zh: 用东西盖上，用锡纸松松地把鸡盖住。

definition: the reporting of news and sport in the media
example: media/newspaper/press coverage
definition_zh: 媒体中的新闻与体育报道
example_zh: 媒体/报纸/媒体报道

definition: having a layer or amount of something on it
example: His face was covered in blood.
definition_zh: 在上面有一层或一定量的某物
example_zh: 他的脸上满是鲜血。

definition: a large animal kept on farms to produce milk or beef
example: to milk a cow
definition_zh: 一种大型动物，用于农场生产牛奶或牛肉
example_zh: 挤牛奶

definition: a line on the surface of something where it has broken but not split into separate parts
example: This cup has a crack in it.
definition_zh: 物体表面的一条线，断裂但未分裂成多个部分
example_zh: 这个杯子有裂缝。

definition: to break without dividing into separate parts; to break something in this way
example: The ice cracked as I stepped onto it.
definition_zh: 在不分裂成独立部分的情况下，能够破碎;以这种方式破碎某物
example_zh: 我踩上去时，冰面发出裂响。

definition: an activity involving a special skill at making things with your hands
example: traditional crafts like basket-weaving
definition_zh: 一项需要用手制作物品的特殊技能的活动
example_zh: 传统手工艺如编篮

definition: to make something using special skills, especially with your hands
example: be crafted (from something), All the furniture is crafted from natural materials.
definition_zh: 用特殊技能，尤其是用双手，做出东西
example_zh: 由某种材料制作，所有家具均采用天然材料制作。

definition: an accident in which a vehicle hits something, for example another vehicle, usually causing damage and often injuring or killing the passengers
example: a car/plane crash
definition_zh: 车辆撞击某物（例如另一辆车）的事故，通常造成损害，且常常导致乘客受伤甚至死亡
example_zh: 一场汽车/飞机失事

definition: if a vehicle crashes or the driver crashes it, it hits an object or another vehicle, causing damage
example: I was terrified that the plane would crash.
definition_zh: 如果车辆发生碰撞，或驾驶员撞上了车辆，车辆会撞上物体或其他车辆，造成损害
example_zh: 我当时非常害怕飞机会坠毁。

definition: to move forward on your hands and knees or with your body close to the ground
example: Our baby is just starting to crawl.
definition_zh: 用手膝着地或身体贴近地面向前移动
example_zh: 我们的宝宝才刚开始爬行。

definition: not sensible; stupid
example: Are you crazy? We could get killed doing that.
definition_zh: 不讲理;愚蠢
example_zh: 你疯了吗？我们这么做可能会被杀。

definition: between yellow and white in colour
example: a cream linen suit
definition_zh: 颜色介于黄色和白色之间
example_zh: 奶油色亚麻西装

definition: the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid that rises to the top of milk, used in cooking or as a type of sauce to put on fruit, etc.
example: We had strawberries and cream for dessert.
definition_zh: 那种浓稠的白色或淡黄色脂肪液体，会浮到牛奶表面，用于烹饪或作为水果酱料等。
example_zh: 我们点了草莓奶油作为甜点。

definition: to make something happen or exist
example: Scientists disagree about how the universe was created.
definition_zh: 让某件事发生或存在
example_zh: 科学家们对宇宙是如何被创造的存在不一的。

definition: the act or process of making something that is new, or of causing something to exist that did not exist before
example: Job creation needs to be the top priority.
definition_zh: 创造新事物的行为或过程，或促使某种此前不存在的东西存在
example_zh: 创造就业必须成为首要任务。

definition: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce something new or a work of art
example: a course on creative writing (= writing stories, plays and poems)
definition_zh: 运用技巧和想象力来创造出新事物或艺术作品
example_zh: 一门创意写作课程（=写故事、戏剧和诗歌）

definition: the use of skill and imagination to produce something new or to produce art
example: Creativity and originality are more important than technical skill.
definition_zh: 运用技巧和想象力创造新事物或创作艺术
example_zh: 创造力和原创性比技术技能更重要。

definition: a person who has made or invented a particular thing
example: Walt Disney, the creator of Mickey Mouse
definition_zh: 一个创造或发明了某样特定东西的人
example_zh: 沃尔特·迪士尼，米老鼠的创作者

definition: a living thing, real or imaginary, that can move around, such as an animal
example: respect for all living creatures
definition_zh: 一种活着的存在，无论是真实的还是想象中的，能够移动的，比如动物
example_zh: 尊重所有生物

definition: the quality that somebody/something has that makes people believe or trust them
example: to gain/lack/lose credibility
definition_zh: 某人或某物所具备的品质，让人们相信或信任他们
example_zh: 获得/缺乏/失去信誉

definition: that can be believed or trusted
example: a credible explanation/witness
definition_zh: 可以相信或值得信赖的
example_zh: 可信的解释/证人

definition: an arrangement that you make, with a shop for example, to pay later for something you buy
example: to get credit
definition_zh: 比如你和商店达成的协议，之后为购买的东西付款
example_zh: 为了获得认可

definition: to add an amount of money to somebody’s bank account
example: credit something, They credited my account two days later.
definition_zh: 向某人的银行账户充值一笔钱
example_zh: 记账了，他们两天后就把我的账户记入账了。

definition: to move slowly, quietly and carefully, because you do not want to be seen or heard
example: I crept up the stairs, trying not to wake my parents.
definition_zh: 动作缓慢、安静、小心翼翼，因为你不想被看见或听见
example_zh: 我悄悄上楼，尽量不吵醒父母。

definition: all the people working on a ship, plane, etc.
example: crew members
definition_zh: 所有在船、飞机等上工作的人。
example_zh: 机组成员

definition: activities that involve breaking the law
example: This month's figures show an increase in violent crime.
definition_zh: 涉及违法的活动
example_zh: 本月的数据显示暴力犯罪有所上升。

definition: connected with or involving crime
example: criminal offences/activities
definition_zh: 与犯罪有关或涉及犯罪
example_zh: 犯罪/活动

definition: a person who commits a crime
example: a convicted criminal
definition_zh: 犯罪者
example_zh: 一名被定罪的罪犯

definition: a time of great danger, difficulty or doubt when problems must be solved or important decisions must be made
example: an economic/a financial crisis
definition_zh: 这是一个充满巨大危险、困难或疑虑的时期，必须解决问题或做出重要决定
example_zh: 经济/金融危机

definition: a standard or principle by which something is judged, or with the help of which a decision is made
example: The main criterion is value for money.
definition_zh: 一种用来评判某事的标准或原则，或是在作出决策的帮助下作出的
example_zh: 主要标准是性价比。

definition: a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, music, etc.
example: a film/an art/a music critic
definition_zh: 一个会对书籍、音乐等优点和缺点发表看法的人。
example_zh: 一部电影/艺术/一位音乐评论家

definition: saying what you think is bad about somebody/something
example: You should just ignore any critical comments.
definition_zh: 说出你认为某人/某事不好的地方
example_zh: 你应该忽略任何批评性评论。

definition: in a way that says what you think is bad about somebody/something
example: She spoke critically of her father.
definition_zh: 以一种表达你对某人或某事不好的看法的方式
example_zh: 她对父亲持批评态度。

definition: the act of expressing disapproval of somebody/something and opinions about their faults or bad qualities; a statement showing this disapproval
example: to draw/face/receive criticism
definition_zh: 表达对某人/某事的不满以及对其缺点或不良品质的看法的行为;表达这种不赞同的陈述
example_zh: 画/面对/接受批评

definition: to say that you think somebody/something is bad; to say what you do not like or think is wrong about somebody/something
example: All you ever do is criticize!
definition_zh: 说你认为某人/某事不好;说你不喜欢或认为某人/某事不对的地方
example_zh: 你整天只会批评！

definition: a piece of written criticism of a set of ideas, a work of art, etc.
example: She wrote a feminist critique of Freud's theories.
definition_zh: 一篇对一组观点的书面批评、一件艺术作品等等。
example_zh: 她写了一篇女性主义的弗洛伊德理论批判。

definition: a plant that is grown in large quantities, especially as food
example: Sugar is an important crop on the island.
definition_zh: 一种大量种植的植物，尤其是作为食用
example_zh: 糖是岛上的重要作物。

definition: a mark or an object formed by two lines crossing each other (X or +); the mark (X) is often used on paper to show something
example: I've put a cross on the map to show where the hotel is.
definition_zh: 标记或由两条交叉线条形成的物体（X或+）;标记（X）常用于纸张上展示某物
example_zh: 我在地图上画了一个十字，标示酒店的位置。

definition: to go across; to pass or stretch from one side to the other
example: As soon as traffic slowed down enough to safely cross, I started walking.
definition_zh: 穿越;从一侧延伸到另一侧
example_zh: 一旦交通缓慢到可以安全过马路，我就开始走路。

definition: a large number of people gathered together in a public place, for example in the streets or at a sports game
example: He pushed his way through the crowd.
definition_zh: 大量人群聚集在公共场所，比如街头或体育比赛现场
example_zh: 他挤过人群。

definition: having a lot of people or too many people
example: We made our way through the crowded streets.
definition_zh: 人太多，或者人太多
example_zh: 我们穿过拥挤的街道。

definition: an object in the shape of a circle, usually made of gold and precious stones, that a king or queen wears on his or her head on official occasions
example: The crown was placed upon the new monarch's head.
definition_zh: 一种圆形的物品，通常由黄金和宝石制成，国王或王后在官方场合佩戴于头上
example_zh: 王冠被戴在新君主的头上。

definition: extremely important, because it will affect other things
example: The next few weeks are going to be crucial.
definition_zh: 极其重要，因为这会影响其他方面
example_zh: 接下来的几周将至关重要。

definition: in its natural state, before it has been processed or refined
example: crude oil/metal
definition_zh: 在加工或精炼之前的天然状态
example_zh: 原油/金属

definition: having a desire to cause physical or mental pain and make somebody suffer
example: He was known to be a cruel dictator.
definition_zh: 想要造成身体或精神上的痛苦，并让他人受苦
example_zh: 他以残忍的独裁者著称。

definition: a journey by sea, visiting different places, especially as a holiday
example: I'd love to go on a round-the-world cruise.
definition_zh: 一次海上之旅，参观不同地方，尤其是度假时
example_zh: 我很想去环球游轮。

definition: to travel in a ship or boat visiting different places, especially as a holiday
example: (+ adv./prep.), They cruised down the Nile.
definition_zh: 乘坐船只旅行，访问不同地方，尤其是度假时
example_zh: （+副词/介词），他们顺尼罗河巡游。

definition: to press something so hard that it is damaged or injured, or loses its shape
example: The car was completely crushed under the truck.
definition_zh: 将某样东西按得太用力，以至于它受损、受伤或失去形状
example_zh: 车被卡车完全压扁了。

definition: a loud sound without words that expresses a strong feeling
example: cry of something, to give a cry of anguish/despair/pain/joy/alarm, etc.
definition_zh: 一种无言的响亮声音，表达强烈的情感
example_zh: 比如喊出痛苦、绝望、痛苦、喜悦、警报等的哭声。

definition: to produce tears from your eyes because you are unhappy or hurt
example: It's all right. Don't cry.
definition_zh: 因为你不开心或受伤，眼里流泪
example_zh: 没事的。别哭。

definition: a small piece of a substance with many even sides, that is formed naturally when the substance becomes solid
example: ice/salt crystals
definition_zh: 一小块具有许多均匀面的物质，当物质变成固体时自然形成
example_zh: 冰/盐晶体

definition: an action or event that is a signal for somebody to do something
example: cue (for something), Jon's arrival was a cue for more champagne.
definition_zh: 一个行为或事件，作为某人采取行动的信号
example_zh: 某事的信号，乔恩的到来是再开香槟的信号。

definition: very popular with a particular group of people
example: a cult movie/book
definition_zh: 在特定群体中非常受欢迎
example_zh: 一部邪典电影/书籍

definition: a way of life, an attitude, an idea, etc. that has become very popular
example: the cult of physical fitness
definition_zh: 一种生活方式、一种态度、一种理念等等，已经非常流行
example_zh: 对身体健康的崇拜

definition: to prepare and use land for growing plants or crops
example: The land around here has never been cultivated.
definition_zh: 为种植植物或作物准备和利用土地
example_zh: 这附近的土地从未被耕种过。

definition: connected with the culture of a particular society or group, its customs, beliefs, etc.
example: Teachers need to be aware of cultural differences.
definition_zh: 与特定社会或群体的文化、习俗、信仰等相关。
example_zh: 教师需要意识到文化差异。

definition: the customs and beliefs, art, way of life and social organization of a particular country or group
example: African/American/European/Islamic culture
definition_zh: 特定国家或群体的风俗与信仰、艺术、生活方式及社会组织
example_zh: 非洲/美国/欧洲/伊斯兰文化

definition: a small container that is like a bowl in shape, usually with a handle, used for drinking tea, coffee, etc.
example: He filled the cup with water.
definition_zh: 一个形状类似碗的小容器，通常带有手柄，用于喝茶、咖啡等。
example_zh: 他往杯子里倒满了水。

definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing dishes, food, clothes, etc.
example: kitchen cupboards
definition_zh: 一件带有门和架子的家具，用来存放餐具、食物、衣物等。
example_zh: 厨房橱柜

definition: a medicine or medical treatment that cures an illness
example: cure for something, the search for a cure for cancer
definition_zh: 一种能够治愈疾病的药物或医疗治疗
example_zh: 治愈某物，寻找治愈癌症的方法

definition: to make a person or an animal healthy again after an illness
example: cure somebody, Will you be able to cure him, Doctor?
definition_zh: 使一个人或动物在疾病后重新健康
example_zh: 治好某人，你能治好他吗，医生？

definition: a strong desire to know about something
example: Children show curiosity about everything.
definition_zh: 强烈的渴望去了解某件事
example_zh: 孩子们对一切都表现出好奇。

definition: having a strong desire to know about something
example: He is such a curious boy, always asking questions.
definition_zh: 强烈渴望了解某件事
example_zh: 他是个好奇的孩子，总是爱问问题。

definition: having a lot of curls or a curved shape
example: long curly hair
definition_zh: 卷发多或曲线型
example_zh: 长卷发

definition: the system of money that a country uses
example: trading in foreign currencies
definition_zh: 一个国家使用的货币体系
example_zh: 外币交易

definition: happening now; of the present time
example: The necklace would be worth over $5 000 at current prices.
definition_zh: 正在发生的事;属于当下
example_zh: 按当前价格，这条项链价值超过5000美元。

definition: the movement of water in the sea or a river; the movement of air in a particular direction
example: with the current, It's easier to go with the current.
definition_zh: 海洋或河流中水的运动;空气向特定方向的运动
example_zh: 顺着水流走会更容易。

definition: at the present time
example: The hourly charge is currently £35.
definition_zh: 目前
example_zh: 目前按小时收费为35英镑。

definition: the subjects that are included in a course of study or taught in a school, college, etc.
example: The school curriculum should be as broad as possible.
definition_zh: 涵盖在学习课程中或在学校、学院等机构教授的科目。
example_zh: 学校课程应尽可能广泛。

definition: a piece of cloth that is hung to cover a window
example: to draw/pull/close the curtains (= to pull them across the window so they cover it)
definition_zh: 一块挂在窗户上用来遮盖的布
example_zh: 拉上/拉下/拉上窗帘（=把窗帘拉到窗户上，遮住窗户）

definition: a line or surface that bends gradually; a smooth bend
example: curve of something, He admired the delicate curve of her ear.
definition_zh: 一条逐渐弯曲的线或曲面;平滑的弯曲
example_zh: 某种弧度，他欣赏着她耳朵那细腻的曲线。

definition: to move or make something move in the shape of a curve; to be in the shape of a curve
example: a curving staircase
definition_zh: 移动或使物体以曲线形状运动;以曲线形状移动
example_zh: 一条弯曲的楼梯

definition: having a round shape
example: a curved edge/surface
definition_zh: 具有圆形
example_zh: 弯曲的边缘/表面

definition: the legal right or duty to take care of or keep somebody/something; the act of taking care of something/somebody
example: Who will have custody of the children?
definition_zh: 照顾或留住某人/某物的法律权利或义务;照顾某物/某人的行为
example_zh: 谁将拥有孩子的监护权？

definition: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community
example: It's a local custom.
definition_zh: 一种社会或社区中被接受的行为方式或做事方式
example_zh: 这是当地的习俗。

definition: a person or an organization that buys goods or services from a shop or business
example: marketing strategies to target potential customers
definition_zh: 从商店或企业购买商品或服务的个人或组织
example_zh: 针对潜在客户的营销策略

definition: a wound caused by something sharp
example: cuts and bruises on the face
definition_zh: 一道被尖锐物造成伤口的伤口
example_zh: 脸上的割伤和淤青

definition: to make an opening or a wound in something, especially with a sharp tool such as a knife or scissors
example: cut something, She cut her finger on a piece of glass.
definition_zh: 用刀或剪刀等锋利工具在某物上开口或割伤
example_zh: 割伤了什么，她手指被玻璃割伤了。

definition: pretty and attractive
example: a cute little baby
definition_zh: 漂亮又有魅力
example_zh: 一个可爱的小宝宝

definition: an article or a story that you cut from a newspaper or magazine and keep
example: newspaper/press cuttings
definition_zh: 一篇文章或故事，你从报纸或杂志剪下来并保留下来
example_zh: 报纸/报纸剪报

definition: a bicycle or motorcycle
example: He was riding his cycle home when he was hit by a lorry.
definition_zh: 自行车或摩托车
example_zh: 他当时骑自行车回家时被一辆卡车撞了。

definition: to ride a bicycle; to travel by bicycle
example: measures to encourage more people to cycle
definition_zh: 骑自行车;骑自行车旅行
example_zh: 鼓励更多人骑行的措施

definition: believing that people only do things to help themselves rather than for good or honest reasons
example: a cynical view/smile
definition_zh: 相信人们做事只是为了帮助自己，而不是出于善意或诚实的理由
example_zh: 一种愤世嫉俗的观点/微笑

definition: father
example: That's my dad over there.
definition_zh: 父亲
example_zh: 那边是我爸爸。

definition: happening, done or produced every day
example: Many people still read a daily newspaper.
definition_zh: 每天都在发生、正在进行或制作
example_zh: 许多人仍然阅读每日报纸。

definition: every day
example: The machines are inspected twice daily.
definition_zh: 每天
example_zh: 这些机器每天接受两次检查。

definition: made from milk
example: dairy products/produce
definition_zh: 由牛奶制成
example_zh: 乳制品/农产品

definition: milk, cheese and other milk products
example: The doctor told me to eat less red meat and dairy.
definition_zh: 牛奶、奶酪及其他乳制品
example_zh: 医生让我少吃红肉和乳制品。

definition: a barrier that is built across a river in order to stop the water from flowing, used especially to make a reservoir (= a lake for storing water) or to produce electricity
example: the Narmada dam in India
definition_zh: 一种横跨河流、用于阻挡水流的屏障，特别用于建造水库（=用于蓄水的湖泊）或发电
example_zh: 印度的纳尔马达大坝

definition: physical harm caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful or valuable
example: serious/severe damage
definition_zh: 对某物造成的物理伤害，使其变得不那么有吸引力、不那么有用或不够有价值
example_zh: 严重/严重损伤

definition: to have a bad or harmful effect on something/somebody
example: The church was badly damaged by the 1997 earthquake.
definition_zh: 对某事或某人产生不良或有害的影响
example_zh: 教堂在1997年的地震中遭受严重破坏。

definition: causing damage; having a bad effect on somebody/something
example: damaging consequences/effects
definition_zh: 造成损害;对某人或某物产生不良影响
example_zh: 有害后果/影响

definition: a series of movements and steps that are usually performed to music; a particular example of these movements and steps
example: Do you know any other Latin American dances?
definition_zh: 一系列通常伴随音乐演奏的动作和步伐;这些动作和步伐的一个具体例子
example_zh: 你知道其他拉丁美洲舞蹈吗？

definition: to move your body to the sound and rhythm of music
example: Do you want to dance?
definition_zh: 随着音乐的声音和节奏移动你的身体
example_zh: 你想跳舞吗？

definition: a person who dances or whose job is dancing
example: She's a fantastic dancer.
definition_zh: 一个会跳舞的人，或者其职业是跳舞的人
example_zh: 她是个很棒的舞者。

definition: moving your body to music
example: There was music and dancing till two in the morning.
definition_zh: 随着音乐动动你的身体
example_zh: 一直到凌晨两点，音乐和舞蹈不断。

definition: the possibility of something happening that will injure, harm or kill somebody, or damage or destroy something
example: Danger! Keep Out!
definition_zh: 有可能发生某些事情，从而伤害、杀死某人，或者损坏、摧毁某物
example_zh: 危险！禁止进入！

definition: likely to injure or harm somebody, or to damage or destroy something
example: The situation is extremely dangerous.
definition_zh: 很可能伤害或伤害他人，或损坏或毁坏某物
example_zh: 局势极其危险。

definition: to be brave enough to do something
example: She said it as loudly as she dared.
definition_zh: 勇敢到去做点什么
example_zh: 她尽可能大声地说了这句话。

definition: with no or very little light, especially because it is night
example: a dark room/street/forest/night
definition_zh: 几乎没有光线，尤其是因为现在是夜晚
example_zh: 一个黑暗的房间/街道/森林/夜晚

definition: the lack of light in a place, especially because it is night
example: Are the children afraid of the dark?
definition_zh: 某处缺乏光线，尤其是因为现在是夜晚
example_zh: 孩子们害怕黑暗吗？

definition: the state of being dark, without any light
example: After a few minutes our eyes got used to the darkness.
definition_zh: 黑暗的状态，没有任何光明
example_zh: 几分钟后，我们的眼睛适应了黑暗。

definition: facts or information, especially when examined and used to find out things or to make decisions
example: We collected publicly available data over a 10-day period.
definition_zh: 事实或信息，尤其是经过审查并用于了解或决策时
example_zh: 我们在10天内收集了公开数据。

definition: an organized set of data that is stored in a computer and can be looked at and used in various ways
example: The database is updated monthly.
definition_zh: 一组有序的数据存储在计算机中，可以被查看和以多种方式使用。
example_zh: 数据库每月更新一次。

definition: a particular day of the month, sometimes in a particular year, given in numbers and words
example: ‘What's the date today?’ ‘The 10th.’
definition_zh: 某个月中的某个特定日期，有时是某一年，以数字和文字表示

definition: to write or print the date on something
example: Thank you for your letter dated 24th March.
definition_zh: 在某物上写入或打印日期
example_zh: 感谢您于3月24日的来信。

definition: a person’s female child
example: We have two sons and a daughter.
definition_zh: 某人的女婴
example_zh: 我们有两个儿子和一个女儿。

definition: the time of day when light first appears
example: at dawn, They start work at dawn.
definition_zh: 光线首次出现的时间
example_zh: 黎明时分，他们一大早就开始工作。

definition: a period of 24 hours
example: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Monday.’
definition_zh: 24小时的期间
example_zh: “今天是星期几？”“星期一。”

definition: no longer alive
example: My mother's dead; she died in 2017.
definition_zh: 已不复活着
example_zh: 我母亲去世了;她在2017年去世。

definition: a point in time by which something must be done
example: I prefer to work to a deadline.
definition_zh: 必须采取行动的时间点
example_zh: 我更喜欢按截止日期工作。

definition: causing or likely to cause death
example: a deadly weapon/disease
definition_zh: 导致或可能导致死亡
example_zh: 致命武器/疾病

definition: an agreement, especially in business, on particular conditions for buying or doing something
example: to sign/strike/finalize/close a deal
definition_zh: 特别是在商业领域，关于购买或做某事的具体条件达成协议
example_zh: 签署/罢免/敲定/达成交易

definition: to give cards to each player in a game of cards
example: Whose turn is it to deal?
definition_zh: 在纸牌游戏中，给每位玩家发牌
example_zh: 轮到谁发牌了？

definition: a person whose business is buying and selling a particular product
example: an art/antique dealer
definition_zh: 一个以买卖某一特定产品的业务为业务的人
example_zh: 一位艺术品/古董商

definition: used at the beginning of a letter before the name or title of the person that you are writing to
example: Dear Sir or Madam
definition_zh: 用于信件开头，置于您写信对象姓名或职称之前
example_zh: 尊敬的先生或女士

definition: used in expressions that show that you are surprised, upset, annoyed or worried
example: Oh dear! I think I've lost my purse!
definition_zh: 用于表达你感到惊讶、难过、恼火或担忧的表达
example_zh: 天哪！我想我丢了钱包！

definition: the fact of somebody dying or being killed
example: the anniversary of his wife’s death
definition_zh: 有人死亡或被杀的事实
example_zh: 他妻子去世的周年纪念日

definition: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposite views and then there is often a vote on the issue.
example: the first ever televised presidential debate
definition_zh: 在公开会议或议会中对某一议题进行正式讨论。在辩论中，两位或更多发言人表达了相反的观点，随后通常会对该议题进行表决。
example_zh: 首次电视转播的总统辩论

definition: to discuss something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution
example: debate (something), Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
definition_zh: 在做出决定或寻找解决方案之前，尤其是正式讨论某件事
example_zh: 辩论（某项），政治家们将在本周晚些时候就该法案进行辩论。

definition: pieces of wood, metal, building materials, etc. that are left after something has been destroyed
example: Emergency teams are still clearing the debris from the plane crash.
definition_zh: 木材、金属、建筑材料等，在某物被毁坏后留下的
example_zh: 紧急救援队仍在清理飞机坠毁留下的残骸。

definition: a sum of money that somebody owes
example: to pay/repay a debt
definition_zh: 某人欠的一笔钱
example_zh: 偿还/偿还债务

definition: the first public appearance of a performer or sports player
example: He will make his debut for the first team this week.
definition_zh: 表演者或运动员的首次公开亮相
example_zh: 他本周将首次代表一线队出场。

definition: a period of ten years, especially a continuous period, such as 1910–1919 or 2000–2009
example: the early decades of the nineteenth century
definition_zh: 十年间的时期，尤其是连续的时期，如1910–1919年或2000–2009年
example_zh: 十九世纪早期的几十年

definition: the 12th and last month of the year
example: She was born in December.
definition_zh: 一年中的第十二个月，也是最后一个月
example_zh: 她出生于十二月。

definition: of a good enough standard or quality
example: a decent meal/place to live
definition_zh: 达到足够好的标准或质量
example_zh: 一顿体面的饭菜/适合居住的地方

definition: to think carefully about the different possibilities that are available and choose one of them
example: It's up to you to decide.
definition_zh: 仔细考虑各种可能性，并从中选择一个
example_zh: 决定权在你手里。

definition: a choice or judgement that you make after thinking and talking about what is the best thing to do
example: I think I've made the right decision.
definition_zh: 这是你在思考并讨论什么才是最好的选择后做出的判断
example_zh: 我觉得我做了正确的决定。

definition: the process of deciding about something important, especially in a group of people or in an organization
example: responsibility for decision-making
definition_zh: 对重要事情作出决定的过程，尤其是在一个群体或组织中
example_zh: 决策责任

definition: very important for the final result of a particular situation
example: a decisive factor/victory/battle
definition_zh: 对于特定情况的最终结果非常重要
example_zh: 决定性因素/胜利/战斗

definition: the top outside floor of a ship or boat
example: on deck, I was the only person on deck at that time of night.
definition_zh: 船只或船只的顶层外层
example_zh: 在甲板上，那个时间我是甲板上唯一的人。

definition: an official or formal statement, especially about the plans of a government or an organization; the act of making such a statement
example: to issue/sign a declaration
definition_zh: 官方或正式声明，特别是关于政府或组织计划的声明;发表此类声明的行为
example_zh: 签发/签署声明

definition: to say something officially or publicly
example: declare something, The government has declared a state of emergency.
definition_zh: 以官方或公开方式说话
example_zh: 宣布点什么，政府已经宣布进入紧急状态。

definition: a continuous decrease in the number, value, quality, etc. of something
example: decline in something, There has been a 5 per cent decline in student numbers.
definition_zh: 某物的数量、价值、质量等持续下降
example_zh: 某方面有所下降，学生人数下降了5%。

definition: to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc.
example: Support for the party continues to decline.
definition_zh: 变得更小、更少、更虚弱，等等。
example_zh: 对该党的支持度持续下降。

definition: to make something look more attractive by putting things on it
example: decorate something with something, They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.
definition_zh: 通过在上面放东西让它看起来更有吸引力
example_zh: 用点东西装饰，他们用花和气球装饰房间。

definition: a thing that makes something look more attractive on special occasions
example: Christmas/festive decorations
definition_zh: 一种在特殊场合让某物看起来更有吸引力的东西
example_zh: 圣诞/节日装饰

definition: the process of reducing something; the amount that something is reduced by
example: Sales for May show a decrease compared with the same month last year.
definition_zh: 还原某物的过程;某物被约减的程度
example_zh: 5月份的销售额较去年同期有所下降。

definition: to become smaller in size, number, etc.; to make something smaller in size, number, etc.
example: Donations have decreased significantly over the past few years.
definition_zh: 让某物在尺寸、数量等方面变小;让某物在大小、数量等方面变小。
example_zh: 过去几年，捐款数量大幅减少。

definition: working hard at something because it is very important to you
example: a dedicated teacher
definition_zh: 努力做一件对你来说非常重要的事情
example_zh: 一位敬业的教师

definition: the hard work and effort that somebody puts into an activity or a purpose because they think it is important
example: hard work and dedication
definition_zh: 一个人因为觉得某项活动或目的重要而投入的辛勤工作和努力
example_zh: 勤奋与奉献

definition: a thing that somebody does that is usually very good or very bad
example: It's a stirring tale of heroic deeds.
definition_zh: 一个人做的一件通常非常好或非常糟糕的事情
example_zh: 这是一个关于英雄事迹的激动人心的故事。

definition: to have a particular opinion about somebody/something
example: deem somebody/something + noun, The evening was deemed a great success.
definition_zh: 对某人或某事有特定的看法
example_zh: 认为某人/某物+名词，晚会被认为非常成功。

definition: having a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom
example: a deep hole/well/river
definition_zh: 从顶部或表面到底部之间有较大的距离
example_zh: 一个深坑/井/河流

definition: a long way below the surface of something or a long way inside or into something
example: Dig deeper!
definition_zh: 深藏在某物表面之下，或深深地潜入某物内部或深入某物之中
example_zh: 挖深一点！

definition: very; very much
example: She is deeply religious.
definition_zh: 非常;非常
example_zh: 她非常虔诚。

definition: what happens or appears if you do not make any other choice or change, especially in a computer program
example: The default is fifty lines.
definition_zh: 如果您不做其他选择或更改，尤其是在计算机程序中，会发生什么或出现什么
example_zh: 默认值为五十行。

definition: failure to win or to be successful
example: The party faces defeat in the election.
definition_zh: 未能获胜或未能成功
example_zh: 该党在选举中面临失败。

definition: to win against somebody in a war, competition, sports game, etc.
example: defeat somebody/something, He defeated the champion in three sets.
definition_zh: 在战争、比赛、体育比赛等比赛中赢下别人。
example_zh: 击败某人/某物，他以三盘击败了冠军。

definition: a fault in something or in the way it has been made that means that it is not perfect
example: a defect in the glass
definition_zh: 某样东西或制作方式上的缺陷，意味着它并不完美
example_zh: 玻璃有缺陷

definition: the act of protecting somebody/something from attack, criticism, etc.
example: in defence of somebody/something, soldiers who died in defence of their country
definition_zh: 保护某人或某物免受攻击、批评等行为。
example_zh: 为保卫某人/某物，为保卫国家而牺牲的士兵

definition: to protect somebody/something from attack
example: defend somebody/something, The role of the military is to defend the country.
definition_zh: 保护某人/某物免受攻击
example_zh: 保卫某个人或某物，军队的职责就是保卫国家。

definition: a player who must stop the other team from scoring in games such as football (soccer), hockey, etc.
example: a passionate defender of human rights
definition_zh: 必须在足球、冰球等比赛中阻止对方得分的球员。
example_zh: 一位充满热情的人权捍卫者

definition: protecting somebody/something against attack
example: As a defensive measure he built a series of coastal forts and watchtowers.
definition_zh: 保护某人/某物免受攻击
example_zh: 作为防御措施，他修建了一系列沿海堡垒和瞭望塔。

definition: the state of not having, or not having enough of, something that is essential
example: deficiency (in something), Vitamin deficiency in the diet can cause illness.
definition_zh: 缺乏或不够的状态——某样至关重要的东西
example_zh: 缺乏（某些方面），饮食中的维生素缺乏可能导致疾病。

definition: the amount by which money spent or owed is greater than money earned in a particular period of time
example: a budget/trade deficit
definition_zh: 所花费或欠款超过特定时期内收入的金额
example_zh: 预算/贸易逆差

definition: to say or explain what the meaning of a word or phrase is
example: define something, The term ‘normal’ is difficult to define.
definition_zh: 说或解释一个词或短语的含义
example_zh: 定义一下，“正常”这个词很难定义。

definition: sure or certain; unlikely to change
example: Can you give me a definite answer by tomorrow?
definition_zh: 确定或确定;不太可能改变
example_zh: 你能在明天之前给我一个明确的答复吗？

definition: a way of emphasizing that something is true and that there is no doubt about it
example: I definitely remember sending the letter.
definition_zh: 一种强调某件事真实且毫无疑问的方式
example_zh: 我确实记得寄出了那封信。

definition: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary
example: The dictionary provides clear, simple definitions.
definition_zh: 对单词或短语含义的解释，尤其是在词典中
example_zh: 该词典提供了清晰、简单的定义。

definition: to refuse to obey or show respect for somebody in authority, a law, a rule, etc.
example: I wouldn't have dared to defy my teachers.
definition_zh: 拒绝服从或尊重掌权者、法律、规则等。
example_zh: 我绝不敢违抗老师。

definition: a unit for measuring temperature
example: at… degrees, Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit (32°F) or zero/nought degrees Celsius (0°C).
definition_zh: 一种用于测量温度的装置
example_zh: 在......摄氏度时，水结冰温度为华氏32度（32°F），即摄氏零度/零度（0°C）。

definition: a period of time when somebody/something has to wait because of a problem that makes something slow or late
example: Commuters will face long delays on the roads today.
definition_zh: 指某人或某物因某些问题导致进展缓慢或延迟而不得不等待的一段时间
example_zh: 今天通勤者将在道路上遭遇长时间延误。

definition: to make somebody/something late or force them to do something more slowly
example: My flight was delayed.
definition_zh: 让某人/某事迟到，或者强迫他们做得慢一点
example_zh: 我的航班延误了。

definition: a person who is chosen or elected to represent the views of a group of people and vote and make decisions for them
example: Congress delegates rejected the proposals.
definition_zh: 被选中或选举出来代表一群人的观点，并为他们投票和做出决定的人
example_zh: 国会代表否决了这些提案。

definition: a group of people who represent the views of an organization, a country, etc.
example: the Dutch delegation to the United Nations
definition_zh: 一组代表某个组织、国家等观点的人。
example_zh: 荷兰代表团出席联合国

definition: to remove something that has been written or printed, or that has been stored on a computer
example: Your name has been deleted from the list.
definition_zh: 删除已写入或打印的或存储在计算机上的内容
example_zh: 你的名字已被从名单中删除。

definition: done on purpose rather than by accident
example: a deliberate act of vandalism
definition_zh: 这是故意为之，而非偶然
example_zh: 蓄意破坏行为

definition: done in a way that was planned, not by chance
example: She's been deliberately ignoring him all day.
definition_zh: 这是经过精心安排的，绝非偶然
example_zh: 她整天都在故意无视他。

definition: easily damaged or broken
example: delicate china teacups
definition_zh: 容易损坏或断裂
example_zh: 精致瓷茶杯

definition: having a very pleasant taste or smell
example: Who cooked this? It's absolutely delicious.
definition_zh: 味道或气味非常宜人
example_zh: 这是谁做的？绝对美味。

definition: a feeling of great pleasure
example: a feeling of sheer/pure delight
definition_zh: 一种极大的愉悦感
example_zh: 一种纯粹/纯粹的喜悦感

definition: to give somebody a lot of pleasure and joy
example: This news will delight his fans all over the world.
definition_zh: 给别人带来极大的快乐和喜悦
example_zh: 这个消息将令全球粉丝欣喜若狂。

definition: very pleased
example: a delighted smile
definition_zh: 非常高兴
example_zh: 一抹欣喜的微笑

definition: to take goods, letters, etc. to the person or people they have been sent to
example: deliver something, I get my food delivered from the supermarket to save time.
definition_zh: 将货物、信件等送达给被寄送的人
example_zh: 送点东西，我就让超市送餐来省时间。

definition: the act of taking goods, letters, etc. to the people they have been sent to
example: Allow 28 days for delivery.
definition_zh: 将货物、信件等送到收件人手中的行为
example_zh: 请预留28天配送时间。

definition: a very strong request for something; something that somebody needs
example: demand for something, a demand for higher pay
definition_zh: 一个非常强烈的请求;某样东西是某人需要的
example_zh: 对某种需求，对更高薪酬的要求

definition: to make a very strong request for something
example: demand something, They are demanding the release of all political prisoners.
definition_zh: 提出一个非常强烈的请求
example_zh: 要求点什么，他们要求释放所有政治犯。

definition: a system of government in which the people of a country can vote to elect their representatives
example: parliamentary democracy
definition_zh: 一种政府制度，使一个国家的人民可以投票选举其代表
example_zh: 议会民主

definition: controlled by representatives who are elected by the people of a country; connected with this system
example: a democratic country
definition_zh: 由该国人民选举产生的代表控制;与该制度相关
example_zh: 一个民主国家

definition: an evil spirit
example: The people believed the girl was possessed by demons.
definition_zh: 一个邪灵
example_zh: 人们相信女孩被恶魔附身。

definition: to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence
example: demonstrate that…, New research convincingly demonstrates that age-related memory loss is not inevitable.
definition_zh: 通过提供证据或证据，清晰地展示某事
example_zh: 证明......新的研究有力地表明，与年龄相关的记忆丧失并非不可避免。

definition: a public meeting or a march (= an organized walk by many people) at which people show that they are protesting against or supporting somebody/something
example: to take part in/go on a demonstration
definition_zh: 一场公开集会或游行（=由许多人组织的游行），人们在其中表明自己是在抗议或支持某人/某事
example_zh: 参加/参加示威

definition: a statement that something is not true or does not exist; the action of denying something
example: denial (of something), the prisoner’s repeated denials of the charges against him
definition_zh: 一种关于某事不真实或不存在的陈述;否认某事的行为
example_zh: 否认（某事），囚犯一再否认对指控的指控

definition: to strongly criticize somebody/something that you think is wrong, illegal, etc.
example: denounce somebody/something, She publicly denounced the government's handling of the crisis.
definition_zh: 强烈批评你认为错误、违法的某人或某事。
example_zh: 她公开谴责政府对危机的处理方式。

definition: containing a lot of people, things, plants, etc. with little space between them
example: a dense crowd/forest
definition_zh: 里面有很多人、物、植物等等，彼此之间几乎没有空隙
example_zh: 密集的人群/森林

definition: the quality of being dense; the degree to which something is dense
example: The population density in this city is very high.
definition_zh: 稠密的性质;某物稠密的程度
example_zh: 这座城市的人口密度非常高。

definition: a person whose job is to take care of people’s teeth
example: to see/visit/consult your dentist
definition_zh: 一个工作是照顾别人牙齿的人
example_zh: 去看/去/咨询你的牙医

definition: to say that something is not true
example: deny something, to deny an allegation/a charge/an accusation
definition_zh: 说某件事不真实
example_zh: 否认某件事，否认指控/指控/指控

definition: to leave a place, especially to start a trip
example: depart (for…) (from…), Flights for Rome depart from Terminal 3.
definition_zh: 离开一个地方，尤其是开始旅程时
example_zh: 起飞（目的地......）（出发地点......），飞往罗马的航班从3号航站楼起飞。

definition: a section of a large organization such as a government, business, university, etc.
example: department of something, the Department of Health
definition_zh: 大型组织的一个部门，比如政府、企业、大学等。
example_zh: 某某部门，卫生部

definition: an act of leaving a place
example: His sudden departure threw the office into chaos.
definition_zh: 离开一个地方的行为
example_zh: 他的突然离开让办公室陷入混乱。

definition: according to
example: Starting salary varies from £26 000 to £30 500, depending on experience.
definition_zh: 根据
example_zh: 起薪根据经验不同，从26,000英镑到30,500英镑不等。

definition: the state of needing the help and support of somebody/something in order to survive or be successful
example: Our relationship was based on mutual dependence.
definition_zh: 需要某人或某物的帮助和支持才能生存或取得成功的状态
example_zh: 我们的关系建立在相互依赖之上。

definition: needing somebody/something in order to survive or be successful
example: a woman with several dependent children
definition_zh: 需要某个人或某物才能生存或取得成功
example_zh: 一位有几个受抚养子女的女人

definition: to show an image of somebody/something in a picture
example: depict somebody/something (as somebody/something), a painting depicting the Virgin and Child
definition_zh: 在图片中展示某人/某物的图像
example_zh: 描绘某人/某物（以某人/某物身份），描绘圣母与圣婴的画作

definition: to move soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action
example: 2 000 troops were deployed in the area.
definition_zh: 将士兵或武器移动到能够随时准备采取军事行动的位置
example_zh: 该地区部署了2000名部队。

definition: the act of moving soldiers or weapons into a position where they are ready for military action
example: the deployment of peacekeeping forces
definition_zh: 将士兵或武器移动到一个随时准备进行军事行动的位置的行为
example_zh: 维和部队的部署

definition: a sum of money that is given as the first part of a larger payment
example: They normally ask you to pay $100 (as a) deposit.
definition_zh: 作为较大付款的第一部分所支付的金额
example_zh: 他们通常会要求你支付100美元（作为押金）。

definition: to put money into a bank account
example: Millions were deposited in Swiss bank accounts.
definition_zh: 把钱存入银行账户
example_zh: 数百万资金被存入瑞士银行账户。

definition: very sad and without hope
example: You mustn't let yourself get depressed.
definition_zh: 非常悲伤，也绝望
example_zh: 你绝不能让自己沮丧。

definition: making you feel very sad and without enthusiasm
example: a depressing sight/thought/experience
definition_zh: 让你感到非常难过，毫无热情
example_zh: 令人沮丧的景象/想法/经历

definition: a medical condition in which a person feels very sad, anxious and without hope and often has physical symptoms such as being unable to sleep, etc.
example: She was diagnosed as having clinical depression.
definition_zh: 这是一种医学状况，患者感到非常悲伤、焦虑且绝望，且常伴有诸如无法入睡等身体症状。
example_zh: 她被诊断为临床抑郁症。

definition: to prevent somebody from having or using something important
example: The children were deprived of a proper education.
definition_zh: 以防止某人拥有或使用重要物品
example_zh: 孩子们被剥夺了正规教育的机会。

definition: the distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something; a particular distance down from the surface of something
example: depth of something, What's the depth of the water here?
definition_zh: 物体顶部或表面到底部的距离;距离物体表面的特定距离
example_zh: 什么东西的深度，这里的水有多深？

definition: a person who is the next most important person below a business manager, a head of a school, a political leader, etc. and who does that person’s job when they are away
example: I'm acting as deputy till the manager returns.
definition_zh: 地位仅次于企业经理、学校负责人或政治领袖等，并在其不在时代理其工作的人
example_zh: 我暂时当副手，直到经理回来。

definition: to obtain something from a particular source
example: Many English words derive from Latin.
definition_zh: 从特定来源获取某物
example_zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语。

definition: to come or go down from a higher to a lower level
example: The plane began to descend.
definition_zh: 从高层级到低层级的来往下
example_zh: 飞机开始下降。

definition: an action of coming or going down
example: The plane began its descent to Heathrow.
definition_zh: 来或下去的动作
example_zh: 飞机开始下降，飞往希思罗机场。

definition: to say what somebody/something is like
example: describe somebody/something, The next section describes our findings in detail.
definition_zh: 说出某人/某物是什么样的
example_zh: 描述某人/某物，下一部分将详细描述我们的发现。

definition: a piece of writing or speech that says what somebody/something is like; the act of writing or saying in words what somebody/something is like
example: Follow the link below for a more detailed description.
definition_zh: 一段文字或演讲，用来说明某个人/某物是什么样的;用文字写下或表达某个人/某物是什么样的行为
example_zh: 点击下方链接获取更详细的描述。

definition: a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand.
example: the Sahara Desert
definition_zh: 一大片水资源极少、植物稀少的土地。许多沙漠被沙覆盖。
example_zh: 撒哈拉沙漠

definition: to leave somebody without help or support
example: She was deserted by her husband.
definition_zh: 让某人失去帮助或支持。
example_zh: 她被丈夫抛弃了。

definition: to do something or show qualities that mean a particular reaction, reward or punishment is appropriate
example: deserve something, You deserve a rest after all that hard work.
definition_zh: 做某事或表现出某种品质，从而导致某种反应、奖励或惩罚是合适的
example_zh: 值得拥有点什么，你值得休息，毕竟你辛苦了。

definition: the general arrangement of the different parts of something that is made, such as a building, book, machine, etc.
example: The basic design of the car is very similar to that of earlier models.
definition_zh: 是指所制作物品不同部分的总体布局，比如建筑物、书籍、机器等。
example_zh: 该车的基本设计与早期车型非常相似。

definition: to decide how something will look, work, etc., by drawing plans, making computer models, etc.
example: design something, He designed and built his own house.
definition_zh: 通过绘制平面图、制作计算机模型等方法来决定某样东西的外观、工作方式等。
example_zh: 设计点什么，他设计并建造了自己的房子。

definition: to say officially that somebody/something has a particular character or name; to describe somebody/something in a particular way
example: be designated (as) something, This area has been designated (as) a National Park.
definition_zh: 正式说明某人/某物具有特定的性格或名称;以特定方式描述某人/某物
example_zh: 被指定为某物，该地区已被指定为国家公园。

definition: a person whose job is to decide how things such as clothes, furniture, tools, etc. will look or work by making drawings, plans or patterns
example: one of the country's top fashion designers
definition_zh: 一个工作是通过绘制图纸、计划或图案来决定衣服、家具、工具等物品的外观或工作方式的人
example_zh: 全国顶尖时装设计师之一

definition: that you would like to have or do; worth having or doing
example: She chatted for a few minutes about the qualities she considered desirable in a secretary.
definition_zh: 你想要拥有或去做的事;值得拥有或去做
example_zh: 她聊了几分钟，谈起她认为秘书值得具备的特质。

definition: a strong wish to have or do something
example: He now had enough money to satisfy all his desires.
definition_zh: 强烈想要拥有或去做某件事
example_zh: 他现在有足够的钱满足所有欲望。

definition: to want something; to wish for something
example: desire something, We all desire health and happiness.
definition_zh: 想要某样东西;去许愿
example_zh: 渴望某样东西，我们都渴望健康和幸福。

definition: a piece of furniture like a table, often with drawers (= parts like boxes in it with handles on the front for pulling them open), that you sit at to read, write, work, etc.
example: at a desk, I spend all day sitting at a desk.
definition_zh: 一件家具，比如桌子，通常带有抽屉（=像盒子这样的部件，前面有拉手可以拉开），你坐在那里读书、写作、工作等等。
example_zh: 在办公桌前，我整天都坐在办公桌前。

definition: a screen on a computer that shows the icons of programs and files that can be used
example: desktop icons
definition_zh: 计算机上的屏幕，显示可使用的程序和文件图标
example_zh: 桌面图标

definition: feeling or showing that you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: The prisoners grew increasingly desperate.
definition_zh: 感到或表现出自己几乎没有希望，并且愿意做任何事而不担心对自己或他人的危险
example_zh: 囚犯们的绝望愈发迫切。

definition: in a way that shows you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: She looked desperately around for a weapon.
definition_zh: 以一种表明你几乎没有希望、愿意做任何事而不用担心自己或他人危险的方式
example_zh: 她拼命地四处张望，寻找武器。

definition: used to show that something happened or is true although something else might have happened to prevent it
example: Her voice was shaking despite all her efforts to control it.
definition_zh: 用于表示某件事发生了或为真，尽管可能发生了其他事情以防止它发生
example_zh: 尽管她极力控制，声音依然颤抖。

definition: a place to which somebody/something is going or being sent
example: popular tourist/holiday destinations like the Bahamas
definition_zh: 某人/某物要去或被送往的地方
example_zh: 巴哈马等热门旅游/度假目的地

definition: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc.
example: The building was completely destroyed by fire.
definition_zh: 把某样东西损坏到不存在、不再工作等等。
example_zh: 建筑被大火彻底摧毁。

definition: the act of destroying something; the process of being destroyed
example: the destruction of the rainforests
definition_zh: 摧毁某物的行为;被毁灭的过程
example_zh: 雨林的毁灭

definition: causing destruction or damage
example: The war demonstrated the destructive power of modern weapons.
definition_zh: 造成破坏或损害
example_zh: 这场战争展示了现代武器的毁灭性力量。

definition: a small individual fact or item; a less important fact or item
example: an expedition planned down to the last detail
definition_zh: 一个较小的个别事实或项目;一个较不重要的事实或项目
example_zh: 一场从最后一个细节开始精心规划的远征

definition: to give a list of facts or all the available information about something
example: The brochure details all the hotels in the area and their facilities.
definition_zh: 给出一份事实列表或关于某事的所有可用信息
example_zh: 宣传册详细介绍了该地区所有酒店及其设施。

definition: giving many details and a lot of information; paying great attention to details
example: a detailed description of the events
definition_zh: 提供大量细节和信息;对细节极为关注
example_zh: 对事件的详细描述

definition: to keep somebody in an official place, such as a police station, a prison or a hospital, and prevent them from leaving
example: One man has been detained for questioning.
definition_zh: 将某人关押在官方场所，如警察局、监狱或医院，并防止其离开
example_zh: 一名男子已被拘留接受讯问。

definition: to discover or notice something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.
example: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
definition_zh: 发现或注意到某样东西，尤其是那些不容易看见、听到的东西。
example_zh: 这些检测旨在及早发现疾病。

definition: the process of discovering or noticing something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.; the fact of being discovered or noticed
example: crime prevention and detection
definition_zh: 发现或注意到某物的过程，尤其是那些不容易看到、听到等不容易的东西;被发现或注意到的事实
example_zh: 犯罪预防与侦查

definition: a person, especially a police officer, whose job is to investigate crimes and catch criminals
example: a police/homicide/undercover detective
definition_zh: 一个人，尤其是警察，他的职责是调查犯罪和抓捕罪犯
example_zh: 警察/凶杀组/卧底侦探

definition: the state of being kept in a place, especially a prison, and prevented from leaving
example: They were sentenced to 12 months' detention in a young offender institution.
definition_zh: 被关在一个地方，尤其是监狱里，被禁止离开的状态
example_zh: 他们被判处在少年犯拘留所拘留12个月。

definition: to become worse
example: Her health deteriorated rapidly, and she died shortly afterwards.
definition_zh: 变得更糟
example_zh: 她的健康迅速恶化，不久后去世。

definition: the quality that makes you continue trying to do something even when this is difficult
example: fierce/grim/dogged determination
definition_zh: 这种品质让你即使困难，也坚持尝试做某件事
example_zh: 坚定/坚韧/坚韧的决心

definition: to discover the facts about something; to calculate something exactly
example: determine something, An inquiry was set up to determine the cause of the accident.
definition_zh: 去发现某件事的事实;精确计算某件事
example_zh: 查明点什么，已经成立调查以查明事故原因。

definition: having made a definite decision to do something and not letting anyone prevent you
example: The opposition to her plan made her more determined than ever.
definition_zh: 做出明确决定，不让任何人阻止你
example_zh: 反对她计划的声音让她比以往任何时候都更加坚定。

definition: to completely destroy a place or an area
example: The bomb devastated much of the old part of the city.
definition_zh: 彻底摧毁一个地方或一个区域
example_zh: 炸弹摧毁了城市的大部分老城区。

definition: to gradually grow or become bigger, more advanced, stronger, etc.; to make something do this
example: From birth to age 5, a child's brain develops rapidly.
definition_zh: 逐渐成长或变得更大、更先进、更强大等等;让某样东西做到这一点
example_zh: 从出生到5岁，孩子的大脑发育迅速。

definition: the steady growth of something so that it becomes more advanced, stronger, etc.
example: a baby’s development in the womb
definition_zh: 某样东西的稳定成长，使其变得更先进、更强大等等。
example_zh: 胎儿在子宫内的发育

definition: an object or a piece of equipment that has been designed to do a particular job
example: a tracking/recording/listening device
definition_zh: 一个为执行特定任务而设计的对象或设备
example_zh: 追踪/录音/监听设备

definition: the most powerful evil being
example: belief in the Devil
definition_zh: 最强大的邪恶存在
example_zh: 对魔鬼的信仰

definition: to invent something new or a new way of doing something
example: A new system has been devised to control traffic in the city.
definition_zh: 发明新东西或一种新的做事方式
example_zh: 已经设计出一套新系统来控制城市内的交通。

definition: to give your time or effort to a particular activity or purpose
example: She devotes much of her time to helping others.
definition_zh: 将你的时间或精力投入到某项特定活动或目的上
example_zh: 她将大量时间投入到帮助他人上。

definition: to say exactly what an illness or the cause of a problem is
example: diagnose something, The test is used to diagnose a variety of diseases.
definition_zh: 要准确说明什么是疾病或问题的根源
example_zh: 诊断某件事，这个测试用于诊断各种疾病。

definition: the act of discovering or identifying the exact cause of an illness or a problem
example: a diagnosis of lung cancer
definition_zh: 发现或确定疾病或问题的确切原因的行为
example_zh: 肺癌诊断

definition: a simple drawing using lines to explain where something is, how something works, etc.
example: The results are shown in diagram 2.
definition_zh: 用线条简单地画出某物的位置、如何运作等等。
example_zh: 结果如图2所示。

definition: a conversation in a book, play or film or in language teaching materials
example: Learners are asked to listen to three short dialogues.
definition_zh: 书籍、戏剧、电影或语言教学材料中的对话
example_zh: 学习者被要求聆听三段简短对话。

definition: a clear precious stone of pure carbon, the hardest substance known. Diamonds are used in jewellery and also in industry, especially for cutting glass.
example: a diamond ring/necklace
definition_zh: 一种透明的纯碳宝石，是已知最坚硬的物质。钻石用于珠宝制作，也用于工业，尤其是切割玻璃。
example_zh: 一枚钻戒/项链

definition: a book in which you can write down the experiences you have each day, your private thoughts, etc.
example: Do you keep a diary (= write one regularly)?
definition_zh: 一本可以把你每天经历的经历、私人想法等写下来的书。
example_zh: 你有写日记吗（=定期写）？

definition: to tell somebody what to do, especially in an annoying way
example: dictate something (to somebody), They are in no position to dictate terms (= tell other people what to do).
definition_zh: 告诉别人该做什么，尤其是用一种让人烦躁的方式
example_zh: 对某人口述某事，他们没有资格下定条款（=告诉别人该做什么）。

definition: a political leader who has complete power over a country, especially one who has gained it using military force
example: The country suffered at the hands of a series of military dictators.
definition_zh: 一位对国家拥有完全权力的政治领袖，尤其是通过军事力量获得权力的人
example_zh: 这个国家曾在一系列军事独裁者的手中遭受苦难。

definition: a book or electronic resource that gives a list of the words of a language in alphabetical order and explains what they mean, or gives a word for them in a foreign language
example: a Spanish-English dictionary
definition_zh: 一本按字母顺序列出语言单词并解释其含义的书籍或电子资源，或为该语言提供一个外语单词
example_zh: 西班牙语-英语词典

definition: to stop living
example: My father died suddenly at the age of 48.
definition_zh: 停止活着
example_zh: 我父亲在48岁时突然去世。

definition: the food and drink that you eat and drink regularly
example: to eat a healthy, balanced diet
definition_zh: 你经常吃喝的食物和饮料
example_zh: 吃健康、均衡的饮食

definition: to be different from somebody/something
example: They hold differing views.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物不同
example_zh: 他们持有不同的观点。

definition: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which somebody/something has changed
example: Americans and Brits speak the same language, but there are big cultural differences.
definition_zh: 两个人或事物之间如何不同;某人/某物发生了怎样的变化
example_zh: 美国人和英国人说的是同一种语言，但存在巨大的文化差异。

definition: not the same as somebody/something; not like somebody/something else
example: different from somebody/something, American English is significantly different from British English.
definition_zh: 不像某个人/某物;不像某个人/别的什么
example_zh: 美式英语与某人/某物有显著不同。

definition: to recognize or show that two things are not the same
example: differentiate (between) A and B, It's difficult to differentiate between the two varieties.
definition_zh: 认识或展示两样东西并不相同
example_zh: 区分（区分）A和B，很难区分这两种类型。

definition: in a different way from somebody/something
example: Boys and girls may behave differently.
definition_zh: 以不同于某人/某物的方式
example_zh: 男孩和女孩的行为可能不同。

definition: not easy; needing effort or skill to do or to understand
example: The competition judges were given a very difficult task.
definition_zh: 不容易;需要努力或技巧才能去做或理解
example_zh: 评委们被赋予了一项非常艰巨的任务。

definition: a problem; a thing or situation that causes problems
example: the difficulties of English syntax
definition_zh: 一个问题;一个引发问题的事物或情境
example_zh: 英语句法的困难

definition: to make a hole in the ground or to move soil from one place to another using your hands, a tool or a machine
example: I think I'll do some digging in the garden.
definition_zh: 用手、工具或机器在地上挖个洞，或将土壤从一个地方移到另一个地方
example_zh: 我想我会去花园里挖挖。

definition: using a system of receiving and sending information as a series of the numbers one and zero, showing that an electronic signal is there or is not there
example: a digital camera
definition_zh: 使用由数字一和零组成的接收和发送信息系统，以显示电子信号是否存在
example_zh: 一台数码相机

definition: a calm and serious manner that deserves respect
example: She accepted the criticism with quiet dignity.
definition_zh: 一种冷静而严肃的态度，值得尊重
example_zh: 她以沉默的尊严接受了批评。

definition: a situation that makes problems, often one in which you have to make a very difficult choice between things of equal importance
example: I could see no way of resolving this moral dilemma.
definition_zh: 这种情况会带来问题，往往意味着你不得不在同等重要的事情之间做出非常艰难的选择
example_zh: 我看不出解决这个道德困境的办法。

definition: a measurement in space, for example how high, wide or long something is
example: We measured the dimensions of the kitchen.
definition_zh: 一个空间测量，比如某物有多高、多宽或多长
example_zh: 我们测量了厨房的尺寸。

definition: to become smaller, weaker, etc.; to make something become smaller, weaker, etc.
example: The world's resources are rapidly diminishing.
definition_zh: 变小、变弱等;让某物变小、变弱，等等。
example_zh: 全球资源正在迅速减少。

definition: the main meal of the day, eaten either in the middle of the day or in the evening
example: It's time for dinner.
definition_zh: 一天的主餐，可以在白天中午或傍晚食用
example_zh: 该吃晚饭了。

definition: to put something quickly into a liquid and take it out again
example: dip something (into something), He dipped the brush into the paint.
definition_zh: 快速将某样东西放入液体中，再取出
example_zh: 蘸点什么（进某个东西里），他把画笔浸进颜料里。

definition: a person whose job is to represent his or her country in a foreign country, for example, in an embassy
example: Washington's top diplomat in Havana
definition_zh: 例如，一个职责是代表本国在外国（例如大使馆）的人
example_zh: 华盛顿驻哈瓦那最高外交官

definition: connected with managing relations between countries (= diplomacy)
example: a diplomatic crisis
definition_zh: 与管理国家间关系相关（=外交）
example_zh: 一场外交危机

definition: going in the straightest line between two places without stopping or changing direction
example: the most direct route
definition_zh: 在两个地点之间保持最直线，不停下来也不改变方向
example_zh: 最直接的路线

definition: without stopping or changing direction or vehicle
example: direct to something, We flew direct to Hong Kong.
definition_zh: 无需停车、改变方向或车辆
example_zh: 直飞某处，我们直接飞到香港。

definition: to control or be in charge of somebody/something
example: He was asked to take command and direct operations.
definition_zh: 控制或掌控某人/某物
example_zh: 他被要求接管指挥并指挥作战行动。

definition: the general position a person or thing moves or points towards
example: in the direction of something, They headed in the direction of the village.
definition_zh: 一个人或物体移动或指向的大致位置
example_zh: 朝着某个方向走去，他们朝村子的方向走去。

definition: without stopping or changing direction
example: The path leads directly to the river.
definition_zh: 无需停车或改变方向
example_zh: 这条路直接通向河边。

definition: one of a group of senior managers who run a company
example: a non-executive director
definition_zh: 公司管理层的成员之一
example_zh: 非执行董事

definition: a book or electronic resource containing lists of information, usually in alphabetical order, for example people’s phone numbers or the names and addresses of businesses in a particular area
example: a telephone/trade directory
definition_zh: 一本书或电子资源，包含信息列表，通常按字母顺序排列，例如人们的电话号码或特定地区企业的名称和地址
example_zh: 电话/行业名录

definition: any substance that makes something dirty, for example dust, soil or mud
example: His clothes were covered in dirt.
definition_zh: 任何使某物变脏的物质，例如灰尘、土壤或泥巴
example_zh: 他的衣服全是泥土。

definition: not clean
example: dirty hands/clothes/dishes
definition_zh: 不干净
example_zh: 脏手/脏衣服/碗碟

definition: a physical or mental condition that makes it difficult for somebody to do some things that most other people can do
example: a physical/developmental/intellectual disability
definition_zh: 一种身体或心理状况，使某人难以完成大多数人能完成的某些事情
example_zh: 身体/发育/智力障碍

definition: having a condition that makes it difficult for you to do some things that most other people can do
example: physically/developmentally/intellectually disabled
definition_zh: 有一种状况让你难以完成大多数人能做的事情
example_zh: 身体/发育/智力障碍

definition: something that causes problems and tends to stop somebody/something from succeeding or making progress
example: a serious/severe/significant disadvantage
definition_zh: 会引发问题，并往往阻碍某人或某物成功或取得进展的事
example_zh: 严重/严重/显著劣势

definition: if two people disagree or one person disagrees with another about something, they have a different opinion about it
example: Even friends disagree sometimes.
definition_zh: 如果两个人在某件事上意见不合，或者一个人和另一个人意见不合，他们对此的看法就不同了
example_zh: 即使是朋友有时也会意见不合。

definition: a situation where people have different opinions about something and often argue
example: disagreement (about/on/over/as to something), Disagreement arose about exactly how to plan the show.
definition_zh: 一种人们对某件事有不同看法、经常争吵的情况
example_zh: 分歧（关于/关于某件事），产生了关于如何具体策划这部剧的分歧。

definition: to become impossible to see
example: With that, Matt promptly disappeared.
definition_zh: 变得难以被看见
example_zh: 说完，马特立刻消失了。

definition: to make somebody feel sad because something that they hope for or expect to happen does not happen or is not as good as they hoped
example: disappoint (somebody), Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
definition_zh: 让某人因为他们所期望或期待的事情没有发生，或者没有达到预期而感到难过
example_zh: 令人失望（某人），她取消演唱会的决定注定会让粉丝失望。

definition: upset because something you hoped for has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected
example: The singer has promised to refund any disappointed fans.
definition_zh: 因为你所期望的事情没有发生，或者没有像你预期的那样好、成功等而感到沮丧
example_zh: 这位歌手承诺会为任何失望的粉丝退款。

definition: not as good, successful, etc. as you had hoped; making you feel disappointed
example: a disappointing result/performance/defeat
definition_zh: 没有你期望的那么好、那么成功;让你感到失望
example_zh: 令人失望的结果/表现/失利

definition: the feeling of being sad because something has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected or hoped
example: Book early for the show to avoid disappointment.
definition_zh: 那种因为事情没有发生、没有达到你预期或期望的那样好、成功等而感到难过的感觉
example_zh: 尽早预订演出以避免失望。

definition: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage
example: the world's worst humanitarian disaster
definition_zh: 突发事件，比如非常严重的事故、洪水或火灾，导致大量人员死亡或造成巨大损失
example_zh: 世界上最严重的人道主义灾难

definition: very bad, harmful or unsuccessful
example: a disastrous harvest/fire/result
definition_zh: 非常糟糕、有害或失败
example_zh: 灾难性的收成/火灾/结果

definition: a thin flat round object
example: He wears an identity disc around his neck.
definition_zh: 一个薄而扁平的圆形物体
example_zh: 他脖子上挂着一张身份识别盘。

definition: to get rid of something that you no longer want or need
example: discard somebody/something, The room was littered with discarded newspapers.
definition_zh: 去处理你不再想要或不需要的东西
example_zh: 扔掉某人/某物，房间里散落着被丢弃的报纸。

definition: to give somebody official permission to leave the police or the armed forces; to make somebody leave the police or the armed forces
example: be discharged from something, He was discharged from the army following his injury.
definition_zh: 授予某人正式许可离开警察或武装部队;强制某人离开警察或武装部队
example_zh: 他因伤被退伍。

definition: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled behaviour or situation that is the result of this training
example: The school has a reputation for high standards of discipline.
definition_zh: 训练人们服从规则和命令，若不遵守则予以惩罚;这种训练所导致的受控行为或情境
example_zh: 学校以严格的纪律标准著称。

definition: to give somebody information about something, especially something that was previously secret
example: disclose something (to somebody), The spokesman refused to disclose details of the takeover to the press.
definition_zh: 把某件事，尤其是之前保密的事情，提供给别人
example_zh: 披露某些事情（向某人），发言人拒绝向媒体透露收购的细节。

definition: the act of making something known or public that was previously secret or private
example: the newspaper’s disclosure of defence secrets
definition_zh: 将原本保密或私密的事情公开或公开的行为
example_zh: 报纸披露国防机密

definition: an amount of money that is taken off the usual cost of something
example: to get/offer a discount
definition_zh: 从某项物品通常成本中扣除的金额
example_zh: 获取/提供折扣

definition: to take an amount of money off the usual cost of something; to sell something at a discount
example: be discounted by something, Most of our stock has been discounted by up to 40 per cent.
definition_zh: 从某物的通常成本中扣除一定金额;以折扣价出售某物
example_zh: 被折价了，我们的大部分库存已经折价了多达40%。

definition: to try to prevent something or to prevent somebody from doing something, especially by making it difficult to do or by showing that you do not approve of it
example: discourage (doing) something, a campaign to discourage smoking among teenagers
definition_zh: 试图阻止某事或阻止某人做某事，尤其是通过让事情变得困难或表现出你不赞成
example_zh: 劝阻（做某事）活动，旨在劝阻青少年吸烟

definition: a long and serious treatment or discussion of a subject in speech or writing
example: discourse on something, a discourse on issues of gender and sexuality
definition_zh: 对某一主题的长篇严肃讨论或演讲或写作
example_zh: 关于某件事的讨论，关于性别与性取向问题的讨论

definition: to be the first person to become aware that a particular place or thing exists
example: Cook is credited with discovering Hawaii.
definition_zh: 成为第一个意识到某个特定地方或事物存在的人
example_zh: 库克被认为是发现夏威夷的人。

definition: an act or the process of finding somebody/something, or learning about something that was not known about before
example: Researchers in this field have made some important new discoveries.
definition_zh: 一个行为、寻找某个人/某物的过程，或者了解一些以前不知道的事情
example_zh: 该领域的研究人员取得了一些重要的新发现。

definition: the freedom or power to decide what should be done in a particular situation
example: I'll leave it up to you to use your discretion.
definition_zh: 在特定情况下决定应采取何种行动的自由或权力
example_zh: 我就把判断权交给你了。

definition: the practice of treating somebody or a particular group in society less fairly than others
example: age/racial/gender/sex discrimination (= because of somebody’s age, race or sex)
definition_zh: 在社会中对某人或某一特定群体给予较不公平的待遇
example_zh: 年龄/种族/性别/性别歧视（=因某人的年龄、种族或性别）

definition: to talk about something with somebody, especially in order to decide something
example: discuss something with somebody, Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
definition_zh: 和别人谈论某件事，尤其是在决定某件事之前
example_zh: 和别人讨论点什么，你和别人谈过这个问题吗？

definition: a conversation about somebody/something; the process of discussing somebody/something
example: I discovered something interesting during a family discussion.
definition_zh: 关于某人/某事的对话;讨论某人/某物的过程
example_zh: 我在一次家庭讨论中发现了一件有趣的事。

definition: an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection
example: heart/lung/liver disease
definition_zh: 一种影响人类、动物或植物的疾病，通常由感染引起
example_zh: 心脏/肺/肝疾病

definition: a flat shallow container for cooking food in or serving it from
example: a baking/serving dish
definition_zh: 一个平坦浅的容器，用于烹饪或上菜
example_zh: 一个烘焙/上菜的盘子

definition: not honest; intending to trick people
example: Beware of dishonest traders in the tourist areas.
definition_zh: 不诚实;打算欺骗别人
example_zh: 在旅游区要当心不诚实的商贩。

definition: a thin flat round object
example: Red blood cells are roughly the shape of a disk.
definition_zh: 一个薄而扁平的圆形物体
example_zh: 红细胞大致呈盘状。

definition: a feeling of not liking somebody/something
example: dislike of somebody/something, He did not try to hide his dislike of his boss.
definition_zh: 一种不喜欢某人或某物的感觉
example_zh: 对某人/某物的厌恶，他从不试图掩饰对老板的厌恶。

definition: to not like somebody/something
example: dislike somebody/something, Why do you dislike him so much?
definition_zh: 不喜欢某人/某物
example_zh: 讨厌某人或某事，为什么那么讨厌他？

definition: to decide that somebody/something is not important and not worth thinking or talking about
example: dismiss somebody/something, to dismiss a suggestion/a claim/an idea
definition_zh: 决定某人/某事不重要，不值得思考或讨论
example_zh: 否定某人/某物，以否定一个建议/一个主张/一个想法

definition: the act of dismissing somebody from their job; an example of this
example: He still hopes to win his claim against unfair dismissal.
definition_zh: 解雇某人的行为;一个例子
example_zh: 他仍然希望能赢得对不公平解雇的诉讼。

definition: a condition or illness that causes problems with the way part of the body or brain works
example: a blood/bowel disorder
definition_zh: 一种导致身体或大脑部分功能出现问题的状况或疾病
example_zh: 一种血液/肠道疾病

definition: to take the place of somebody/something
example: be displaced (by somebody/something), Gradually factory workers have been displaced by machines.
definition_zh: 取代某人/某物的位置
example_zh: 被某个人或某物取代，工厂工人逐渐被机器取代。

definition: an arrangement of things in a public place to inform or entertain people or advertise something for sale
example: a beautiful floral display
definition_zh: 在公共场所摆放物品，用来告知或娱乐人们，或宣传出售商品
example_zh: 美丽的花艺展示

definition: to put something in a place where people can see it easily; to show something to people
example: display something, The exhibition gives local artists an opportunity to display their work.
definition_zh: 把东西放在人们容易看到的地方;向人们展示某样东西
example_zh: 展示一些东西，展览为本地艺术家提供了展示作品的机会。

definition: the act of getting rid of something
example: The council is responsible for waste disposal and street cleaning.
definition_zh: 处理掉某样东西的行为
example_zh: 市议会负责垃圾处理和街道清洁工作。

definition: to arrange things or people in a particular way or position
example: The visitors disposed themselves in a circle round the statue.
definition_zh: 以特定方式或位置安排事物或人物
example_zh: 来访者围成一圈围着雕像。

definition: an argument between two people, groups or countries; discussion about a subject on which people disagree
example: industrial/pay disputes
definition_zh: 两个人、团体或国家之间的争论;关于人们意见不合的话题的讨论
example_zh: 工业/薪酬纠纷

definition: to question whether something is true or legally or officially acceptable
example: dispute something, These figures have been disputed.
definition_zh: 质疑某件事是否真实、法律或官方是否可接受
example_zh: 有异议吗？这些数字已经被质疑了。

definition: to make it difficult for something to continue in the normal way
example: Demonstrators succeeded in disrupting the meeting.
definition_zh: 使某事难以正常进行
example_zh: 示威者成功扰乱了会议。

definition: a situation in which it is difficult for something to continue in the normal way; the act of stopping something from continuing in the normal way
example: We aim to help you move house with minimum disruption to yourself.
definition_zh: 一种情况，某件事很难以正常方式继续;阻止某物以正常方式继续的行为
example_zh: 我们的目标是帮助您在对自己影响最小的情况下完成搬家。

definition: to mix with a liquid and become part of it
example: Salt dissolves in water.
definition_zh: 与液体混合并成为其中的一部分
example_zh: 盐会溶解在水里。

definition: the amount of space between two places or things
example: a short/long distance
definition_zh: 两个地方或物体之间的距离
example_zh: 短距离/长距离

definition: far away in space or time
example: the distant sound of music
definition_zh: 遥远的空间或时间
example_zh: 远处传来的音乐声

definition: easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc.
example: There was a distinct smell of gas.
definition_zh: 容易或清晰地听到、看见、感受到等。
example_zh: 空气中弥漫着明显的煤气味。

definition: a clear difference or contrast especially between people or things that are similar or related
example: distinctions between traditional and modern societies
definition_zh: 尤其是相似或相关的人或事物之间的明显差异或对比
example_zh: 传统社会与现代社会的区别

definition: having a quality or characteristic that makes something different and easily noticed
example: clothes with a distinctive style
definition_zh: 拥有一种让某样东西与众不同、容易被注意到的特质或特征
example_zh: 风格独特的服装

definition: to recognize the difference between two people or things
example: distinguish between A and B, At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?
definition_zh: 识别两个人或两个事物之间的区别
example_zh: 区分A和B，孩子什么年龄能分辨对与错？

definition: to change the shape, appearance or sound of something so that it is strange or not clear
example: a fairground mirror that distorts your shape
definition_zh: 改变某物的形状、外观或声音，使其显得奇怪或不清晰
example_zh: 一面扭曲你形状的游乐场镜子

definition: to take somebody’s attention away from what they are trying to do
example: You're distracting me from my work.
definition_zh: 把别人的注意力从他们正在做的事情上转移开
example_zh: 你在分散我对工作的注意力。

definition: a feeling of great worry or unhappiness; great mental pain
example: The newspaper article caused the actor considerable distress.
definition_zh: 极度担忧或不快乐的感觉;巨大的精神痛苦
example_zh: 这篇报纸文章给这位演员带来了极大的痛苦。

definition: to make somebody feel very worried or unhappy
example: distress somebody, It was clear that the letter had deeply distressed her.
definition_zh: 让某人感到非常担心或不开心
example_zh: “让某人难过”，很明显这封信深深地让她痛苦不堪。

definition: to give things to a large number of people; to share something between a number of people
example: distribute something, The leaflets have been widely distributed.
definition_zh: 把东西送给大量人;在多人之间分享某样东西
example_zh: 分发点东西，传单已经广泛散发。

definition: the way that something is spread or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people
example: distribution of something, They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
definition_zh: 某样东西在特定区域或特定群体中传播或存在的方式
example_zh: 某种分布，他们研究了疾病的地理分布。

definition: an area of a country or town, especially one that has particular features
example: the City of London’s financial district
definition_zh: 一个国家或城镇的区域，尤其是具有特殊特征的区域
example_zh: 伦敦金融城金融区

definition: to interrupt somebody when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.
example: I'm sorry to disturb you, but can I talk to you for a moment?
definition_zh: 在别人试图工作、睡觉等时打断他们。
example_zh: 抱歉打扰你，我能和你谈一会儿吗？

definition: making you feel anxious and upset or shocked
example: a disturbing piece of news
definition_zh: 让你感到焦虑、难过或震惊
example_zh: 一条令人不安的消息

definition: a jump into deep water with your head first and your arms in front of you
example: a spectacular high dive (= from high above the water)
definition_zh: 头朝前、双臂前方跳入深水
example_zh: 壮观的高空跳水（= 从水面高处跳水）

definition: to jump into water with your head and arms going in first
example: dive (from/off something) (into something), We dived into the river to cool off.
definition_zh: 跳进水里时，头和手臂先下水
example_zh: 跳进（从某物/从某物上）（进入某物），我们跳进河里降温。

definition: very different from each other and of various kinds
example: People from diverse cultures were invited to the event.
definition_zh: 彼此之间差异很大，种类各异
example_zh: 来自不同文化背景的人们都受邀参加了此次活动。

definition: a range of many people or things that are very different from each other
example: the biological diversity of the rainforests
definition_zh: 由许多彼此截然不同的人或事物组成的范围
example_zh: 雨林的生物多样性

definition: to make somebody/something change direction
example: be diverted, The course of the stream has now been diverted.
definition_zh: 让某人/某物改变方向
example_zh: 被改道，溪流的走向现在已被改道。

definition: a difference between two groups of people or two things that separates them from each other
example: He offered advice on bridging cultural divides.
definition_zh: 两群人之间的差异，或者将他们区分开来的两件事
example_zh: 他提出了弥合文化鸿沟的建议。

definition: to separate into parts; to make something separate into parts
example: The cells began to divide rapidly.
definition_zh: 把东西分成一些部分;让某样东西分成几部分
example_zh: 细胞开始迅速分裂。

definition: coming from or connected with God or a god
example: divine law/love/will
definition_zh: 来自或与上帝或某个上帝相连
example_zh: 神圣的律法/爱/意志

definition: the process or result of dividing into separate parts; the process or result of dividing something or sharing it out
example: The organism begins as a single cell and grows by cell division.
definition_zh: 分割成不同部分的过程或结果;分割或分享某物的过程或结果
example_zh: 该生物最初是一个单细胞，通过细胞分裂而生长。

definition: the legal ending of a marriage
example: The marriage ended in divorce in 1996.
definition_zh: 婚姻的法律终结
example_zh: 这段婚姻于1996年以离婚告终。

definition: to end your marriage to somebody legally
example: They're getting divorced.
definition_zh: 以法律方式结束你与某人的婚姻
example_zh: 他们要离婚了。

definition: no longer married because your marriage has been legally ended
example: My parents are divorced.
definition_zh: 因为你的婚姻已经在法律上结束，所以不再结婚
example_zh: 我父母离婚了。

definition: used to refer to actions that you do not mention by name or do not know about
example: What are you doing this evening?
definition_zh: 用于指代您未提及姓名或不了解的操作
example_zh: 你今晚打算干什么？

definition: used before a full verb to form negative sentences and questions
example: I don't like fish.
definition_zh: 用于在完整动词之前，形成否定句和疑问句
example_zh: 我不喜欢鱼。

definition: a person who has been trained in medical science, whose job is to treat people who are ill or injured
example: You'd better see a doctor about that cough.
definition_zh: 一个接受过医学科学训练的人，他的工作是治疗生病或受伤的人
example_zh: 你最好去看医生，把你的咳嗽处理一下。

definition: a belief or set of beliefs held and taught by a Church, a political party, etc.
example: the doctrine of parliamentary sovereignty
definition_zh: 指教会、政党等所持有和传导的信仰或一套信仰。
example_zh: 议会主权原则

definition: an official paper, book or electronic file that gives information about something, or that can be used as evidence or proof of something
example: Please read and sign the attached document.
definition_zh: 一份官方文件、书籍或电子文件，提供有关某事的信息，或可作为某事的证据或证明
example_zh: 请阅读并签署随附文件。

definition: to record something in the form of a written document, photograph, film, etc.
example: Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.
definition_zh: 以书面文件、照片、胶片等形式记录某物。
example_zh: 十九世纪的城市生活有详尽的记录。

definition: a film or a radio or television programme giving facts about something
example: There were some interesting interviews in the documentary.
definition_zh: 一部电影、一部广播或电视节目，提供关于某事的事实
example_zh: 纪录片里有一些有趣的访谈。

definition: the documents that are required for something, or that give evidence or proof of something
example: I couldn't enter the country because I didn't have all the necessary documentation.
definition_zh: 那些为某事所必需的文件，或者能证明某件事的证据或证明
example_zh: 我无法入境，因为我没有所有必要的证件。

definition: an animal with four legs and a tail, often kept as a pet or trained for work, for example hunting or guarding buildings. There are many types of dog, some of which are wild.
example: I took the dog for a walk.
definition_zh: 一种有四条腿和尾巴的动物，常被饲养或训练用于工作，例如狩猎或守卫建筑物。狗种类繁多，其中一些是野生的。
example_zh: 我带狗去散步了。

definition: the unit of money in the US, Canada, Australia and several other countries
example: You will be paid in American dollars.
definition_zh: 在美国、加拿大、澳大利亚及其他几个国家，货币单位
example_zh: 你将以美元支付报酬。

definition: an area of knowledge or activity; especially one that somebody is responsible for
example: Financial matters are her domain.
definition_zh: 一个知识或活动领域;尤其是那种有人负责的领域
example_zh: 财务事务是她的职责。

definition: of or inside a particular country; not foreign or international
example: domestic affairs/politics
definition_zh: 来自特定国家或在特定国家境内;非外国或国际
example_zh: 国内事务/政治

definition: the fact of being more important, powerful or easy to notice than somebody/something else
example: political/economic dominance
definition_zh: 比起某个人或某物，你更重要、更强大或更容易被注意到
example_zh: 政治/经济主导地位

definition: more important, powerful or easy to notice than other things
example: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.
definition_zh: 比其他事物更重要、更有力量或更容易被注意到
example_zh: 该公司已在全球市场取得了主导地位。

definition: to control or have a lot of influence over somebody/something, especially in an unpleasant way
example: She always says a lot in meetings, but she doesn't dominate.
definition_zh: 控制或对某人/某物产生巨大影响，尤其是以一种令人不快的方式
example_zh: 她在会议上总是说很多话，但她并不主导一切。

definition: to give money, food, clothes, etc. to somebody/something, especially a charity
example: donate something to somebody/something, He donated thousands of pounds to charity.
definition_zh: 把钱、食物、衣服等捐给某人或某物，尤其是慈善机构
