example_zh: 捐赠给某人/某物，他捐了数千英镑给慈善机构。

definition: something that is given to a person or an organization such as a charity, in order to help them; the act of giving something in this way
example: a generous/large/small donation
definition_zh: 为帮助某人或慈善机构而给予某项物品;以这种方式给予某物的行为
example_zh: 慷慨/大额/小额捐赠

definition: a person or an organization that makes a gift of money, clothes, food, etc. to a charity, etc.
example: international aid donors (= countries that give money, etc. to help other countries)
definition_zh: 比如个人或组织向慈善机构捐赠金钱、衣服、食物等。
example_zh: 国际援助捐助方（=为帮助其他国家提供资金等的国家）

definition: a piece of wood, glass, etc. that is opened and closed so that people can get in and out of a room, building, car, etc.; a similar thing in a cupboard
example: Open the door!
definition_zh: 一块木头、玻璃等，可以开合，方便人们进出房间、建筑、汽车等;橱柜里类似的东西
example_zh: 开门！

definition: an amount of a medicine or a drug that is taken once, or regularly over a period of time
example: a high/low/lethal dose
definition_zh: 一种药物或药物的剂量，该剂量在一段时间内一次性或定期服用
example_zh: 高剂量/低剂量/致命剂量

definition: a small round mark, especially one that is printed
example: There are dots above the letters i and j.
definition_zh: 一个小圆的标记，尤其是印刷好的那种
example_zh: 字母 i 和 j 上方有点。

definition: twice as much or as many as usual
example: a double helping
definition_zh: 比平时多一倍或多一倍
example_zh: 双份

definition: in twos or in two parts
example: I thought I was seeing double (= seeing two of something).
definition_zh: 两份或两份
example_zh: 我以为我看到的是双重（=看到两个什么东西）。

definition: twice as much or as many as
example: His income is double hers.
definition_zh: 两倍或等于的数量
example_zh: 他的收入是她的两倍。

definition: a number or amount that is twice as much or as many as another number or amount
example: He gets paid double for doing the same job I do.
definition_zh: 一个比另一个数字或金额多一倍或多的数字或金额
example_zh: 他做和我一样的工作，拿的是双倍工资。

definition: to become, or make something become, twice as much or as many
example: Membership almost doubled in two years.
definition_zh: 成为或让某样东西成为两倍、同样多的数量
example_zh: 两年内会员人数几乎翻了一番。

definition: a feeling of being uncertain about something or not believing something
example: a feeling of doubt and uncertainty
definition_zh: 一种对某件事感到不确定或不相信某事的感觉
example_zh: 一种怀疑和不确定的感觉

definition: to feel uncertain about something; to feel that something is not true, will probably not happen, etc.
example: doubt something, There seems no reason to doubt her story.
definition_zh: 对某件事感到不确定;觉得某件事不真实，可能不会发生，等等。
example_zh: 怀疑点什么，似乎没有理由怀疑她的说法。

definition: to or at a lower place or position
example: She jumped down off the chair.
definition_zh: 去或在较低的位置或位置
example_zh: 她从椅子上跳了下来。

definition: from a high or higher point on something to a lower one
example: The stone rolled down the hill.
definition_zh: 从某物的高点或更高点到低点
example_zh: 石头滚下山坡。

definition: data that is downloaded from another computer system
example: A staggering 99.8 % of digital music downloads are to mobile handsets.
definition_zh: 从另一台计算机系统下载的数据
example_zh: 惊人的数字音乐下载占 99.8% 的移动端。

definition: to get data from another computer, usually using the internet
example: download something, to download files/music/software
definition_zh: 从另一台计算机获取数据，通常通过互联网
example_zh: 下载某个东西，以下载文件/音乐/软件

definition: on a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: a downstairs bathroom
definition_zh: 在你所在的房子或建筑物的一层，尤其是地面层的那层楼上
example_zh: 一楼浴室

definition: down the stairs; on or to a floor of a house or building lower than the one you are on, especially the one at ground level
example: I couldn't sleep so I went downstairs and watched TV.
definition_zh: 下楼梯;在你所在的楼层或建筑物的下一层楼上或楼层，尤其是地面层的楼层
example_zh: 我睡不着，就下楼看电视。

definition: in, towards or typical of the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: a downtown store
definition_zh: 位于城市中心、朝向或典型的市中心，尤其是其主要商业区
example_zh: 市中心商店

definition: in or towards the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: to go/work downtown
definition_zh: 位于城市中心或其主要商业区附近
example_zh: 去市中心工作/上班

definition: the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: a hotel in the heart of downtown
definition_zh: 城市中心，尤其是其主要商业区
example_zh: 市中心的一家酒店

definition: towards the ground; towards a lower place or position
example: She was lying face downwards on the grass.
definition_zh: 朝向地面;朝向较低的位置或位置
example_zh: 她脸朝下躺在草地上。

definition: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: Give me a dozen, please.
definition_zh: 一群十二个同类生物
example_zh: 给我一打，拜托。

definition: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: Give me a dozen, please.
definition_zh: 一群十二个同类生物
example_zh: 给我一打，拜托。

definition: a rough written version of something that is not yet in its final form
example: This is only the first draft of my speech.
definition_zh: 一个尚未最终成形的粗略写作版本
example_zh: 这只是我演讲稿的第一稿。

definition: to write the first rough version of something such as a letter, speech, book or law
example: I'll draft a letter for you.
definition_zh: 写出一本书的初步版本，比如信件、演讲稿、书籍或法律
example_zh: 我帮你起草一封信。

definition: to pull somebody/something along with effort and difficulty
example: drag somebody/something, The sack is too heavy to lift—you’ll have to drag it.
definition_zh: 用努力和困难拉着某人或某物前进
example_zh: 拖着某个人/什么东西，麻袋太重，搬不动——你得拖着它。

definition: to make something empty or dry by removing the liquid from it; to become empty or dry in this way
example: Drain and rinse the pasta.
definition_zh: 通过去除液体使某物空或干;以这种方式变得空或干
example_zh: 将意大利面沥干并冲洗干净。

definition: a play for the theatre, television or radio
example: a costume/period/courtroom/crime drama
definition_zh: 一部为戏剧、电视或广播而作的戏剧
example_zh: 服装/时代/法庭/犯罪剧

definition: sudden, very great and often surprising
example: a dramatic increase/change/improvement/shift
definition_zh: 突然、非常伟大，而且常常令人惊讶
example_zh: 剧烈的增加/变化/改善/转变

definition: very suddenly and to a very great and often surprising degree
example: Prices have fallen dramatically.
definition_zh: 非常突然，而且以一种极其巨大、常常令人惊讶的程度
example_zh: 价格大幅下跌。

definition: to make pictures, or a picture of something, with a pencil, pen or chalk (but not paint)
example: You draw beautifully.
definition_zh: 用铅笔、钢笔或粉笔（但不包括颜料）画画，或者画出某物的图像
example_zh: 你画得真漂亮。

definition: a picture made using a pencil or pen rather than paint
example: a pencil/pen-and-ink/charcoal drawing
definition_zh: 用铅笔或钢笔而非颜料绘制的图片
example_zh: 一幅铅笔/钢笔/炭笔画

definition: a series of images, events and feelings that happen in your mind while you are asleep
example: I had a really weird dream last night.
definition_zh: 一系列在你睡梦中脑海中出现的画面、事件和感受
example_zh: 我昨晚做了一个非常奇怪的梦。

definition: to experience a series of images, events and feelings in your mind while you are asleep
example: Did I talk in my sleep? I must have been dreaming.
definition_zh: 在你睡觉时，在脑海中体验一系列的画面、事件和感受
example_zh: 我睡梦时说话了吗？我一定是在做梦。

definition: a piece of clothing that is made in one piece and hangs down to cover the body as far as the legs, sometimes reaching to below the knees, or to the ankles
example: a long white dress
definition_zh: 一种一体制成、垂挂到身体的衣服，有时甚至垂到膝盖以下，甚至到脚踝
example_zh: 一件长白裙子

definition: to put clothes on yourself/somebody
example: I dressed quickly.
definition_zh: 给自己穿衣服/给别人穿上
example_zh: 我迅速穿好衣服。

definition: wearing clothes and not naked or wearing clothes for sleeping
example: Hurry up and get dressed.
definition_zh: 穿着衣服但不裸体，或穿睡衣
example_zh: 快点穿好衣服。

definition: to move along smoothly and slowly in water or air
example: Clouds drifted across the sky.
definition_zh: 在水中或空气中平稳缓慢地移动
example_zh: 云朵在天空中飘荡。

definition: a liquid for drinking; an amount of a liquid that you drink
example: Can I have a drink?
definition_zh: 一种饮用液体;你喝的液体的量
example_zh: 我可以喝一杯吗？

definition: to take liquid into your mouth and then down your throat into your stomach
example: drink something, I don't drink coffee.
definition_zh: 把液体含入口中，然后顺着喉咙进入胃里
example_zh: 喝点什么，我不喝咖啡。

definition: a journey in a car or other vehicle
example: Let's go for a drive.
definition_zh: 乘坐汽车或其他车辆的旅程
example_zh: 我们去兜风吧。

definition: to operate a vehicle so that it goes in a particular direction
example: Can you drive?
definition_zh: 驾驶车辆使其朝特定方向行驶
example_zh: 你会开车吗？

definition: a person who drives a vehicle
example: a bus/train/taxi driver
definition_zh: 驾驶车辆的人
example_zh: 公交/火车/出租车司机

definition: strong and powerful; having a strong influence in making something happen
example: Who was the driving force (= the person with the strongest influence) in the band?
definition_zh: 强大而有力;在推动某件事发生方面有着强大的影响力
example_zh: 在乐队里，谁是推动力（=影响力最强的人）？

definition: the way that somebody drives a vehicle; the act of driving
example: She was convicted of dangerous driving.
definition_zh: 某人驾驶车辆的方式;驾驶行为
example_zh: 她被判危险驾驶罪。

definition: a very small amount of liquid that forms a round shape
example: The first drops of rain fell.
definition_zh: 极少量液体形成圆形
example_zh: 第一滴雨落下。

definition: to allow something to fall by accident; to fall by accident
example: drop something, Be careful not to drop that plate.
definition_zh: 允许某物偶然坠落;意外坠落
example_zh: 掉点东西，小心别掉盘子。

definition: a long period of time when there is little or no rain
example: Farmers are facing ruin after two years of severe drought.
definition_zh: 一段长时间几乎没有降雨的时期
example_zh: 经过两年严重干旱，农民正面临破产。

definition: to die because you have been underwater too long and you cannot breathe; to kill somebody by holding them underwater
example: Two children drowned after falling into the river.
definition_zh: 因为在水下太久无法呼吸而死;把人按在水下，导致死亡
example_zh: 两名孩子坠入河中溺亡。

definition: an illegal substance that some people smoke, inject, etc. for the physical and mental effects it has
example: He does not smoke or take drugs.
definition_zh: 这是一种非法物质，有些人会吸食、注射等，以引起身体和心理的影响
example_zh: 他不抽烟也不吸毒。

definition: a musical instrument made of a hollow round frame with plastic or skin stretched tightly across one or both ends. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.
example: to play the drum
definition_zh: 一种由中空圆形框架制成的乐器，一端或两端紧绷塑料或皮革。你用鼓棒或手敲击它来演奏它。
example_zh: 打鼓

definition: having drunk so much alcohol that it is impossible to think or speak clearly
example: They were clearly too drunk to drive.
definition_zh: 喝了太多酒，以至于根本无法清晰思考或说话
example_zh: 他们显然醉得不能开车。

definition: not wet or sticky; without water or moisture
example: Is my shirt dry yet?
definition_zh: 不湿也不黏;无水或湿气
example_zh: 我的衬衫干了吗？

definition: to become dry; to make something dry
example: He did the laundry and hung it out to dry.
definition_zh: 变得干燥;让某物变得干燥
example_zh: 他洗完衣服晾了晾干。

definition: having two parts or aspects
example: his dual role as composer and conductor
definition_zh: 具有两个部分或两个方面
example_zh: 他作为作曲家和指挥的双重角色

definition: to give somebody/something a particular name, often in a humorous or critical way
example: The media dubbed anorexia ‘the slimming disease’.
definition_zh: 给某人或某物取一个特定的名字，通常是以幽默或批判的方式
example_zh: 媒体称厌食症为“瘦身病”。

definition: caused by somebody/something; because of somebody/something
example: The team's success was largely due to her efforts.
definition_zh: 由某人/某物引起的;因为某人/某物
example_zh: 球队的成功在很大程度上归功于她的努力。

definition: not interesting or exciting
example: Life in a small town could be deadly dull.
definition_zh: 既不有趣也不令人兴奋
example_zh: 小镇生活有时会无聊得要命。

definition: stupid
example: That was a pretty dumb thing to do.
definition_zh: 愚蠢
example_zh: 那真是个挺蠢的决定。

definition: to get rid of something you do not want, especially in a place that is not suitable
example: Too much toxic waste is being dumped at sea.
definition_zh: 把你不想要的东西扔掉，尤其是在一个不合适的地方
example_zh: 大量有毒废料被倾倒在海上。

definition: two people who perform together or are often seen or thought of together
example: the comedy duo Laurel and Hardy
definition_zh: 两个人一起表演，或者经常被看到或被联想到在一起
example_zh: 喜剧二人组劳莱与哈代

definition: the length of time that something lasts or continues
example: The school was used as a hospital for the duration of the war.
definition_zh: 某件事持续或持续的时间长度
example_zh: 这所学校在整个战争期间一直作为医院使用。

definition: all through a period of time
example: during the 1990s
definition_zh: 在一段时间里
example_zh: 在1990年代

definition: a fine powder that consists of very small pieces of sand, earth, etc.
example: A cloud of dust rose as the truck drove off.
definition_zh: 一种由非常细小的沙粒、泥土等组成的细粉。
example_zh: 卡车驶离时，扬起一团尘土。

definition: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility
example: duty to do something, It is my duty to report it to the police.
definition_zh: 你觉得自己必须做的事，因为这是你的道德或法律责任
example_zh: 有责任做点什么，我有责任向警察报案。

definition: a disk on which large amounts of information, especially films, photographs and video, can be stored, for use on a DVD player or computer (the abbreviation for ‘digital versatile disc’ or ‘digital videodisc’)
example: Let's just stay in and watch a DVD.
definition_zh: 一种可以存储大量信息，尤其是胶片、照片和视频的光盘，用于DVD播放器或计算机（即“数字多功能光盘”或“数字视频光盘”的缩写）
example_zh: 我们就待在家里看个DVD吧。

definition: having a lot of energy and a strong personality
example: a dynamic leader
definition_zh: 精力充沛，性格坚强
example_zh: 一位充满活力的领导者

definition: the way in which people or things behave and react to each other in a particular situation
example: the dynamics of political change
definition_zh: 人或事物在特定情境中如何行为和反应彼此
example_zh: 政治变革的动态

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用来指两个或更多人或事物，当你分别想到它们时
example_zh: 每个答案价值20分。

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用来指两个或更多人或事物，当你分别想到它们时
example_zh: 每个答案价值20分。

definition: used to refer to every one of two or more people or things, when you are thinking about them separately
example: Each answer is worth 20 points.
definition_zh: 用来指两个或更多人或事物，当你分别想到它们时
example_zh: 每个答案价值20分。

definition: very interested and excited by something that is going to happen or about something that you want to do; showing this
example: eager crowds outside the stadium
definition_zh: 对即将发生的事情或你想做的事情感到非常感兴趣和兴奋;展示这一点
example_zh: 体育场外热情的人群

definition: either of the organs on the sides of the head that you hear with
example: the left/right ear
definition_zh: 你听到的头部两侧任一器官
example_zh: 左耳/右耳

definition: near the beginning of a period of time, an event etc.
example: the early morning
definition_zh: 在某个时期、某个事件的开始前不久。
example_zh: 清晨

definition: near the beginning of a period of time, an event, a piece of work, etc.
example: We arrived early the next day.
definition_zh: 在某个时期、某个事件、一件作品等的开始时。
example_zh: 第二天一早我们就到了。

definition: to get money for work that you do
example: earn (something), He earns about $40 000 a year.
definition_zh: 通过工作赚钱
example_zh: 赚取（某物），他一年大约赚4万美元。

definition: the money that you earn for the work that you do
example: a rise in average earnings
definition_zh: 你为所做的工作所赚取的钱
example_zh: 平均收入的上升

definition: the world; the planet that we live on
example: the planet Earth
definition_zh: 这个世界;我们生活的星球
example_zh: 地球

definition: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface
example: a devastating/massive/powerful earthquake
definition_zh: 地球表面突然剧烈震动
example_zh: 一场毁灭性/巨大/强烈的地震

definition: lack of difficulty
example: with ease, He passed the exam with ease.
definition_zh: 缺乏难度
example_zh: 他轻松通过了考试。

definition: to become less unpleasant, painful or severe; to make something less unpleasant, etc.
example: The pain immediately eased.
definition_zh: 变得不那么令人不快、痛苦或严重；使某事变得不那么令人不快等。
example_zh: 疼痛立刻减轻了。

definition: without problems or difficulty
example: The museum is easily accessible by car.
definition_zh: 毫无问题或困难
example_zh: 博物馆可驾车轻松抵达。

definition: in or towards the east
example: East Africa
definition_zh: 在东方或向东
example_zh: 东非

definition: towards the east
example: The house faces east.
definition_zh: 向东
example_zh: 房子朝东。

definition: the direction that you look towards to see the sun rise; one of the four main points of the compass
example: Which way is east?
definition_zh: 你望向太阳升起的方向;指南针的四个主要方向之一
example_zh: 东边在哪？

definition: located in the east or facing east
example: eastern Spain
definition_zh: 位于东方或面向东方
example_zh: 西班牙东部

definition: not difficult; done or obtained without a lot of effort or problems
example: an easy way to make bread
definition_zh: 不难;几乎无需付出太多努力或困难就能完成或获得
example_zh: 一种简单的面包制作方法

definition: to put food in your mouth, bite it and swallow it
example: I was too nervous to eat.
definition_zh: 要把食物放进嘴里，咬一咬然后吞下去
example_zh: 我紧张得吃不下东西。

definition: the reflecting of sound off a wall or inside a particular space so that a noise appears to be repeated; a sound that is reflected back in this way
example: There was an echo on the phone and I couldn't hear clearly.
definition_zh: 声音在墙壁或特定空间内反射，使噪音看起来重复;声音以这种方式被反射回来
example_zh: 电话里有回声，我听不清楚。

definition: if a sound echoes, it is reflected off a wall, the side of a mountain, etc. so that you can hear it again
example: Her footsteps echoed in the empty room.
definition_zh: 如果声音回响，它会反射到墙壁、山坡等地，这样你就能再次听到它
example_zh: 她的脚步声在空荡的房间里回荡。

definition: connected with the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their environment
example: We risk upsetting the ecological balance of the area.
definition_zh: 与植物和生物彼此之间以及与环境的关系相关
example_zh: 我们有可能破坏该地区的生态平衡。

definition: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society
example: They discussed social, economic and political issues.
definition_zh: 与一个国家、地区或社会的贸易、工业及财富发展相关
example_zh: 他们讨论了社会、经济和政治问题。

definition: the study of how a society organizes its money, trade and industry
example: He studied politics and economics at Yale.
definition_zh: 研究一个社会如何组织其货币、贸易和工业
example_zh: 他在耶鲁大学学习政治和经济学。

definition: a person who studies or writes about economics
example: the World Bank's chief economist
definition_zh: 一个研究或撰写经济学的人
example_zh: 世界银行首席经济学家

definition: the relationship between production, trade and the supply of money in a particular country or region
example: The economy is in recession.
definition_zh: 特定国家或地区生产、贸易与货币供应之间的关系
example_zh: 经济正处于衰退之中。

definition: the outside limit of an object, a surface or an area; the part furthest from the centre
example: I gripped the edge of my desk to steady myself.
definition_zh: 物体、表面或区域的外界;距离中心最远的部分
example_zh: 我抓住桌沿稳住自己。

definition: to prepare a piece of writing, a book, etc. to be published by correcting the mistakes, making improvements to it, etc.
example: edit (something), This draft text will need to be edited.
definition_zh: 通过纠正错误、改进内容等，准备一篇文章、一本书等以供出版。
example_zh: 编辑（某项），这份草稿文本需要进行编辑。

definition: the form in which a book, newspaper, etc. is published
example: a paperback/hardback edition
definition_zh: 书籍、报纸等以何种形式出版
example_zh: 平装/精装版

definition: a person who is in charge of a newspaper, magazine, etc., or part of one, and who decides what should be included
example: the editor of the Washington Post
definition_zh: 负责报纸、杂志等或其一部分的人，负责决定应包含哪些内容
example_zh: 《华盛顿邮报》主编

definition: connected with the task of preparing something such as a newspaper, a book or a television or radio programme, to be published or broadcast
example: the magazine’s editorial staff
definition_zh: 与准备报纸、书籍或电视或广播节目等内容以出版或播出相关任务相关
example_zh: 杂志编辑团队

definition: to teach somebody over a period of time at a school, university, etc.
example: be educated, She was educated in the US.
definition_zh: 在学校、大学等地，在一段时间内教导某人。
example_zh: 她曾在美国接受教育。

definition: having had the kind of education mentioned; having been to the school, college or university mentioned
example: privately educated children
definition_zh: 接受过上述教育类型;曾就读于上述学校、学院或大学
example_zh: 私立教育的孩子

definition: a process of teaching, training and learning, especially in schools, colleges or universities, to improve knowledge and develop skills
example: primary/elementary education
definition_zh: 一个教学、培训和学习的过程，尤其是在学校、学院或大学中，旨在提升知识和发展技能
example_zh: 小学/小学教育

definition: connected with education
example: children with special educational needs
definition_zh: 与教育相关
example_zh: 有特殊教育需求的儿童

definition: a person whose job is to teach or educate people
example: adult educators (= who teach adults)
definition_zh: 一个职责是教导或教育他人的人
example_zh: 成人教育者（=教授成人）

definition: a change that somebody/something causes in somebody/something else; a result
example: the beneficial effects of exercise
definition_zh: 某人/某物在某人/某物身上引起的变化;一个结果
example_zh: 锻炼的有益效果

definition: producing the result that is wanted or intended; producing a successful result
example: Aspirin is a simple but highly effective treatment.
definition_zh: 产生期望或预期的结果;产生成功的结果
example_zh: 阿司匹林是一种简单但极为有效的治疗方法。

definition: in a way that produces the intended result or a successful result
example: The company must reduce costs to compete effectively.
definition_zh: 以一种能够产生预期结果或成功结果的方式
example_zh: 公司必须降低成本以有效竞争。

definition: the fact of producing the result that is wanted or intended; the fact of producing a successful result
example: to check the effectiveness of the security system
definition_zh: 能够产生所期望或预期的结果;成功产生结果的事实
example_zh: 检查安全系统的有效性

definition: the quality of doing something well with no waste of time or money
example: improvements in efficiency at the factory
definition_zh: 那种把事情做好、不浪费时间和金钱的品质
example_zh: 工厂效率的提升

definition: doing something in a good, careful and complete way with no waste of time, money or energy
example: a highly efficient worker
definition_zh: 以良好、细致且完整的方式完成某件事，不浪费时间、金钱或精力
example_zh: 一位高效员工

definition: in a good and careful way, with no waste of time, money or energy
example: a very efficiently organized event
definition_zh: 以良好且细致的方式进行，绝不浪费时间、金钱或精力
example_zh: 一次组织极为高效的活动

definition: an attempt to do something especially when it is difficult to do
example: The project was a team effort.
definition_zh: 尝试做某件事，尤其是在很难做的时候
example_zh: 这个项目是团队合作的结果。

definition: a small oval object with a thin hard shell produced by a female bird and containing a young bird; a similar object (without a hard shell) produced by a female fish, insect, etc.
example: The female sits on the eggs until they hatch.
definition_zh: 一个由雌鸟产生、壳薄而坚硬的小椭圆形物体，内含幼鸟;一个类似的物体（无硬壳），由雌性鱼类、昆虫等产生。
example_zh: 雌鸟会坐在卵上直到卵孵化。

definition: your sense of your own value and importance
example: He has the biggest ego of anyone I've ever met.
definition_zh: 你对自身价值和重要性的认知
example_zh: 他是我见过最自负的人。

definition: the number 8
example: There are eight students in the room.
definition_zh: 数字8
example_zh: 房间里有八个学生。

definition: the number 18
example: She turned eighteen last month.
definition_zh: 数字18
example_zh: 她上个月满十八岁了。

definition: the number 80
example: My grandfather is eighty years old.
definition_zh: 数字80
example_zh: 我祖父已经八十岁了。

definition: used after negative phrases to state that a feeling or situation is similar to one already mentioned
example: Pete can't go and I can't either.
definition_zh: 用于置于否定短语之后，表示某种情绪或情境与前述情境相似
example_zh: 皮特不能去，我也不能。

definition: one or the other of two; it does not matter which
example: You can park on either side of the street.
definition_zh: 两者之一;无论哪一种都无所谓
example_zh: 你可以把车停在街道的任一侧。

definition: one or the other of two; it does not matter which
example: You can park on either side of the street.
definition_zh: 两者之一;无论哪一种都无所谓
example_zh: 你可以把车停在街道的任一侧。

definition: very complicated and detailed; carefully prepared and organized
example: elaborate designs
definition_zh: 非常复杂且细致;精心准备和组织
example_zh: 精致的设计

definition: the joint between the upper and lower parts of the arm where it bends in the middle
example: She jabbed him with her elbow.
definition_zh: 手臂上下部分之间的关节，中部弯曲处
example_zh: 她用胳膊肘戳了他一下。

definition: used as a polite word for ‘old’
example: an elderly man/woman/lady
definition_zh: 作为“老”的委婉称呼
example_zh: 一位年长的男士/女士/女士

definition: to choose somebody to do a particular job by voting for them
example: elect somebody/something, Voters will elect a new president on 30 March next year.
definition_zh: 通过投票选出某人担任某项职务
example_zh: 选出某人，选民将在明年3月30日选出新总统。

definition: the process of choosing a person or a group of people for a position, especially a political position, by voting
example: presidential/parliamentary/local elections
definition_zh: 通过投票选择个人或一群人担任某一职位，尤其是政治职位的过程
example_zh: 总统/议会/地方选举

definition: connected with elections
example: electoral systems/reforms
definition_zh: 与选举相关
example_zh: 选举制度/改革

definition: connected with electricity; using, produced by or producing electricity
example: an electric car/vehicle
definition_zh: 与电力相连;使用、由电力生产或生产电力
example_zh: 电动汽车/电动汽车

definition: connected with electricity; using or producing electricity
example: an electrical fault in the engine
definition_zh: 与电力相连;使用或生产电力
example_zh: 发动机电气故障

definition: a form of energy from charged elementary particles, usually supplied as electric current through cables, wires, etc. for lighting, heating, driving machines, etc.
example: materials that conduct electricity
definition_zh: 一种由带电基本粒子产生的能量形式，通常通过电缆、导线等以电流形式提供，用于照明、供暖、驱动机械等。
example_zh: 导电材料

definition: having or using many small parts, such as microchips, that control and direct a small electric current
example: Airline passengers no longer have to turn off all electronic devices while on the plane.
definition_zh: 拥有或使用许多微型芯片等小部件，用于控制和引导微小电流
example_zh: 航空乘客在飞机上不再需要关闭所有电子设备。

definition: the branch of science and technology that studies electric currents in electronic equipment
example: the electronics industry
definition_zh: 研究电子设备电流的科学与技术分支
example_zh: 电子工业

definition: attractive and showing a good sense of style
example: She was tall and elegant.
definition_zh: 有吸引力，且展现出良好的品味
example_zh: 她身材高挑，气质优雅。

definition: a necessary or typical part of something; one of several parts that something contains
example: There are three important elements to consider.
definition_zh: 某物的必要或典型部分;某物所包含的多个部分之一
example_zh: 有三个重要因素需要考虑。

definition: in or connected with the first stages of a course of study
example: an elementary English course
definition_zh: 在学习课程的初期阶段中或与之相关的
example_zh: 一门初级英语课程

definition: a very large animal with thick grey skin, large ears, two curved outer teeth called tusks and a long nose called a trunk. There are two types of elephant, the African and the Asian.
example: herds of elephants
definition_zh: 这是一种体型非常大的动物，皮肤厚灰，耳朵大，外侧有两颗称为獠牙的弯曲牙齿，以及称为“象鼻”的长鼻子。象有两种类型，非洲象和亚洲象。
example_zh: 大象群

definition: to give somebody/something a higher position or rank, often more important than they deserve
example: elevate somebody/something (to something), He elevated many of his friends to powerful positions within the government.
definition_zh: 给某人或某物更高的职位或等级，往往比他们应得的更重要
example_zh: 提升某人/某物（提升某人）——他把许多朋友提升到政府中的权势位置。

example: There are only eleven of these rare animals left.
example_zh: 如今只剩下十一只这种稀有动物。

definition: a person who is eligible for something or to do something, is able to have or do it because they have the right qualifications, are the right age, etc.
example: eligible (for something), Only those over 70 are eligible for the special payment.
definition_zh: 一个有资格做某事或做某事的人，是因为他们具备合适的资格、合适的年龄等，所以能够拥有或做到它。
example_zh: 有资格（某项）：只有70岁以上的人才有资格获得特别补助。

definition: to remove or get rid of something
example: eliminate something, Credit cards eliminate the need to carry a lot of cash.
definition_zh: 移除或摆脱某些东西
example_zh: 信用卡消除了携带大量现金的需求。

definition: a small group of people in a society, etc. who are powerful and have a lot of influence, because they are rich, intelligent, etc.
example: a member of the ruling/intellectual elite
definition_zh: 社会中的一小群人，他们有权势，拥有很大影响力，因为他们富有、聪明等等。
example_zh: 统治/知识精英的一员

definition: in addition to something already mentioned
example: What else did he say?
definition_zh: 除了前面提到的一点之外
example_zh: 他还说了什么？

definition: in, at or to another place or other places
example: Dissatisfied customers will look elsewhere.
definition_zh: 在、在或前往其他地方或其他地方
example_zh: 不满意的客户会另觅他处。

definition: a way of sending messages and data to other people by means of computers connected together in a network
example: I will be on vacation for a week in November, with no access to email.
definition_zh: 一种通过连接在网络中的计算机向他人发送消息和数据的方式
example_zh: 我十一月将休假一周，期间无法使用电子邮件。

definition: to send a message to somebody by email
example: email somebody, Patrick emailed me yesterday.
definition_zh: 通过电子邮件向某人发送消息
example_zh: 给某人发邮件，帕特里克昨天给我发了邮件。

definition: to get onto a ship or plane; to put somebody/something onto a ship or plane
example: We stood on the pier and watched as they embarked.
definition_zh: 登上一艘船或飞机;把某人或某物送上一艘船或飞机
example_zh: 我们站在码头上，看着他们登船。

definition: shy, uncomfortable or ashamed, especially in a social situation
example: I've never felt so embarrassed in my life!
definition_zh: 害羞、不自在或羞耻，尤其是在社交场合
example_zh: 我这辈子从没这么尴尬过！

definition: making you feel shy, uncomfortable or ashamed
example: an embarrassing moment/situation
definition_zh: 让你感到害羞、不自在或羞愧
example_zh: 一个令人尴尬的时刻/情境

definition: shy, uncomfortable or guilty feelings; a feeling of being embarrassed
example: I nearly died of embarrassment when he said that.
definition_zh: 害羞、不自在或内疚的感觉;一种尴尬的感觉
example_zh: 他说那句话时我差点尴尬得要死。

definition: a group of officials led by an ambassador who represent their government in a foreign country
example: embassy officials
definition_zh: 一群由大使领导的官员组成的团体，代表本国政府驻外
example_zh: 大使馆官员

definition: to fix something in a substance or solid object
example: be embedded in something, an operation to remove glass that was embedded in his leg
definition_zh: 在物质或固体物体中固定某物
example_zh: 被嵌入某物中，一项手术，用来清除嵌在他腿上的玻璃

definition: to express or represent an idea or a quality
example: embody something, a politician who embodied the hopes of black youth
definition_zh: 表达或代表一个理念或某种品质
example_zh: 体现某种东西，一位体现黑人青年希望的政治家

definition: to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love or friendship
example: They embraced and promised to keep in touch.
definition_zh: 把手臂环抱某人，作为爱或友谊的象征
example_zh: 他们拥抱并承诺保持联系。

definition: to move out of or away from something and become possible to see
example: The crabs emerge at low tide to look for food.
definition_zh: 让自己离开或远离某样东西，变得可能被看见
example_zh: 退潮时，螃蟹会出水寻找食物。

definition: the fact of somebody/something moving out of or away from something and becoming possible to see
example: the island’s emergence from the sea 3 000 years ago
definition_zh: 某人或某物从某物中移动或远离某物，从而变得可能被看见这一事实
example_zh: 三千年前，这座岛屿从海中浮现

definition: a sudden serious and dangerous event or situation that needs immediate action to deal with it
example: This is a medical emergency needing urgent treatment with antibiotics.
definition_zh: 突发严重且危险的事件或情况，需要立即采取行动以应对
example_zh: 这是紧急医疗状况，需要用抗生素紧急治疗。

definition: the production or sending out of light, heat, gas, etc.
example: the emission of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
definition_zh: 光、热、气体等的产生或释放。
example_zh: 二氧化碳向大气中排放

definition: a strong feeling such as love, fear or anger; the part of a person’s character that consists of feelings
example: to show/express your emotions
definition_zh: 强烈的情感，如爱、恐惧或愤怒;一个人性格中由情感组成的部分
example_zh: 表达/表达你的情感

definition: connected with people’s feelings (= with the emotions)
example: emotional problems/stress
definition_zh: 与人们的感受相连（= 与情绪）
example_zh: 情绪问题/压力

definition: in a way that is connected with people's feelings (= with the emotions)
example: emotionally disturbed children
definition_zh: 以一种与人们的感受相关联的方式（= 与情绪）
example_zh: 情绪障碍儿童

definition: special importance that is given to something
example: emphasis on/upon something, Since the elections there has been a greater emphasis on education.
definition_zh: 赋予某物特殊意义
example_zh: 强调某件事，自选举以来，教育的重视有所增加。

definition: to give special importance to something
example: emphasize something, His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.
definition_zh: 赋予某件事特殊意义
example_zh: 强调点什么，他的演讲强调了吸引工业到镇上的重要性。

definition: a group of countries or states that are controlled by one leader or government
example: These invasions almost led to the collapse of the Roman Empire.
definition_zh: 一组由一位领导人或政府控制的国家或国家
example_zh: 这些入侵几乎导致了罗马帝国的崩溃。

definition: based on experiments or experience rather than ideas or theories
example: empirical evidence/knowledge/research
definition_zh: 基于实验或经验，而非想法或理论
example_zh: 实证证据/知识/研究

definition: to give somebody a job to do for payment
example: employ somebody, How many people does the company employ?
definition_zh: 给别人一份工作以换取报酬
example_zh: 雇佣某人，公司雇了多少人？

definition: a person who is paid to work for somebody
example: The firm has over 500 employees.
definition_zh: 一个受雇为某人工作的人
example_zh: 公司拥有500多名员工。

definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them
example: They're very good employers (= they treat the people that work for them well).
definition_zh: 一个付钱请人为他们工作的个人或公司
example_zh: 他们是非常好的雇主（=他们对待为他们工作的人很好）。

definition: work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed
example: full-time/part-time employment
definition_zh: 工作，尤其是为了赚钱而工作;就业状态
example_zh: 全职/兼职就业

definition: to give somebody the power or authority to do something
example: be empowered (to do something), The courts were empowered to impose the death sentence for certain crimes.
definition_zh: 赋予某人权力或权威去做某事
example_zh: 法院被赋予对某些罪行判处死刑的权力。

definition: with no people or things inside
example: an empty box/glass/bottle
definition_zh: 里面没有人，也没有东西
example_zh: 一个空盒子/玻璃/瓶子

definition: to remove everything that is in a container, etc.
example: empty something, She emptied the bins, washed the glasses and went to bed.
definition_zh: 把容器里的所有东西都拿出来等等。
example_zh: 倒空了什么东西，她倒空了垃圾桶，洗了杯子，然后上床睡觉。

definition: to make it possible for somebody/something to do something
example: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.
definition_zh: 为了让某人/某物能够做某件事
example_zh: 这一新项目将使年长者能够进入大学学习。

definition: to pass a law
example: (be) enacted (by somebody/something), legislation enacted by parliament
definition_zh: 通过法律
example_zh: （由）制定（由某人/某物），由议会制定的立法

definition: to include a large number or range of things
example: The job encompasses a wide range of responsibilities.
definition_zh: 以包含大量或范围的事物
example_zh: 这份工作涵盖了广泛的职责范围。

definition: a meeting, especially one that is sudden, unexpected or violent
example: a chance encounter
definition_zh: 一次会面，尤其是突然、出乎意料或暴力的会面
example_zh: 一次偶然的邂逅

definition: to experience something, especially something unpleasant or difficult, while you are trying to do something else
example: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.
definition_zh: 在尝试做别的事情时，体验某件事，尤其是不愉快或困难的事情
example_zh: 我们在第一周遇到了不少困难。

definition: to give somebody support, courage or hope
example: encourage somebody, We were greatly encouraged by the positive response of the public.
definition_zh: 给别人支持、勇气或希望
example_zh: 鼓励别人，我们深受公众积极回应的鼓舞。

definition: the act of encouraging somebody to do something; something that encourages somebody
example: a few words of encouragement
definition_zh: 鼓励某人做某事的行为;鼓励某人的事情
example_zh: 几句鼓励的话

definition: that gives somebody support, courage or hope
example: This month's unemployment figures are not very encouraging.
definition_zh: 这能给别人带来支持、勇气或希望
example_zh: 本月的失业数据并不令人鼓舞。

definition: the final part of a period of time, an event, an activity or a story
example: It's the end of an era.
definition_zh: 一个时间段、一个事件、一个活动或一个故事的最后部分
example_zh: 这是一个时代的终结。

definition: to finish; to reach a point and go no further; to make something finish
example: At last the war ended.
definition_zh: 完成;达到某一点却不再前进;让某件事完成
example_zh: 战争终于结束了。

definition: an attempt to do something, especially something new or difficult
example: There have been great advances in the field of scientific endeavour.
definition_zh: 尝试做点什么，尤其是新事物或困难的事
example_zh: 科学研究领域取得了巨大进展。

definition: the last part of a story, film, etc.
example: His stories usually have a happy ending.
definition_zh: 故事、电影等的最后一部分。
example_zh: 他的故事通常都有一个圆满的结局。

definition: very large in size or amount and seeming to have no end
example: endless patience
definition_zh: 体积或数量都非常大，似乎没有尽头
example_zh: 无尽的耐心

definition: to say publicly that you support a person, statement or course of action
example: I wholeheartedly endorse his remarks.
definition_zh: 公开表示你支持某人、某言论或某一行动方案
example_zh: 我完全赞同他的言论。

definition: a public statement or action showing that you support somebody/something
example: The election victory is a clear endorsement of their policies.
definition_zh: 公开声明或行动，表明你支持某人或某事
example_zh: 这次选举胜利明确地认可了他们的政策。

definition: to experience and deal with something that is painful or unpleasant without giving up
example: endure something, They had to endure a long wait before the case came to trial.
definition_zh: 经历并应对痛苦或不愉快的事情，而不放弃
example_zh: 忍受点什么，他们不得不忍受漫长的等待，直到案件开庭。

definition: a person who hates somebody or who acts or speaks against somebody/something
example: She didn't have an enemy in the world.
definition_zh: 一个恨某人，或者对某人/某物采取行动或言论的人
example_zh: 她在这世界上没有敌人。

definition: the strength, effort and enthusiasm required for physical or mental activity, work, etc.
example: It's a waste of time and energy.
definition_zh: 身体或精神活动、工作等所需的力量、努力和热情。
example_zh: 这完全是浪费时间和精力。

definition: to make sure that people obey a particular law or rule
example: enforce something, It's the job of the police to enforce the law.
definition_zh: 以确保人们遵守某条特定的法律或规则
example_zh: 执行某件事，警察的职责就是执法。

definition: the act of making people obey a particular law or rule
example: strict enforcement of regulations
definition_zh: 强迫人们遵守某条特定法律或规则的行为
example_zh: 严格执行法规

definition: to succeed in attracting and keeping somebody’s attention and interest
example: It is a movie that engages both the mind and the eye.
definition_zh: 成功吸引并保持某人的注意力和兴趣
example_zh: 这是一部既能吸引人心又能触动人心的电影。

definition: having agreed to marry somebody
example: When did you get engaged?
definition_zh: 答应嫁给某人
example_zh: 你什么时候订婚的？

definition: an agreement to marry somebody; the period during which two people are engaged
example: Their engagement was announced in the local paper.
definition_zh: 与某人结婚的协议;两个人订婚的期间
example_zh: 他们的订婚消息在当地报纸上公布了。

definition: interesting or pleasant in a way that attracts your attention
example: an engaging smile
definition_zh: 以一种吸引你注意力的方式有趣或愉快
example_zh: 迷人的微笑

definition: the part of a vehicle that produces power to make the vehicle move
example: a diesel/petrol engine
definition_zh: 车辆中产生动力以驱动车辆前进的部分
example_zh: 柴油/汽油发动机

definition: a person whose job involves designing and building engines, machines, roads, bridges, etc.
example: We worked with a team of scientists and engineers.
definition_zh: 一个工作内容涉及设计和制造发动机、机器、道路、桥梁等的人。
example_zh: 我们与一支科学家和工程师团队合作。

definition: the activity of applying scientific knowledge to the design, building and control of machines, roads, bridges, electrical equipment, etc.
example: The bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
definition_zh: 将科学知识应用于机器、道路、桥梁、电气设备等的设计、制造和控制的活动。
example_zh: 这座桥是现代工程的杰作。

definition: to increase or further improve the good quality, value or status of somebody/something
example: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
definition_zh: 提高或进一步提升某人/某物的良好质量、价值或地位
example_zh: 这是一个提升公司声誉的机会。

definition: to get pleasure from something
example: enjoy something, We thoroughly enjoyed our time in New York.
definition_zh: 从中获得快感
example_zh: 享受点什么，我们非常享受在纽约的时光。

definition: giving pleasure
example: an enjoyable weekend/experience
definition_zh: 带来快乐
example_zh: 一个愉快的周末/体验

definition: extremely large
example: an enormous house/dog
definition_zh: 极其庞大
example_zh: 一栋巨大的房子/狗

definition: to the necessary degree
example: I hadn't trained enough for the game.
definition_zh: 在必要程度上
example_zh: 我没为这项运动训练得足够。

definition: used before plural or uncountable nouns to mean ‘as many or as much as somebody needs or wants’
example: Have you made enough copies?
definition_zh: 在复数或不可数名词之前用来表示“数量多或需要多少”。
example_zh: 你复制够多了吗？

definition: as many or as much as somebody needs or wants
example: Six bottles should be enough.
definition_zh: 数量多或数量取决于需要或想要
example_zh: 六瓶应该够了。

definition: to ask somebody for some information
example: enquire about somebody/something, I called the station to enquire about train times.
definition_zh: 想向某人打听一些信息
example_zh: 询问某人或某事，我打电话给车站询问火车时间。

definition: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something
example: a murder enquiry
definition_zh: 一个官方程序，用于查明某事的成因或获取有关某事的信息
example_zh: 谋杀调查

definition: to improve the quality of something, often by adding something to it
example: The study of science has enriched all our lives.
definition_zh: 提升某样东西的质量，通常是通过给它添加一些东西
example_zh: 科学的研究丰富了我们所有人的生活。

definition: to arrange for yourself or for somebody else to officially join a course, school, etc.
example: You need to enrol before the end of August.
definition_zh: 为自己或他人安排正式加入课程、学校等。
example_zh: 你需要在八月底之前报名。

definition: to happen after or as a result of another event
example: An argument ensued.
definition_zh: 发生在其他事件之后或由此而发生
example_zh: 随后发生了争吵。

definition: to make sure that something happens or is definite
example: ensure something, We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.
definition_zh: 以确保某件事发生或确定
example_zh: 确保一些事情，我们正在努力保障城市居民的安全。

definition: to come or go into something
example: Knock before you enter.
definition_zh: 进入或进入某物
example_zh: 进来前先敲门。

definition: a company or business
example: He is in charge of an enterprise with a turnover of $26 billion.
definition_zh: 一家公司或企业
example_zh: 他负责的是一家营业额达260亿美元的企业。

definition: to interest somebody or make somebody laugh in order to please them
example: The aim of the series is both to entertain and inform.
definition_zh: 为了吸引某人或逗乐某人，以取悦他们
example_zh: 该系列的目标既是娱乐，也是提供信息。

definition: that you enjoy watching, listening to, doing or experiencing
example: an entertaining speech/evening
definition_zh: 你喜欢观看、聆听、做或体验的
example_zh: 一场有趣的演讲/夜晚

definition: films, music, etc. used to entertain people; an example of this
example: radio, television and other forms of entertainment
definition_zh: 电影、音乐等，用来娱乐人们;一个例子
example_zh: 广播、电视及其他娱乐形式

definition: a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it
example: Her voice was full of enthusiasm.
definition_zh: 对某件事感到强烈的兴奋和兴趣，并渴望参与其中
example_zh: 她的声音充满了热情。

definition: a person who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it
example: a football enthusiast
definition_zh: 一个对某件事非常感兴趣、并且花很多时间去做的人
example_zh: 一名足球爱好者

definition: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest about somebody/something
example: an enthusiastic supporter
definition_zh: 对某人或某事表现出强烈的兴奋和兴趣
example_zh: 一位热情的支持者

definition: including everything, everyone or every part
example: The entire village was destroyed.
definition_zh: 包括一切，所有人或每一部分
example_zh: 整个村庄被毁。

definition: in every way possible; completely
example: The experience was entirely new to me.
definition_zh: 以各种可能的方式;完全
example_zh: 这段经历对我来说完全是全新的。

definition: to give somebody the right to have or to do something
example: be entitled to something, You will be entitled to your pension when you reach 65.
definition_zh: 赋予某人拥有或做某事的权利
example_zh: 你有资格领取一些东西，等你年满65岁时，你就有资格领取养老金。

definition: something that exists separately from other things and has its own identity
example: The unit has become part of a larger department and no longer exists as a separate entity.
definition_zh: 一种独立于其他事物存在、拥有自身身份的东西
example_zh: 该单位已成为更大部门的一部分，不再作为独立实体存在。

definition: a door, gate, passage, etc. used for entering a room, building or place
example: the front/back/side entrance of the house
definition_zh: 用于进入房间、建筑物或场所的门、门、通道等
example_zh: 房屋的正门/后门/侧门

definition: a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, especially when this involves taking financial risks
example: A creative entrepreneur, he was continually dreaming up new projects.
definition_zh: 一个通过创业或经营企业赚钱的人，尤其是在涉及承担财务风险时
example_zh: 作为一名富有创意的企业家，他不断构思新的项目。

definition: an act of going into or getting into a place
example: She made her entry to the sound of thunderous applause.
definition_zh: 进入或进入某个地方的行为
example_zh: 她在雷鸣般的掌声中登场。

definition: a flat paper container used for sending letters in, with a part that you stick down to close it
example: Writing paper and envelopes are provided in your room.
definition_zh: 一个平坦的纸容器，用来寄信，有一个需要插入即可关闭的部分
example_zh: 您的房间内已提供写字纸和信封。

definition: the natural world in which people, animals and plants live
example: The government should do more to protect the environment.
definition_zh: 人类、动物和植物生活的自然世界
example_zh: 政府应当做更多保护环境的工作。

definition: connected with the natural conditions in which people, animals and plants live; connected with the environment
example: the environmental impact of pollution
definition_zh: 与人类、动物和植物所处的自然条件相连;与环境相连
example_zh: 污染对环境的影响

definition: a large number of cases of a particular disease or medical condition happening at the same time in a particular community
example: the outbreak of a flu epidemic
definition_zh: 在同一特定社区同时发生大量特定疾病或医疗状况的病例
example_zh: 流感疫情的爆发

definition: one part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts
example: The next episode has not yet been filmed.
definition_zh: 一个故事的一部分，在电视或广播中分成多个部分播出
example_zh: 下一集尚未拍摄。

definition: the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: There is an equal number of boys and girls in the class.
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、价值等方面都和其他东西一样
example_zh: 班上男女生人数相等。

definition: a person or thing of the same quality or with the same status, rights, etc. as another
example: She treats the people who work for her as her equals.
definition_zh: 一个与另一个人或事物具有相同质量或相同的地位、权利等
example_zh: 她把为她工作的人当作平等对待。

definition: to be the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: 2x plus y equals 7 (= 2x+y=7)
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、价值等方面与其他东西相同
example_zh: 2x加y等于7（= 2x+y=7）

definition: the fact of being equal in rights, status, advantages, etc.
example: racial/social/gender equality
definition_zh: 在权利、地位、优势等方面平等这一事实。
example_zh: 种族/社会/性别平等

definition: to the same degree; in the same or in a similar way
example: Diet and exercise are equally important.
definition_zh: 以同样的程度;以相同或类似的方式
example_zh: 饮食和锻炼同样重要。

definition: a statement showing that two amounts or values are equal, for example 2x + y = 54
example: the numbers on the right-hand side of the equation
definition_zh: 一种表明两个数值相等的陈述，例如 2x + y = 54
example_zh: 方程右侧的数字

definition: to provide yourself/somebody/something with the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: equip something, to be fully/poorly equipped
definition_zh: 为自己/某人/某物提供实现特定目的或活动所需的物品
example_zh: 装备点东西，让装备完整/装备不足

definition: the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: a useful piece of equipment for the kitchen
definition_zh: 为特定目的或活动所必需的物品
example_zh: 厨房实用设备

definition: equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.
example: 250 grams or an equivalent amount in ounces
definition_zh: 价值、数量、意义、重要性等都相等。
example_zh: 250克或等值数量（盎司）

definition: a thing, amount, word, etc. that is equal in value, meaning or purpose to something else
example: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.
definition_zh: 一个在价值、意义或目的上与其他事物相等的事物、数量、词语等
example_zh: 请以您自己的货币发送20欧元或等值金额。

definition: a period of time, usually in history, that is different from other periods because of particular characteristics or events
example: the Victorian/modern/post-war era
definition_zh: 这段时期通常在历史上，因某些特征或事件而与其他时期不同
example_zh: 维多利亚时代/现代/战后时代

definition: to build something
example: The church was erected in 1582.
definition_zh: 去建造点什么
example_zh: 教堂建于1582年。

definition: a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something
example: spelling/typographical/grammatical errors
definition_zh: 一个错误，尤其是导致问题或影响某事结果的错误
example_zh: 拼写/排版/语法错误

definition: when a volcano erupts or burning rocks, smoke, etc. erupt or are erupted, the burning rocks, etc. are thrown out from the volcano
example: The volcano could erupt at any time.
definition_zh: 当火山喷发或燃烧的岩石、烟雾等喷发时，燃烧的岩石等会被从火山中抛出
example_zh: 火山随时可能喷发。

definition: to become greater, worse, more serious, etc.; to make something greater, worse, more serious, etc.
example: the escalating costs of healthcare
definition_zh: 变得更伟大、更糟、更严肃，等等;让某件事变得更伟大、更糟、更严肃，等等。
example_zh: 医疗成本不断攀升

definition: the act or a method of escaping from a place or an unpleasant or dangerous situation
example: I had a narrow escape (= I was lucky to have escaped).
definition_zh: 逃离某处或不愉快或危险情境的行为或方法。
example_zh: 我侥幸逃脱了（=我很幸运逃过一劫）。

definition: to get away from a place where you have been kept as a prisoner or not allowed to leave
example: Two prisoners have escaped.
definition_zh: 逃离一个你被囚禁或不被允许离开的地方
example_zh: 两名囚犯逃脱了。

definition: more with one person, thing, etc. than with others, or more in particular circumstances than in others
example: Teenagers are very fashion conscious, especially girls.
definition_zh: 对某一个人、某件事等的关系比对其他人更严重，或者在特定情况下比在其他情况下更严重
example_zh: 青少年非常注重时尚，尤其是女孩。

definition: a short piece of writing by a student as part of a course of study
example: I have to write an essay this weekend.
definition_zh: 学生作为学习课程的一部分写下的一篇短文
example_zh: 我这个周末得写一篇论文。

definition: the most important quality or feature of something, that makes it what it is
example: His paintings capture the essence of France.
definition_zh: 某物最重要的品质或特征，正是它使该事物成为其本身
example_zh: 他的画作捕捉了法国的精髓。

definition: completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation or for a particular activity
example: an essential part/feature of something
definition_zh: 完全必要;在特定情境或特定活动中极为重要
example_zh: 某物的必不可少部分/特征

definition: when you think about the true, important or basic nature of somebody/something
example: There are three essentially different ways of tackling the problem.
definition_zh: 当你思考某人/某物的真实、重要或基本本质时
example_zh: 解决这个问题有三种本质上不同的方法。

definition: to start or create an organization, a system, etc. that is meant to last for a long time
example: The committee was established in 1912.
definition_zh: 建立或创建一个组织、系统等，旨在长期存在
example_zh: 该委员会成立于1912年。

definition: an organization, a large institution or a hotel
example: The visa is for foreign nationals wishing to study at a university, college or similar educational establishment.
definition_zh: 一个组织、一家大型机构或一家酒店
example_zh: 该签证适用于希望在大学、学院或类似教育机构学习的外国公民。

definition: an area of land with a lot of houses or factories of the same type on it
example: on an estate, She lives in a tower block on an estate in London.
definition_zh: 一片土地上有许多同类型房屋或工厂
example_zh: 她住在伦敦一处住宅区的一栋高楼里。

definition: a judgement that you make without having the exact details or figures about the size, amount, cost, etc. of something
example: to provide/obtain an estimate
definition_zh: 这是你在没有确切细节或数字的情况下做出的判断，比如对某物的大小、数量、成本等
example_zh: 提供/获取估价

definition: to form an idea of the cost, size, value etc. of something, but without calculating it exactly
example: estimate something, to estimate the cost/value/number of something
definition_zh: 形成对某物成本、规模、价值等的概念，但不精确计算
example_zh: 估算某样东西，用来估算某样东西的成本/价值/数量

definition: without an end; existing or continuing forever
example: the promise of eternal life in heaven
definition_zh: 没有终结;存在或永续
example_zh: 天堂永生的应许

definition: moral principles that control or influence a person’s behaviour
example: professional/business/medical ethics
definition_zh: 控制或影响一个人行为的道德原则
example_zh: 职业/商业/医学伦理

definition: connected with beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
example: ethical issues/standards/questions/dilemmas
definition_zh: 与对错的信念和原则相连
example_zh: 伦理问题/标准/问题/困境

definition: connected with or belonging to a group of people that share a cultural tradition
example: ethnic background/origin
definition_zh: 与共享文化传统的群体有联系或属于
example_zh: 族裔背景/起源

definition: the unit of money of some countries of the European Union
example: I paid five euros for it.
definition_zh: 欧盟部分国家的货币单位
example_zh: 我花了五欧元买的。

definition: to move people from a place of danger to a safer place
example: evacuate something, Police evacuated nearby buildings.
definition_zh: 把人们从危险之地转移到更安全的地方
example_zh: 疏散某处，警方已疏散附近建筑物。

definition: to form an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: evaluate something, The trial will evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
definition_zh: 在认真思考某物的数量、价值或质量后形成判断
example_zh: 评估某些东西，试验将评估不同药物的疗效。

definition: the act of forming an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: an evaluation of the healthcare system
definition_zh: 在认真思考某物的数量、价值或质量后形成判断的行为
example_zh: 对医疗体系的评估

definition: that can be divided exactly by two
example: 4, 6, 8 and 10 are all even numbers.
definition_zh: 可以精确除以二

definition: used to emphasize something unexpected or surprising
example: She didn't even call to say she wasn't coming.
definition_zh: 用来强调某些意想不到或令人惊讶的事物
example_zh: 她甚至没打电话说她不来了。

definition: the part of the day between the afternoon and the time you go to bed
example: Remember to call me this evening.
definition_zh: 下午到你睡觉之间的那段时间
example_zh: 记得今晚给我打电话。

definition: a thing that happens, especially something important
example: recent/current/world events
definition_zh: 一件会发生的事，尤其是重要的事
example_zh: 近期/当前/世界事件

definition: at the end of a period of time or a series of events
example: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
definition_zh: 在一段时间或一系列事件结束时
example_zh: 我们的航班最终晚点了五个小时。

definition: used in negative sentences and questions, or sentences with if to mean ‘at any time’
example: Nothing ever happens here.
definition_zh: 用于否定句和疑问句，或带有if表示“任何时刻”的句子
example_zh: 这里从来不会发生什么事。

definition: used with singular nouns to refer to all the members of a group of things or people
example: She knows every student in the school.
definition_zh: 与单数名词一起使用，指代一个群体或人群中的所有成员
example_zh: 她认识学校里的每个学生。

definition: every person; all people
example: Everybody knows Tom.
definition_zh: 每一个人;所有人
example_zh: 人人都认识汤姆。

definition: used or happening every day or regularly; ordinary
example: Change is a part of everyday life in business.
definition_zh: 每天或定期使用或发生;普通
example_zh: 变化是商业日常生活的一部分。

definition: every person; all people
example: Everyone cheered and clapped.
definition_zh: 每一个人;所有人
example_zh: 所有人欢呼鼓掌。

definition: all things
example: Everything had gone.
definition_zh: 万物皆有
example_zh: 一切都没了。

definition: in, to or at every place; all places
example: I've looked everywhere.
definition_zh: 在每个地方、前往或在每个地方;所有地点
example_zh: 我到处找过。

definition: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true
example: evidence (of something), Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.
definition_zh: 那些让你相信某事是真实的事实、迹象或物体
example_zh: 证据（某种证据），研究人员发现了暴露于太阳与皮肤癌之间存在明确的科学证据。

definition: clear; easily seen
example: The orchestra played with evident enjoyment.
definition_zh: 清晰;一眼就能看见
example_zh: 乐团演奏时明显乐在其中。

definition: enjoying harming others; morally bad and cruel
example: Police described the killer as ‘a desperate and evil man’.
definition_zh: 享受伤害他人;道德上恶劣且残忍
example_zh: 警方形容凶手是“一个绝望且邪恶的人”。

definition: a force that causes bad things to happen; morally bad behaviour
example: the eternal struggle between good and evil
definition_zh: 一种导致坏事发生的力量;道德上的不良行为
example_zh: 善与恶之间的永恒斗争

definition: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
example: The music evoked memories of her youth.
definition_zh: 把一种感觉、一段记忆或一个画面带进你的脑海
example_zh: 音乐唤起了她年轻时的回忆。

definition: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment
example: the evolution of the human species
definition_zh: 植物、动物等在地球历史中缓慢而稳定地发展，它们适应环境变化
example_zh: 人类物种的进化

definition: connected with evolution; connected with slow steady development and change
example: evolutionary theory
definition_zh: 与进化相连;与缓慢稳定的发展和变化相连
example_zh: 进化论

definition: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way
example: evolve (from something) (into something), The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.
definition_zh: 逐步发展，尤其是从简单形式发展到更复杂的形式;以这种方式发展某样东西
example_zh: 演变（从某物）（变成某物），这个想法源自我在阁楼发现的一幅画。

definition: correct in every detail
example: The new palace is an exact replica of the original building.
definition_zh: 每一个细节都正确
example_zh: 新宫殿是原建筑的精确复制品。

definition: used to emphasize that something is correct in every way or in every detail
example: It's exactly nine o'clock.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事在各方面或每个细节上都是正确的
example_zh: 现在正好九点。

definition: to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is
example: The hotel was really filthy and I'm not exaggerating.
definition_zh: 让某件事看起来比实际更大、更好、更糟或更重要
example_zh: 酒店真的脏得要命，我一点也不夸张。

definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: to take an exam
definition_zh: 正式的笔试、口头或实践测试，尤其是在学校或大学，用来看看你对某门学科了解多少，或者你能做什么
example_zh: 参加考试

definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: successful candidates in GCSE examinations
definition_zh: 正式的笔试、口头或实践测试，尤其是在学校或大学，用来看看你对某门学科了解多少，或者你能做什么
example_zh: GCSE考试的成功考生

definition: to consider or study an idea, a subject, etc. very carefully
example: examine something, This study sets out to examine in detail the possible effects of climate change.
definition_zh: 非常仔细地考虑或研究一个想法、一个主题等等
example_zh: 研究某件事，本研究旨在详细探讨气候变化可能带来的影响。

definition: something such as an object, a fact or a situation that shows, explains or supports what you say
example: Let me give you an example.
definition_zh: 比如一个物体、一个事实或情境，用来展示、解释或支持你所说的内容
example_zh: 让我给你举个例子。

definition: to be greater than a particular number or amount
example: The price will not exceed £100.
definition_zh: 大于某个特定数量或金额
example_zh: 价格不会超过100英镑。

definition: the quality of being extremely good
example: a reputation for academic excellence
definition_zh: 极其优秀的品质
example_zh: 学术卓越的声誉

definition: extremely good
example: an excellent book/article
definition_zh: 极好
example_zh: 一本出色的书籍/文章

definition: used before you mention something that makes a statement not completely true
example: I didn't tell him anything except that I needed the money.
definition_zh: 在你提到某些让某个陈述不完全真实的事情之前使用。
example_zh: 我什么都没告诉他，只说我需要这笔钱。

definition: used before you mention the only thing or person about which a statement is not true
example: We work every day except Sunday.
definition_zh: 在你提到唯一关于某句话不真实的事物或人物之前使用
example_zh: 我们除了周日外每天都在工作。

definition: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
example: Most of the buildings in the town are modern, but the church is an exception.
definition_zh: 未包含在一般陈述中的个人或事物
example_zh: 镇上的大多数建筑都是现代建筑，但教堂是个例外。

definition: unusually good
example: At the age of five he showed exceptional talent as a musician.
definition_zh: 异常好
example_zh: 五岁时，他展现出非凡的音乐天赋。

definition: in addition to an amount that is necessary, usual or legal
example: Excess food is stored as fat.
definition_zh: 此外，还有必要、通常或合法的金额
example_zh: 多余的食物会储存为脂肪。

definition: more than is necessary, reasonable or acceptable
example: You can throw away any excess.
definition_zh: 超出必要、合理或可接受的范围
example_zh: 多余的部分你可以扔掉。

definition: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate
example: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
definition_zh: 超出合理或适当的程度
example_zh: 他们抱怨楼上公寓传来的噪音太大。

definition: an act of giving something to somebody or doing something for somebody and receiving something in return
example: The exchange of prisoners took place this morning.
definition_zh: 一种给予某人某物或为他人做某事，并得到回报的行为
example_zh: 俘虏交换是在今天上午进行的。

definition: to give something to somebody and at the same time receive the same type of thing from them
example: exchange something, to exchange news/information
definition_zh: 把东西送给别人，同时又从他们那里得到同样的回报
example_zh: 交换一些东西，交换新闻/信息

definition: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: Staff got excited when they heard they were getting a bonus.
definition_zh: 感受到或表现出快乐和热情
example_zh: 员工们听说要拿奖金时兴奋不已。

definition: the state of feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: The news caused great excitement among her friends.
definition_zh: 感受到或表现出快乐和热情的状态
example_zh: 这个消息在她的朋友们中引起了极大的兴奋。

definition: causing great interest or excitement
example: This is an exciting opportunity for me.
definition_zh: 引发极大兴趣或激动
example_zh: 这对我来说是一个令人兴奋的机会。

definition: to deliberately not include something in what you are doing or considering
example: The cost of borrowing has been excluded from the inflation figures.
definition_zh: 在你正在做或考虑的事情中，故意不包含某些内容
example_zh: 借款成本已被排除在通胀数据之外。

definition: the act of preventing somebody/something from entering a place or taking part in something
example: exclusion (of somebody/something) (from something), He was disappointed with his exclusion from the England squad.
definition_zh: 阻止某人/某物进入某处或参与某事的行为
example_zh: 被排除在外（某人/某物）（被某事排除在外），他对自己被排除在英格兰国家队阵容之外感到失望。

definition: only to be used by one particular person or group; only given to one particular person or group
example: The hotel has exclusive access to the beach.
definition_zh: 仅限特定个人或团体使用;仅限于特定个人或团体
example_zh: 酒店享有专属海滩通道。

definition: for only one particular person, group or use
example: The resort caters almost exclusively for a high-society public.
definition_zh: 仅针对特定个人、群体或用途
example_zh: 该度假村几乎专门服务于上流社会的人群。

definition: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour
example: Late again! What's your excuse this time?
definition_zh: 一个你用来解释或辩护你行为的理由，无论是真实还是虚构的
example_zh: 又迟到了！这次你有什么借口？

definition: to forgive somebody for something that they have done, for example not being polite or making a small mistake
example: excuse something, Please excuse the mess.
definition_zh: 原谅别人做过的事，比如不礼貌或犯了一个小错误
example_zh: 请原谅点什么，请原谅这里的凌乱。

definition: to kill somebody, especially as a legal punishment
example: be executed (for something), He was executed for treason.
definition_zh: 杀人，尤其是作为法律惩罚
example_zh: 被处死（因为某事），他被处死了，罪名是叛国。

definition: the act of killing somebody, especially as a legal punishment
example: He faced execution by hanging for murder.
definition_zh: 杀人的行为，尤其是作为法律惩罚
example_zh: 他因谋杀面临绞刑处决。

definition: connected with managing a business or an organization, and with making plans and decisions
example: She has an executive position in a finance company.
definition_zh: 与管理企业或组织、制定计划和决策相关
example_zh: 她在一家金融公司担任高管职位。

definition: a person who has an important job as a manager of a company or an organization
example: company/corporate/business/industry executives
definition_zh: 一个担任公司或组织经理重要职责的人
example_zh: 公司/企业/商业/行业高管

definition: physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger
example: Swimming is good exercise.
definition_zh: 你为保持健康或增强力量而进行的身体或心理活动
example_zh: 游泳是很好的锻炼。

definition: to do sports or other physical activities in order to stay healthy or become stronger; to make an animal do this
example: an hour’s class of exercising to music
definition_zh: 为了保持健康或增强力量，进行体育或其他体力活动;让动物做到这一点
example_zh: 一小时的音乐锻炼课

definition: to use power or influence to affect somebody/something
example: He exerted all his authority to make them accept the plan.
definition_zh: 利用权力或影响力影响某人或某物
example_zh: 他动用了全部权力，让他们接受这个计划。

definition: an object or a collection of objects put in a public place, for example a museum, so that people can see it
example: The museum contains some interesting exhibits on Spanish rural life.
definition_zh: 一件物品或一组物品被放置在公共场所，比如博物馆，以便人们看到它
example_zh: 博物馆收藏了一些关于西班牙乡村生活的有趣展品。

definition: to show something in a public place for people to enjoy or to give them information
example: exhibit something (at/in…), They will be exhibiting their new designs at the trade fairs.
definition_zh: 在公共场所展示某物供人们欣赏或提供信息
example_zh: 展出一些东西（at/in...），他们将在贸易展上展示他们的新设计。

definition: a collection of things, for example works of art, that are shown to the public
example: Have you seen the Picasso exhibition?
definition_zh: 一组向公众展示的物品，例如艺术品
example_zh: 你看过毕加索的展览吗？

definition: the state of being sent to live in another country that is not your own, especially for political reasons or as a punishment
example: a place of exile
definition_zh: 被送去另一个不是自己国家生活的状态，尤其是出于政治原因或惩罚
example_zh: 流放之地

definition: to be real; to be present in a place or situation
example: Does life exist on other planets?
definition_zh: 真实存在;在某个地方或情境中存在
example_zh: 其他星球上是否存在生命？

definition: the state or fact of being real or living or of being present
example: I was unaware of his existence until today.
definition_zh: 真实、活着或存在的状态或事实
example_zh: 直到今天我才知道他的存在。

definition: a way out of a public building or vehicle
example: Where's the exit?
definition_zh: 公共建筑或车辆的逃生通道
example_zh: 出口在哪里？

definition: to go out; to leave a building, stage, vehicle, etc.
example: (+ adv./prep.), The bullet entered her back and exited through her chest.
definition_zh: 出门;离开建筑、舞台、车辆等。
example_zh: （+ 副词/介词），子弹从她的背部穿过，穿过胸部。

definition: from or in another country, especially a tropical one; seeming exciting and unusual because it seems to be connected with foreign countries
example: brightly-coloured exotic flowers/plants/birds
definition_zh: 来自或来自其他国家，尤其是热带国家;看起来既令人兴奋又不寻常，因为它似乎与外国有关
example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的异国花卉/植物/鸟类

definition: to become greater in size, number or importance; to make something greater in size, number or importance
example: Metals expand when they are heated.
definition_zh: 在规模、数量或重要性上变得更大;使某物在规模、数量或重要性上变得更大;
example_zh: 金属在加热时会膨胀。

definition: an act of increasing or making something increase in size, amount or importance
example: a period of rapid economic expansion
definition_zh: 增加或使某物在体积、数量或重要性上增加的行为
example_zh: 经济快速扩张的时期

definition: to think or believe that something will happen or that somebody will do something
example: expect something, The company is expecting record sales this year.
definition_zh: 去想或相信某件事会发生，或者有人会做某件事
example_zh: 期待点什么，公司预计今年销量将创纪录。

definition: a belief that something will happen because it is likely
example: expectation of something, We are confident in our expectation of a full recovery.
definition_zh: 一种相信某件事会发生的信念，因为它很可能会发生
example_zh: 对某种期待，我们对完全康复的期待充满信心。

definition: that you think will happen
example: Double the expected number of people came to the meeting.
definition_zh: 你认为会发生的事
example_zh: 出席会议的人数是预期的两倍。

definition: an organized journey with a particular purpose, especially to find out about a place that is not well known
example: to plan/lead/go on an expedition
definition_zh: 一次有明确目的的有组织旅行，尤其是为了探索鲜为人知的地方
example_zh: 计划/领导/参加探险

definition: the act of spending or using money; an amount of money spent
example: a reduction in public/government/military expenditure
definition_zh: 消费或使用金钱的行为;花费的金额
example_zh: 公共/政府/军事支出的减少

definition: the money that you spend on something
example: The garden was transformed at great expense.
definition_zh: 你花在某样东西上的钱
example_zh: 花园经过改造，花费巨大。

definition: costing a lot of money
example: an expensive car/restaurant/holiday
definition_zh: 花费不菲
example_zh: 一辆昂贵的汽车/餐厅/度假

definition: the knowledge and skill that you have gained through doing something for a period of time; the process of gaining this
example: My lack of practical experience was a disadvantage.
definition_zh: 你通过一段时间做某件事所获得的知识和技能;获得这些的过程
example_zh: 我缺乏实际经验是个劣势。

definition: to have a particular situation affect you or happen to you
example: Many people have never experienced these difficulties first-hand.
definition_zh: 某个特定情况影响你或发生在你身上
example_zh: 许多人从未亲身经历过这些困难。

definition: having knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity
example: an experienced player/teacher
definition_zh: 在某项特定工作或活动中具备知识或技能
example_zh: 一位经验丰富的演奏者/教师

definition: a scientific test that is done in order to study what happens and to gain new knowledge
example: to do/perform/conduct an experiment
definition_zh: 一种科学测试，旨在研究发生了什么并获得新知识
example_zh: 进行/执行/进行实验

definition: to do a scientific experiment or experiments
example: After experimenting at Columbia University, he realized that fission was the key to releasing nuclear energy.
definition_zh: 进行科学实验或实验
example_zh: 在哥伦比亚大学进行实验后，他意识到裂变是释放核能的关键。

definition: based on new ideas, forms or methods that are used to find out what effect they have
example: The school's experimental teaching methods include letting the children decide what to study.
definition_zh: 基于新的想法、形式或方法，用来了解其效果
example_zh: 学校的实验性教学方法包括让学生自行决定学习什么。

definition: done with, having or involving great knowledge or skill
example: to seek expert advice
definition_zh: 拥有、拥有或涉及高超知识或技能
example_zh: 寻求专家建议

definition: a person with special knowledge, skill or training in something
example: a legal/security/medical/computer expert
definition_zh: 一个在某方面拥有特殊知识、技能或训练的人
example_zh: 法律/安全/医疗/计算机专家

definition: expert knowledge or skill in a particular subject, activity or job
example: professional/scientific/technical, etc. expertise
definition_zh: 在特定学科、活动或工作方面的专业知识或技能
example_zh: 专业/科学/技术等专长

definition: to be no longer legally acceptable because the period of time for which it could be used has ended
example: When does your driving licence expire?
definition_zh: 由于其可使用的期限已届满，因此不再具有法律上的可接受性
example_zh: 你的驾照什么时候到期？

definition: to tell somebody about something in a way that makes it easy to understand
example: explain (something), He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.
definition_zh: 用一种容易理解的方式告诉别人一件事
example_zh: 解释（什么），他试图解释嘻哈和说唱的区别。

definition: a statement, fact, or situation that tells you why something happened; a reason given for something
example: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.
definition_zh: 一种陈述、事实或情境，告诉你某件事发生的原因;给出某事的理由
example_zh: 最可能的解释是他的飞机延误了。

definition: clear and easy to understand, so that you have no doubt what is meant
example: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
definition_zh: 清晰易懂，让您毫无疑问地明白其含义
example_zh: 他给了我非常明确的路线，告诉我如何到达那里。

definition: clearly or directly, so that the meaning is easy to understand
example: The report states explicitly that the system was to blame.
definition_zh: 清晰或直接，以便易于理解
example_zh: 报告明确指出，是体制造成的。

definition: to burst (= break apart) or make something burst loudly and violently, causing damage
example: A second bomb exploded in a crowded market.
definition_zh: 爆炸（=碎裂）或让某物响亮剧烈爆裂，造成损害
example_zh: 第二枚炸弹在拥挤的市场中爆炸。

definition: to treat a person or situation as an opportunity to gain an advantage for yourself
example: He exploited his father's name to get himself a job.
definition_zh: 把一个人或情境当作为自己争取优势的机会
example_zh: 他利用父亲的名声谋取工作。

definition: a situation in which somebody treats somebody else in an unfair way, especially in order to make money from their work
example: the exploitation of children
definition_zh: 一种情形：有人以不公平的方式对待他人，尤其是为了从自己的工作中赚钱
example_zh: 儿童的剥削

definition: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or look for something in it
example: Budgets for space exploration have been cut back.
definition_zh: 穿梭于一个地方，以了解它或寻找其中的东西的行为
example_zh: 太空探索的预算被削减了。

definition: to travel to or around an area or a country in order to learn about it
example: As soon as we arrived on the island we were eager to explore.
definition_zh: 前往或绕行一个地区或国家以了解它
example_zh: 一到岛上，我们就迫不及待想去探索。

definition: the sudden violent bursting and loud noise of something such as a bomb exploding; the act of deliberately causing something to explode
example: a bomb/nuclear/gas explosion
definition_zh: 比如炸弹爆炸时突然剧烈爆炸和巨大声响;故意让某物爆炸的行为
example_zh: 炸弹/核/毒气爆炸

definition: easily able or likely to explode
example: an explosive device (= a bomb)
definition_zh: 容易爆炸或极有可能爆炸
example_zh: 爆炸装置（=炸弹）

definition: a substance that is able or likely to cause an explosion
example: plastic explosives
definition_zh: 一种能够或很可能引发爆炸的物质
example_zh: 塑料炸药

definition: the selling and transporting of goods to another country
example: a ban on the export of live cattle
definition_zh: 向他国销售和运输货物
example_zh: 禁止出口活牛

definition: to sell and send goods to another country
example: export (something), The islands export sugar and fruit.
definition_zh: 向其他国家销售和寄送货物
example_zh: 出口（某类），岛屿出口糖和水果。

definition: to show something that is usually hidden
example: expose something, He smiled suddenly, exposing a set of amazingly white teeth.
definition_zh: 展示通常隐藏的内容
example_zh: 露出什么，“他突然笑了，露出一口异常洁白的牙齿。

definition: the state of being in a place or situation where there is no protection from something harmful or unpleasant
example: prolonged exposure to harmful radiation
definition_zh: 处于一个没有任何保护免受有害或不愉快事物保护的状态
example_zh: 长期暴露于有害辐射

definition: to show or make known a feeling, an opinion, etc. by words, looks or actions
example: express something, Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.
definition_zh: 通过言语、眼神或行为表达或表达某种感受、观点等
example_zh: 表达一些意见，老师们对这些变化表示担忧。

definition: a word or phrase
example: What's the meaning of the expression ‘on cloud nine’?
definition_zh: 一个单词或短语
example_zh: “在云端”这句话是什么意思？

definition: to make something longer or larger
example: to extend a fence/road/house
definition_zh: 让某样东西变长或更大
example_zh: 延伸围栏/道路/房屋

definition: the act of increasing the area of activity, group of people, etc. that is affected by something
example: the extension of new technology into developing countries
definition_zh: 扩大受某影响的活动范围、人群等的行为
example_zh: 将新技术推广到发展中国家

definition: covering a large area; great in amount
example: The house has extensive grounds.
definition_zh: 覆盖面积大;数量巨大
example_zh: 这座宅邸拥有广阔的庭院。

definition: in a way that covers a large area
example: She has travelled extensively.
definition_zh: 以覆盖大范围的方式
example_zh: 她曾广泛旅行。

definition: how large, important, serious, etc. something is
example: It is difficult to assess the full extent of the damage.
definition_zh: 某件事有多大、多重要、多严重等等
example_zh: 评估损害的全部程度是很难的。

definition: connected with or located on the outside of something/somebody
example: the external walls of the building
definition_zh: 与某物/某人相连或位于外部
example_zh: 建筑的外墙

definition: more than is usual, expected, or than exists already
example: extra money/cash/funding
definition_zh: 比通常、预期或已经存在的还要多
example_zh: 额外资金/现金/资金

definition: in addition; more than is usual, expected or exists already
example: to pay/cost extra
definition_zh: 此外;比通常、预期或已经存在的还要多
example_zh: 额外付费/额外费用

definition: a thing that is added to something that is not usual, standard or necessary and that costs more
example: The monthly fee is fixed and there are no hidden extras (= unexpected costs).
definition_zh: 一种附加在不常见、不标准或不必要的事物上的东西，而且成本更高的东西
example_zh: 月费固定，没有隐藏额外费用（= 意外费用）。

definition: a short passage from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea of what the whole thing is like
example: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
definition_zh: 一小段书里的一段、一段音乐之类的片段，能让你大致了解整个过程是什么样的
example_zh: 以下摘录自她的新小说。

definition: to remove or obtain a substance from something, for example by using an industrial or a chemical process
example: a machine that extracts excess moisture from the air
definition_zh: 例如，通过工业或化学工艺从某物中提取或获取某种物质
example_zh: 一种从空气中提取多余水分的机器

definition: unexpected, surprising or strange
example: What an extraordinary thing to say!
definition_zh: 出乎意料、令人惊讶或奇怪
example_zh: 真是非凡的话！

definition: very great in degree
example: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.
definition_zh: 学位非常出色
example_zh: 我们目前正承受极大压力。

definition: a feeling, situation, way of behaving, etc. that is as different as possible from another or is opposite to it
example: extremes of love and hate
definition_zh: 一种感觉、情境、行为方式等，尽可能与另一种不同或相反
example_zh: 爱与恨的极端

definition: to a very high degree
example: It is extremely important to follow the directions exactly.
definition_zh: 在非常高的程度上
example_zh: 严格按照说明操作非常重要。

definition: a person whose opinions, especially about religion or politics, are extreme, and who may do things that are violent or illegal for what they believe
example: left-wing/right-wing/political/religious extremists
definition_zh: 一个观点极端的人，尤其是在宗教或政治方面，可能做出与其信仰相符的暴力或非法行为
example_zh: 左翼/右翼/政治/宗教极端分子

definition: either of the two organs on the face that you see with
example: The suspect has dark hair and green eyes.
definition_zh: 你看到的脸上的两个器官中的任一个
example_zh: 嫌疑人有黑发和绿色眼睛。

definition: material made by weaving wool, cotton, silk, etc., used for making clothes, curtains, etc. and for covering furniture
example: They sell a wide variety of printed cotton fabric.
definition_zh: 由羊毛、棉、丝等织造的材料，用于制作服装、窗帘等以及覆盖家具
example_zh: 他们出售各种印花棉布。

definition: extremely good
example: They put on a fabulous performance.
definition_zh: 极好
example_zh: 他们表演得非常精彩。

definition: the front part of the head, where the eyes, nose and mouth are
example: a pretty/pale/round face
definition_zh: 头部前部，即眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴所在的位置
example_zh: 一张漂亮/苍白/圆润的脸

definition: to be opposite somebody/something; to have your face or front pointing towards somebody/something or in a particular direction
example: face somebody/something, She turned and faced him.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物相对;让你的脸或正面朝向某个人/某物或某个特定方向
example_zh: 面对某个人/某物，她转身面对他。

definition: to make an action or a process possible or easier
example: The new trade agreement should facilitate more rapid economic growth.
definition_zh: 使某个动作或过程成为可能或更简单
example_zh: 新的贸易协定应促进更快的经济增长。

definition: buildings, services, equipment, etc. that are provided for a particular purpose
example: leisure/sports facilities
definition_zh: 为特定目的而提供的建筑物、服务、设备等
example_zh: 休闲/体育设施

definition: a thing that is known to be true, especially when it can be proved
example: fact about something, First, some basic facts about healthy eating.
definition_zh: 一件众所周知的事实，尤其是当它可以被证明时
example_zh: 关于某件事的事实，首先，关于健康饮食的一些基本事实。

definition: a small group of people within a larger one, whose members have some different aims and beliefs to those of the larger group
example: There are rival factions within the administration.
definition_zh: 一个大群体中的一小群人，其成员的目标和信念与大群体有所不同
example_zh: 政府内部存在对立派系。

definition: one of several things that cause or influence something
example: Obesity is a major risk factor for heart disease.
definition_zh: 其中一种是导致或影响某件事的几个因素之一
example_zh: 肥胖是心脏病的主要风险因素。

definition: a building or group of buildings where goods are made, mainly by machine
example: a car factory
definition_zh: 一栋建筑或一组建筑物，主要通过机器制造货物
example_zh: 汽车工厂

definition: a department or group of related departments in a college or university
example: the Faculty of Law
definition_zh: 学院或大学中的一个系或相关系的集合
example_zh: 法学院

definition: to become or to make something become paler or less bright
example: The curtains had faded in the sun.
definition_zh: 变成或让某物变得更苍白或不那么明亮
example_zh: 窗帘在阳光下褪去了。

definition: to not be successful in achieving something
example: Many diets fail because they are boring.
definition_zh: 未能成功实现某项成就
example_zh: 许多减肥失败是因为它们无聊。

definition: not successful
example: a failed writer
definition_zh: 未成功
example_zh: 一个失败的作家

definition: lack of success in doing or achieving something
example: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.
definition_zh: 在做某事或实现某事上缺乏成功
example_zh: 计划的成败取决于你。

definition: acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
example: a fair deal/wage/price
definition_zh: 在特定情况下是可接受且适当的
example_zh: 公平的交易/工资/价格

definition: to some extent but not very
example: fairly simple/easy/straightforward
definition_zh: 在某种程度上，但不算特别
example_zh: 相当简单/简单/直接

definition: the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is reasonable
example: The fairness of the judicial system is being questioned.
definition_zh: 对待人们的平等或合理对待的质量
example_zh: 司法系统的公正性正受到质疑。

definition: trust in somebody’s ability or knowledge; trust that somebody/something will do what has been promised
example: If the company can retain its customers' faith, it could become the market leader.
definition_zh: 信任某人的能力或知识;相信某人/某物会兑现承诺
example_zh: 如果公司能够赢得客户的信任，它有望成为市场领导者。

definition: not what somebody claims it is; appearing to be something it is not
example: There were a few stalls selling fake designer clothing.
definition_zh: 不是别人声称的样子;看起来像其实不是的东西
example_zh: 有几个摊位卖假名牌服装。

definition: an act of falling
example: I had a bad fall and broke my arm.
definition_zh: 坠落的行为
example_zh: 我摔得很重，摔断了胳膊。

definition: to drop down from a higher level to a lower level
example: The rain was falling steadily.
definition_zh: 从较高级别降级到较低级别
example_zh: 雨一直在下。

definition: wrong; not correct or true
