definition: to use a particular name or word to describe somebody/something
example: term somebody/something + adj., At his age, he can hardly be termed young.
definition_zh: 使用某个特定的名字或词语来描述某人或某物
example_zh: 用某某/某某+形容词称呼他，以他的年纪，很难称得上年轻。

definition: that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly
example: He has terminal lung cancer.
definition_zh: 这种病无法治愈，最终会慢慢走向死亡
example_zh: 他患有晚期肺癌。

definition: a building or set of buildings at an airport where passengers arrive and leave
example: A second terminal was opened last year.
definition_zh: 机场内旅客抵达和离开的建筑物或建筑群
example_zh: 去年又开设了第二个航站楼。

definition: to end; to make something end
example: Your contract of employment terminates in December.
definition_zh: 结束;让某件事结束
example_zh: 你的雇佣合同将在十二月到期。

definition: the conditions that people offer, demand or accept when they make an agreement, an arrangement or a contract
example: peace terms
definition_zh: 人们在达成协议、安排或合同时所提供、要求或接受的条件
example_zh: 和平条款

definition: used to refer to an area of land when you are mentioning its natural features, for example, if it is rough, flat, etc.
example: difficult/rough/mountainous terrain
definition_zh: 用来指你提到某片土地的自然特征时，比如它是否崎岖、平坦等。
example_zh: 困难/崎岖/山地地形

definition: very unpleasant; making you feel very unhappy, upset or frightened
example: a terrible experience
definition_zh: 非常不愉快;让你感到非常不开心、难过或害怕
example_zh: 一次糟糕的经历

definition: very
example: I'm terribly sorry—did I hurt you?
definition_zh: 非常
example_zh: 我非常抱歉——我伤害你了吗？

definition: excellent; wonderful
example: I feel absolutely terrific today!
definition_zh: 非常好;太棒了
example_zh: 我今天感觉棒极了！

definition: to make somebody feel extremely frightened
example: terrify somebody, Flying terrifies her.
definition_zh: 让某人感到极度恐惧
example_zh: 吓唬别人，飞翔让她害怕。

definition: land that is under the control of a particular country or political leader
example: enemy/disputed/foreign territory
definition_zh: 受特定国家或政治领导人控制的土地
example_zh: 敌对/争议/外国领土

definition: a feeling of extreme fear
example: a feeling of sheer/pure terror
definition_zh: 极度恐惧的感觉
example_zh: 一种纯粹的恐惧感

definition: the use of violent action in order to achieve political aims or to force a government to act

definition_zh: 参与恐怖主义的人

definition: an examination of somebody’s knowledge or ability, consisting of questions for them to answer or activities for them to perform
example: an IQ/a fitness test
definition_zh: 对某人的知识或能力进行考察，包括让他们回答的问题或需要他们完成的活动

definition: to find out how much somebody knows, or what they can do by asking them questions or giving them activities to perform
example: test somebody, Students will be tested at the end of each module.
definition_zh: 通过提问或布置任务来了解某人到底知道多少，或者他们能做些什么

definition: to make a statement that something happened or that something is true, especially as a witness in court
example: testify against somebody/something, She refused to testify against her husband.
definition_zh: 要做出某件事确实发生过或某件事是真的声明，尤其是在法庭上作为证人
example_zh: 她拒绝作证指控某人或某物，却拒绝作证指控她丈夫。

definition: a thing that shows that something else exists or is true
example: This increase in exports bears testimony to the successes of industry.
definition_zh: 一种表明别的事物存在或真实存在的东西

definition: the activity of testing somebody/something in order to find something out, see if it works, etc.
example: nuclear testing
definition_zh: 就是测试某个人或某物以发现问题、看看是否有效等的活动。
example_zh: 核试验

definition: any form of written material
example: a computer that can process text
definition_zh: 任何形式的书面材料

definition: to send somebody a written message using a mobile phone
example: I'll text you when I get home.
definition_zh: 使用手机向某人发送书面信息

definition: a book that teaches a particular subject and that is used especially in schools and colleges

definition_zh: 一本教授特定学科的书，尤其在学校和大学中使用

definition: the way a surface, substance or piece of cloth feels when you touch it, for example how rough, smooth, hard or soft it is
example: the soft texture of velvet
definition_zh: 比如你触摸某个表面、物质或布片时的触感，比如它的粗糙、光滑、硬度或柔软程度

definition: used to introduce the second part of a comparison

definition_zh: 用于介绍比较的第二部分

definition: used to introduce the second part of a comparison

definition_zh: 用于介绍比较的第二部分
example_zh: 我比她年长。

definition: to tell somebody that you are grateful for something

definition_zh: 告诉别人你对某件事心怀感激
example_zh: 感谢某人吧，我必须写信感谢玛利亚送来的礼物。

definition: used to show that you are pleased that something good has happened or that something bad has been avoided
example: There was a fire in the building, but thankfully no one was hurt.
definition_zh: 用来表达你为发生了好事或避免了坏事感到高兴
example_zh: 大楼里发生了火灾，但幸好没有人受伤。

definition: used to show that you are grateful to somebody for something they have done
example: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks (= thanks for asking).’
definition_zh: 用来表达你对某人所做的事情的感激
example_zh: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢（=谢谢关心）。”

definition: words or actions that show that you are grateful to somebody for something
example: thanks to somebody for something, How can I ever express my thanks to you for all you've done?
definition_zh: 那些表达你对某人感激的言语或行为
example_zh: 感谢某人，我该如何表达对你所做的一切的感谢呢？

definition: to such a degree; so
example: I can't walk that far (= as far as that).
definition_zh: 如此程度;所以
example_zh: 我走不了那么远（=就那么远）。

definition: used after some verbs, adjectives and nouns to introduce a new part of the sentence
example: She said (that) the story was true.
definition_zh: 在某些动词、形容词和名词之后使用，用于引入句子的新部分
example_zh: 她说（说）这个故事是真的。

definition: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker or as near to the speaker as another
example: Look at that man over there.
definition_zh: 用于指称不靠近说话者或与说话人不近的人或事物，或者与说话人不一样靠近
example_zh: 看看那边那个人。

definition: used for referring to a person or thing that is not near the speaker, or not as near to the speaker as another
example: Who's that?
definition_zh: 用于指称不靠近说话者，或不像另一个人那样离说话者那么近的人或事物
example_zh: 那是谁？

definition: used to refer to somebody/something that has already been mentioned or is easily understood
example: There were three questions. The first two were relatively easy but the third one was hard.
definition_zh: 用于指已经被提及或易于理解的人/物

definition: a building or an outdoor area where plays and similar types of entertainment are performed

definition_zh: 一栋建筑或户外区域用于上演戏剧及类似娱乐活动
example_zh: 百老汇剧院

definition: connected with the theatre
example: a theatrical agent
definition_zh: 与剧院的关联
example_zh: 一位戏剧经纪人

definition: the crime of stealing something from a person or place

definition_zh: 从某人或某地偷窃某物的犯罪

definition: of or belonging to people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: Their parties are always fun.
definition_zh: 属于或属于已经提及或易于识别的人、动物或事物
example_zh: 他们的派对总是很有趣。

definition: of or belonging to them
example: Theirs are the children with very fair hair.
definition_zh: 属于或属于他们

definition: used when referring to people, animals or things as the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: Tell them the news.
definition_zh: 用于将人、动物或事物作为动词或介词的宾语，或在动词 be 之后
example_zh: 告诉他们这个消息。

definition: the subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing or work of art
example: the central/main/key/major theme
definition_zh: 演讲、作品或艺术作品中的主题或主要思想
example_zh: 核心/主旨/关键/主要主题

definition: used when people or animals performing an action are also affected by it
example: They seemed to be enjoying themselves.
definition_zh: 当执行某项操作的人或动物也会受到其影响时，会使用。
example_zh: 他们似乎玩得很开心。

definition: used to refer to a particular time in the past or future
example: Life was harder then because neither of us had a job.
definition_zh: 用于指代过去或未来的某个特定时间
example_zh: 那时生活更艰难，因为我们俩都没有工作。

definition: the study of religion and beliefs
example: a degree in theology
definition_zh: 宗教与信仰的研究
example_zh: 神学学位

definition: connected with the ideas and principles on which a particular subject is based, rather than with practice and experiment
example: a theoretical approach
definition_zh: 与某个特定主题所依据的理念和原则相关，而非实践和实验
example_zh: 理论方法

definition: a formal set of ideas that is intended to explain why something happens or exists
example: theory of something, the theory of evolution/relativity
definition_zh: 一套旨在解释某事为何发生或存在而正式的思想集合
example_zh: 某物理论，进化论/相对论

definition: a specialist who treats a particular type of illness or problem, or who uses a particular type of treatment
example: a speech therapist
definition_zh: 一位治疗特定类型疾病或问题的专家，或使用特定治疗方式的专家
example_zh: 一名言语治疗师

definition: the treatment of a physical problem or an illness
example: He is receiving therapy for cancer.
definition_zh: 治疗身体问题或疾病
example_zh: 他正在接受癌症治疗。

definition: used to show that something exists or happens
example: There's a restaurant around the corner.
definition_zh: 用于显示某事存在或发生
example_zh: 拐角处有一家餐厅。

definition: after the time or event mentioned
example: She married at 17 and gave birth to her first child shortly thereafter.
definition_zh: 在所述时间或事件之后
example_zh: 她17岁时结婚，不久后生下了第一个孩子。

definition: used to introduce the result of the action or situation mentioned
example: Regular exercise strengthens the heart, thereby reducing the risk of heart attack.
definition_zh: 用于介绍所述行为或情境的结果
example_zh: 规律锻炼能增强心脏功能，从而降低心脏病发作的风险。

definition: used to introduce the logical result of something that has just been mentioned
example: He's only 17 and therefore not eligible to vote.
definition_zh: 用于介绍刚刚提到的事物的逻辑结果
example_zh: 他才17岁，因此没有投票资格。

definition: a long piece of writing completed by a student as part of a university degree, based on their own research
example: Students must submit a thesis on an agreed subject within four years.
definition_zh: 学生基于自身研究完成的一篇长篇文章，作为大学学位的一部分
example_zh: 学生必须在四年内提交关于约定主题的论文。

definition: people, animals or things that have already been mentioned or are easily identified
example: ‘Where are John and Liz?’ ‘They went for a walk.’
definition_zh: 人、动物或已经被提及或容易识别的事物

definition: having a larger distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal

definition_zh: 比其他类似物体或正常物体之间的相对侧或表面间距更大

definition: a person who steals something from another person or place

definition_zh: 一个人从他人或地方偷取物品

definition: having a smaller distance between opposite sides or surfaces than other similar objects or than normal

definition_zh: 相对侧或表面之间的距离比其他类似物体或正常物体更小

definition: an object whose name you do not use because you do not need to or want to, or because you do not know it

definition_zh: 一个你不使用它名称的对象，因为你不需要、不想使用它，或者因为你不知道它
example_zh: 能把那边那个东西递给我吗？

definition: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe something

definition_zh: 对某事或某人有特定的想法或观点;相信某事

definition_zh: 思考某事的过程

definition_zh: 数字13

definition_zh: 用来指一个与你很近的特定人物、事物或事件，尤其是与另一个人相比时

definition_zh: 用来指你身边或刚刚被提及的人或事物

definition: done completely; with great attention to detail

definition_zh: 完全完成;对细节极为讲究
example_zh: 对该领域的深入了解

definition: very much; completely
example: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
definition_zh: 非常；完全
example_zh: 我们玩得非常开心。

definition: used especially at the end of a sentence or clause to add a fact or an opinion that makes the previous statement less strong or less important
example: Our team lost. It was a good game though.
definition_zh: 尤其是在句子或子句的结尾时，用来补充一个事实或观点，使前述陈述变得不那么有力或不那么重要

definition: despite the fact that
example: Anne was fond of Tim, though he often annoyed her.
definition_zh: 尽管

definition_zh: 你想起或记得的某件事

definition: making people think seriously about a particular subject or issue

definition_zh: 让人们认真思考某个特定主题或问题

definition: a statement in which you tell somebody that you will punish or harm them, especially if they do not do what you want

definition_zh: 一种声明，你告诉某人你会惩罚或伤害他们，尤其是如果他们不按你想要的做

definition: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want

definition_zh: 非常兴奋和满意

definition_zh: 成为并继续成功、坚强、健康等等。

definition: a passage in the neck through which food and air pass on their way into the body; the front part of the neck

definition_zh: 颈部的一条通道，食物和空气通过它进入体内;颈部前部

example: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
definition_zh: 从某物的一端或一侧到另一端或另一侧

definition_zh: 从某物或某人的一端或一侧到另一端

definition_zh: 在某物的每一个部分或其中

definition_zh: 手侧那根短而粗的手指，与另外四根略有距离

definition_zh: 就这样;像这样

definition_zh: 一张打印出来的纸，或者手机或电脑收到的信息或图片，赋予你乘坐特定公交、火车等的权利，或者进入剧院等。

definition: a regular rise and fall in the level of the sea, caused by the pull of the moon and sun; the flow of water that happens as the sea rises and falls

definition: arranged neatly and with everything in order

definition_zh: 整齐地摆放，一切都井然有序

definition: to make something look neat by putting things in the place where they belong

definition_zh: 把东西放到该在的位置，让东西看起来整洁
example_zh: 我整个上午都在打扫和整理。

definition: a long, narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, especially by men, with a knot in front

definition_zh: 一种长而窄的布，通常系在脖子上，尤其是男性佩戴，前面有结

definition: to attach or hold two or more things together using string, rope, etc.; to fasten somebody/something with string, rope, etc.

definition_zh: 用细绳、绳索等将两个或多个物体连接或固定在一起；用细绳、绳索等捆住某人或某物。

definition_zh: 牢牢固定在应有位置;难以移动、打开或分离

definition: what is measured in minutes, hours, days, etc.

definition_zh: 具体是用分钟、小时、天等单位来衡量的。
example_zh: 世界存在于时间和空间中。

definition_zh: 恰好在正确的时间发生

definition: a metal container in which food is sold; the contents of one of these containers

definition_zh: 用于销售食品的金属容器;其中一个容器内的内容物

definition_zh: 体积或数量非常小
example_zh: 一个小宝宝

definition: a small piece of advice about something practical
example: tip on/for doing something, handy tips for buying a computer
definition_zh: 关于一些实用的小建议
example_zh: 关于某件事的小贴士/购买电脑的小贴士

definition: to give somebody an extra amount of money to thank them for something they have done for you as part of their job
example: Americans were always welcome because they tended to tip heavily.
definition_zh: 给某人额外的钱，以感谢他们作为工作的一部分为你所做的事情
example_zh: 美国人总是受欢迎，因为他们倾向于给小费。

definition: feeling that you would like to sleep or rest; needing rest
example: to be/look/feel tired
definition_zh: 感觉自己想睡觉或休息;需要休息
example_zh: 感到/看起来/感觉疲惫

definition: a piece of soft paper, used especially as a handkerchief
example: a box of tissues
definition_zh: 一张软纸，特别用作手帕
example_zh: 一盒纸巾

definition: the name of a book, poem, painting, piece of music, etc.
example: What's title of her new book?
definition_zh: 一本书、一首诗、一幅画、一首音乐作品等等。
example_zh: 她的新书叫什么？

definition: to give a book, piece of music, etc. a particular name
example: be titled…, Their first album was titled ‘Made in Valmez’.
definition_zh: 给一本书、一首音乐等取一个特定的名字
example_zh: 他们的首张专辑名为《Made in Valmez》。

definition: used to show purpose or intention
example: I set out to buy food.
definition_zh: 用于表达目的或意图
example_zh: 我出发去买食物。

definition: in the direction of something; towards something
example: I walked to the office.
definition_zh: 朝着某个方向;朝着某个方向
example_zh: 我走到办公室。

definition: the dried leaves of the tobacco plant that are used for making cigarettes, smoking in a pipe, etc.
example: tobacco smoke
definition_zh: 烟草植物的干叶，用于制烟、吸烟等。
example_zh: 烟草烟雾

definition: on this day
example: I've got a piano lesson later today.
definition_zh: 就在这一天
example_zh: 我今天晚些时候有钢琴课。

definition: this day
example: Today is her tenth birthday.
definition_zh: 今天
example_zh: 今天是她十岁生日。

definition: one of the five small parts that stick out from the foot; any similar part on the foot of an animal or bird
example: the big/little toe (= the largest/smallest toe)
definition_zh: 从脚部突出的五个小部分之一;动物或鸟类脚部上的任何类似部位
example_zh: 大脚趾/小脚趾（= 最大/最小脚趾）

definition: with or near to somebody/something else; with each other
example: We grew up together.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物一起或靠近;彼此之间
example_zh: 我们一起长大。

definition: a large bowl attached to a pipe that you sit on or stand over when you get rid of waste matter from your body
example: Have you flushed the toilet?
definition_zh: 一个连接在管子上的大碗，你在排出体内废物时会坐在上面或站在上面
example_zh: 你冲过马桶了吗？

definition: the quality of being willing to accept or tolerate somebody/something, especially opinions or behaviour that you may not agree with, or people who are not like you
example: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
definition_zh: 愿意接受或容忍某人或某事的品质，尤其是那些你可能不同意的观点或行为，或者那些与你不同的人
example_zh: 她对任何形式的玩笑都毫无容忍度。

definition: to allow somebody to do something that you do not agree with or like
example: tolerate something, Their relationship was tolerated but not encouraged.
definition_zh: 允许别人做你不同意或不喜欢的事情
example_zh: 容忍点什么，他们的关系被容忍，但并不被鼓励。

definition: money that you pay to use a particular road or bridge
example: motorway tolls
definition_zh: 你为使用某条特定道路或桥梁所支付的费用
example_zh: 高速公路收费

definition: a soft fruit with a lot of juice and shiny red skin that is eaten as a vegetable either raw or cooked
example: a bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich
definition_zh: 一种汁液丰富、皮肤发亮红润的软果，可作为蔬菜食用，生吃或熟食
example_zh: 培根、生菜和番茄三明治

definition: on or during the day after today
example: I'm off now. See you tomorrow.
definition_zh: 在今天之后的那一天
example_zh: 我现在要走了。明天见。

definition: the day after today
example: Today is Tuesday, so tomorrow is Wednesday.
definition_zh: 明天
example_zh: 今天是星期二，所以明天就是星期三。

definition: a unit for measuring weight, in the UK 2 240 pounds (long ton) and in the US 2 000 pounds (short ton)
example: (informal), What have you got in this bag? It weighs a ton (= is very heavy).
definition_zh: 这是一种重量单位，英国为2 240磅（长吨），美国为2 000磅（短吨）
example_zh: （非正式）你这个包里装的是什么？它重达一吨（= 非常重）。

definition: the quality of somebody’s voice, especially expressing a particular emotion
example: speaking in hushed/low/clipped/measured, etc. tones
definition_zh: 一个人声音的质量，尤其是表达某种特定情绪时的声音
example_zh: 用低声、低声、简短、有节奏的语气说话

definition: the soft part in the mouth that moves around, used for tasting, swallowing, speaking, etc.
example: He clicked his tongue to attract their attention.
definition_zh: 口腔内那个会移动的柔软部分，用于品尝、吞咽、说话等。
example_zh: 他咂了咂舌，想引起他们的注意。

definition: on or during the evening or night of today
example: Will you have dinner with me tonight?
definition_zh: 在今天的晚上或当晚
example_zh: 今晚你愿意和我共进晚餐吗？

definition: the evening or night of today
example: Here are tonight's football results.
definition_zh: 今天的晚上或夜晚
example_zh: 以下是今晚的橄榄球赛果。

definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1 000 kilograms
example: a record grain harvest of 236m tonnes
definition_zh: 一个用于测量重量的单位，等于1 000公斤
example_zh: 创纪录的2.36亿吨粮食收获

definition: used before adjectives and adverbs to say that something is more than is good, necessary, possible, etc.
example: He's far too young to go on his own.
definition_zh: 用于形容词和副词之前，表示某事超出了“好”、“必要”、“可能”等。
example_zh: 他太年轻了，不能自己去。

definition: an instrument such as a hammer, screwdriver, saw, etc. that you hold in your hand and use for making things, repairing things, etc.
example: garden tools
definition_zh: 一种工具，比如锤子、螺丝刀、锯子等，你握在手里用来制作、修理东西等等。
example_zh: 园艺工具

definition: any of the hard white structures in the mouth used for biting food
example: I've just had a tooth out at the dentist's.
definition_zh: 任何用于咬食的口腔硬白色结构
example_zh: 我刚在牙医那里拔了一颗牙。

definition: highest in position
example: He lives on the top floor.
definition_zh: 最高位置
example_zh: 他住在顶楼。

definition: the highest part or point of something
example: at the top of something, She was standing at the top of the stairs.
definition_zh: 某物的最高部分或点
example_zh: 在某处顶端，她站在楼梯顶端。

definition: to be higher than a particular amount
example: Worldwide sales look set to top $1 billion.
definition_zh: 高于某一特定金额
example_zh: 全球销售额预计将突破10亿美元。

definition: a subject that you talk, write or learn about
example: The main topic of conversation was Tom's new girlfriend.
definition_zh: 你谈论、写作或学习的主题
example_zh: 谈话的主要话题是汤姆的新女友。

definition: the act of causing somebody severe pain in order to punish them or make them say or do something
example: Many of the refugees have suffered torture.
definition_zh: 为惩罚某人或迫使他们说话或做某事而施加严重疼痛的行为
example_zh: 许多难民遭受了酷刑。

definition: to hurt somebody physically or mentally in order to punish them or make them tell you something
example: torture somebody, Many of the rebels were captured and tortured by secret police.
definition_zh: 为了惩罚某人或逼他们说出某件事，身体或精神上伤害他们
example_zh: 折磨某人，许多叛乱者被秘密警察抓捕并折磨。

definition: to throw something lightly or carelessly
example: toss something + adv./prep., I tossed the book aside and got up.
definition_zh: 轻轻或随意地扔东西
example_zh: 扔点东西 + 进度/准备，我把书扔到一边，站了起来。

definition: being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together
example: Their total cost was $18 000.
definition_zh: 是指在所有人或所有事物被计数或加总之后的数量或数量
example_zh: 他们的总花费为18,000美元。

definition: the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together; the final number of people or things when they have all been counted
example: a total of something, You got 47 points on the written examination and 18 on the oral, making a total of 65.
definition_zh: 当你把多个数字或数量相加时得到的数量;当所有人或事物全部计数完毕后，最终得到的数量
example_zh: 总共多少，笔试得了47分，口试得了18分，总共65分。

definition: to reach a particular total
example: Imports totalled $1.5 billion last year.
definition_zh: 以达到特定总数
example_zh: 去年进口总额为15亿美元。

definition: completely
example: They come from totally different cultures.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 他们来自完全不同的文化。

definition: the sense that enables you to be aware of things and what they are like when you put your hands and fingers on them
example: the sense of touch
definition_zh: 那种让你能觉察事物、以及当你把手和手指放在它们上时它们是什么样子的感觉
example_zh: 触觉

definition: to put your hand or another part of your body onto somebody/something
example: Don't touch that plate—it's hot!
definition_zh: 把你的手或身体的其他部位放在某个人/某物上
example_zh: 别碰那盘子——太烫了！

definition: having or causing problems or difficulties
example: a tough childhood
definition_zh: 遇到或造成问题或困难
example_zh: 一段艰难的童年

definition: a journey made for pleasure during which several different towns, countries, etc. are visited
example: a walking/sightseeing/bus tour
definition_zh: 这是一场为娱乐而设计的旅程，途中会访问多个不同的城镇、国家等
example_zh: 步行/观光/巴士游览

definition: to travel around a place, for example on holiday, or to perform, to advertise something, etc.
example: tour something, He toured America with his one-man show.
definition_zh: 比如去旅行，比如度假、表演、宣传什么的。
example_zh: 巡演了某件事，他带着独角戏巡演了美国。

definition: the business activity connected with providing accommodation, services and entertainment for people who are visiting a place for pleasure
example: The area is heavily dependent on tourism.
definition_zh: 为来访娱乐场所的人们提供住宿、服务和娱乐相关的商业活动
example_zh: 该地区高度依赖旅游业。

definition: a person who is travelling or visiting a place for pleasure
example: busloads of foreign tourists
definition_zh: 一个为了娱乐而旅行或访问某地的人
example_zh: 一车车载满的外国游客

definition: a sports competition involving a number of teams or players who take part in different games and must leave the competition if they lose. The competition continues until there is only the winner left.
example: a golf/tennis/soccer/chess tournament
definition_zh: 一项体育比赛，涉及多个队伍或球员，他们参加不同的比赛，若输了必须退出比赛。比赛持续进行，直到只剩下冠军。
example_zh: 高尔夫/网球/足球/国际象棋锦标赛

definition: in the direction of somebody/something
example: They were heading towards the German border.
definition_zh: 朝着某个人/某物的方向
example_zh: 他们正朝着德国边境前进。

definition: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things, especially your body
example: Help yourself to a clean towel.
definition_zh: 一块用来擦干物品的布或纸，尤其是你的身体
example_zh: 随便拿一条干净的毛巾。

definition: a tall narrow building or part of a building, especially of a church or castle
example: a bell tower
definition_zh: 一栋高而窄的建筑或建筑的一部分，尤其是教堂或城堡的建筑
example_zh: 钟楼

definition: a place with many houses, shops, etc. where people live and work. It is larger than a village but smaller than a city.
example: The nearest town is ten miles away.
definition_zh: 一个有许多房屋、商店等的地方，人们在那里生活和工作。它比一个村庄大，但比一个城市小。
example_zh: 最近的城镇距离十英里。

definition: containing poison; poisonous
example: toxic chemicals/fumes/gases/substances
definition_zh: 含有毒药;有毒
example_zh: 有毒化学品/烟雾/气体/物质

definition: made as a copy of a particular thing and used for playing with
example: a toy car
definition_zh: 作为特定物品的复制品制作，用于玩弄
example_zh: 一辆玩具车

definition: an object for children to play with
example: cuddly/stuffed toys
definition_zh: 一个供孩子们玩耍的物品
example_zh: 毛绒玩具/毛绒玩具

definition: a mark, an object or a sign that shows that somebody/something existed or was present
example: It's exciting to discover traces of earlier civilizations.
definition_zh: 一个标记、一个物体或一个标志，表明某人/某物曾存在或曾在场
example_zh: 发现早期文明的痕迹令人兴奋。

definition: to find or discover somebody/something by looking carefully for them/it
example: We finally traced him to an address in Chicago.
definition_zh: 通过仔细寻找某人/某物/某物，来发现或发现他们/某物
example_zh: 我们终于追踪到他在芝加哥的一个地址。

definition: rails (= metal bars) that a train moves along
example: railway/railroad tracks
definition_zh: 列车沿线行驶的轨道（=金属杆）
example_zh: 铁路/铁路轨道

definition: to find somebody/something by following the marks, signs, information, etc., that they have left behind them
example: track somebody/something, hunters tracking and shooting bears
definition_zh: 通过追踪他们留下的标记、迹象、信息等，找到某个人或某物
example_zh: 追踪某人/某物，猎人追踪并射杀熊

definition: the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries
example: international/foreign/global/world trade
definition_zh: 在个人或国家之间进行买卖或交换商品或服务的活动
example_zh: 国际/对外/全球/世界贸易

definition: to buy and sell things
example: trade in something, The firm openly traded in arms.
definition_zh: 买卖东西
example_zh: 做某项贸易，该公司公开从事军火贸易。

definition: a name, symbol or design that a company uses for its products and that cannot be used by anyone else
example: ‘Big Mac’ is McDonald's best-known trademark.
definition_zh: 公司用于其产品且不能被他人使用的名称、符号或设计
example_zh: “巨无霸”是麦当劳最著名的标志。

definition: the activity of buying and selling things
example: new laws on Sunday trading (= shops being open on Sundays)
definition_zh: 买卖物品的活动
example_zh: 关于周日营业的新法律（=商店周日营业）

definition: a belief, custom or way of doing something that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people; a set of these beliefs or customs
example: religious/cultural/ancient traditions
definition_zh: 一种在特定群体中长期存在的信仰、习俗或做某事的方式;这些信仰或习俗的集合
example_zh: 宗教/文化/古代传统

definition: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time
example: traditional dress/music/art/culture/dance
definition_zh: 成为某一特定群体信仰、习俗或生活方式的一部分，这些信仰、习俗或生活方式长期未曾改变
example_zh: 传统服饰/音乐/艺术/文化/舞蹈

definition: the vehicles that are on a road at a particular time
example: There's always a lot of traffic at this time of day.
definition_zh: 在特定时间行驶在道路上的车辆
example_zh: 这个时间段总是车流拥堵。

definition: a very sad event or situation, especially one that involves death
example: It's a tragedy that she died so young.
definition_zh: 一个非常悲伤的事件或情境，尤其是涉及死亡的事件
example_zh: 她这么年轻就去世了，真是悲剧。

definition: making you feel very sad, usually because somebody has died or suffered a lot
example: He was killed in a tragic accident at the age of 24.
definition_zh: 让你感到非常难过，通常是因为有人去世或受了很多苦
example_zh: 他在24岁时因一场悲惨事故去世。

definition: a long line or series of marks that is left by somebody/something
example: a trail of blood
definition_zh: 一长条线或一连串由某人/某物留下的痕迹
example_zh: 一道血迹

definition: to pull something behind somebody/something, usually along the ground; to be pulled along in this way
example: trail something, A jeep trailing a cloud of dust was speeding in my direction.
definition_zh: 拉着某物到某人或某物身后，通常是沿着地面;被这样拉着走
example_zh: 跟踪什么的，一辆吉普车拖着一团尘土朝我飞驰而来。

definition: a truck, or a container with wheels, that is pulled by another vehicle
example: a car towing a trailer with a boat on it
definition_zh: 一辆卡车，或一个带轮子的集装箱，由另一辆车牵引
example_zh: 一辆拖着拖车的汽车，拖着一艘船

definition: a number of connected coaches or trucks, pulled by an engine or powered by a motor in each one, taking people and goods from one place to another
example: to get on/off a train
definition_zh: 多辆相连的长途车或卡车，由发动机牵引或由电机驱动，将人员和货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方
example_zh: 上/下火车

definition: to teach a person or an animal the skills for a particular job or activity; to be taught in this way
example: train somebody/something, highly trained professionals
definition_zh: 教人或动物从事特定工作或活动的技能;以这种方式被教导
example_zh: 培训某人/某物，训练有素的专业人士

definition: a shoe that you wear for sports or as informal clothing
example: a pair of trainers
definition_zh: 一种你用于运动或休闲穿着的鞋子
example_zh: 一双运动鞋

definition: the process of learning the skills that you need to do a job
example: staff training
definition_zh: 学习完成工作所需技能的过程
example_zh: 员工培训

definition: a particular quality in your personality
example: personality traits
definition_zh: 你性格中的某种特殊品质
example_zh: 性格特质

definition: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling
example: financial transactions between companies
definition_zh: 一笔交易，是人与人之间进行的，尤其是买卖的行为
example_zh: 公司间的金融交易

definition: a written or printed copy of words that have been spoken
example: a transcript of the interview
definition_zh: 已说出的文字的书面或印刷副本
example_zh: 采访记录

definition: the act of moving somebody/something from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens
example: electronic data transfer
definition_zh: 将某人或某物从一个地点、群体或工作转移到另一个地点的行为;发生这种情况的场合
example_zh: 电子数据传输

definition: to move from one place to another; to move something/somebody from one place to another
example: transfer (to something), The film studio is transferring to Hollywood.
definition_zh: 从一个地方移动到另一个地方;将某物或某人从一个地方移动到另一个地方
example_zh: 转会（到某处），电影制片厂正在搬迁到好莱坞。

definition: to change the form of something; to change in form
example: transform something/somebody (into something), The photochemical reactions transform the light into electrical impulses.
definition_zh: 改变某物的形态;改变形态
example_zh: 把某物/某人（变成某物），光化学反应将光转化为电脉冲。

definition: a complete change in somebody/something
example: The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
definition_zh: 某人/某物的彻底转变
example_zh: 在过去十年里，我们的工作方式发生了彻底的转变。

definition: the process of being moved or carried from one place to another
example: The cost includes transit.
definition_zh: 从一个地方搬运或搬运到另一个地方的过程
example_zh: 费用包括交通费用。

definition: the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another
example: transition from something to something, the transition from school to full-time work
definition_zh: 从一种状态或状态转变为另一种状态的过程或一段时间
example_zh: 从某样东西过渡到另一件事，从学校到全职工作的转变

definition: to express the meaning of speech or writing in a different language
example: translate something into something, He translated the letter into English.
definition_zh: 用另一种语言表达言语或书写的含义
example_zh: 把某件事翻译成某种东西，他把信翻译成了英文。

definition: the process of changing something that is written or spoken into another language
example: an error in translation
definition_zh: 将书写或口语内容改写成另一种语言的过程
example_zh: 翻译错误

definition: the act or process of passing something from one person, place or thing to another
example: the transmission of the disease
definition_zh: 将某物从一个人、一个地方或事物传递给另一个人的行为或过程
example_zh: 疾病的传播

definition: to send an electronic signal, radio or television broadcast, etc.
example: signals transmitted from a satellite
definition_zh: 用于发送电子信号、广播或电视广播等。
example_zh: 来自卫星传输的信号

definition: the quality of something, such as a situation or an argument, that makes it easy to understand
example: a need for greater transparency in legal documents
definition_zh: 某件事的质量，比如情境或论点，使其易于理解
example_zh: 法律文件需要更大透明度

definition: allowing you to see through it
example: The insect's wings are almost transparent.
definition_zh: 让你能够透过它看穿它
example_zh: 这种昆虫的翅膀几乎透明。

definition: a system for carrying people or goods from one place to another using vehicles, roads, etc.
example: air/freight/road transport
definition_zh: 一种利用车辆、道路等将人员或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的系统。
example_zh: 航空/货运/公路运输

definition: to take something/somebody from one place to another in a vehicle
example: to transport goods/passengers
definition_zh: 用车辆把某样东西/某人从一个地方送到另一个地方
example_zh: 用于运输货物/乘客

definition: a system for carrying people or goods from one place to another using vehicles, roads, etc.
example: public transportation (= the system of buses, trains, etc. provided for people to travel from one place to another)
definition_zh: 一种利用车辆、道路等将人员或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的系统。
example_zh: 公共交通（= 为人们从一个地方到另一个地方提供的公交、火车等系统）

definition: a piece of equipment for catching animals
example: a fox with its leg in a trap
definition_zh: 一种用于捕捉动物的设备
example_zh: 一只被困在陷阱里的狐狸

definition: to put somebody in a dangerous place that they cannot get out of
example: be trapped, Help! I'm trapped!
definition_zh: 把某人置于一个无法脱身的危险境地
example_zh: 被困住了，救命！我被困住了！

definition: a mental condition caused by severe shock, stress or fear, especially when the harmful effects last for a long time
example: the effects of trauma and stress on the body
definition_zh: 一种由严重的休克、压力或恐惧引发的精神状况，尤其是当有害影响持续较长时间时
example_zh: 创伤和压力对身体的影响

definition: the act or activity of travelling
example: air/rail/space travel
definition_zh: 旅行的行为或活动
example_zh: 航空/铁路/太空旅行

definition: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance
example: I go to bed early if I'm travelling the next day.
definition_zh: 从一个地方到另一个地方，尤其是长距离旅行
example_zh: 如果第二天要出差，我会早点睡觉。

definition: a person who is travelling or who often travels
example: She is a frequent traveller to Belgium.
definition_zh: 一个正在旅行或经常旅行的人
example_zh: 她经常前往比利时旅行。

definition: a collection of valuable things such as gold, silver and jewellery
example: buried treasure
definition_zh: 收藏了黄金、白银和首饰等贵重物品
example_zh: 埋藏的宝藏

definition: to behave in a particular way towards somebody/something
example: treat somebody/something with something, to treat people with respect
definition_zh: 对某人或某物以特定方式表现
example_zh: 用某种方式对待某人或某物，以尊重对待他人

definition: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make somebody look and feel good
example: The drug is used in the treatment of depression.
definition_zh: 为治愈疾病或受伤，或让某人看起来和感觉良好而进行的治疗
example_zh: 该药物用于治疗抑郁症。

definition: a formal agreement between two or more countries
example: the Treaty of Rome
definition_zh: 两个或多个国家之间的正式协议
example_zh: 《罗马条约》

definition: a tall plant that can live a long time. Trees have a thick central wooden trunk from which branches grow, usually with leaves on them
example: an oak/olive/apple tree
definition_zh: 一种高大且寿命很长的植物。树木中央有一条粗壮的木质树干，枝条通常长出，枝条上通常长着叶子
example_zh: 一棵橡树/橄榄树/苹果树

definition: very great
example: a tremendous explosion
definition_zh: 非常好
example_zh: 一场巨大的爆炸

definition: a general direction in which a situation is changing or developing
example: social/economic/political/demographic trends
definition_zh: 一个大致方向，说明情况正在发生变化或发展
example_zh: 社会/经济/政治/人口趋势

definition: a formal examination of evidence in court by a judge and often a jury, to decide if somebody accused of a crime is guilty or not
example: a murder/criminal trial
definition_zh: 法官以及通常由陪审团在法庭上对证据进行正式审查，以判断被指控犯罪的人是否有罪
example_zh: 谋杀/刑事审判

definition: connected with a tribe or tribes
example: tribal art
definition_zh: 与某个或多个部落相关的
example_zh: 部落艺术

definition: a social group in a traditional society consisting of people with the same language, culture, religion, etc., living in a particular area and often having one leader known as a chief
example: They were a nomadic horse-riding tribe.
definition_zh: 传统社会中的一个社会群体，由拥有相同语言、文化、宗教等信仰的人组成，居住在特定地区，通常有一位领导者被称为酋长
example_zh: 他们是一个游牧骑马部落。

definition: a type of court with the authority to deal with a particular problem or disagreement
example: an international war crimes tribunal
definition_zh: 一种具有处理特定问题或分歧权力的法院类型
example_zh: 国际战争罪行法庭

definition: an act, a statement or a gift that is intended to show your love or respect, especially for a dead person
example: At her funeral her oldest friend paid tribute to her life and work.
definition_zh: 一种行为、一句话或一份礼物，旨在表达你对逝者的爱或尊重，尤其是对死者的尊重
example_zh: 在她的葬礼上，她最老的朋友向她的一生和作品致敬。

definition: something that you do to make somebody believe something that is not true, or to annoy somebody as a joke
example: They had to think of a trick to get past the guards.
definition_zh: 你用来让别人相信不真实的事情，或者开玩笑惹恼别人的事情
example_zh: 他们得想个办法绕过守卫。

definition: to make somebody believe something which is not true, especially in order to cheat them
example: trick somebody, I'd been tricked and I felt stupid.
definition_zh: 让某人相信不真实的事情，尤其是为了欺骗他们
example_zh: 骗了别人，我被骗了，我觉得自己很傻。

definition: the part of a gun that you press in order to fire it
example: to pull/squeeze the trigger
definition_zh: 枪械中你按压以发射的部分
example_zh: 拉动/扣动扳机

definition: to make something happen suddenly
example: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
definition_zh: 让某件事突然发生
example_zh: 坚果可能会引发剧烈的过敏反应。

example: The country's debt reached one trillion dollars.
example_zh: 该国债务达到一万亿美元。

definition: a group of three people or things
example: A trio of English runners featured in the women’s 1 500 metres.
definition_zh: 三个人或三个东西组成的小组
example_zh: 三名英国选手参加了女子1500米比赛。

definition: a journey to a place and back again, especially a short one for pleasure or a particular purpose
example: Did you have a good trip?
definition_zh: 往返一个地方的旅程，尤其是为了娱乐或特定目的的短途旅程
example_zh: 旅途愉快吗？

definition: to catch your foot on something and fall or almost fall
example: She tripped and fell.
definition_zh: 脚被什么东西绊住，跌倒或差点摔倒
example_zh: 她绊倒了，摔倒了。

definition: a great success, achievement or victory
example: one of the greatest triumphs of modern science
definition_zh: 一次巨大的成功、成就或胜利
example_zh: 现代科学的伟大成就之一

definition: soldiers, especially in large groups
example: They announced the withdrawal of 12 000 troops from the area.
definition_zh: 士兵，尤其是大群体
example_zh: 他们宣布将有12,000名士兵从该地区撤出。

definition: an object such as a silver cup that is given as a prize for winning a competition
example: a trophy cabinet
definition_zh: 比如一个作为赢得比赛奖品的银杯这样的物品
example_zh: 一个奖杯柜

definition: coming from, found in or typical of the tropics
example: tropical fish/birds/fruit
definition_zh: 来自、分布于热带或典型的热带地区
example_zh: 热带鱼/鸟类/水果

definition: a problem, worry, difficulty, etc. or a situation causing this
example: We have trouble getting staff.
definition_zh: 是问题、担忧、困难等等，或者某个情境导致这种情况
example_zh: 我们很难找到员工。

definition: to make somebody worried or upset
example: What is it that's troubling you?
definition_zh: 让某人担心或难过
example_zh: 是什么困扰着你？

definition: worried and anxious
example: She looked into his troubled face.
definition_zh: 既担忧又焦虑
example_zh: 她凝视着他那张忧虑的脸。

definition: a piece of clothing that covers the lower body and is divided into two parts to cover each leg separately
example: a pair of grey trousers
definition_zh: 一件覆盖下半身的衣服，分为两部分，分别覆盖每条腿
example_zh: 一条灰色长裤

definition: a large vehicle for carrying heavy loads by road
example: a truck driver
definition_zh: 一种用于公路运输重载的大型车辆
example_zh: 一名卡车司机

definition: connected with facts rather than things that have been invented or guessed
example: Indicate whether the following statements are true or false.
definition_zh: 与事实相连，而非凭空捏造或猜测的事物
example_zh: 请指示以下语句是真还是假。

definition: used to emphasize that a particular statement, feeling, etc. is sincere or real
example: She truly believes that none of this is her fault.
definition_zh: 用于强调某一特定陈述、感受等是真诚或真实的
example_zh: 她真心相信这一切都不是她的错。

definition: the belief that somebody/something is good, sincere, honest, etc. and will not try to harm or trick you
example: Our partnership is based on trust.
definition_zh: 相信某人或某物是善良、真诚、诚实的，不会试图伤害或欺骗你
example_zh: 我们的合作建立在信任之上。

definition: to have confidence in somebody; to believe that somebody is good, sincere, honest, etc.
example: trust somebody, She trusts Alan implicitly.
definition_zh: 对某人有信心;相信某人是善良、真诚、诚实的，等等。
example_zh: 信任别人，她对艾伦信任得无比。

definition: a person or an organization that has control of money or property that has been put into a trust for somebody
example: The bank will act as trustees for the estate until the child is 18.
definition_zh: 一个对已为某人设立信托的资金或财产拥有控制权的人或组织
example_zh: 银行将作为遗产的受托人，直到孩子满18岁。

definition: the true facts about something, rather than the things that have been invented or guessed
example: Do you think she's telling the truth?
definition_zh: 关于某件事的真实事实，而不是那些被发明或猜测出来的事情
example_zh: 你觉得她说的是实话吗？

definition: an act of trying to do something
example: I doubt they'll be able to help but it's worth a try (= worth asking them).
definition_zh: 一种试图做点什么的行为
example_zh: 我怀疑他们能帮不上忙，但值得一试（= 值得问问他们）。

definition: to make an attempt or effort to do or get something
example: I don't know if I can come but I'll try.
definition_zh: 尝试或努力去做或得到某件事
example_zh: 我不知道我能不能去，但我会试试。

definition: an extremely large wave in the sea caused, for example, by an earthquake
example: A tsunami early warning system was set up in Hawaii.
definition_zh: 例如，由地震引发的海中极其巨大的海浪
example_zh: 夏威夷建立了海啸预警系统。

definition: a long, hollow pipe made of metal, plastic, rubber, etc., through which liquids or gases move from one place to another
example: He had to be fed through a feeding tube for several months.
definition_zh: 一根由金属、塑料、橡胶等材质制成的长空管，液体或气体通过它从一个地方流动到另一个地方
example_zh: 他不得不通过喂食管喂养好几个月。

definition: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday
example: It's Tuesday today, isn't it?
definition_zh: 星期一之后、星期三之前的星期一天
example_zh: 今天是星期二，对吧？

definition: the act of teaching something, especially to one person or to people in small groups
example: She received private tuition in French.
definition_zh: 教某件事的行为，尤其是教一个人或小组中的人
example_zh: 她接受了法语私人辅导。

definition: a series of musical notes that are sung or played in a particular order to form a piece of music
example: to sing/whistle a tune
definition_zh: 一系列按特定顺序唱或演奏的音符，构成一首音乐作品
example_zh: 唱/吹口哨

definition: a passage built underground, for example to allow a road or railway to go through a hill, under a river, etc.
example: a railway/railroad tunnel
definition_zh: 例如，地下建造的通道，例如让道路或铁路穿过山丘、河流下方等。
example_zh: 一条铁路/铁路隧道

definition: the time when somebody in a group of people should or is allowed to do something
example: When it's your turn, take another card.
definition_zh: 一个群体中的某人应该或被允许做某件事的时间
example_zh: 轮到你时，再抽一张牌。

definition: to move or make something move around a central point
example: The wheels of the car began to turn.
definition_zh: 移动或让物体绕中心点移动
example_zh: 车轮开始转动。

definition: the number of people who attend a particular event
example: This year's festival attracted a record turnout.
definition_zh: 参加某一特定活动的人数
example_zh: 今年的电影节吸引了创纪录的观众人数。

definition: the total amount of goods or services sold by a company during a particular period of time
example: an annual turnover of $75 million
definition_zh: 公司在特定时期内销售的商品或服务总量
example_zh: 年营业额为7500万美元

definition: television
example: We spent the evening watching TV.
definition_zh: 电视
example_zh: 我们整个晚上都在看电视。

example: There are only twelve of these rare animals left.
example_zh: 如今只剩下十二种这种稀有动物。

definition: the number 20
example: There are twenty students in the classroom.
definition_zh: 数字20
example_zh: 教室里有二十名学生。

definition: two times; on two occasions
example: I don't know him well; I've only met him twice.
definition_zh: 两次;两次
example_zh: 我不太了解他;我只见过他两次。

definition: used to describe one of a pair of children who are twins
example: a twin brother/sister
definition_zh: 用来形容一对双胞胎孩子中的一个
example_zh: 一对双胞胎兄妹

definition: one of two children born at the same time to the same mother
example: She's expecting twins.
definition_zh: 同一个母亲同时出生的两个孩子之一
example_zh: 她怀的是双胞胎。

definition: the action of turning something with your hand, or of turning a part of your body
example: She gave the lid another twist and it came off.
definition_zh: 用手转动某样东西，或者转动身体某部分的动作
example_zh: 她又拧了转盖子，盖子就脱了。

definition: to bend or turn something into a particular shape
example: Twist the wire to form a circle.
definition_zh: 将某物弯曲或变形成特定形状
example_zh: 把铁丝扭成一个圆。

example: There are only two cookies left.
example_zh: 只剩两块饼干了。

definition: a class or group of people or things that share particular qualities or features and are part of a larger group; a kind or sort
example: a rare blood type
definition_zh: 一个群体或群体，这些人或事物具有特定特质或特征，属于一个更大的群体;一种类型或类型
example_zh: 一种罕见的血型

definition: to write something using a computer keyboard or typewriter
example: How fast can you type?
definition_zh: 使用计算机键盘或打字机写东西
example_zh: 你打字最快有多快？

definition: having the usual qualities or features of a particular type of person, thing or group
example: a typical Italian cafe
definition_zh: 具备某类人、事物或群体的常见特质或特征
example_zh: 一家典型的意大利咖啡馆

definition: used to say that something usually happens in the way that you are stating
example: The standard chips are typically used for databases and other business software.
definition_zh: 以前常说，事情通常会以你说的方式发生
example_zh: 标准芯片通常用于数据库和其他商业软件。

definition: a thick rubber ring that fits around the edge of a wheel of a car, bicycle, etc.
example: a front/rear tyre
definition_zh: 一个厚橡胶圈，可以套在汽车、自行车等车轮的边缘。
example_zh: 前后轮胎

definition: unpleasant to look at
example: an ugly face
definition_zh: 看起来不好看
example_zh: 一张丑陋的脸

definition: happening at the end of a long process
example: our ultimate goal/aim/objective/target
definition_zh: 在漫长过程的终点发生
example_zh: 我们的最终目标/目标/目标/目标

definition: in the end; finally
example: A poor diet will ultimately lead to illness.
definition_zh: 最终;终于
example_zh: 不良饮食最终会导致疾病。

definition: an object with a round folding frame of long, straight pieces of metal covered with material, that you use to protect yourself from the rain or from hot sun
example: to carry/hold an umbrella
definition_zh: 一个带有圆形折叠框架的物体，框架由长而直的金属片组成，外覆材料，用来保护自己免受雨水或烈日曝晒
example_zh: 携带/持伞

definition: not having the skill, strength, time, knowledge, etc. to do something
example: a former soldier who has been unable to find work since the war ended
definition_zh: 没有足够的技能、力量、时间、知识等去做某件事
example_zh: 一位自战争结束后一直找不到工作的前士兵

definition: so bad that you think it should not be allowed
example: Such behaviour is totally unacceptable in a civilized society.
definition_zh: 糟糕到你觉得不该允许
example_zh: 在一个文明社会中，这种行为是完全不可接受的。

definition: the state of being uncertain
example: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.
definition_zh: 不确定的状态
example_zh: 关于公司的未来存在相当大的不确定性。

definition: the brother of your mother or father; the husband of your aunt or uncle
example: Uncle Ian
definition_zh: 你母亲或父亲的兄弟;你姑姑或叔叔的丈夫
example_zh: 伊恩叔叔

definition: not letting you feel physically comfortable; unpleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
example: uncomfortable shoes
definition_zh: 不让你感到身体舒适;穿着、坐起来都不舒服等等。
example_zh: 不舒服的鞋子

definition: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness, and not able to use your senses
example: They found him lying unconscious on the floor.
definition_zh: 处于类似睡眠状态，因为受伤或生病，无法使用感官
example_zh: 他们发现他昏迷倒在地上。

definition: below something
example: He pulled up the covers and crawled under.
definition_zh: 在某物下方
example_zh: 他拉起被子，钻进去。

definition: in, to or through a position that is below something
example: Have you looked under the bed?
definition_zh: 在某个位于某物之下的位置内、进入或通过
example_zh: 你找过床底下吗？

definition: to experience something, especially a change or something unpleasant
example: to undergo tests/trials/repairs
definition_zh: 体验某种东西，尤其是变化或不愉快的感受
example_zh: 接受测试/试验/维修

definition: a university or college student who is studying for their first degree
example: a first-year undergraduate
definition_zh: 正在攻读第一个学位的大学生或学院学生
example_zh: 一名一年级本科生

definition: under the surface of the ground
example: an underground bunker/tunnel
definition_zh: 地下
example_zh: 地下掩体/隧道

definition: under the surface of the ground
example: Rescuers found victims trapped several feet underground.
definition_zh: 地下
example_zh: 救援人员发现受害者被困在地下数英尺深处。

definition: important in a situation but not always easily noticed or stated clearly
example: The underlying assumption is that the amount of money available is limited.
definition_zh: 在某种情境中很重要，但并不总是容易被注意到或清晰表达
example_zh: 基本假设是可用的资金是有限的。

definition: to make something, especially somebody’s confidence or authority, gradually weaker or less effective
example: Our confidence in the team has been seriously undermined by their recent defeats.
definition_zh: 让某样东西，尤其是某人的自信或权威，逐渐变得脆弱或无效
example_zh: 他们最近的失利严重削弱了我们对球队的信心。

definition: to know or realize the meaning of words, a language, what somebody says, etc.
example: understand (something), Can you understand French?
definition_zh: 要知道或理解单词、语言、别人说了什么的含义等等。
example_zh: 懂点什么？你能听懂法语吗？

definition: the knowledge that somebody has about a particular subject or situation
example: Students will gain a broad understanding of the workings of Parliament.
definition_zh: 某人对某个特定主题或情境的了解
example_zh: 学生将广泛了解议会的运作方式。

definition: to make yourself responsible for something and start doing it
example: to undertake a task/project
definition_zh: 让自己对某件事负责并开始去做
example_zh: 执行任务/项目

definition: clothes that you wear under other clothes and next to the skin
example: I never wear underwear.
definition_zh: 你穿在其他衣服下面、贴着皮肤的衣服
example_zh: 我从不穿内裤。

definition: used to emphasize that something exists or is definitely true
example: There is undoubtedly a great deal of truth in what he says.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事确实存在或绝对真实
example_zh: 他说的话无疑有很大的真实性。

definition: without a job although able to work
example: How long have you been unemployed?
definition_zh: 虽然没有工作，但仍然能工作
example_zh: 你失业多久了？

definition: the fact of a number of people not having a job; the number of people without a job
example: an area of high/low unemployment
definition_zh: 有若干人没有工作;还有失业人数
example_zh: 高/低失业率地区

definition: if something is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it
example: Things took an unexpected turn.
definition_zh: 如果某件事出乎意料，那会让你感到惊讶，因为你原本没预料到。
example_zh: 事情出现了意想不到的转折。

definition: not right or fair according to a set of rules or principles; not treating people equally
example: They had been given an unfair advantage.
definition_zh: 不符合一套规则或原则的正确或公平;不平等对待人
example_zh: 他们被赋予了不公平的优势。

definition: to spread open or flat something that has previously been folded; to become open and flat
example: to unfold a map
definition_zh: 将先前折叠过的物体展开或摊平;使之展开且平整
example_zh: 展开地图

definition: having bad luck; caused by bad luck
example: He was unfortunate to lose in the final round.
definition_zh: 运气不好;由坏运气引起的
example_zh: 他在决赛轮中不幸落败。

definition: used to say that a particular situation or fact makes you sad or disappointed, or gets you into a difficult position
example: Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend the meeting.
definition_zh: 过去说的是一种特定情况或事实让你感到难过、失望，或者让你陷入困境
example_zh: 很遗憾，我无法参加这次会议。

definition: not happy; sad
example: to feel/look/seem/sound/become unhappy
definition_zh: 不开心;悲伤
example_zh: 感受/看上去/听起来/变得不快乐

definition: the special set of clothes worn by all members of an organization or a group at work, or by children at school
example: The hat is part of the school uniform.
definition_zh: 组织或团体所有成员在工作中穿的特殊服装，或学校里的儿童穿着的服装
example_zh: 帽子是校服的一部分。

definition: to join people, things, parts of a country, etc. together so that they form a single unit
example: The new leader hopes to unify the country.
definition_zh: 将人、事物、国家的部分等连接在一起，形成一个整体
example_zh: 新领导人希望实现国家统一。

definition: an organization of workers, usually in a particular industry, that exists to protect their interests, improve conditions of work, etc.
example: I've joined the union.
definition_zh: 一种通常属于特定行业的工人组织，旨在保护工人利益、改善工作条件等。
example_zh: 我加入了工会。

definition: being the only one of its kind
example: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.
definition_zh: 它是独一无二的
example_zh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

definition: a single thing, person or group that is complete by itself but can also form part of something larger
example: After 1946 the British Government treated the four territorial divisions as a single unit.
definition_zh: 一个整体、一个人或一个群体，它们本身就完整，但也可以成为更大事物的一部分
example_zh: 1946年后，英国政府将四个领土行政区视为一个整体。

definition: to join together with other people in order to do something as a group
example: Nationalist parties united to oppose the government's plans.
definition_zh: 与其他人联合起来，作为一个团队去做某件事
example_zh: 民族主义政党联合起来反对政府的计划。

definition: joined together as a political unit or by shared aims
example: the United States of America
definition_zh: 作为一个政治单位或因共同目标而联合起来
example_zh: 美利坚合众国

definition: the state of being in agreement and working together; the state of being joined together to form one unit
example: European unity
definition_zh: 达成一致并共同工作的状态;合而为一的状态，形成一个整体
example_zh: 欧洲团结

definition: done by or involving all the people in the world or in a particular group
example: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.
definition_zh: 由全世界所有人或某个特定群体共同完成或参与其中
example_zh: 这些问题是老年普遍现象。

definition: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars
example: in the universe, Could there be intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?
definition_zh: 整个空间以及其中的一切，包括地球、行星和恒星
example_zh: 宇宙中，宇宙中可能存在智慧生命吗？

definition: an institution at the highest level of education where you can study for a degree or do research
example: Is there a university in this town?
definition_zh: 一所处于最高教育水平的机构，你可以在那里攻读学位或从事科研
example_zh: 这镇上有大学吗？

definition: not known or identified
example: A previously unknown group claimed responsibility for the bombing.
definition_zh: 未知或未确认身份
example_zh: 一个此前未知的团体声称对爆炸负责。

definition: used to say that something can only happen or be true in a particular situation
example: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.
definition_zh: 过去常说某件事只能在特定情境下发生或成立
example_zh: 除非你有医生证明，否则你不会拿到工资。

definition: different from a particular person or thing
example: Music is quite unlike any other art form.
definition_zh: 与某个特定的人或事物不同
example_zh: 音乐与其他任何艺术形式都截然不同。

definition: not likely to happen; not probable
example: unlikely to do something, The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
definition_zh: 不太可能发生;不太可能
example_zh: 不太可能有所作为，这个项目似乎不太可能成功。

definition: not needed; more than is needed
example: They were found guilty of causing unnecessary suffering to animals.
definition_zh: 不需要;超出所需
example_zh: 他们被判定对动物造成不必要的痛苦。

definition: not pleasant or comfortable
example: an unpleasant experience/surprise/task
definition_zh: 既不愉快也不舒服
example_zh: 一次不愉快的经历/惊喜/任务

definition: that has never happened, been done or been known before
example: The situation is unprecedented in modern times.
definition_zh: 这从未发生过，也从未被做过，也从未被知晓
example_zh: 这种情况在现代史无前例。

definition: up to the point in time or the event mentioned
example: Let's wait until the rain stops.
definition_zh: 直到所提及的时间点或事件
example_zh: 等雨停了再说吧。

definition: up to the point in time or the event mentioned
example: Let's wait until the rain stops.
definition_zh: 直到所提及的时间点或事件
example_zh: 等雨停了再说吧。

definition: different from what is usual or normal
example: The case is highly unusual.
definition_zh: 与正常或正常不同
example_zh: 此案极为罕见。

definition: to remove a cover or curtain from a painting, statue, etc. so that it can be seen in public for the first time
example: The Queen unveiled a plaque to mark the official opening of the hospital.
definition_zh: 拆除画作、雕像等的覆盖物或帷幕，使其首次在公众面前可见
example_zh: 女王为医院的正式开业揭幕了一块纪念牌匾。

definition: towards or in a higher position
example: He jumped up from his chair.
definition_zh: 朝向或处于更高的位置
example_zh: 他从椅子上跳了起来。

definition: to or in a higher position somewhere
example: She climbed up the flight of steps.
definition_zh: 去或在某个更高的位置
example_zh: 她爬上了那段楼梯。

definition: going to happen soon
example: the upcoming presidential election
definition_zh: 很快就会发生
example_zh: 即将到来的总统选举

definition: a report or broadcast that gives the most recent information about something; a new version of something containing the most recent information
example: They will send you regular updates by email.
definition_zh: 一份报告或广播，提供关于某事的最新信息;包含最新信息的某个内容的新版本;
example_zh: 他们会通过电子邮件定期向你发送更新。

definition: to make something more modern by adding new parts, etc.
example: an updated version of the app
definition_zh: 通过添加新零件等，让东西更现代化。
example_zh: 应用的更新版本

definition: the act of making a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; the more powerful and efficient machine, computer system, etc.
example: instructions for installing an upgrade to the existing system
definition_zh: 使机器、计算机系统等变得更强大、更高效的行为;更强大、更高效的机器、计算机系统等。
example_zh: 为现有系统安装升级的说明

definition: to make a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; to start using a new and better version of a machine, system, etc.
example: upgrade something, We are constantly upgrading our software to meet customers' needs.
definition_zh: 让机器、计算机系统等更强大、更高效;开始使用机器、系统等的新型、更好的版本。
example_zh: 升级某些东西，我们不断升级软件以满足客户需求。

definition: to support something that you think is right and make sure that it continues to exist
example: We have a duty to uphold the law.
definition_zh: 支持你认为正确的事物，并确保它继续存在
example_zh: 我们有责任维护法律。

definition: on or onto something; used especially in formal language
example: Once upon a time, there lived a king.
definition_zh: 在某物上或在某物上;尤其在正式语言中使用
example_zh: 很久很久以前，有一位国王。

definition: located above something else, especially something of the same type or the other of a pair
example: her upper lip
definition_zh: 位于其他物体之上，尤其是同类型或一对之中的另一处
example_zh: 她的上唇

definition: unhappy or disappointed because of something unpleasant that has happened
example: I understand how upset you must be feeling.
definition_zh: 因为发生了不愉快的事情而感到不快乐或失望
example_zh: 我理解你一定有多难过。

definition: to make somebody/yourself feel unhappy, anxious or annoyed
example: upset somebody/yourself, This decision is likely to upset a lot of people.
definition_zh: 让某人/你自己感到不开心、焦虑或恼火
example_zh: 让别人/自己不高兴，这个决定很可能会让很多人不高兴。

definition: on a floor of a house or other building that is higher than the one that you are on
example: an upstairs room/window/bathroom
definition_zh: 在房屋或其他建筑物的某层，该楼层比你所在的楼层更高
example_zh: 楼上的房间/窗户/浴室

definition: up the stairs; on or to a floor of a house or other building higher than the one that you are on
example: to run/walk/head upstairs
definition_zh: 上楼梯;在房屋或其他建筑的楼层上或楼层，比你所在楼层更高
example_zh: 跑步/走路/上楼

definition: towards a higher place or position
example: Place your hands on the table with the palms facing upwards.
definition_zh: 朝着更高的地方或位置
example_zh: 把双手放在桌上，掌心朝上。

definition: connected with a town or city
example: urban and rural communities
definition_zh: 与城镇或城市相关联
example_zh: 城市与农村社区

definition: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something
example: urge somebody to do something, If you ever get the chance to visit this place, I strongly urge you to do so.
definition_zh: 建议或努力说服某人去做某件事
example_zh: 催促某人做点什么，如果你有机会来这里，我强烈建议你一定要去。

definition: that needs to be dealt with or happen immediately
example: The police have issued an urgent appeal for information.
definition_zh: 这需要立即处理或立即处理
example_zh: 警方已发出紧急呼吁，要求提供信息。

definition: used when the speaker or writer and another or others are the object of a verb or preposition, or after the verb be
example: She gave us a picture as a wedding present.
definition_zh: 当说话者或作者与他人或他人是动词或介词的宾语，或在动词 be 之后时使用。
example_zh: 她送了我们一张照片作为结婚礼物。

definition: the way in which words are used in a language
example: a book on current English usage
definition_zh: 语言中词语的使用方式
example_zh: 一本关于当前英语用法的书

definition: the act of using something; the state of being used
example: A ban was imposed on the use of chemical weapons.
definition_zh: 使用某物的行为;被使用状态
example_zh: 对化学武器的使用实施了禁令。

definition: to do something with a machine, a method, an object, etc. for a particular purpose
example: use something, Can I use the photocopier?
definition_zh: 为了特定目的，使用机器、方法、物体等进行某件事
example_zh: 用点什么，我能用复印机吗？

definition: familiar with something because you do it or experience it often
example: used to doing something, I'm not used to eating so much at lunchtime.
definition_zh: 熟悉某件事，因为你经常做或亲身经历它
example_zh: 习惯做点什么，但不习惯午饭吃这么多。

definition: used to say that something happened continuously or frequently during a period in the past
example: I used to live in London.
definition_zh: 过去的话常说，过去某个时期里某件事是持续或频繁发生的
example_zh: 我以前住在伦敦。

definition: that can help you to do or achieve what you want
example: a useful tool
definition_zh: 这能帮助你实现或实现你想要的事
example_zh: 一个有用的工具

definition: not useful; not doing or achieving what is needed or wanted
example: This pen is useless.
definition_zh: 没有用处;没有做或完成所需或想要的事
example_zh: 这支笔没用。

definition: a person or thing that uses something
example: road users
definition_zh: 使用某物的人或物
example_zh: 道路使用者

definition: that happens or is done most of the time or in most cases
example: This is the usual way of doing it.
definition_zh: 这种情况大多数情况下都会发生或被执行
example_zh: 这是通常的做法。

definition: in the way that is usual or normal; most often
example: How long does the journey usually take?
definition_zh: 以通常或正常的方式;最常见的是
example_zh: 这段旅程通常需要多长时间？

definition: a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply
example: a privatized electricity utility
definition_zh: 为公众提供的服务，例如电力、水或燃气供应
example_zh: 一家私有化的电力公用事业

definition: to use something, especially for a practical purpose
example: The Romans were the first to utilize concrete as a building material.
definition_zh: 用点东西，尤其是出于实际目的
example_zh: 罗马人是最早使用混凝土作为建筑材料的人。

definition: completely
example: We're so utterly different from each other.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 我们彼此完全不同。

definition: a period of time spent travelling or resting away from home
example: on vacation, They're on vacation in Hawaii right now.
definition_zh: 一段在远离家乡旅行或休息的时光
example_zh: 他们正在度假，现在正在夏威夷度假。

definition: a space that is completely empty of all substances, including all air or other gas
example: a vacuum pump (= one that creates a vacuum)
definition_zh: 一个完全空无一物的空间，包括所有空气或其他气体
example_zh: 真空泵（= 产生真空的泵）

definition: not clear in a person’s mind
example: to have a vague impression/memory/recollection of something
definition_zh: 在一个人心里并不清晰
example_zh: 对某件事有模糊的印象/记忆/回忆

definition: that is legally or officially acceptable
example: Do you have a valid passport?
definition_zh: 这是法律或官方上可以接受的
example_zh: 你有有效护照吗？

definition: the state of being legally or officially acceptable
example: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.
definition_zh: 法律或官方可接受的状态
example_zh: 协议的有效期已届满。

definition: an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; the land that a river flows through
example: in a valley, In the valley below cows were grazing peacefully.
definition_zh: 丘陵或山脉之间的低洼地带，通常有河流穿过;河流流经的土地
example_zh: 在山谷里，下面的山谷里，牛群安静地吃草。

definition: worth a lot of money
example: My home is my most valuable asset.
definition_zh: 价值不菲
example_zh: 我的家是我最宝贵的资产。

definition: how much something is worth in money or other goods for which it can be exchanged
example: to go up/rise/increase in value
definition_zh: 某物以金钱或其他商品的价格价值，可以兑换
example_zh: 价值的上升/上升/提升

definition: to think that somebody/something is important
example: value somebody/something, He has come to value her advice and support.
definition_zh: 认为某人/某物很重要
example_zh: 珍视某人/某物，他已经开始珍视她的建议和支持。

definition: a covered vehicle with no side windows in its back half, usually smaller than a lorry, used for carrying goods or people
example: the driver of a white van
definition_zh: 一种后半部没有侧窗的有盖车辆，通常比卡车小，用于运载货物或人员
example_zh: 白色面包车的司机

definition: to disappear suddenly and/or in a way that you cannot explain
example: He turned around and vanished into the house.
definition_zh: 突然消失，或者以一种你无法解释的方式消失
example_zh: 他转身消失在屋里。

definition: often changing; likely to change
example: variable temperatures
definition_zh: 经常变化;很可能改变
example_zh: 可变温度

definition: a situation, number or quantity that can vary or be varied
example: With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.
definition_zh: 一种可能变化或可变化的情形、数量或数量
example_zh: 由于变量众多，计算成本变得困难。

definition: a change, especially in the amount or level of something
example: The dial records very slight variations in pressure.
definition_zh: 变化，尤其是在某件事的数量或程度上
example_zh: 表盘记录的压力变化非常细微。

definition: of many different types
example: varied opinions
definition_zh: 多种类型
example_zh: 各种不同意见

definition: several different sorts of the same thing
example: There is a wide variety of patterns to choose from.
definition_zh: 同一种东西的几种不同类型
example_zh: 有种类繁多的图案可供选择。

definition: several different
example: various types/forms/kinds of somebody/something
definition_zh: 多种不同
example_zh: 各种类型/形态/某人/某物的类型

definition: to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.
example: New techniques were introduced with varying degrees of success.
definition_zh: 它们在大小、形状等方面都有所不同。
example_zh: 新技术被引入，成效不一。

definition: extremely large in area, size, amount, etc.
example: a vast area of forest
definition_zh: 在面积、大小、数量等方面都极其庞大。
example_zh: 一片广袤的森林

definition: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food. Potatoes, beans and onions are all vegetables.
example: The children don't eat enough fresh vegetables.
definition_zh: 一种植物或植物的一部分，作为食物食用。土豆、豆类和洋葱都是蔬菜。
example_zh: 孩子们吃得不够新鲜蔬菜。

definition: a thing that is used for transporting people or goods from one place to another, such as a car or lorry
example: motor vehicles (= cars, buses, lorries, etc.)
definition_zh: 一种用于将人或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的东西，比如汽车或卡车
example_zh: 机动车辆（= 汽车、公交车、卡车等）

definition: any of the tubes that carry blood from all parts of the body towards the heart
example: the jugular vein
definition_zh: 任何将血液从身体各个部位输送到心脏的管道
example_zh: 颈静脉

definition: a business project or activity, especially one that involves taking risks
example: A disastrous business venture lost him thousands of dollars.
definition_zh: 一个商业项目或活动，尤其是涉及冒险的项目
example_zh: 一次灾难性的商业冒险让他损失了数千美元。

definition: to go somewhere even though you know that it might be dangerous or unpleasant
example: They ventured nervously into the water.
definition_zh: 即使知道可能危险或不愉快，仍要去某个地方
example_zh: 他们紧张地走进水中。

definition: a place where people meet for an organized event, for example a concert, sporting event or conference
example: The band will be playing at 20 different venues on their UK tour.
definition_zh: 人们为组织活动（例如音乐会、体育赛事或会议）聚在一起的地方
example_zh: 乐队将在英国巡演期间于20个不同的场地演出。

definition: relating to words
example: The job applicant must have good verbal skills.
definition_zh: 与词语相关的
example_zh: 求职者必须具备良好的口语能力。

definition: an official judgement made in court or at an inquest (= an official investigation into somebody's death)
example: Has the jury reached a verdict?
definition_zh: 在法庭或验尸聆讯中作出的正式判决（=对某人死亡的官方调查）
example_zh: 陪审团已经达成裁决了吗？

definition: to check that something is true or accurate
example: verify something, We have no way of verifying his story.
definition_zh: 核查某件事是否真实或准确
example_zh: 核实点什么，我们没法验证他的说法。

definition: writing that is arranged in lines, often with a regular rhythm or pattern of rhyme
example: in verse, Most of the play is written in verse, but some of it is in prose.
definition_zh: 文字按行排列，通常带有规律的节奏或押韵模式
example_zh: 以诗体形式，剧本大部分以诗体形式写成，但部分为散文。

definition: a form of something that is slightly different from an earlier form or from other forms of the same thing
example: version of something, the latest version of the software package
definition_zh: 一种与早期形式或同类事物其他形式略有不同的形式
example_zh: 某物的版本，软件包的最新版本

definition: used to show that two teams or sides are against each other
example: It is France versus Brazil in the final.
definition_zh: 用于表示两支队伍或双方彼此对阵
example_zh: 决赛是法国对阵巴西。

definition: going straight up or down from a level surface or from top to bottom in a picture, etc.
example: the vertical axis of the graph
definition_zh: 比如从平面直上或直下，或者在图片中从上到下，等等。
example_zh: 图的垂直轴

definition: used to emphasize that you are talking about a particular thing or person and not about another
example: He might be phoning her at this very moment.
definition_zh: 用来强调你谈论的是某个特定的事情或人物，而不是另一个
example_zh: 他可能此刻正给她打电话。

definition: used before adjectives, adverbs and determiners to mean ‘in a high degree’ or ‘extremely’
example: Very few people know that.
definition_zh: 用于置于形容词、副词和限定词之前，表示“在高度程度上”或“极度”的意思
example_zh: 很少有人知道这一点。

definition: a tube that carries blood through the body of a person or an animal, or liquid through the parts of a plant
example: to burst/rupture a blood vessel
definition_zh: 一种将血液输送到人体或动物体内，或液体通过植物各部位的管道
example_zh: 导致血管破裂/破裂

definition: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular area or activity
example: the veteran American actor, Clint Eastwood
definition_zh: 一个在某个特定领域或活动中有丰富经验的人
example_zh: 资深美国演员克林特·伊斯特伍德

definition: through a place
example: We flew home via Dubai.
definition_zh: 穿过一个地方
example_zh: 我们经迪拜飞回家。

definition: that can be done; that will be successful
example: a viable option/proposition
definition_zh: 这是可以做到的;这将取得成功
example_zh: 一个可行的选项/提案

definition: full of life and energy
example: a vibrant city
definition_zh: 充满生命力和活力
example_zh: 一座充满活力的城市

definition: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs
example: At the door were two plain-clothes detectives from the vice squad.
definition_zh: 涉及性或毒品的犯罪活动
example_zh: 门口站着两名便衣侦探，来自风化组。

definition: violent and cruel
example: a vicious attack
definition_zh: 暴力而残忍
example_zh: 一场凶猛的攻击

definition: a person who has been attacked, injured or killed as the result of a crime, a disease, an accident, etc.
example: shooting/murder victims
definition_zh: 指因犯罪、疾病、事故等原因遭受袭击、受伤或死亡的人。
example_zh: 枪击/谋杀受害者

definition: success in a game, an election, a war, etc.
example: to win a narrow victory
definition_zh: 在游戏、选举、战争等中取得成功。
example_zh: 以微弱优势赢得胜利

definition: a system of recording moving pictures and sound, either using a digital method of storing data or (in the past) using videotape
example: A wedding is the perfect subject for video.
definition_zh: 一种记录动态影像和声音的系统，可以采用数字存储方式，或（过去）使用录像带
example_zh: 婚礼是视频的绝佳题材。

definition: what you can see from a particular place or position, especially beautiful countryside
example: view of something, There were magnificent views of the surrounding countryside.
definition_zh: 你从某个特定地点或位置看到的景象，尤其是美丽的乡村景色
example_zh: 某处景象，周围乡村景色壮丽。

definition: to think about somebody/something in a particular way
example: view somebody/something + adv./prep., How do you view your position within the company?
definition_zh: 以特定方式思考某人或某物
example_zh: 查看某人/某物 + 副词/介词，您如何看待自己在公司的职位？

definition: a person watching television or a video on the internet
example: The programme attracted millions of viewers.
definition_zh: 一个人正在看电视或在互联网上观看视频
example_zh: 该节目吸引了数百万观众。

definition: a way of thinking about a subject
example: from a… viewpoint, Try looking at things from a different viewpoint.
definition_zh: 一种思考主题的方式
example_zh: 从一个......视角，试着换个角度看问题。

definition: a very small town located in a country area
example: We visited towns and villages all over Spain.
definition_zh: 一个位于乡村地区的非常小镇
example_zh: 我们走访了西班牙各地的城镇和村庄。

definition: a person who lives in a village
example: Some of the villagers have lived here all their lives.
definition_zh: 一个住在村庄里的人
example_zh: 有些村民一生都住在这里。

definition: to go against or refuse to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: to violate international law
definition_zh: 违背或拒绝遵守法律、协议等。
example_zh: 违反国际法

definition: the act of going against or refusing to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: They were in open violation of the treaty.
definition_zh: 违抗或拒绝遵守法律、协议等行为。
example_zh: 他们公然违反了条约。

definition: violent behaviour that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: Police do not think this killing was a random act of violence.
definition_zh: 旨在伤害或杀害他人的暴力行为
example_zh: 警方认为这起杀人案并非随机暴力行为。

definition: involving or caused by physical force that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: violent crime/criminals
definition_zh: 涉及或由意图伤害或杀害他人的身体力量引起的
example_zh: 暴力犯罪/罪犯

definition: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the internet
example: a system to help programmers create virtual environments
definition_zh: 通过使用计算机软件，例如在互联网上，假装存在
example_zh: 一个帮助程序员创建虚拟环境的系统

definition: behaviour or attitudes that show high moral standards
example: He led a life of virtue.
definition_zh: 表现出高道德标准的行为或态度
example_zh: 他过着美德高尚的生活。

definition: a living thing, too small to be seen without a microscope, that causes disease in people, animals and plants
example: the flu/influenza virus
definition_zh: 一种生命体，体型太小，不借助显微镜无法看见，却会引发人类、动物和植物的疾病
example_zh: 流感/流感病毒

definition: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country
example: to apply for a visa
definition_zh: 由外国官员在护照上盖印或标记，允许你进入、通过或离开该国
example_zh: 申请签证

definition: that can be seen
example: The house is clearly visible from the beach.
definition_zh: 这一点可以看出来
example_zh: 从海滩上可以清楚地看到这座房子。

definition: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position
example: to have good/perfect/poor/blurred/normal vision
definition_zh: 能够看到;你从某个特定位置能看到的区域
example_zh: 拥有良好/完美/差/模糊/正常视力

definition: an occasion or a period of time when somebody goes to see a place or person and spends time there
example: a two-day/three-day visit
definition_zh: 某个事件或一段时间，某人去看某个地方或某个人，并在那里度过时光
example_zh: 为期两天/三天的访问

definition: to go to see a person or a place for a period of time
example: My parents are coming to visit me next week.
definition_zh: 去见一个人或某个地方一段时间
example_zh: 我父母下周要来看我。

definition: a person who visits a person or place
example: We've got visitors coming this weekend.
definition_zh: 访问某人或某地的人
example_zh: 这个周末我们有访客要来。

definition: of or connected with seeing or sight
example: the visual arts
definition_zh: 与视觉或视觉有关或与之相关
example_zh: 视觉艺术

definition: necessary or essential in order for something to succeed or exist
example: vital for somebody/something, the vitamins that are vital for health
definition_zh: 为使某事成功或存在所必需或必要
example_zh: 对某人/某物至关重要，那些对健康至关重要的维生素

definition: a natural substance found in food that is an essential part of what humans and animals need to help them grow and stay healthy. There are many different vitamins.
example: vitamin A/B/D/E
definition_zh: 这是一种存在于食物中的天然物质，是人类和动物帮助它们成长和保持健康所必需的重要组成部分。维生素有很多种。
example_zh: 维生素A/B/D/E

definition: connected with the voice
example: vocal music
definition_zh: 与声音连接
example_zh: 声乐

definition: the sound or sounds produced through the mouth by a person speaking or singing
example: I could hear voices in the next room.
definition_zh: 指一个人说话或唱歌时通过嘴巴发出的声音或声音
example_zh: 我能听到隔壁房间有声音。

definition: the amount of space that an object or a substance fills; the amount of space that a container has
example: volume of something, How do you measure the volume of a gas?
definition_zh: 物体或物质所占满的空间;容器所拥有的空间
example_zh: 某物的体积，你如何测量气体的体积？

definition: done willingly, not because you are forced
example: a voluntary agreement
definition_zh: 这是自愿的，而不是被迫
example_zh: 自愿协议

definition: a person who does a job without being paid for it
example: Schools need volunteers to help children to read.
definition_zh: 一个做工作却不拿报酬的人
example_zh: 学校需要志愿者帮助孩子们学习阅读。

definition: to offer to do something without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it
example: He has been volunteering for 11 years now.
definition_zh: 主动提出做某件事，而不必被迫，也不必领取报酬
example_zh: 他已经做志愿者11年了。

definition: a formal choice that you make in an election or at a meeting in order to choose somebody or decide something
example: to win/lose votes
definition_zh: 你在选举或会议上为选择某人或决定某事而做出的正式决定
example_zh: 赢得或输掉选票

definition: to show formally by marking a paper, raising your hand, using a voting machine, etc. which person you want to win an election, or which plan or idea you support
example: How did you vote at the last election?
definition_zh: 通过在纸上做标记、举手、使用投票机等方式正式表明你希望谁赢得选举，或者你支持哪种方案或理念
example_zh: 你上次选举的投票方式如何？

definition: the action of choosing somebody/something in an election or at a meeting
example: He was eliminated in the first round of voting.
definition_zh: 在选举或会议上选择某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 他在第一轮投票中被淘汰。

definition: to make a formal and serious promise to do something or a formal statement that is true
example: vow to do something, She vowed never to speak to him again.
definition_zh: 作出正式且严肃的承诺，或作出真实的正式声明
example_zh: 发誓要做点什么，她发誓再也不和他说话。

definition: the fact of being weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: the vulnerability of newborn babies to disease
definition_zh: 那种软弱、容易受到身体或情感伤害的事实
example_zh: 新生儿易感性

definition: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: These offices are highly vulnerable to terrorist attack.
definition_zh: 虚弱，容易在身体或情感上受伤
example_zh: 这些办公室极易遭受恐怖袭击。

definition: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week or every month, for work or services
example: wage/wages of something, wages of £300 a week
definition_zh: 你每周或每月为工作或服务而获得的固定收入
example_zh: 工资/某项工资，每周300英镑工资

definition: an act of waiting; an amount of time waited
example: The wait seemed interminable.
definition_zh: 一种等待的行为;等待的时间
example_zh: 等待似乎漫长无尽。

definition: to stay where you are or delay doing something until somebody/something comes or something happens
example: She rang the bell and waited.
definition_zh: 要么待在原地，要么拖延做某件事，直到有人/某物出现或者发生什么事
example_zh: 她按响门铃，静静等待。

definition: a man whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant, etc.
example: I'll ask the waiter for the bill.
definition_zh: 一个工作是在餐厅等座位上服务顾客的人。
example_zh: 我去问服务员结账。

definition: to stop sleeping; to make somebody stop sleeping
example: I always wake early in the summer.
definition_zh: 停止睡眠;让某人停止睡眠
example_zh: 我夏天总是早起。

definition: a journey on foot, usually for pleasure or exercise
example: Let's go for a walk.
definition_zh: 徒步旅行，通常用于娱乐或锻炼
example_zh: 我们去散步吧。

definition: to move or go somewhere by putting one foot in front of the other on the ground, but without running
example: The baby is just learning to walk.
definition_zh: 通过一只脚在地上移动或前往某个地方，但不跑
example_zh: 宝宝才刚学会走路。

definition: a long, solid structure that rises straight up from the ground, made of stone, brick or concrete, that surrounds, divides or protects an area of land
example: to build a wall
definition_zh: 一种从地面直直升起的长而坚固的结构，由石头、砖块或混凝土制成，环绕、分隔或保护一块土地
example_zh: 去修建一堵墙

definition: to walk slowly around or to a place, often without any particular sense of purpose or direction
example: + adv./prep., She wandered aimlessly around the streets.
definition_zh: 慢慢地绕着走，或者走向某个地方，往往没有特别的目的或方向感
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她漫无目的地在街上游荡。

definition: to have a desire or a wish for something/somebody
example: want somebody/something, Do you want some more tea?
definition_zh: 对某事或某人有一种渴望或愿望
example_zh: 想要某个人/什么，你还想再喝点茶吗？

definition: a situation in which two or more countries or groups of people fight against each other over a period of time
example: the Second World War
definition_zh: 一种情形：两个或多个国家或群体在一段时间内相互对抗
example_zh: 第二次世界大战

definition: a separate room or area in a hospital for people with the same type of medical condition
example: a maternity/surgical/psychiatric/children’s ward
definition_zh: 医院内为患有相同病症的患者设立的单独房间或区域
example_zh: 产科/外科/精神科/儿童病房

definition: a building where large quantities of goods are stored, especially before they are sent to shops to be sold
example: Police are investigating a fire at a furniture warehouse.
definition_zh: 一座存放大量货物的建筑，尤其是在货物被送到商店出售之前。
example_zh: 警方正在调查一家家具仓库的火灾。

definition: the activity of fighting a war, especially using particular weapons or methods
example: air/naval/guerrilla warfare
definition_zh: 参与战争的活动，尤其是使用特定武器或方法的行为
example_zh: 空中/海军/游击战

definition: at a fairly high temperature in a way that is pleasant, rather than being hot or cold
example: warm weather/temperatures/air
definition_zh: 以相当高的温度，以一种舒适的方式，而不是冷热的感觉
example_zh: 温暖的天气/温度/空气

definition: to make something/somebody warm or warmer; to become warm or warmer
example: warm something/somebody/yourself, Come in and warm yourself by the fire.
definition_zh: 让某物或某人变得温暖或更温暖;变得更温暖或更温暖
example_zh: 给点什么/某人/你自己暖暖，进来在火炉旁取暖。

definition: the process of making something, or of becoming, warm or warmer
example: atmospheric warming
definition_zh: 让某物变得温暖或变得温暖的过程
example_zh: 大气变暖

definition: to tell somebody about something, especially something dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it
example: warn somebody, I tried to warn him, but he wouldn't listen.
definition_zh: 告诉别人一些事情，尤其是危险或不愉快的事情，以便他们能够避免发生
example_zh: 我试图警告他，但他不听。

definition: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it
example: I had absolutely no warning.
definition_zh: 一句话、一件事件等，告诉某人未来可能会发生一些糟糕或不愉快的事情，以便他们尽量避免
example_zh: 我完全没有任何预警。

definition: a legal document that is signed by a judge and gives the police authority to do something
example: an arrest warrant
definition_zh: 一份由法官签署的法律文件，赋予警方采取行动的权力
example_zh: 逮捕令

definition: to make something necessary or appropriate in a particular situation
